articles.title: All the Guests at Shakira’s Madrid Residency (Updating)
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: Since Shakira kicked off her residency in Madrid, each new date has brought the anticipation of discovering who might join her on stage. The 12-concert series began on Sept. 18 and runs through Oct. 11 as part of the Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour.
paras.zh: 自从夏奇拉在马德里开始她的驻地演出以来，每一次新的约会都会让人期待谁会和她一起登台。作为 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡回演唱会的一部分，这个由 12 场音乐会组成的系列从 9 月 18 日开始，一直持续到 10 月 11 日。

paras.en: For the first two nights, there were no guest appearances, but they weren’t needed to maintain the energy during the two-hour show. Songs like “Girl Like Me,” “Te Felicito,” “TQG,” “Soltera” and “Hips Don’t Lie” kept the stadium singing at full volume — along with “Te Dejo Madrid,” a new addition to the setlist compared to previous stops on the tour. As the residency progressed, the first guest appearances began to roll in — some completely unexpected, others hinted at by Shakira herself through clues on her social media.
paras.zh: 前两晚没有客串，但也不需要他们在两个小时的演出中保持精力。像“Girl Like Me”、“Te Felicito”、“TQG”、“Soltera”和“Hips Don't Lie”这样的歌曲让体育场的歌声保持在最大音量，还有“Te Dejo Madrid”，与巡演之前的几站相比，这是新加入的歌曲。随着驻场的进展，第一批客串开始出现——有些完全出乎意料，有些是夏奇拉本人通过社交媒体上的线索暗示的。

paras.en: The Colombian superstar has been drawing around 55,000 people per night to Estadio Shakira, a temporary venue built specifically for these 12 shows at Iberdrola Music. Back in January, Billboard announced that Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour had set a Guinness World Record as the highest-grossing tour of all time by a Hispanic artist, with $421.6 million earned and 3.3 million tickets sold across 86 shows, according to figures reported to Billboard Boxscore.
paras.zh: 这位哥伦比亚巨星每晚都会吸引约 55,000 人前往 Estadio Shakira，这是一个专门为 Iberdrola Music 的这 12 场演出而建造的临时场地。 Billboard Boxscore 的数据显示，早在 1 月份，Billboard 就宣布 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡回演唱会创下了吉尼斯世界纪录，成为西班牙裔艺人有史以来票房最高的巡回演唱会，共 86 场演出，收入 4.216 亿美元，售出 330 万张门票。

paras.en: Midway through the residency, Shakira shared her thoughts on Instagram about the experience so far: “We’re halfway through our residency! 6 concerts in total, and each one has had an incredible energy. It’s impossible to say which of the 6 has been the best; they’ve all been absolutely spectacular. Thank you, Madrid, for being with me!” the global superstar wrote.
paras.zh: 驻场进行到一半时，夏奇拉在 Instagram 上分享了她对迄今为止这段经历的看法：“我们的驻场已经过半了！总共 6 场音乐会，每一场都充满了令人难以置信的能量。很难说 6 场音乐会中哪一场是最好的；它们都非常壮观。谢谢马德里和我在一起！”这位全球巨星写道。

paras.en: Below, see our updating list of all the artists who have joined Shakira on stage during her European residency in Madrid.
paras.zh: 下面是我们更新的所有在夏奇拉欧洲驻地马德里演出期间与夏奇拉一起登上舞台的艺术家名单。

paras.en: - Sept. 20: Laura Pausini The first guest arrived during the third show of the residency, when Laura Pausini made a surprise appearance to sing “Antología” alongside Shakira. The Italian singer had previously covered the Pies Descalzos (1995) classic on her album Yo Canto 2 (2026), but this time she was able to perform it with Shakira, creating one of the most moving moments of the night. “I don’t know if it showed on the big screen, but her eyes were filled with tears,” Pausini said before joking about the title of the Colombian singer’s latest album. “The album is Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran (Women Don’t Cry Anymore), but tonight there’s one woman who’s going to cry tears of happiness, and that’s me.” The two ended the performance in an embrace.
paras.zh: - 9月20日：劳拉·保西尼 (Laura Pausini) 第一位嘉宾在驻场项目的第三场演出中抵达，劳拉·保西尼 (Laura Pausini) 惊喜现身，与夏奇拉 (Shakira) 一起演唱《Antología》。这位意大利歌手此前曾在她的专辑《Yo Canto 2》（2026）中翻唱过《Pies Descalzos》（1995）经典歌曲，但这次她能够与夏奇拉一起表演，创造了当晚最动人的时刻之一。 “我不知道它是否出现在大屏幕上，但她的眼睛里充满了泪水，”保西尼在开玩笑地谈论这位哥伦比亚歌手最新专辑的标题之前说道。 “这张专辑是 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran（女人不再哭泣），但今晚有一个女人会流下幸福的眼泪，那就是我。”两人在拥抱中结束了演出。

paras.en: - Sept. 25: Triplets Ghetto Kids The Triplets Ghetto Kids also joined the residency during “Dai Dai,” the official song of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The collective of young Ugandan dancers reunited with Shakira after having shared the stage with her during the World Cup final performance. On Oct. 3, they returned to accompany her during the song.
paras.zh: - 9 月 25 日：Triplets Ghetto Kids Triplets Ghetto Kids 也加入了 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯官方歌曲《Dai Dai》的驻场演出。乌干达年轻舞者团体在世界杯决赛表演期间与夏奇拉同台演出后，与夏奇拉重聚。 10月3日，他们回来为她伴奏。

paras.en: - Sept. 25 & 26: Alejandro Sanz One of the most anticipated reunions happened with Alejandro Sanz, who joined Shakira for two consecutive nights. On Sept. 25, they performed “La Tortura” together once again, the hit collaboration they released more than two decades ago, in 2005. Sanz returned to the stage the following night, and this time they added his hit “Corazón Partío,” which they performed together for the first time. “Alejandro, I love you!” Shakira shouted as she bid him farewell after the first night, while Sanz later summarized the reunion on his social media: “Two nights with you, and my ‘corazón partío’ (broken heart) feels fuller than ever.” Watch the moment here.
paras.zh: - 9 月 25 日和 26 日：亚历杭德罗·桑斯 (Alejandro Sanz) 最令人期待的重聚之一发生在亚历杭德罗·桑斯 (Alejandro Sanz) 身上，他连续两晚与夏奇拉 (Shakira) 在一起。 9月25日，他们再次一起表演了《La Tortura》，这是他们二十多年前（2005年）发行的热门合作歌曲。第二天晚上，桑斯回到舞台，这次他们添加了他的热门歌曲《Corazón Partío》，这是他们第一次一起表演。 “亚历杭德罗，我爱你！”第一晚结束后，夏奇拉在向他告别时大声喊道，而桑斯后来在社交媒体上总结了这次团聚：“和你在一起的两个晚上，我的‘corazónpartío’（破碎的心）感觉比以往任何时候都更加充实。”在这里观看这一刻。

paras.en: - Sept. 27: Manuel Turizo The guest for the sixth night of the residency was Manuel Turizo, whose appearance Shakira had teased on social media the day before. The two Colombians teamed up to perform their 2023 collaboration “Copa Vacía” live for the first time. Watch them here.
paras.zh: - 9 月 27 日：Manuel Turizo 驻场第六晚的嘉宾是 Manuel Turizo，前一天夏奇拉在社交媒体上调侃了他的出现。两位哥伦比亚人首次联手现场表演了 2023 年合作的“Copa Vacía”。在这里观察他们。

paras.en: - Oct. 3: Dua Lipa When it seemed like the guest list had already delivered plenty of unforgettable moments, Dua Lipa’s appearance became one of the biggest surprises of the residency. Shakira invited her to sing “Antología,” and the two shared the stage for the first time. “For me, it’s an honor and a privilege to sing this song, which means so much to me, with this woman who is so admired and loved around the world,” Shakira said before welcoming the British star. “Today, I officially declare myself your fan.” After their performance, as the two embraced, the Colombian singer-songwriter once again expressed her excitement. “Oh my, oh my, what this tour was missing,” she said. Dua Lipa had previously performed “Antología” in November 2025 during her show in Bogota as part of her Radical Optimism Tour. This time, she had the chance to sing it alongside Shakira, and after the concert, she shared her excitement via Instagram. “I felt that you, me, and the audience were one. Very grateful to take home such a beautiful memory!!!” she wrote in Spanish.
paras.zh: - 10月3日：Dua Lipa 当嘉宾名单似乎已经带来了很多难忘的时刻时，Dua Lipa的出现成为了驻场最大的惊喜之一。夏奇拉邀请她演唱《Antología》，两人首次同台演出。夏奇拉在欢迎这位英国明星之前说道：“对我来说，能和这位在全世界都受到钦佩和喜爱的女人一起演唱这首歌是一种荣幸，这对我来说意义重大。” “今天，我正式宣布自己是你的粉丝。”演出结束后，当两人拥抱时，这位哥伦比亚创作型歌手再次表达了她的兴奋之情。 “天哪，天哪，这次旅行缺少了什么，”她说。 Dua Lipa 此前曾于 2025 年 11 月在波哥大演出期间表演过《Antología》，这是她激进乐观巡演的一部分。这次，她有机会与夏奇拉一起演唱这首歌，演唱会结束后，她通过Instagram分享了她的兴奋之情。 “我觉得你、我、观众是一体的。非常感谢能把这么美好的回忆带回家！！！”她用西班牙语写的。

articles.title: Shakira’s Madrid Concert Sets an Amazon Music Livestreaming Record
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Shakira‘s Oct. 3 Madrid concert has made history as the most-viewed livestream performance by a female artist on Amazon Music to date.
paras.zh: 夏奇拉 10 月 3 日的马德里演唱会创造了历史，成为亚马逊音乐上迄今为止观看次数最多的女艺人现场直播表演。

paras.en: The streaming service shared the news via press release on Sunday (Oct. 4), the day after the Colombian superstar’s performance was broadcast live. The show was part of Shakira’s 12-date residency in Spain’s capital at Shakira Stadium on her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour.
paras.zh: 周日（10 月 4 日），也就是这位哥伦比亚巨星现场直播表演的第二天，该流媒体服务通过新闻稿分享了这一消息。这场演出是夏奇拉在西班牙首都夏奇拉体育场进行 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡演 12 场演出的一部分。

paras.en: Beyond Shakira’s anticipated set full of hits spanning three decades of her career in Latin music, the Oct. 3 concert included a very special surprise: Dua Lipa appeared onstage with the star to perform an acoustic “Antología,” from Shakira’s 1997 Pies Descalzos album — an intimate moment that Shak gushed was “what this tour was missing.”
paras.zh: 除了夏奇拉在拉丁音乐生涯三十年里所期待的一系列热门歌曲之外，10 月 3 日的音乐会还带来了一个非常特别的惊喜：杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa) 与这位明星一起出现在舞台上，表演了夏奇拉 1997 年 Pies Descalzos 专辑中的原声歌曲《Antología》——夏奇滔滔不绝地说，这是“这次巡演所缺少的”亲密时刻。

paras.en: “For me, it’s an honor and a privilege to sing this song, which means so much to me, with this woman who is so admired and loved around the world,” Shakira said while introducing Dua Lipa to the crowd of more than 50,000 fans in front of them, plus those at home catching their duet via livestream, which viewers were able to watch via Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch.
paras.zh: “对我来说，与这位在全世界都受到钦佩和喜爱的女性一起演唱这首歌对我来说意义重大，”夏奇拉在向面前的 50,000 多名歌迷以及那些在家里通过直播观看二重唱的观众介绍 Dua Lipa 时说道，观众可以通过 Amazon Music、Prime Video 和 Twitch 观看这首歌。

paras.en: Post-show, Dua Lipa shared her excitement on Instagram, writing in Spanish, “I felt that you, me, and the audience were one. Very grateful to take home such a beautiful memory!!!”
paras.zh: 演出结束后，杜阿·利帕在 Instagram 上分享了她的兴奋之情，用西班牙语写道：“我觉得你、我和观众是一体的。非常感谢能把如此美好的回忆带回家！！！”

paras.en: Shakira Stadium was built as a temporary venue within Madrid’s Iberdrola Music complex specifically for the star’s concert residency in the city, which opened on Sept. 18 and wraps with a 12th date on Oct. 11.
paras.zh: 夏奇拉体育场是马德里 Iberdrola 音乐中心内的一个临时场地，专门用于这位明星在该市的驻场音乐会，该体育场于 9 月 18 日开幕，并于 10 月 11 日结束第 12 场演出。

paras.en: Amazon Music’s livestream of Saturday night’s Shakira concert led the streamer’s 2026 Women Shaping Latin Music campaign, celebrating the artists, sounds and cultural movements shaping Latin music.
paras.zh: 亚马逊音乐周六晚上的夏奇拉音乐会直播引领了该流媒体的 2026 年女性塑造拉丁音乐活动，庆祝塑造拉丁音乐的艺术家、声音和文化运动。

articles.title: Fans Choose Victoria Monét’s ‘Frequency of Love’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Frequency of Love, the new album from Victoria Monét, tops this week’s new music poll.
paras.zh: 维多利亚·莫奈 (Victoria Monet) 的新专辑《爱的频率》(Frequency of Love) 在本周的新音乐民意调查中名列前茅。

paras.en: Listeners voted in a poll published Friday (Oct. 2) on Billboard, choosing Monét’s sophomore full-length LP as their favorite new music.
paras.zh: 周五（10 月 2 日）在 Billboard 上发布的一项民意调查中，听众进行了投票，选择莫奈的第二张全长 LP 作为他们最喜欢的新音乐。

paras.en: The album topped new Friday music releases from Noah Kahan, Miranda Lambert, Drake and more. By the poll’s closing time on Sunday, Monét pulled in 40% of the vote.
paras.zh: 这张专辑在诺亚·卡汉、米兰达·兰伯特、德雷克等人的周五新音乐发行中名列前茅。截至周日投票结束时，莫奈获得了 40% 的选票。

paras.en: Fans first got a taste of Frequency of Love, Monét’s follow-up to Jaguar II, through three early singles, “Let Me,” “Reach Out” and “Juicy.” The 22-track collection officially arrived on Oct. 2.
paras.zh: 歌迷们首先通过三首早期单曲《Let Me》、《Reach Out》和《Juicy》领略了莫奈继《Jaguar II》之后的《Frequency of Love》。该专辑包含 22 首曲目，于 10 月 2 日正式上市。

paras.en: The album has a number of intriguing features, including one from her own daughter — who got a special shout-out from the singer on social media this weekend for her contribution to the song “You Mean the World to Me”: “Thank you for your patience and understanding and unconditional love while mommy was in school, while I made this album, every time I had to step out of the door without you and when work didn’t end once I got back home!” Monét wrote to 5-year-old Hazel on Saturday. “I am so honored to have you as a feature on this album (you sound soooo beautiful) and I am so proud of your growth in every way, your natural empathy, your humor, your respect, the way you love and your undeniable talent! Forevemore, it’s you and me baby.”
paras.zh: 这张专辑有许多有趣的特点，其中包括她自己女儿的一个特点——这个周末，她在社交媒体上特别感谢了她对歌曲“You Mean the World to Me”的贡献：“感谢您在妈妈上学时的耐心、理解和无条件的爱，当我制作这张专辑时，每次我不得不在没有您的情况下走出家门，当我回到家后工作还没有结束时！”周六，莫奈给 5 岁的黑兹尔写了一封信。 “我很荣幸你能成为这张专辑的主角（你听起来太美了），我为你在各方面的成长、你天生的同理心、你的幽默、你的尊重、你爱的方式和你不可否认的才华感到骄傲！永远，这是你和我的宝贝。”

paras.en: “You Mean the World to Me” also features Leon Thomas. Also on Monét’s new album: Lucky Daye, SZA, Bryson Tiller, Chlöe and Bruno Mars, whose Romantic Tour recently had Monet booked as a supporting act.
paras.zh: 莱昂·托马斯还出演了《你对我来说意味着整个世界》。莫奈的新专辑中还有 Lucky Daye、SZA、Bryson Tiller、Chlöe 和布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars)，他们的浪漫巡演最近为莫奈预订了配角。

paras.en: Following her spot as an opener on the road with Bruno Mars, she’s embarking on her own headlining Frequency of Love Tour this month, starting Oct. 27 in Raleigh, N.C., and running through mid-December.
paras.zh: 继与布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars) 一起作为开场嘉宾之后，她本月将开始自己的头条新闻“Frequency of Love”巡演，从 10 月 27 日在北卡罗来纳州罗利开始，一直持续到 12 月中旬。

paras.en: Trailing behind Frequency of Love on the poll are Noah Kahan’s new single “Draw You Out,” with 29% of the vote, Miranda Lambert’s Crisco album, with nearly 7% of the vote, and Drake’s HABIBTI (FOMO) deluxe release, with almost 6% of the vote.
paras.zh: 在民意调查中，落后于《Frequency of Love》的是诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 的新单曲《Draw You Out》，获得了 29% 的选票；米兰达·兰伯特 (Miranda Lambert) 的 Crisco 专辑，获得了近 7% 的选票；以及德雷克 (Drake) 的 HABIBTI (FOMO) 豪华专辑，获得了近 6% 的选票。

paras.en: See the final results of this week’s poll below.
paras.zh: 请参阅下面本周投票的最终结果。

articles.title: So Long, Kody & Robyn: Where to Watch ‘Sister Wives’ Season 21 for Free Online Featuring Only the OG Spouses
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: Kody and Robyn Brown will not return for Season 21 of Sister Wives, according to TLC’s recently released trailer. While the network and couple have not shared a detailed explanation, reports suggest several possible factors. These include the show’s new focus on Kody’s former wives, possible contract and creative disagreements and Kody’s previously stated desire to step away from reality television and reduce public scrutiny. Sister Wives Season 21 will focus primarily on Meri, Janelle and Christine.
paras.zh: 根据 TLC 最近发布的预告片，科迪和罗宾·布朗将不会回归《妻子姐妹》第 21 季。虽然该网络和这对夫妇没有分享详细的解释，但报告提出了几个可能的因素。其中包括该节目对科迪前妻的新关注、可能的合同和创意分歧，以及科迪之前表示的退出真人秀节目并减少公众监督的愿望。 《姐妹妻子》第 21 季将主要关注梅里、珍妮尔和克里斯汀。

paras.en: At a Glance: Where to Watch Sister Wives Season 21 for Free Online
paras.zh: 概览：哪里可以免费在线观看《嫂子》第 21 季

paras.en: - When: Sunday, Oct. 4 at 10:00 p.m. ET/PT
paras.zh: - 时间：10 月 4 日星期日晚上 10:00 ET/PT

paras.en: - Stream: For those without cable, you can stream TLC on Philo, DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV and Sling TV during the premiere time or on demand later
paras.zh: - 流媒体：对于没有有线电视的用户，您可以在首映期间或稍后点播时在 Philo、DirecTV、Hulu + Live TV 和 Sling TV 上流传输 TLC

paras.zh: 《Sister Wives》第 21 季将于晚上 10:00 在 TLC 上首播，有线电视或卫星电视均可观看。东部时间/太平洋时间 2026 年 10 月 4 日（星期日）。

paras.en: Where to Watch Sister Wives Season 21 for Free Online
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看《妻妾成群》第 21 季

paras.en: Sister Wives Season 21 airs live on TLC Sunday, Oct. 4 at 10:00 p.m. ET/PT, but fans can stream Season 21 through Philo, DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV and Sling during the premiere time or on demand after the initial air time. Philo offers a seven-day free trial while DirecTV and Hulu + Live TV have shorter trial offers for eligible customers.
paras.zh: 《Sister Wives》第 21 季将于 10 月 4 日星期日晚上 10:00 在 TLC 直播。东部时间/太平洋时间，但粉丝可以在首播期间或首播时间后点播通过 Philo、DirecTV、Hulu + Live TV 和 Sling 观看第 21 季。 Philo 提供 7 天免费试用期，而 DirecTV 和 Hulu + Live TV 则为符合条件的客户提供较短的试用期。

paras.en: Here’s a breakdown of the streaming platforms offering TLC for Sister Wives Season 21.
paras.zh: 以下是为《姐妹妻子》第 21 季提供 TLC 的流媒体平台的详细信息。

paras.en: DirecTV carries TLC on channel 280 in HD, making it another option for watching Sister Wives live. TLC is included in multiple DirecTV packages, including Entertainment and higher-tier options. DirecTV currently advertises a five-day free trial for its streaming TV plans. Eligible new customers can use the trial to watch TLC and other included channels, but the service requires a payment method and converts to a paid subscription if it is not canceled before the trial expires.
paras.zh: DirecTV 在 280 频道上提供 TLC 高清频道，使其成为观看《Sister Wives》直播的另一种选择。 TLC 包含在多个 DirecTV 套餐中，包括娱乐和更高级别的选项。 DirecTV 目前为其流媒体电视计划宣传五天免费试用。符合条件的新客户可以使用试用版观看 TLC 和其他包含的频道，但该服务需要付款方式，如果在试用期结束前未取消，该服务将转换为付费订阅。

paras.en: Sling offers TLC through its Blue package as well as its Orange & Blue package. The current Sling Blue lineup includes more than 40 live channels and TLC is among them. Sling Blue starts at $45.99 per month, while Orange & Blue starts at $60.99 per month. Sling does not offer a traditional free trial, although it provides short-term passes and a free streaming option with limited channels. TLC can be watched live through an eligible Sling plan, with DVR and on-demand options also available.
paras.zh: Sling 通过其蓝色包装以及橙色和蓝色包装提供 TLC。目前的 Sling Blue 系列包括 40 多个直播频道，TLC 就是其中之一。 Sling Blue 起价为每月 45.99 美元，Orange & Blue 起价为每月 60.99 美元。 Sling 不提供传统的免费试用，但它提供短期通行证和频道有限的免费流媒体选项。可以通过符合条件的 Sling 计划现场观看 TLC，还可以使用 DVR 和点播选项。

articles.title: ‘Lanterns’ Team Breaks Down Finale’s Emotional Gamble, Hal Jordan’s Ultimate Fate and John Stewart’s Future
articles.author: Brian Davids

paras.en: [This story contains major spoilers for the Lanterns season one finale, “Dirt and Stars.“]
paras.zh: [这个故事包含《灯笼》第一季大结局“泥土与星星”的主要剧透。]

paras.en: For a Lanterns season one finale that ends with John Stewart taking flight as his own brand of Green Lantern, it’s a rightfully grounded affair until then.
paras.zh: 在《灯笼》第一季的大结局中，约翰·斯图尔特以他自己品牌的绿灯侠的身份起飞，在此之前这是一件理所当然的事情。

paras.en: There is no otherworldly threat for the sake of obligatory spectacle, a welcome change of pace from the superhero genre’s oft-reused playbook. Instead, it remains focused on the ever-evolving relationship between Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) and John (Aaron Pierre).
paras.zh: 为了强制性的奇观，没有超凡脱俗的威胁，与超级英雄类型经常重复使用的剧本相比，这是一个值得欢迎的节奏变化。相反，它仍然关注哈尔·乔丹（凯尔·钱德勒饰）和约翰（亚伦·皮埃尔饰）之间不断发展的关系。

paras.en: “There was never a version of the finale that was more action-oriented,” Lanterns showrunner Chris Mundy told moderator Mallory Rubin of The Ringer during the finale press conference, which featured the creative brain trust alongside stars Pierre and Chandler. “If we landed it emotionally with [Hal and John], we would’ve done our job. [Action for action’s sake] would’ve been distraction and incident instead of emotion.”
paras.zh: “从来没有哪个版本的大结局比这更以动作为导向，”《灯笼》的制作人克里斯·芒迪在大结局新闻发布会上对《林格》的主持人马洛里·鲁宾说道，这次新闻发布会的特色是创意智囊团与明星皮埃尔和钱德勒一起。 “如果我们在情感上与[哈尔和约翰]达成一致，我们就完成了我们的工作。[为了行动而行动]会分散注意力和事件而不是情感。”

paras.en: Structurally, co-creator Damon Lindelof considers episode five’s “Battle of Rushville” to be this series’ version of the CGI slugfest and sky-beam invasion we’ve seen time and time again.
paras.zh: 从结构上来说，联合创作者达蒙·林德洛夫 (Damon Lindelof) 认为第五集的“拉什维尔之战”是我们一次又一次看到的 CGI 战斗和天光入侵的系列版本。

paras.en: “If we had to make a two-hour Lanterns movie, you would have to have a bombastic third-act action set piece — and then two or three minutes of coda,” Lindelof said. “We got to do that [coda] over the course of [the last] three episodes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们必须制作一部两小时的《灯笼》电影，你就必须有一个夸张的第三幕动作片，然后是两到三分钟的尾声，”林德洛夫说。 “我们必须在[最后]三集中完成[尾声]。”

paras.en: Co-creator Tom King, who originally pitched the series’ earthy, True Detective-like spin on Green Lantern lore, added: “One of our sticking points from day one was to avoid clichés like they’re the plague. They make it boring and give you that superhero exhaustion we’ve seen a thousand think pieces about. So it’s not what you expect, and that’s entirely what this show has been.”
paras.zh: 联合创作者汤姆·金最初提出了该剧朴实、真探般的绿灯侠传说，他补充道：“从第一天开始，我们的症结之一就是避免陈词滥调，就像它们是瘟疫一样。它们让故事变得无聊，让你感到超级英雄的疲惫感，我们已经看到了上千种想法。所以这不是你所期望的，而这完全是这部剧的目的。”

paras.en: Getting into the weeds of plot, the finale begins with an addendum to episode five, as Sheriff Kerry Kane (Kelly Macdonald) arrives at Rushville’s demolished motel to find a defeated Hal Jordan still lying in the rubble following his confrontations with John and Zoe (Poorna Jagannathan). He has already accepted that he’ll be sent to prison for reckless endangerment, allowing the Guardians of the Universe to carry out their long-standing plan to permanently replace him as Earth’s Green Lantern.
paras.zh: 进入情节的杂草，结局从第五集的附录开始，警长克里·凯恩（凯莉·麦克唐纳饰）到达拉什维尔被拆毁的汽车旅馆，发现被击败的哈尔·乔丹在与约翰和佐伊（普尔娜·贾甘纳坦饰）对抗后仍然躺在废墟中。他已经接受了自己将因鲁莽危害他人而被送进监狱的事实，这使得宇宙守护者能够执行他们长期的计划，永久取代他成为地球的绿灯侠。

paras.en: The narrative then jumps forward to an earlier point in 2026 to track the burgeoning romance between Hal and Kerry. Hal’s decade’s worth of prison letters clearly had a profound effect on her, because she makes sure to pick him up after his 10-year sentence with a six-pack of Schlitz in hand. But Hal’s return to Rushville with Kerry is met with the coldest of welcomes, including ongoing acts of vandalism against his rental. After all, his selfish desire to retain his Lantern status not only got locals killed, but presumably also brought an end to the 30 years of good health and prosperity Zoe had provided in exchange for the townsfolk protecting her Manhunter identity.
paras.zh: 然后故事跳转到 2026 年的早些时候，追踪哈尔和克里之间迅速发展的浪漫关系。哈尔十年来的监狱信件显然对她产生了深远的影响，因为她一定会在哈尔被判十年徒刑后去接他，手里拿着六罐施利茨啤酒。但哈尔和克里一起回到拉什维尔却受到了最冷淡的欢迎，包括对他的出租屋的持续破坏行为。毕竟，他想要保留自己的灯笼身份的自私欲望不仅导致了当地人的死亡，而且很可能也结束了佐伊为换取镇民保护她的猎人身份而提供的 30 年的健康和繁荣。

paras.en: During a hostile dinner date, Zoe stands up and tries to appeal to the fellow patrons’ better angels in regard to Hal. She points out that he’s trying to make amends every day by being of service to the community in any way he can. That plea falls on deaf ears, as Hal’s rental home — a different one from the one John later stays at — is eventually set ablaze by arsonists. Hal immediately grabs his extraterrestrial flower pet, Earl, and heads for an upstairs exit, but the staircase collapses, leaving the fates of Hal and Earl up in the air.
paras.zh: 在一次充满敌意的晚餐约会中，佐伊站起来，试图呼吁其他顾客对哈尔抱有更好的态度。她指出，他每天都在尽其所能地为社区服务，试图弥补这一点。这一请求被置若罔闻，哈尔的出租屋——与约翰后来住的不同——最终被纵火犯纵火焚烧。哈尔立即抓住他的外星花宠物厄尔，朝楼上的出口走去，但楼梯倒塌了，哈尔和厄尔的命运悬而未决。

paras.en: Hal suddenly wakes up on the floor of a slaughterhouse that now houses Zoe’s leftover Manhunter technology, which heals and regenerates damage done to still-living tissue. Her grandson, Noah Macon (Shea Pritchard), then steps forward to reveal himself as a Manhunter. He rehabilitated Hal’s charred body just as Zoe did for John following the burning car accident that Hal engineered. Noah asks Hal to keep the exchange secret, since his mother, Kerry, is still under the impression that he does not know his true nature as a Manhunter.
paras.zh: 哈尔突然在屠宰场的地板上醒来，屠宰场现在存放着佐伊剩余的猎人技术，该技术可以治愈并再生对仍然活着的组织造成的损伤。她的孙子诺亚·梅肯（谢伊·普里查德饰）随后挺身而出，表明自己是一名猎人。他修复了哈尔烧焦的身体，就像佐伊在哈尔策划的燃烧车祸后为约翰所做的那样。诺亚要求哈尔保守这次交换的秘密，因为他的母亲凯瑞仍然认为他不知道自己作为猎人的真实本性。

paras.en: If you’re like me, then you probably wondered whether Noah also had to re-skin Earl following the house fire. We knew he somehow made it out alive since John reunited with him after Hal’s death. Fortunately, Rubin read my very specific question aloud to the panel for clarity. Apparently, many other journalists had submitted a similar query about their concern for Earl.
paras.zh: 如果您像我一样，那么您可能想知道诺亚是否也必须在房屋火灾后重新剥皮厄尔。自从哈尔死后约翰与他重聚以来，我们知道他以某种方式活了下来。幸运的是，鲁宾向小组大声朗读了我非常具体的问题，以便清楚地了解。显然，许多其他记者也就他们对厄尔的担忧提出了类似的询问。

paras.en: “That’s an excellent question that I’ve never considered. Someone went deeper than we did, and we thought we went deep,” Mundy said mid-laugh. “I don’t think Earl needed to be re-skinned. I don’t think Earl goes down that easily.”
paras.zh: “这是一个很好的问题，我从来没有考虑过。有人比我们走得更深，而我们认为我们走得更深。”蒙迪笑着说道。 “我不认为厄尔需要重新换皮。我不认为厄尔那么容易倒下。”

paras.en: Lindelof continued, “I think Earl is pretty resilient. The botanical creatures of the galaxy can grow their own skin, I would imagine. Earl probably has the thickest skin of anybody on the show.”
paras.zh: 林德洛夫继续说道：“我认为厄尔的适应力相当强。我想，银河系的植物生物可以长出自己的皮肤。厄尔可能是剧中皮肤最厚的人。”

paras.en: After the slaughterhouse, the episode cuts to Antaan’s (Paul Ben-Victor) home planet, which Zoe had annihilated prior to her Rushville arrival in 1986. The scene resumes episode seven’s cliffhanger involving Sinestro (Ulrich Thomsen), John and the holographic version of Hal, dubbed “Halogram.” The disgraced former Green Lantern had been recapping the same Hal-related events we’d just seen visualized so that John can continue piecing together the puzzle surrounding his mentor’s murder.
paras.zh: 屠宰场之后，这一集切入安坦 (保罗·本-维克多饰) 的母星，佐伊在 1986 年到达拉什维尔之前已经消灭了这颗行星。 这一场景延续了第七集的悬念，涉及塞尼斯特罗 (乌尔里奇·汤姆森饰)、约翰和被称为“全息图”的全息版哈尔。这位名誉扫地的前绿灯侠一直在重述我们刚刚看到的与哈尔相关的可视化事件，以便约翰能够继续拼凑出围绕他的导师被谋杀的谜团。

paras.en: It was Noah who broke Sinestro out of his previous Oa prison so that he could forge the teen a ring-charging lantern while imprisoned on Antaan’s planet. After Noah saved his life and revealed himself, Hal still couldn’t resist surveilling the young Manhunter. He then discovered that Zoe had left him a portal to the aforementioned planet that had caused her so much guilt and anguish. Hal stepped through it to find Sinestro inside his newest island prison, and the two caught each other up to speed on the circumstances that led them there. It was the last time Sinestro saw his former protégé alive.
paras.zh: 诺亚将辛斯特罗从他之前的欧阿监狱中救了出来，这样他就可以在被囚禁在安坦星球上时为这名少年锻造一盏充电环灯笼。诺亚救了他一命并现身后，哈尔仍然忍不住监视这位年轻的猎人。然后他发现佐伊给他留下了通往上述星球的门户，这给她带来了如此多的内疚和痛苦。哈尔穿过它，在他最新的岛上监狱里找到了塞尼斯特罗，两人互相了解了导致他们来到这里的情况。这是塞尼斯特罗最后一次见到他的前门徒活着。

paras.en: Sinestro posits to John that Noah killed Hal for not honoring their agreement to leave him alone, and while John deduces that Noah wants a ring and a lantern to kill the Guardians who ordered John to assassinate his grandmother, he isn’t fully satisfied with that rationale for killing Hal. He then departs with Halogram for Rushville, where Noah’s boot awaits him. In the process, Noah seizes the ring and lantern from John, acquiring everything he needs to go after the Guardians.
paras.zh: 辛斯特罗向约翰假设，诺亚杀死哈尔是因为他没有遵守他们不打扰他的协议，而约翰推断诺亚想要一枚戒指和一盏灯笼来杀死那些命令约翰刺杀他祖母的守护者，但他对杀死哈尔的理由并不完全满意。然后他带着 Halogram 出发前往拉什维尔，诺亚的靴子在那里等着他。在此过程中，诺亚从约翰手中夺走了戒指和灯笼，获得了追捕守护者所需的一切。

paras.en: After giving him a beating, Noah has John drive him to his final high school football game. He wants to know why John killed his grandmother, but John reveals that she wanted that outcome. Her death would drive away all of the outside agitators and leave Noah’s secret identity in peace. Noah then tearfully takes the blame for killing Hal, fearing his mom would find out about his Manhunter activities from Hal. As Sinestro had also theorized, Noah admits to wrestling with his synthetic nature versus his human nurture. John relates to him by sharing how he’s dealt with overcoming his own unique programming.
paras.zh: 诺亚殴打了他之后，让约翰开车送他去看最后一场高中橄榄球比赛。他想知道约翰为什么杀了他的祖母，但约翰透露她想要这个结果。她的死将赶走所有外界的煽动者，让诺亚的秘密身份得到安宁。诺亚泪流满面地承担了杀死哈尔的责任，担心他的妈妈会从哈尔那里发现他的猎人活动。正如塞尼斯特罗所推测的那样，诺亚承认他正在与他的合成本性和他的人类教养进行斗争。约翰通过分享他如何克服自己独特的编程来与他建立联系。

paras.en: Noah proceeds to weigh his two paths. There’s one where he plays college football at the University of Nebraska and gets married. Then he’s tempted with another where he maximizes his abilities to achieve fame, political power and military capabilities. However, he chooses neither. He relinquishes the ring and lantern, and asks John to euthanize him after he finishes playing his last game. Conflicted, John seeks Halogram’s counsel, but he’s not responding.
paras.zh: 诺亚继续权衡他的两条道路。其中一个是他在内布拉斯加大学打大学橄榄球并结婚的地方。然后他又受到了另一种诱惑，他最大限度地发挥自己的能力来获得名誉、政治权力和军事能力。然而，他两者都不选择。他交出了戒指和灯笼，并要求约翰在他玩完最后一场游戏后对他实施安乐死。约翰感到矛盾，寻求哈拉格拉姆的建议，但他没有回应。

paras.en: John then approaches Kerry at the game about Noah’s secret, prompting her to finally spill her guts after all this time. Hal had also confronted her at the football field about Noah’s true nature, forcing her to recount how, upon making her bargain with Zoe in episode five’s 2007 flashback, Zoe’s alien tech gave her far more than a new pinky finger. She walked away as the expectant mother of a baby Manhunter, believing she could love him enough to combat his innately dangerous wiring.
paras.zh: 随后，约翰在比赛中向凯瑞讲述了诺亚的秘密，促使她在这么长时间后终于吐露了自己的内心。哈尔还在足球场上与她对峙，询问诺亚的真实本性，迫使她讲述在第五集 2007 年的闪回中与佐伊讨价还价后，佐伊的外星科技给了她的不仅仅是一个新的小指。她作为一个婴儿猎人的准妈妈离开了，相信她可以足够爱他，以对抗他与生俱来的危险线路。

paras.en: Hal blindsides her with the revelation that Noah does in fact know he’s a Manhunter and that he’s planning what we now know to be a revenge mission against the Guardians. Fearing for their safety, Hal says they must get out of Dodge before trouble comes, but Kerry doesn’t want to accept that her Rushville life is over — so much so that she draws her weapon in a panic and shoots Hal as he says, “Goddamnit, I love you.” Kerry immediately regrets the impulsive decision.
paras.zh: 哈尔让她措手不及，他透露诺亚实际上知道自己是猎人，而且他正在计划我们现在知道的针对守护者的复仇任务。由于担心他们的安全，哈尔说他们必须在麻烦来临之前离开道奇，但凯丽不想接受她在拉什维尔的生活已经结束的事实——以至于她惊慌失措地拔出武器，射杀了哈尔，因为哈尔说：“该死的，我爱你。”克里立即对这个冲动的决定感到后悔。

paras.en: John can’t understand why she’d call him to investigate Hal’s murder if she’s the one who did it. She explains that what she really wanted was for him to assess whether Noah is as monstrous as the rest of his kind. John determines that Noah has fought off his intrinsic qualities because he sacrificed the ring and covered for his mom out of love. Kerry is then alarmed when John announces that he’s not going to kill Noah like he requested. He wants to believe this kid can fight the good fight against his worst self, but he knows deep down the jury is still out.
paras.zh: 约翰不明白如果她是哈尔谋杀案的凶手，她为什么要打电话给他调查哈尔的谋杀案。她解释说，她真正想让他评估诺亚是否和其他同类一样可怕。约翰认为诺亚已经摆脱了他的内在品质，因为他出于爱而牺牲了戒指并为他的母亲提供掩护。当约翰宣布他不会按照诺亚的要求杀死诺亚时，克里感到震惊。他想相信这个孩子能够与最坏的自己进行一场美好的战斗，但他内心深处知道，目前还没有定论。

paras.en: Kerry offers to turn herself in for Hal’s murder, but John refuses to honor her request out of deference to what Hal would’ve wanted. The last we see of the broken Macon family is them briefly reunited to celebrate Noah’s victory and his commitment to the Nebraska Cornhuskers.
paras.zh: 凯瑞提出要因谋杀哈尔而自首，但约翰出于对哈尔意愿的尊重而拒绝满足她的要求。我们最后一次看到破碎的梅肯家族是他们短暂地团聚，庆祝诺亚的胜利和他对内布拉斯加州玉米壳队的承诺。

paras.en: John makes his way into town to signal Guy Gardner. Guy shows up to see Hal’s ring on John’s finger and protests that John removed it from Hal’s corpse after guilting Guy into stealing it from the Guardians. John clarifies that he needed it to solve the mystery of Hal’s heroic death. Guy takes further issue with John’s “unsanctioned” lantern, and John then informs Guy that he’ll be taking on earthbound Lantern responsibilities from this point forward. He proclaims himself to be a solo act who operates without a higher command calling his shots.
paras.zh: 约翰进城向盖伊·加德纳发出信号。盖伊出现，看到约翰手指上戴着哈尔的戒指，并抗议约翰在让盖伊从银河护卫队偷走戒指后将其从哈尔的尸体上取下。约翰澄清说，他需要它来解开哈尔英勇死亡的谜团。盖伊对约翰的“未经批准”的灯笼提出了进一步的问题，然后约翰告诉盖伊，从现在起他将承担地球上的灯笼责任。他宣称自己是一个独行者，无需上级指挥就可以行动。

paras.en: Guy stresses that the Guardians are going to send an army to deal with this matter, but John relays a coded message basically telling them to leave him alone. It’s likely a reminder that he did their dirty work by delivering Zoe’s crystallized heart, and that, as their first choice to replace Hal, he’s earned some grace. Guy flies off with his tail between his legs, insisting that their business isn’t settled.
paras.zh: 盖伊强调守护者将派遣一支军队来处理此事，但约翰转达了一条密码信息，基本上是告诉他们不要打扰他。这很可能是在提醒我们，他通过交付佐伊的结晶心脏来完成他们的肮脏工作，而作为他们取代哈尔的首选，他赢得了一些恩典。盖伊夹着尾巴飞走了，坚称他们的事还没有解决。

paras.en: At long last, Halogram reappears after Guy exits, admitting he’s been listening to everything that’s transpired since they parted ways after deserting Sinestro. (Notably, he didn’t gloat that he was right about Kerry being his real self’s killer.) Backup Hal first rattles John by pointing out the risky roll of the dice he’s taking with Noah. He then gives him some final reassurance that he’s going to be a better Lantern than he ever was and that it’s finally time to pair himself with the ring. John has been hesitating all episode because Sinestro confirmed that Halogram will cease to be once John syncs the ring with the new lantern. Halogram then spells out the theme of the season by saying, “Don’t be afraid to be afraid.”
paras.zh: 最后，哈拉图在盖伊退出后再次出现，承认自从他们抛弃辛斯特罗后分道扬镳以来，他一直在倾听所发生的一切。 （值得注意的是，他并没有幸灾乐祸地认为自己关于克里是真正的自我杀手的说法是正确的。）替补哈尔首先指出他与诺亚掷骰子的风险，这让约翰感到不安。然后他给了他最后的保证，他将成为一个比以往更好的灯笼，并且终于是时候将自己与戒指配对了。约翰在整个情节中一直在犹豫，因为辛斯特罗确认，一旦约翰将戒指与新灯笼同步，光环图将不再存在。然后，Halogram 阐明了本季的主题：“不要害怕害怕。”

paras.en: Before they part ways, Halogram has one more joke up his sleeve. He lies to John and pretends that he glitched during the part of Kerry’s story in which she quoted Hal’s last words as she shot him to death. So John repeats those words, “I love you,” and Halogram milks the moment with, “And I love you too, Junior,” before winking goodbye. It’s a punchline, but an emotionally resonant and valid one, even if Halogram didn’t personally share as much history with John as his real counterpart did.
paras.zh: 在他们分别之前，Halogram 还藏着一个笑话。他对约翰撒了谎，假装自己在凯瑞的故事中出现了故障，在凯瑞的故事中，她引用了哈尔开枪打死他时的最后一句话。于是约翰重复了这句话，“我爱你”，而哈拉格拉姆则用“我也爱你，朱尼尔”来充实这一刻，然后眨眼告别。这是一个妙语，但却是一个能引起情感共鸣且有效的妙语，即使哈拉格拉姆本人并没有像他真正的对手那样与约翰分享那么多的历史。

paras.en: “It was painfully exposed. It was a purely honest, open moment, and it was a joyous thing to be able to do on screen,” Chandler recalled. “It was easy to do with Aaron, because, although I really don’t like him very much, I knew I was getting paid.”
paras.zh: “它被暴露得很痛苦。那是一个纯粹诚实、开放的时刻，能够在银幕上表演是一件快乐的事情，”钱德勒回忆道。 “和亚伦在一起很容易，因为虽然我真的不太喜欢他，但我知道我得到了报酬。”

paras.en: As Chandler just showed, he and Pierre constantly ribbed each other throughout the filming and promotion of the show. But certain scenes, like the final goodbye, stopped them in their tracks because of the weight of the moment.
paras.zh: 正如钱德勒刚才所展示的那样，他和皮埃尔在节目的拍摄和宣传过程中不断互相取笑。但某些场景，比如最后的告别，因为这一刻的沉重而让他们停下了脚步。

paras.en: “Kyle believes he made me cry on that day, but I think I made him cry,” Pierre said. “We’ll have to let the episode air and see what the verdict is.”
paras.zh: “凯尔相信那天他让我哭了，但我认为是我让他哭了，”皮埃尔说。 “我们必须让这一集播出，看看判决是什么。”

paras.en: In the end, John takes the leap to become his own Lantern, one who doesn’t answer to overlords of any kind. He even rewrites the Green Lantern oath to account for his newfound embrace of fear. Oddly enough, that advice didn’t just come from Hal. Sinestro also informed John’s decision to use fear to his advantage, unlike the traditional Green Lantern modus operandi. The lantern that John acquired from Sinestro is even infused with fear-based elements from Antaan’s planet. Last but not least, John also restores relations with his parents, allowing his mother, Bernadette, to exhale after years of estrangement.
paras.zh: 最后，约翰一跃成为了自己的灯笼，一个不向任何形式的霸主负责的人。他甚至重写了绿灯侠的誓言，以解释他新发现的恐惧。奇怪的是，这个建议不仅仅来自哈尔。塞尼斯特罗还告知约翰利用恐惧为自己谋利的决定，这与绿灯侠传统的作案手法不同。约翰从塞尼斯特罗那里获得的灯笼甚至注入了来自安塔安星球的基于恐惧的元素。最后但并非最不重要的一点是，约翰还与父母恢复了关系，让他的母亲伯纳黛特在多年的疏远后松了口气。

paras.en: Unlike the other major story points discussed so far, John’s revised oath was not decided on until the writers were breaking the finale in the room. Will purists object to John rewriting the oath in such a significant way? Mundy remembered the writers being “crazily nervous” about the choice until writer Justin Britt-Gibson put things into perspective by saying, “We’re not rewriting it; we’re remixing it.”
paras.zh: 与迄今为止讨论的其他主要故事点不同，约翰修改后的誓言直到编剧们在房间里打破结局时才决定。纯粹主义者会反对约翰以如此重要的方式重写誓言吗？蒙迪记得编剧们对这个选择“非常紧张”，直到编剧贾斯汀·布里特·吉布森正确看待事情，他说：“我们不是重写它，而是重新混合它。”

paras.en: When you look at all the hierarchies John has served — his demanding parents, the Guardians, the Marines, the Green Lantern Corps — Lindelof stated that he has to finally exist on his own terms. “We were definitely nervous and scared about doing it, but we started to say, ‘If we’re not afraid of doing an idea, then we probably shouldn’t do it,'”he added.
paras.zh: 当你看到约翰服务过的所有阶层——他要求严格的父母、守护者、海军陆战队、绿灯军团——林德洛夫表示，他最终必须按照自己的方式存在。 “我们确实对这样做感到紧张和害怕，但我们开始说，‘如果我们不害怕做一个想法，那么我们可能不应该这样做，’”他补充道。

paras.en: Lindelof continued: “It just felt right, and we understood that it’s probably going to be the thing that divides the fandom, et cetera.”
paras.zh: 林德洛夫继续说道：“这感觉不错，我们知道这可能会成为粉丝群体分裂的原因，等等。”

paras.en: King then followed Lindelof by explaining why the Green Lantern oath doesn’t technically apply to John. “John is not a hundred percent a Green Lantern anymore. He has an unsanctioned lantern that has a bit of yellow and a bit of fear in it,” King said. “So he’s not saying the same oath as every other Green Lantern — just like a Yellow Lantern or an Orange Lantern says something different. John is this utterly unique creation that he chose for himself. So getting his own unique oath seemed to line up very much with the lore and where we’re going from here.”
paras.zh: 金接着解释了为什么绿灯侠誓言在技术上不适用于约翰。 “约翰不再是百分百的绿灯侠了。他有一个未经批准的灯笼，里面有一点黄色和一点恐惧，”金说。 “所以他并没有和其他绿灯侠说同样的誓言——就像黄灯笼或橙灯笼说不同的东西一样。约翰是他为自己选择的一个完全独特的创造物。所以，获得他自己独特的誓言似乎与传说和我们今后的发展方向非常一致。”

paras.en: King believes such creative license ultimately honors the Green Lantern authors that preceded the Lanterns team. “None of them said, ‘I just want to copy the person before me.’ So to honor that legacy and creativity, you have to push the ball a little farther,” King said.
paras.zh: 金认为，这样的创意许可最终是为了向《绿灯侠》团队之前的《绿灯侠》作者致敬。 “他们没有人说，‘我只是想复制我之前的人。’因此，为了尊重这一遗产和创造力，你必须把球推得更远，”金说。

paras.en: Certain corners of the internet did not react well to Hal Jordan, historically the most popular Green Lantern, being murdered in the series premiere. Personally, I never sweated the story choice because Halogram seemed like a permanently clever way of keeping Chandler employed in the DCU going forward. But now that Hal’s backup consciousness has been overwritten with John’s, many Hal Jordan fans will likely cling to Sinestro’s offer back on Antaan’s planet to bring him back to life “for real.” Still, it was likely a desperate gambit from a manipulative alien who would do or say anything to free himself from his newest prison.
paras.zh: 互联网上的某些角落对历史上最受欢迎的绿灯侠哈尔·乔丹在该剧首映中被谋杀反应不佳。就我个人而言，我从不担心故事的选择，因为全息图似乎是让钱德勒在 DCU 继续工作的永久聪明方法。但现在哈尔的后备意识已经被约翰的覆盖了，许多哈尔·乔丹的粉丝可能会坚持塞尼斯特罗重返安坦星球的提议，让他“真正”复活。尽管如此，这很可能是一个控制欲强的外星人的孤注一掷的策略，他会做任何事或说任何话来将自己从新的监狱中解救出来。

paras.en: Another question of mine made the cut at the press conference regarding what alternate routes and destinations were considered. “I don’t think there was ever really another ending,” Mundy said in response. He did recall writing some unfilmed material that enabled John to catch Bernadette up to speed on Hal, but then Lindelof chimed in to make clear what everyone wanted to know. There was never a resurrection in store for Hal, something a number of fans felt was signed, sealed and delivered based on the early 2000s comic Green Lantern: Rebirth.
paras.zh: 我的另一个问题在新闻发布会上被削减，涉及考虑哪些替代路线和目的地。 “我不认为还有其他结局，”蒙迪回应道。他确实记得写了一些未拍摄的材料，使约翰能够赶上伯纳黛特对哈尔的了解，但随后林德洛夫插话澄清了每个人都想知道的事情。哈尔从未复活，许多粉丝认为这是根据 2000 年代初的漫画《绿灯侠：重生》签名、密封和交付的。

paras.en: “The ending of the pilot is that Hal Jordan is dead, and in the very early days, we knew that we didn’t want it to be a fake-out,” Lindelof said. “In order for all of the emotional progression to feel real and earned and lived, we were sticking to that, and there wasn’t going to be a rug-pull.”
paras.zh: “试播集的结局是哈尔·乔丹死了，在很早的时候，我们就知道我们不希望它是假的，”林德洛夫说。 “为了让所有的情感进展都感觉真实、值得、生活，我们坚持这一点，并且不会出现拖拉。”

paras.en: As for other potential candidates to kill Hal, Mundy nominated Kerry during the early stages, and she stuck from then on. The more important issue was portraying Kerry’s wrongful act without the audience losing sympathy for her and her precarious situation as a loving mother to a Manhunter. “We wrestled early with the idea of not wanting her to feel duplicitous. Was there a way for her to love Hal and also kill him?” Lindelof said. “And as three married men [co-writing this show], we were like, ‘Absolutely! 1,000 percent.’ The show started to become less of a whodunit and more of a why-done-it.”
paras.zh: 至于杀死哈尔的其他潜在候选人，蒙迪在早期阶段提名了克里，从那时起她就坚持了下来。更重要的问题是在描绘凯瑞的错误行为的同时，又不让观众失去对她的同情，以及她作为一名猎人的慈母的不稳定处境。 “我们一开始就想不想让她感到口是心非。有没有办法让她既爱哈尔，又杀了他？”林德洛夫说道。 “作为三个已婚男人（共同创作这个节目），我们的反应是，‘绝对！百分之千。’这个节目开始变得不再是一部侦探小说，而更像是一个为什么这么做的故事。”

paras.en: Mundy’s season-two writers room has been underway for several months now. He told THR during the August press junket that he’d soon be going in to pitch season two to DC Studios brass James Gunn and Peter Safran. But as of the evening of Oct. 4, no official green light has been announced, nor did the finale press event address the future. That said, a recent report that the series averages 19 million overall viewers per episode bodes well in this era where even renewed shows are no longer safe. Time will also tell how Skydance’s impending acquisition of Warner Bros. Television, HBO and DC Studios affects matters.
paras.zh: 蒙迪的第二季编剧室已经开工几个月了。他在 8 月份的新闻发布会上告诉 THR，他很快就会向 DC 工作室的铜管詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 推销第二季。但截至 10 月 4 日晚，官方尚未宣布开绿灯，压轴新闻发布会也未提及未来。尽管如此，最近的一份报告称，该剧每集平均观众人数为 1,900 万，这在这个连续订节目都不再安全的时代是个好兆头。时间还将告诉我们 Skydance 即将收购华纳兄弟电视台、HBO 和 DC Studios 会产生怎样的影响。

paras.en: Perhaps the most impactful line of the series thus far was Hal’s final line in his self-written eulogy, which John read aloud at his funeral: “I hope I mattered.” As co-writer of that sixth episode, Lindelof adds further context that gets to the heart of what Lanterns season one hoped to accomplish. “What I think Hal is saying is, ‘I hope I mattered to you.’ And that’s transmitting directly to John.”
paras.zh: 迄今为止，该系列中最有影响力的台词也许是哈尔自写的悼词中的最后一句台词，约翰在他的葬礼上大声朗读了这句话：“我希望我很重要。”作为第六集的联合编剧，林德洛夫添加了更多背景信息，触及《灯笼》第一季希望实现的核心目标。 “我认为哈尔所说的是，‘我希望我对你很重要。’这句话直接传递给约翰。”

paras.en: Hal wasn’t intending to satisfy vanity or ego.
paras.zh: 哈尔无意满足虚荣心或自我意识。

paras.en: “It’s not, ‘I hope I mattered because I saved the world from a giant fucking alien starfish. It’s not, ‘I want there to be statues built of me. I need my name to be on an arch or monument,’” Lindelof explained from Hal’s perspective. “It’s just, ‘I hope I’m remembered and that I had a significant role in your life.’”
paras.zh: “这不是，‘我希望我很重要，因为我从一只巨大的外星海星手中拯救了世界。这不是，‘我希望那里有我的雕像。我需要我的名字出现在拱门或纪念碑上，’”林德洛夫从哈尔的角度解释道。 “只是，‘我希望大家记住我，希望我在你的生活中扮演重要的角色。’”

paras.en: Lindelof concludes with a fitting sentiment: “I hope that the audience feels like the show mattered and that Hal mattered to them as well.”
paras.zh: 林德洛夫以恰当的观点总结道：“我希望观众觉得这部剧很重要，哈尔对他们来说也很重要。”

paras.en: Lanterns season one is now streaming in full on HBO Max.
paras.zh: 《灯笼》第一季现已在 HBO Max 上完整播出。

articles.title: John Oliver Has Re-Acquired Russell Crowe’s Iconic Jock Strap
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: Russell Crowe‘s jock strap is back in John Oliver’s possession once again.
paras.zh: 罗素·克劳 (Russell Crowe) 的护身带再次回到约翰·奥利弗 (John Oliver) 手中。

paras.en: This marks the third time the Last Week Tonight host has taken ownership of the undergarment that Crowe wore in 2005’s Cinderella Man.
paras.zh: 这标志着《上周今夜秀》主持人第三次拥有克劳在 2005 年《灰姑娘男人》中所穿内衣的所有权。

paras.en: Here’s the backstory: In 1028, Oliver bought the item at an auction Crowe called “The Art of the Divorce.” He put up more than 200 items for sale in the wake of his divorce from Danielle Spencer.
paras.zh: 背景故事是这样的：1028 年，奥利弗在克罗举办的一场名为“离婚的艺术”的拍卖会上买下了这件物品。与丹妮尔·斯宾塞离婚后，他出售了 200 多件物品。

paras.en: Following the auction, Crowe told Good Morning Britain that the jock strap turned out to be “one of the most popular items” leading up to the event.
paras.zh: 拍卖结束后，克罗告诉《早安英国》，护体带成为了此次活动前“最受欢迎的物品之一”。

paras.en: “It was my jock strap when I won the heavyweight championship of the world as the character James J. Braddock in the film Cinderella Man,” he said. “I put it in the collection as a piece of whimsy and a bit of a gag. Funny enough, it’s garnered a lot of attention.”
paras.zh: “当我在电影《灰姑娘男人》中扮演詹姆斯·J·布拉多克一角，赢得世界重量级冠军时，就是我的护身带，”他说。 “我把它放在这个系列中，是因为我有点奇思妙想，也有点搞笑。有趣的是，它引起了很多关注。”

paras.en: Of course, it also drew the attention of Last Week Tonight, which purchased it for $7,000 (in addition to some other items). Oliver and his staff then donated it to the last remaining Blockbuster Video store in Anchorage, Alaska, to help boost their business. The store put it on display but then closed in the summer of 2018.
paras.zh: 当然，它也引起了 Last Week Tonight 的注意，该杂志以 7,000 美元的价格购买了它（还有其他一些商品）。奥利弗和他的员工随后将其捐赠给阿拉斯加安克雷奇最后一家百视达音像店，以帮助促进他们的业务。该商店曾将其展出，但随后于 2018 年夏季关闭。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Crowe said he donated the profits to the Australia Zoo, which said it would use the money to fund the “John Oliver Koala Chlamydia Ward.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，克罗表示，他将利润捐赠给了澳大利亚动物园，该动物园表示将用这笔钱资助“约翰奥利弗考拉衣原体病房”。

paras.en: After the Anchorage Blockbuster closed, the jockstrap found its way back to Oliver toward the end of 2018. Crowe even appeared in a sketch with the item.
paras.zh: 安克雷奇大片关闭后，这款护体裤在 2018 年底又回到了奥利弗手中。克罗甚至还出现在与该物品的草图中。

paras.en: Last Week Tonight staffers then put it up auction again in 2025 to help raise funds for public TV and radio stations, with the item fetching $21,000 from an anonymous buyer.
paras.zh: 《上周今夜秀》的工作人员随后于 2025 年再次将其拍卖，以帮助为公共电视台和广播电台筹集资金，该物品从一位匿名买家手中拍出了 21,000 美元的价格。

paras.en: It found its way back to auction again in August of this year, and the jock strap was purchased by an unknown buyer for $10,000 at yet another auction. It turns out that buyer was the Last Week Tonight team.
paras.zh: 今年 8 月，它再次重返拍卖场，在另一场拍卖会上，一位不知名的买家以 10,000 美元的价格买下了这条护身带。原来买家是《上周今夜秀》团队。

paras.en: Oliver revealed this news on Sunday’s Last Week Tonight during a story on the Secret Service. Oliver explained the agency’s “zero fail” mission and compared that to his own show’s mission.
paras.zh: 奥利弗在周日的《上周今晚》的特勤局报道中透露了这一消息。奥利弗解释了该机构的“零失败”使命，并将其与他自己的节目的使命进行了比较。

paras.en: “If [they] fail, it can change the course of history, a level of pressure I truly cannot fathom,” he said. “I’m pretty confident the historical legacy of this show will be a few hundred thousand dollars for food banks, a koala chlamydia ward, and whatever the fuck is going on with Russell Crowe’s jockstrap right now.
paras.zh: “如果（他们）失败，可能会改变历史进程，这是我真正无法理解的压力，”他说。 “我非常有信心，这部剧的历史遗产将是为食品银行、考拉衣原体病房以及拉塞尔·克劳的护体裤现在他妈的发生了什么事提供数十万美元。

paras.en: “Because, quick update: After we auctioned the jockstrap off at the end of last year, in aid of public media, it was apparently put up for auction again in August, where, I’m happy to tell you: It sold for $10,000. And the reason I know that is, of course we fucking bought it back.”
paras.zh: “因为，快速更新：去年年底我们在公共媒体的帮助下拍卖了下体护体后，它显然在八月份再次被拍卖，我很高兴地告诉你：它以 10,000 美元的价格出售。我知道这一点的原因是，我们当然把它买回来了。”

paras.en: He brought out the undergarment and then addressed it directly: “I cannot wait to find out where you’re gonna go next.”
paras.zh: 他拿出内衣，直接说道：“我迫不及待地想知道你接下来要去哪里。”
