paras.en: He and backrow partner Jermaine McEwan call themselves “The Bruise Crew” and they’ll have as many as they dished out while prop Cody Hopwood made 46 tackles which is more than his age (20) and his number of NRL appearances (18) combined.
paras.zh: 他和后排搭档 Jermaine McEwan 称自己为“The Bruise Crew”，他们将尽可能多地铲球，而道具 Cody Hopwood 则完成 46 次铲断，这比他的年龄 (20 岁) 和他在 NRL 出场次数 (18 次) 的总和还多。

paras.en: Ponga was their best and not just for his try. His defence was stellar; he threw himself into collisions and refused to give up on anything.
paras.zh: 庞加是他们最好的球员，而不仅仅是他的尝试。他的防守非常出色；他全身心投入到碰撞中，拒绝放弃任何事情。

paras.en: The captain – and he is the captain now, when once he was just the bloke who led them onto the field – was close to tears at the end of the match.
paras.zh: 队长——他现在是队长，曾经他只是带领他们走上球场的人——在比赛结束时几乎流下了眼泪。

paras.en: His people left the ground in the horrible daze that comes only when the greatest prize has been ripped from your hands, but they could not have asked for more from their team.
paras.zh: 他的人民在可怕的茫然中离开了地面，只有当最伟大的奖品从你手中被夺走时才会出现，但他们不能向他们的团队要求更多。

paras.en: The Knights could have played better – a couple of passes were loose and some of their work under the high ball wasn’t great — but it is difficult to imagine a way they could have fought harder.
paras.zh: 骑士队本来可以打得更好——有几次传球松散，而且他们在高球下的一些工作也不是很好——但很难想象他们还能打得更努力。

paras.en: They cannot take a premiership trophy home, but they can take plenty of hope.
paras.zh: 他们无法将英超奖杯带回家，但他们可以抱有很大的希望。

paras.en: The future might feel like it doesn’t matter now but between the young forwards, the return of Dylan Brown, Trey Mooney, Jacob Saifiti and Phoenix Crossland combined with Newcastle, it makes it very unlikely they’ll have to wait another 25 years for another shot.
paras.zh: 未来可能现在看起来并不重要，但在年轻前锋迪伦·布朗、特雷·穆尼、雅各布·赛菲蒂和菲尼克斯·克罗斯兰的回归以及纽卡斯尔的年轻前锋之间，他们不太可能需要再等 25 年才能再次射门。

paras.en: But you never know. Each chance at a premiership can be the last.
paras.zh: 但你永远不知道。每一次担任首相的机会都可能是最后一次。

paras.en: That’s why it’s important, if they were fated to go down, that they did it like this, why men of steel and coal had to leave a little piece of themselves out there.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么重要的是，如果他们注定要失败，那么他们这样做是很重要的，为什么钢铁和煤炭的人必须留下自己的一小部分在那里。

paras.en: Their city will be proud of them. Their people will be proud of them.
paras.zh: 他们的城市将为他们感到骄傲。他们的人民将为他们感到骄傲。

paras.en: There is little glory in defeat, but after a game like that, there is no shame either.
paras.zh: 失败没有什么荣耀，但在这样的一场比赛之后，也没有什么可耻的。

articles.title: Verstappen ends drought with win, Russell retires with five laps to go

paras.en: Max Verstappen has secured his first win of the Formula 1 season, as Kimi Antonelli extended his drivers' championship advantage.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 赢得了他在一级方程式赛季的首场胜利，基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 扩大了他的车手冠军优势。

paras.en: Antonelli finished second, while teammate and title rival George Russell suffered a suspected power unit failure with five laps to go.
paras.zh: 安东内利获得第二名，而队友兼冠军竞争对手乔治·拉塞尔在还剩五圈时遭遇疑似动力装置故障。

paras.en: Formula 1 heads to Singapore for the next race of the season on Sunday, October 11.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车将于 10 月 11 日（星期日）前往新加坡参加本赛季的下一场比赛。

paras.en: Max Verstappen's long wait for another Formula 1 race win is finally over, and the drivers' championship race might be over, too.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘对另一场一级方程式比赛胜利的漫长等待终于结束了，车手冠军争夺战也可能结束了。

paras.en: Verstappen took his first victory of an often-frustrating year for the four-time champion at Formula 1's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，维斯塔潘在马来西亚举行的一级方程式巴林大奖赛上，为四届冠军维斯塔潘赢得了这常常令人沮丧的一年中的第一场胜利。

paras.en: A retirement for George Russell handed a huge title boost to Kimi Antonelli.
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔的退役给基米·安东内利带来了巨大的冠军提升。

paras.en: Verstappen was leading from Antonelli and Russell behind the safety car with five laps to go when Russell suddenly pulled over in his Mercedes.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在安全车后面领先于安东内利和拉塞尔，还剩五圈时，拉塞尔突然将他的奔驰车靠边停车。

paras.en: Antonelli further stretched his lead over teammate Russell from 66 points to 84, with seven races remaining on the schedule, including those in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 安东内利进一步将他对队友拉塞尔的领先优势从66分扩大到84分，赛程还剩七场比赛，包括卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛。

paras.en: Mercedes told Antonelli over the radio it appeared Russell had suffered a power unit problem.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯通过无线电告诉安东内利，拉塞尔似乎遇到了动力装置问题。

paras.en: Antonelli finished second and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton passed Verstappen's Red Bull teammate Isack Hadjar for third.
paras.zh: 安东内利获得第二名，法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿超越维斯塔潘的红牛队友伊萨克·哈贾尔获得第三名。

paras.en: Four-time champion Verstappen had not won since the final race of last season, but upgrades to his Red Bull car made him competitive again in Malaysia this week.
paras.zh: 四届冠军维斯塔潘自上赛季最后一场比赛以来就没有获胜过，但他的红牛赛车的升级使他本周在马来西亚再次具有竞争力。

paras.en: "Good job guys, wow," he told the team over the radio, thanking them for a "fantastic weekend".
paras.zh: “干得好，伙计们，哇，”他通过广播对团队说，感谢他们度过了一个“美妙的周末”。

paras.en: The first wet-weather race for F1 in 2026 started more than 90 minutes later than planned.
paras.zh: F1 2026 年首场雨天比赛比原计划晚了 90 多分钟开始。

paras.en: The start was first delayed 40 minutes for heavy rain, then suspended again when cars had apparent software problems on the formation lap.
paras.zh: 发车先是因大雨推迟了 40 分钟，随后由于赛车在暖胎圈出现明显的软件问题而再次暂停。

paras.en: When it finally did get underway, Verstappen was slow off the line and lost places to Antonelli and Russell. He chased down Russell and then got past Antonelli in a side-by-side fight after a safety-car restart.
paras.zh: 当比赛最终开始时，维斯塔潘下线速度缓慢，位置被安东内利和拉塞尔抢走。他追上了拉塞尔，然后在安全车重新启动后在并肩战斗中超越了安东内利。

paras.en: After Verstappen took the win, he had another small delay before hearing his anthem. Crowd chants filled an awkward silence as Verstappen waited on the top step of the podium before the Dutch anthem finally began.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘获胜后，他在听到国歌之前又稍稍延迟了一些。在荷兰国歌最终开始之前，维斯塔潘在领奖台的最高一级台阶上等待，人群的呼喊声充满了尴尬的沉默。

paras.en: The race was relocated because of the Iran war, becoming F1's first event at the Sepang circuit in Malaysia since 2017.
paras.zh: 该赛事因伊朗战争而搬迁，成为自2017年以来F1首次在马来西亚雪邦赛道举行的赛事。

paras.en: Hamilton's third place capped a remarkable recovery for the seven-time champion and ends a run of five races without a podium finish for the Italian team.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿的第三名结束了这位七届冠军的显着复苏，并结束了意大利车队连续五场比赛没有登上领奖台的记​​录。

paras.en: It seemed almost impossible early in the race as Hamilton, and his teammate Charles Leclerc, were near the back of the pack. Ferrari had gambled on sending them to the start on dry-weather tyres as the track began to dry after rain, causing Hamilton to drop from second to near the back.
paras.zh: 在比赛初期，这似乎几乎是不可能的，因为汉密尔顿和他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔几乎处于落后位置。由于赛道在雨后开始变干，法拉利决定让他们使用干燥天气的轮胎起跑，导致汉密尔顿从第二位跌至接近后面的位置。

paras.en: Leclerc also overtook Hadjar late on to follow Hamilton into fourth place, as Hadjar ended up fifth. Oscar Piastri was sixth for McLaren after a punchy late battle with Liam Lawson of Racing Bulls, who was seventh after racing near the front at the start.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔也在晚些时候超越了哈贾尔，追随汉密尔顿进入第四位，而哈贾尔最终排名第五。迈凯轮车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里 (Oscar Piastri) 在与公牛队 (Racing Bulls) 的利亚姆·劳森 (Liam Lawson) 进行了一场激烈的较量后，获得了第六名，而后者在发车时就接近前方，获得了第七名。

paras.en: Fernando Alonso was eighth in Aston Martin's best result of the season, Lando Norris ninth after going off-track and losing places, with Lawson's teammate Arvid Lindblad 10th.
paras.zh: 费尔南多·阿隆索在阿斯顿·马丁本赛季的最佳成绩中排名第八，兰多·诺里斯在偏离赛道并失去位置后排名第九，劳森的队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德排名第十。

articles.title: Cornell president calls alleged gang rape 'deeply disturbing,' pledges greater transparency

paras.en: Cornell president calls alleged gang rape 'deeply disturbing,' pledges greater transparency
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学校长称轮奸案“令人深感不安”，承诺提高透明度

paras.en: Michael Kotlikoff addressed Cornell community in 8-minute video message
paras.zh: 迈克尔·科特里科夫 (Michael Kotlikoff) 在 8 分钟的视频中向康奈尔大学社区发表讲话

paras.en: Cornell University's president called the alleged gang rape of a student at a fraternity house in 2024 "deeply disturbing" on Saturday, saying it would weigh on the school for years to come and pledging greater transparency amid mounting outrage over the university's purported handling of the case.
paras.zh: 周六，康奈尔大学校长称一名学生于 2024 年在兄弟会所发生的轮奸事件“令人深感不安”，称这将在未来几年给学校带来压力，并承诺在人们对该大学据称处理此案的愤怒日益加剧的情况下提高透明度。

paras.en: In an eight-minute video message to the Cornell community, Michael Kotlikoff described the past week as one of the most difficult in the university's history and acknowledged troubling questions about the investigations that followed the allegations.
paras.zh: 在向康奈尔大学社区发布的八分钟视频信息中，迈克尔·科特里科夫将过去的一周描述为该大学历史上最困难的一周之一，并承认有关指控后调查的令人不安的问题。

paras.en: "My heart aches when I think of what she experienced," Kotlikoff said. "It raises heartbreaking and troubling issues about sexual assault, dehumanization and aspects of party culture, alcohol and drug use."
paras.zh: “当我想到她所经历的事情时，我的心很痛，”科特里科夫说。 “它提出了性侵犯、非人化以及政党文化、酗酒和吸毒等方面的令人心碎和令人不安的问题。”

paras.en: Kotlikoff reaffirmed his commitment to supporting an independent review of Cornell's handling of the case called for by New York Gov. Kathy Hochul and said the school's board of trustees would announce details next week. He also expressed support for Hochul's decision to turn the criminal investigation over to the state attorney general.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫重申，他致力于支持纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）呼吁对康奈尔大学处理此案进行独立审查，并表示学校董事会将于下周宣布细节。他还表示支持霍楚尔将刑事调查移交给州总检察长的决定。

paras.en: "I want to acknowledge something that can be difficult for an institution to say," Kotlikoff said. "We don't have all the answers, but we are committed to investigating and finding the answers our community deserves."
paras.zh: “我想承认一些对于一个机构来说可能很难说出来的事情，”科特里科夫说。 “我们没有所有的答案，但我们致力于调查并找到我们社区应得的答案。”

paras.en: Scrutiny has mounted in recent days over Cornell's response to allegations that the woman was sexually assaulted by multiple fraternity members in 2024. The woman, identified in court documents as Jane Doe, has sued the university and seven former students.
paras.zh: 最近几天，人们对康奈尔大学对有关该女子在 2024 年遭到多名兄弟会成员性侵犯的指控的回应进行了越来越多的审查。法庭文件中称该女子为无名氏 (Jane Doe)，她已起诉该大学和七名前学生。

paras.en: During a student assembly hearing Thursday that gave students an opportunity to voice concerns and discuss proposals to improve Cornell's response to sexual assault, several speakers called for Kotlikoff's resignation.
paras.zh: 周四举行的学生集会听证会上，学生们有机会表达担忧并讨论改善康奈尔大学对性侵犯应对措施的建议，几位发言者呼吁科利科夫辞职。

paras.en: Hochul, asked at a news conference Friday whether she believed Kotlikoff should resign over the university's handling of the case, declined to take a position, saying she did not yet have enough information.
paras.zh: 霍楚尔在周五的新闻发布会上被问及她是否认为科特利科夫应该因大学处理此案的方式而辞职时，她拒绝表明立场，称她还没有足够的信息。

paras.en: Kotlikoff acknowledged frustration that Cornell has not communicated enough, saying that has led to distrust. While citing "real legal and privacy limits" on what the university can disclose, he pledged greater transparency and more opportunities for students, parents and others to engage with university leaders.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫承认康奈尔大学没有充分沟通感到沮丧，并表示这导致了不信任。他在援引大学可披露信息的“真正的法律和隐私限制”的同时，承诺提高透明度，为学生、家长和其他人提供更多与大学领导接触的机会。

paras.en: He also committed Cornell's support to legislative efforts to change New York's sexual assault laws.
paras.zh: 他还承诺康奈尔大学支持改变纽约性侵犯法的立法努力。

paras.en: The case has renewed scrutiny of a state law that makes it difficult to prosecute sexual assaults involving people who voluntarily consume alcohol or drugs, even if they became too intoxicated to consent.
paras.zh: 此案重新审视了一项州法律，该法律规定很难起诉涉及自愿饮酒或吸毒的人的性侵犯，即使他们喝得酩酊大醉而无法同意。

paras.en: Tompkins County district attorney Matthew Van Houten cited the law in defending his initial decision not to pursue charges, saying the woman's original statement to police described voluntary drug use and sexual activity.
paras.zh: 汤普金斯县地方检察官马修·范·豪顿（Matthew Van Houten）援引法律为他最初不起诉的决定辩护，称该女子最初向警方提供的陈述描述了自愿吸毒和性活动。

paras.en: Critics have long sought to close what they call the "voluntary intoxication loophole," which distinguishes between people incapacitated by drugs administered without their consent and those who voluntarily became intoxicated. Hochul has pledged to push for changes to the law.
paras.zh: 批评者长期以来一直试图堵住他们所谓的“自愿中毒漏洞”，该漏洞区分了因未经同意服用药物而丧失行为能力的人和自愿中毒的人。霍楚尔承诺推动法律修改。

paras.en: Kotlikoff also called for a "serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life," saying Cornell would engage students, alumni and others in examining how to preserve the benefits of Greek life while strengthening accountability and transparency.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫还呼吁“认真审视兄弟会和姐妹会在校园生活中的作用”，并表示康奈尔大学将让学生、校友和其他人共同研究如何在加强问责制和透明度的同时保护希腊生活的好处。

paras.en: "Being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility for our own actions, for how we treat others or for speaking up when someone may be at risk," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“作为一个群体的一部分，永远不会减少个人对自己的行为、对待他人的方式或在有人面临危险时大声疾呼的责任。”

articles.title: Pro-Ukraine governing coalition wins 35% in Latvian election

paras.en: Pro-Ukraine governing coalition wins 35% in Latvian election
paras.zh: 亲乌克兰执政联盟在拉脱维亚大选中赢得35%

paras.en: Vote came amid growing concern about potential Russian aggression
paras.zh: 投票是在人们日益担心俄罗斯潜在侵略的背景下进行的

paras.en: Latvian lawmakers on Sunday planned to begin negotiations to form a new government following a parliamentary election in which pro-Ukraine prime minister Andris Kulbergs's four-party coalition emerged with 35 per cent of the vote.
paras.zh: 拉脱维亚立法者周日计划在议会选举后开始谈判组建新政府，亲乌克兰总理安德里斯·库尔伯格的四党联盟以 35% 的选票当选。

paras.en: A political crisis in May over the handling of stray drones suspected of coming from Ukraine brought down the governing coalition that had been under strain over several other issues. The parliament, or Saeima, then approved the coalition led by Kulbergs of the centrist United List party, previously in opposition.
paras.zh: 五月，因处理疑似来自乌克兰的流浪无人机而引发的政治危机，导致执政联盟因其他几个问题而面临压力。随后，议会（Saeima）批准了由此前反对派的中间派联合名单党库尔伯格领导的联盟。

paras.en: Latvia, like its Baltic neighbours Lithuania and Estonia, strongly supports Ukraine in its fight against Moscow’s invasion. It borders both Russia and Moscow-allied Belarus.
paras.zh: 拉脱维亚与波罗的海邻国立陶宛和爱沙尼亚一样，大力支持乌克兰对抗莫斯科的入侵。它与俄罗斯和莫斯科盟友白俄罗斯接壤。

paras.en: Saturday’s vote came as the small republic on NATO’s eastern flank contends with growing concern about potential Russian aggression.
paras.zh: 周六的投票是在北约东翼的小共和国对俄罗斯潜在侵略日益担忧的情况下进行的。

paras.en: The election saw a voter turnout above 51 per cent, according to election data. Nearly 1.56 million people in the nation of more than 1.8 million were entitled to choose the 100 members of the single-chamber Saeima for a four-year term.
paras.zh: 根据选举数据，此次选举的选民投票率超过 51%。全国超过 180 万人口中的近 156 万人有权选出单院议会的 100 名成员，任期四年。

paras.en: The United List party is expected to take 42 seats in parliament, and a multiparty coalition will be needed to govern in a splintered political landscape. Parties must take at least five per cent of the vote to win parliamentary seats.
paras.zh: 联合名单党预计将在议会中占据 42 个席位，并且需要一个多党联盟来在分裂的政治格局中进行执政。政党必须获得至少百分之五的选票才能赢得议会席位。

articles.title: Russia to intensify strikes on Ukraine after Zelenskyy remarks, defence ministry says

paras.en: Russia to intensify strikes on Ukraine after Zelenskyy remarks, defence ministry says
paras.zh: 国防部称，泽连斯基发表言论后，俄罗斯将加强对乌克兰的打击

paras.en: Ukraine will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称乌克兰将加倍攻击俄罗斯炼油厂

paras.en: Russia will intensify strikes on targets in Kyiv and other regions of Ukraine following recent remarks by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the Russian Defence Ministry said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周日表示，继乌克兰总统泽连斯基最近发表讲话后，俄罗斯将加强对基辅和乌克兰其他地区目标的打击。

paras.en: The ministry said Russian forces would step up attacks on military facilities, defence industry sites and related infrastructure in Kyiv and elsewhere in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 国防部表示，俄罗斯军队将加大对基辅和乌克兰其他地方的军事设施、国防工业场所和相关基础设施的攻击力度。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told Reuters in an interview that Ukraine will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries in response to a new policy of airstrikes by Moscow designed to force people to abandon Kyiv and other cities, but will not target civilians.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在接受路透社采访时表示，乌克兰将加大力度攻击俄罗斯炼油厂，以回应莫斯科新的空袭政策，旨在迫使人们放弃基辅和其他城市，但不会针对平民。

paras.en: 3 injured in drone fire at industrial site, authorities say
paras.zh: 当局称工业现场无人机起火造成3人受伤

paras.en: Meanwhile, a fire broke out at an industrial site in Russia's Krasnodar region after falling drone debris struck the site in the Temryuk district, regional authorities said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯克拉斯诺达尔地区当局周日表示，坠落的无人机碎片击中了特姆留克地区的一处工业场地，引发火灾。

paras.en: Three people were injured and were receiving medical treatment, while emergency services were working at the scene.
paras.zh: 三人受伤并正在接受治疗，紧急服务人员正在现场工作。

articles.title: UK remands 2 Iranians over alleged antisemitic terror plot

paras.en: Two Iranian nationals charged with plotting acts of terrorism against the United Kingdom's Jewish community were remanded in custody by a court in London on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，两名被控策划针对英国犹太社区实施恐怖主义行为的伊朗国民被伦敦一家法院还押。

paras.en: The pair were detained on September 20, the eve of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
paras.zh: 两人于 9 月 20 日被拘留，即犹太历中最神圣的赎罪日前夕。

paras.en: The case only came to light on Friday when the two men were charged, just days after another terror plot, which the UK has linked to Iran, was foiled.
paras.zh: 此案直到周五才曝光，两名男子被指控，而就在几天前，另一起英国认为与伊朗有关的恐怖阴谋被挫败。

paras.en: Prosecutor Mark Luckett told Westminster Magistrates' Court that Rahman S., 34, and Salam A., 36, are accused of carrying out "hostile reconnaissance" on Jewish targets in Manchester, northern England.
paras.zh: 检察官马克·卢克特 (Mark Luckett) 告诉威斯敏斯特地方法院，34 岁的拉赫曼 S. (Rahman S.) 和 36 岁的萨拉姆 A. (Salam A.) 被指控对英格兰北部曼彻斯特的犹太人目标进行“敌对侦察”。

paras.en: He said the two men planned to use a "homemade explosive device" and had allegedly been in contact with a third party, an Iranian national, most likely operating from within Iran.
paras.zh: 他说，这两个人计划使用“自制爆炸装置”，并据称与第三方（一名伊朗国民）接触，该第三方很可能在伊朗境内运作。

paras.en: The contact is alleged to have given the pair instructions on how to put together a homemade device from chlorine and brake fluid, the court heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，这名联系人据称向两人提供了如何用氯和制动液组装自制装置的指导。

paras.en: Luckett said the two suspects had used online resources, including images, plans and maps, to identify and research potential attack sites.
paras.zh: 卢克特表示，两名嫌疑人利用图像、计划和地图等在线资源来识别和研究潜在的攻击地点。

paras.en: He told the court that the targets included the Manchester Jewish Museum and the Heaton Park synagogue, where two Jewish worshippers were killed in a knife attack a year ago on Friday.
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，目标包括曼彻斯特犹太博物馆和希顿公园犹太教堂，一年前的周五，两名犹太礼拜者在一次持刀袭击中丧生。

paras.en: The two Iranian suspects had arrived in Britain in small boats that crossed the English Channel from mainland Europe, Luckett added.
paras.zh: 卢克特补充说，两名伊朗嫌疑人乘坐小船从欧洲大陆穿越英吉利海峡抵达英国。

paras.en: One had been granted asylum, while the other's application is still pending, the court heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，其中一人已获得庇护，而另一人的申请仍在审理中。

paras.en: The pair did not enter a plea and were remanded in custody until their next hearing at London's Old Bailey on October 23.
paras.zh: 两人没有提出抗辩，并被还押候审，直到 10 月 23 日在伦敦老贝利举行下一次听证会。

paras.en: Vicki Evans, senior national coordinator of counterterror policing, said the plot was believed to be isolated and there was no ongoing public threat.
paras.zh: 国家反恐警务高级协调员维琪·埃文斯表示，据信该阴谋是孤立的，不存在持续的公共威胁。

paras.en: Police find no link to RAF Fairford plot
paras.zh: 警方发现与英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋没有任何联系

paras.en: Evans also said the Manchester plot was "not connected in any way" to the suspected terror plot at RAF Fairford last weekend, which Prime Minister Andy Burnham said showed "strong indications" of Iranian involvement.
paras.zh: 埃文斯还表示，曼彻斯特的阴谋与上周末在皇家空军费尔福德发生的涉嫌恐怖阴谋“没有任何联系”，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，这表明“强烈迹象”表明伊朗参与其中。

paras.en: Also on Saturday, police said a dual British-Iranian national, arrested on Thursday in connection with the RAF Fairford plot, was released on police bail.
paras.zh: 同样在周六，警方表示，周四因与英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋有关而被捕的一名英国和伊朗双重国籍人士已获警方保释。

paras.en: The 25-year-old was the sixth person arrested and then bailed as the investigation continues.
paras.zh: 这名 25 岁的男子是第六名被捕者，随后随着调查的继续而被保释。

paras.en: Police said the five other men held are all British nationals in their 20s and from London.
paras.zh: 警方称，另外五名被拘留的男子都是来自伦敦的 20 多岁英国公民。

paras.en: Police uncovered the RAF Fairford plot when a farmer spotted suspicious white vans near the base early on Sunday morning and called the authorities. Officers found petrol inside the vans, but no explosives.
paras.zh: 周日清晨，一名农民在基地附近发现可疑的白色货车，并向当局报警，警方发现了英国皇家空军费尔福德基地的阴谋。警方在货车内发现了汽油，但没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: UK media reported this week that one of the suspects dialled the police about an hour earlier, though that has not been confirmed.
paras.zh: 英国媒体本周报道称，其中一名嫌疑人大约一小时前打电话给警方，但这一消息尚未得到证实。

paras.en: Tehran has rejected as baseless accusations of targeting RAF Fairford, which lies 90 miles (145 kilometers) west of London and has been used by US bombers to strike Iran.
paras.zh: 德黑兰否认针对英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地的指控，称其毫无根据。该基地位于伦敦以西 90 英里（145 公里）处，曾被美国轰炸机用来袭击伊朗。

paras.en: The UK remains on high alert for potential threats from Russia and Iran.
paras.zh: 英国仍对来自俄罗斯和伊朗的潜在威胁保持高度警惕。

paras.en: Iran has previously used proxies to commit crimes on British soil, including repeated attacks and plots against Jewish targets, as well as against dissidents.
paras.zh: 伊朗此前曾利用代理人在英国领土上犯下罪行，包括针对犹太目标以及持不同政见者的多次袭击和阴谋。

paras.en: Antisemitic attacks more broadly have risen sharply since Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列以来，更广泛的反犹太主义袭击急剧增加。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Pakistan vs. Afghanistan: From allies and neighbors to war

paras.en: On Thursday night, Pakistan attacked targets in Afghanistan. The results of that attack are disputed. The Taliban, the Islamic fundamentalist nationalist movement that controls Afghanistan, says that between nine and 10 civilians were killed, including women and children. But Pakistan claims the strike killed 22 militants and destroyed weapons and ammunition depots.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，巴基斯坦袭击了阿富汗境内的目标。这次攻击的结果存在争议。控制阿富汗的伊斯兰原教旨主义民族主义运动塔利班表示，有 9 至 10 名平民被杀，其中包括妇女和儿童。但巴基斯坦声称此次空袭打死了 22 名武装分子，并摧毁了武器和弹药库。

paras.en: These early October attacks are just the latest escalation in a conflict between the two countries that reignited mid-September, after months of comparative calm.
paras.zh: 十月初的这些袭击只是两国冲突的最新升级，冲突在经历了几个月的相对平静之后于九月中旬重新燃起。

paras.en: The conflict was sparked again after a series of attacks on Pakistani security forces. On September 18, an attack on a police compound in the northwestern city of Kohat resulted in the deaths of 31 people and more than 100 injured. A splinter group belonging to the Pakistani Taliban, also known as Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan, or TTP, claimed responsibility for the attack in Kohat, in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, bordering Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦安全部队遭受一系列袭击后，冲突再次引发。 9月18日，西北部城市科哈特一处警察大院遭到袭击，造成31人死亡、100多人受伤。巴基斯坦塔利班的一个分支组织（也称为巴基斯坦塔利班运动，TTP）声称对发生在与阿富汗接壤的开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省科哈特的袭击事件负责。

paras.en: Pakistan accused Afghanistan of providing the TTP with a safe haven. Afghanistan denies this but clashes at the border and then airstrikes by Pakistan followed.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦指责阿富汗为跨太平洋伙伴关系提供了避风港。阿富汗否认这一点，但边境发生冲突，随后巴基斯坦发动空袭。

paras.en: The TTP in Pakistan is not the same as Afghanistan's Taliban. Although it does have close ideological and personnel ties to the Afghan Taliban, it is an independent organization that fights the Pakistani state.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦的TTP与阿富汗的塔利班不一样。尽管它确实与阿富汗塔利班有密切的意识形态和人员联系，但它是一个与巴基斯坦国家作战的独立组织。

paras.en: Many of its fighters sided with the Taliban during that country's long-running insurgency against international and US troops. This is why, after the Taliban returned to power in 2021, the TTP gained more room and more leverage. This has meant that Afghanistan — a former ally of Pakistan — has increasingly become a threat to its neighbor.
paras.zh: 在该国针对国际部队和美军的长期叛乱期间，许多武装分子站在塔利班一边。这就是为什么2021年塔利班重新掌权后，TTP获得了更大的空间和更大的筹码。这意味着巴基斯坦的前盟友阿富汗日益成为其邻国的威胁。

paras.en: Pakistan has asked the Taliban to take action against the TTP, but the close connection between the two make this difficult.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦已要求塔利班对TTP采取行动，但两者之间的密切联系使这一行动变得困难。

paras.en: "Because of these personal connections and networks, it is extremely difficult for the Afghan Taliban to break away," says Conrad Schetter, director of the Bonn International Center for Conflict Studies, or BICC.
paras.zh: 波恩国际冲突研究中心（BICC）主任康拉德·谢特（Conrad Schetter）表示：“由于这些个人关系和网络，阿富汗塔利班很难脱离。”

paras.en: The connections don't mean that the Taliban has any control over the TTP. There are certainly historical connections between the two, but Schetter doesn't believe that equals any sort of strong, direct influence.
paras.zh: 这些联系并不意味着塔利班对 TTP 有任何控制。两者之间确实存在历史联系，但谢特认为这并不等于任何形式的强大、直接影响。

paras.en: "The Taliban are simply not prepared to take orders from Islamabad," adds Thomas Ruttig, co-director of the Afghanistan Analysts Network, a think tank working between Kabul and Berlin. "They won't let anyone outside interfere."
paras.zh: “塔利班根本不准备接受伊斯兰堡的命令，”在喀布尔和柏林之间工作的阿富汗分析网络联合主任托马斯·鲁蒂格补充道。 “他们不会让外界任何人干涉。”

paras.en: This means the Pakistani policy of supporting the Taliban in order to gain influence in Afghanistan hasn't worked.
paras.zh: 这意味着巴基斯坦支持塔利班以在阿富汗获得影响力的政策并没有奏效。

paras.en: There's also another older conflict that has an impact on the current situation. This involves what is known as the Durand Line, drawn in 1893 by a British diplomat and an Afghan emir to mark spheres of influence between British India and Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 还有另一场较早的冲突对当前局势产生了影响。其中包括所谓的杜兰德线，该线由一位英国外交官和一位阿富汗埃米尔于 1893 年绘制，用于标记英属印度和阿富汗之间的势力范围。

paras.en: The current border between Afghanistan and Pakistan follows the Durand Line and also divides an area on both sides, homeland to Pashtuns, who make up the largest ethnic group in Afghanistan and second largest in Pakistan.
paras.zh: 目前阿富汗和巴基斯坦之间的边界沿着杜兰德线，并在双方之间划分了一个地区，该地区是普什图人的家园，普什图人是阿富汗最大的族群，也是巴基斯坦第二大族群。

paras.en: So the border dispute here isn't just about territory, it's also about identity.
paras.zh: 因此，这里的边界争端不仅仅是领土问题，还涉及身份问题。

paras.en: "Ethnic and nationalist elements play a significant role in the conflict," Schetter tells DW. Many Pashtuns still refuse to accept the border that the Durand Line created.
paras.zh: “种族和民族主义因素在冲突中发挥着重要作用，”谢特告诉德国之声。许多普什图人仍然拒绝接受杜兰德线所划定的边界。

paras.en: In Pakistan, the country's long-running rivalry with India also plays a part. A friendly Afghanistan would have been advantageous for Pakistan. But India has also strengthened its ties to the Taliban.
paras.zh: 在巴基斯坦，该国与印度的长期竞争也起到了一定作用。一个友好的阿富汗对巴基斯坦来说是有利的。但印度也加强了与塔利班的联系。

paras.en: "While Islamabad once viewed Afghanistan as a source of 'strategic depth' in its rivalry with India, it now increasingly views its north-western neighbor as a liability," an analysis by British think tank Chatham House notes.
paras.zh: 英国智库查塔姆研究所的一项分析指出，“虽然伊斯兰堡曾经将阿富汗视为与印度竞争的‘战略纵深’来源，但现在它越来越多地将其西北邻国视为一种负担。”

paras.en: Pakistan still has power over Afghanistan, though. As a landlocked country, Afghanistan relies on trade routes through neighboring countries, and Pakistan in particular. Pakistan can use border closures and trade restrictions to exert pressure even as the Taliban regime is trying to reduce dependence on Pakistan and find new economic and political partners.
paras.zh: 不过，巴基斯坦仍然对阿富汗拥有权力。作为一个内陆国家，阿富汗依赖邻国，特别是巴基斯坦的贸易路线。即使塔利班政权试图减少对巴基斯坦的依赖并寻找新的经济和政治伙伴，巴基斯坦也可以利用边境关闭和贸易限制来施加压力。

paras.en: Trade and security considerations are now becoming tangled. Pakistan has held talks with the TTP that were mediated by the Taliban and ceasefires were agreed upon. Talks between Pakistan and Afghanistan also took place. But none of the temporary agreements resolved the crucial question of how to prevent attacks on Pakistan from Afghan territory.
paras.zh: 贸易和安全考虑现在变得纠缠在一起。在塔利班的斡旋下，巴基斯坦与 TTP 举行了会谈，并达成了停火协议。巴基斯坦和阿富汗之间也举行了会谈。但这些临时协议都没有解决如何防止从阿富汗领土袭击巴基斯坦的关键问题。

paras.en: So in parallel with diplomacy, Pakistan has also been relying on economic and political pressure, for example, by closing borders and restricting trade and by sending Afghan refugees back into Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 因此，在外交努力的同时，巴基斯坦还一直依靠经济和政治压力，例如关闭边界和限制贸易以及将阿富汗难民送回阿富汗。

paras.en: An analysis by the US-based Council on Foreign Relations notes that the Taliban are worried that if they crack down on the TTP too hard, they will drive the group towards another extremist militant group, the Islamic State in Khorasan Province or IS-K. This group opposes the Taliban.
paras.zh: 总部位于美国的外交关系委员会的一项分析指出，塔利班担心，如果他们对TTP打击过于严厉，他们将把该组织推向另一个极端主义武装组织——呼罗珊省伊斯兰国（IS-K）。该组织反对塔利班。

paras.en: The conflict recently escalated to another level. At the end of September, Kabul reported 28 killed and 32 captured fighters who had infiltrated Afghanistan from Nuristan province, Pakistan. The Taliban accused Pakistan of supporting its armed opponents, something Pakistan has denied.
paras.zh: 最近，冲突升级到另一个级别。 9月底，喀布尔报告称，从巴基斯坦努里斯坦省渗透到阿富汗的武装分子有28人死亡、32人被俘。塔利班指责巴基斯坦支持其武装反对派，但巴基斯坦对此予以否认。

paras.en: "It is known from past decades that Pakistan has regularly supported armed groups on the Afghan side — for example, the Mujahideen during the Soviet occupation and later the Taliban," Ruttig points out. "What's new though is that Pakistan apparently also supports parts of today's armed anti-Taliban opposition."
paras.zh: 鲁蒂格指出：“过去几十年来，众所周知，巴基斯坦经常支持阿富汗方面的武装团体，例如苏联占领期间的圣战者组织和后来的塔利班。” “不过，新的情况是，巴基斯坦显然也支持当今部分武装反塔利班反对派。”

paras.en: This is turning the dispute over the TTP into a larger conflict in which both sides accuse each other of supporting armed groups from the other's territory.
paras.zh: 这使得 TTP 争端变成了一场更大的冲突，双方都指责对方支持对方领土上的武装团体。

paras.en: British think tank Chatham House speaks of a significant escalation compared to previous border skirmishes. Worryingly, a conflict over armed groups and border incidents is turning into a direct confrontation between the two nation states.
paras.zh: 英国智库查塔姆研究所表示，与之前的边境冲突相比，局势显着升级。令人担忧的是，武装团体和边境事件的冲突正在演变成两个民族国家之间的直接对抗。

paras.en: Ruttig believes that it would be possible to contain the spiraling violence if both sides return to negotiations.
paras.zh: 鲁蒂格认为，如果双方重返谈判，就有可能遏制不断升级的暴力事件。

paras.en: "If both sides were willing to return to the negotiating table — perhaps with international mediation —there would be ways to contain the conflict and, above all, to protect the civilian population on both sides," he argues.
paras.zh: 他认为：“如果双方愿意重返谈判桌——或许通过国际调解——就会有办法遏制冲突，最重要的是保护双方的平民。”

paras.en: In a late September commentary in Pakistani weekly magazine The Friday Times, Pakistani analyst Saqib Ali Khan advocates for several things that could ease the tensions. That includes a reliable channel between Islamabad and Kabul, a separate approach for armed groups and greater involvement of the population along the border.
paras.zh: 在巴基斯坦周刊《星期五时报》九月下旬的一篇评论中，巴基斯坦分析家萨奇布·阿里·汗主张采取几项可以缓解紧张局势的措施。这包括伊斯兰堡和喀布尔之间的可靠通道、武装团体的单独行动以及边境沿线民众的更多参与。

paras.en: The conflict, he argues, is not merely a dispute between two governments but also a security, border, economic and regional conflict.
paras.zh: 他认为，这场冲突不仅仅是两国政府之间的争端，也是安全、边界、经济和地区冲突。

paras.en: "Along those lines, there would have to be a shift in perspective on both sides," Schetter concludes.
paras.zh: “沿着这些思路，双方的观点都必须转变，”谢特总结道。

paras.en: In the long term, greater economic integration is also needed, he adds, so that Pakistan and Afghanistan do not define their relationship solely through security and power issues.
paras.zh: 他补充说，从长远来看，还需要更大程度的经济一体化，这样巴基斯坦和阿富汗就不会仅仅通过安全和权力问题来定义他们的关系。

paras.en: This story was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初以德语发表。

articles.title: Bosnia-Herzegovina votes amid divisive campaigns, EU bid

paras.en: Polling began in Bosnia and Herzegovina on Sunday, with around 3.4 million voters eligible to take part in the Balkan country's general election.
paras.zh: 周日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那开始投票，约有 340 万选民有资格参加这个巴尔干国家的大选。

paras.en: Citizens are electing officials across multiple tiers of government, including members of the multiethnic, tripartite presidency.
paras.zh: 公民正在选举各级政府的官员，包括多民族、三方总统的成员。

paras.en: They will also choose lawmakers for the federal parliament and the heads of institutions for the country's two largely autonomous entities — the Muslim-Croat Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Serb-run Republika Srpska.
paras.zh: 他们还将选举联邦议会的议员以及该国两个基本上自治的实体——波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那穆斯林克族联邦和塞族管理的斯普斯卡共和国——的机构负责人。

paras.en: The election comes at a time when the country is struggling with a number of challenges. There's been an economic slowdown, sluggish progress toward EU membership, and a long-drawn-out political gridlock, with the ethnically based dominant parties from the two entities repeatedly stalling decisions by the weak central government that links them.
paras.zh: 此次选举正值该国面临诸多挑战之际。经济放缓，加入欧盟的进程缓慢，政治僵局旷日持久，两个实体中以种族为基础的占主导地位的政党一再拖延将它们联系在一起的软弱中央政府的决定。

paras.en: The election will see adversary ethnic parties, the Bosniak SDA, Serb SNSD and Croat HDZ BiH, pitted against multi-ethnic opposition coalitions led by the Social Democratic Party.
paras.zh: 选举中，波什尼亚克社会民主党、塞尔维亚少女社会党和克罗地亚民主自由党等敌对少数民族政党将与社会民主党领导的多民族反对派联盟展开对决。

paras.en: Polls close at 7 p.m. local time (1700 GMT), with preliminary results expected to be released late Sunday.
paras.zh: 投票于晚上 7 点结束当地时间（1700 GMT），初步结果预计将于周日晚间公布。

paras.en: What is the system that governs Bosnia-Herzegovina?
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的统治制度是什么？

paras.en: The economic, administrative and political responsibilities in Bosnia and Herzegovina are divided between the multiethnic central government, the self-governing neutral Brcko district and the two semi-autonomous entities.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的经济、行政和政治责任由多民族中央政府、自治中立布尔奇科区和两个半自治实体承担。

paras.en: Both entities are further split into several cantons and communities.
paras.zh: 这两个实体进一步分为几个州和社区。

paras.en: The complicated framework — divided along ethnic lines — was set up during the US-brokered 1995 Dayton Peace Accords, following the 1992-95 Bosnian war which was triggered by the breakup of Yugoslavia.
paras.zh: 这个按照种族划分的复杂框架是在美国斡旋的 1995 年《代顿和平协定》期间建立的，此前南斯拉夫解体引发了 1992-95 年波斯尼亚战争。

paras.en: Currently in Bosnia and Herzegovina's populace, around half are Muslim Bosniaks, while 31% are Orthodox Serb and 15% are Catholic Croat.
paras.zh: 目前，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的人口中，大约一半是穆斯林波斯尼亚人，31% 是东正教塞尔维亚人，15% 是天主教克罗地亚人。

paras.en: The country has been peaceful in recent years but its ethnonationalist parties have kept the divisions alive even as voters say they want to move on from the war-era rhetoric and division.
paras.zh: 该国近年来一直很和平，但其民族主义政党却让分歧持续存在，尽管选民表示他们希望摆脱战争时代的言论和分歧。

paras.en: Milorad Dodik not on the ballot but still dominant in Republika Srpska
paras.zh: 米洛拉德·多迪克（Milorad Dodik）未参加选票，但在塞族共和国仍占主导地位

paras.en: In Republika Srpska, secessionist leader Milorad Dodik of the SNSD party remains the key figure despite not being on the ballot.
paras.zh: 在塞族共和国，少女社会党的分离主义领导人米洛拉德·多迪克尽管没有参加投票，但仍然是关键人物。

paras.en: Dodik, the former president of the Serb-majority entity, is barred from holding public office for six years after being convicted of defying the top international envoy overseeing the 1995 peace process.
paras.zh: 塞族占多数的实体前总统多迪克因藐视监督 1995 年和平进程的最高国际特使而被定罪，六年内不得担任公职。

paras.en: Dodik-backed Savo Minic is running for the Republika Srpska's presidency.
paras.zh: 多迪克支持的萨沃·米尼奇正在竞选塞族共和国总统。

paras.en: Dodik wants close ties with Serbia and Russia. He has just returned from Moscow where he met Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 多迪克希望与塞尔维亚和俄罗斯建立密切关系。他刚刚从莫斯科回来，在那里会见了俄罗斯总统普京。

paras.en: "Bosnia and Herzegovina is dead, it is an impossible country," Dodik told supporters at the final rally of his in Banja Luka on Friday.
paras.zh: “波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那已经死了，这是一个不可能的国家，”多迪克周五在巴尼亚卢卡举行的最后一次集会上对支持者说。

paras.en: What is happening in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina?
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦正在发生什么？

paras.en: In the Muslim-Croat federation, Bosniak parties are advocating for a stronger central state.
paras.zh: 在穆斯林-克罗地亚联邦中，波斯尼亚克族政党主张建立一个更强大的中央政府。

paras.en: The main Bosniak SDA party is focused on efforts to keep the country united against Serb separatism.
paras.zh: 波什尼亚克斯坦主要政党 SDA 致力于保持国家团结，反对塞族分裂主义。

paras.en: Bosnian Croats are also largely backing their ethnic parties, including the Bosnian branch of Croatia's ruling conservative Croatian Democratic Union.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚克族也主要支持他们的少数民族政党，包括克罗地亚执政的保守派克罗地亚民主联盟的波斯尼亚分支。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Denis Becirovic, the incumbent Bosniak presidency member, has vowed a renewed path to the EU and NATO.
paras.zh: 与此同时，现任波什尼亚克主席国成员丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇发誓要开辟通往欧盟和北约的新道路。

paras.en: Bosnia and Herzegovina has been a candidate for EU membership since 2022.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那自 2022 年以来一直是欧盟成员国候选国。

paras.en: But the actual start of membership talks depends on the prior implementation of numerous reforms, including strengthening judicial oversight and passing anti-corruption laws.
paras.zh: 但成员谈判的实际启动取决于多项改革的事先实施，包括加强司法监督和通过反腐败法。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您就可以始终首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Philippines arrests 244 suspects in online scam crackdown

paras.en: Philippine authorities have arrested more than 200 foreign workers, mostly Chinese, in their biggest crackdown this year on illegal offshore gaming operators.
paras.zh: 菲律宾当局在今年对非法离岸博彩运营商进行的最大规模打击行动中逮捕了 200 多名外国工人，其中大部分是中国人。

paras.en: The country’s Immigration Bureau reported late on Saturday that military and other law enforcement agencies had raided two addresses on the southern Philippine island of Mindanao on Friday. Criminal gangs are accused of using Philippine offshore gaming operators (POGOs) as cover for various crimes.
paras.zh: 该国移民局周六晚间报告称，军方和其他执法机构周五突击搜查了菲律宾南部棉兰老岛的两个地址。犯罪团伙被指控利用菲律宾离岸博彩运营商（POGO）作为各种犯罪活动的掩护。

paras.en: The raid on one site resulted in the arrest of 110 Chinese citizens, two Cambodians and a Hong Kong resident, according to the bureau’s statement.
paras.zh: 根据该局的声明，对一个地点的突击搜查导致 110 名中国公民、两名柬埔寨人和一名香港居民被捕。

paras.en: A further 131 foreign citizens were arrested at the second site. Again, the majority were Chinese, alongside citizens of Malaysia, Indonesia and Myanmar, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 另有 131 名外国公民在第二个地点被捕。声明称，其中大多数是中国人，还有马来西亚、印度尼西亚和缅甸公民。

paras.en: Authorities seized large quantities of computer equipment, mobile phones, laptops and SIM cards.
paras.zh: 当局查获了大量电脑设备、手机、笔记本电脑和 SIM 卡。

paras.en: Manila banned POGOs in 2024 on the grounds that crime groups use them as a cover for human trafficking, money laundering, kidnappings, fraud and murder.
paras.zh: 马尼拉于 2024 年禁止网络博彩公司，理由是犯罪集团利用它们作为人口贩运、洗钱、绑架、欺诈和谋杀的掩护。

paras.en: A 2023 United Nations report noted that in recent years hundreds of thousands of people have been trafficked by gangs and forced to work in scam centres and other illegal online operations across Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 联合国 2023 年的一份报告指出，近年来，东南亚各地有数十万人被犯罪团伙拐卖，被迫在诈骗中心和其他非法在线场所工作。

paras.en: The UN report estimated that at least 120,000 people across Myanmar and approximately 100,000 in Cambodia may be trapped in scam operations, with other criminal-owned enterprises in Laos, the Philippines and Thailand ranging from crypto-fraud to online gambling.
paras.zh: 联合国报告估计，缅甸至少有 12 万人、柬埔寨约有 10 万人可能陷入诈骗活动，老挝、菲律宾和泰国的其他犯罪企业也从事从加密货币诈骗到在线赌博等各种活动。

paras.en: The Philippine government is investigating potential human trafficking-related offences by several of those arrested in the latest raids, while the rest will be deported.
paras.zh: 菲律宾政府正在调查在最近的突袭中被捕的几名人员可能犯下的与人口贩运相关的罪行，其余人将被驱逐出境。

paras.en: International concern has grown in recent years over similar scam operations in other Asian nations, where trafficking victims are tricked or coerced into promoting bogus cryptocurrency investments and other cons.
paras.zh: 近年来，国际社会对其他亚洲国家的类似诈骗活动越来越关注，这些国家的人口贩运受害者被欺骗或胁迫推销虚假的加密货币投资和其他骗局。

paras.en: “We will continue to enforce our immigration laws against foreign nationals who violate the conditions of their stay and ensure that the Philippines is not used as a base for illegal activities,” immigration chief Joel Viado said in the statement.
paras.zh: 移民局局长乔尔·维亚多（Joel Viado）在声明中表示：“我们将继续对违反逗留条件的外国人执行我们的移民法，并确保菲律宾不被用作非法活动的基地。”

paras.en: Chinese embassy spokesperson Ji Lingpeng told the AFP news agency that they are “reaching out to the Philippine law enforcement agencies on the details of this case”.
paras.zh: 中国大使馆发言人吉令鹏告诉法新社，他们正在“就此案的细节与菲律宾执法机构联系”。

paras.en: “Chinese law prohibits any form of gambling, including Chinese nationals gambling overseas or working for gambling companies,” he added.
paras.zh: “中国法律禁止任何形式的赌博，包括中国公民在海外赌博或为赌博公司工作，”他补充道。

articles.title: US and Man City’s Cavan Sullivan becomes youngest international goalscorer

paras.en: Cavan Sullivan became the youngest US international goalscorer in history as the United States defeated archrivals Mexico 3-0 in a friendly international in Arizona on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六在亚利桑那州举行的一场友谊赛中，美国队以 3-0 击败宿敌墨西哥队，卡万·沙利文成为美国历史上最年轻的国际进球球员。

paras.en: Sullivan, who is poised to join English Premier League side Manchester City next year, netted a superbly taken goal in the 62nd minute to double the USA lead at the State Farm Stadium in Glendale.
paras.zh: 沙利文将于明年加盟英超球队曼城，他在第 62 分钟打入精彩进球，将美国队在格伦代尔州立农场体育场的领先优势扩大一倍。

paras.en: At 17 years and five days, Sullivan beat Mathis Albert’s five-day-old record as the youngest US goalscorer.
paras.zh: 沙利文以 17 岁零 5 天的成绩打破了马西斯·阿尔伯特 (Mathis Albert) 保持五天之久的纪录，成为美国最年轻的进球者。

paras.en: Albert, aged 17 and 31 days, scored during Tuesday’s 4-2 defeat of Chile.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯特现年 17 岁又 31 天，在周二 4-2 击败智利的比赛中进球。

paras.en: “These are the moments you dream of when you’re three, four, five or six-years-old,” Sullivan said.
paras.zh: “当你三岁、四岁、五岁或六岁时，这些都是你梦想的时刻，”沙利文说。

paras.en: “I manifested this moment, not just these past couple of hours when I found out I was starting, but my whole life,” he added.
paras.zh: “我体现了这一刻，不仅仅是我发现自己开始的过去几个小时，而是我的一生，”他补充道。

paras.en: Sullivan’s strike came after another teenager — 18-year-old Julian Hall — had given Mauricio Pochettino’s side the lead in the 28th minute.
paras.zh: 沙利文的进球是在另一名青少年——18岁的朱利安·霍尔——在第28分钟为毛里西奥·波切蒂诺的球队取得领先之后发生的。

paras.en: Hall’s goal was his third in as many games since being handed his international debut by US coach Pochettino in last week’s defeat of Peru. Hall also scored in the victory over Chile.
paras.zh: 霍尔的进球是他自上周击败秘鲁队的比赛中由美国教练波切蒂诺上演国际首秀以来，他在多场比赛中的第三个进球。霍尔在战胜智利的比赛中也取得进球。

paras.en: The loss puts more pressure on Mexico coach Rafael Marquez, who is still seeking his first win since taking over following the World Cup.
paras.zh: 这场失利给墨西哥队主教练拉斐尔·马克斯带来了更大的压力，他仍在寻求世界杯后接任以来的首场胜利。

paras.en: Mexico dominated possession and territory early on but were unable to find a way through a well-organised United States defence.
paras.zh: 墨西哥队一开始就占据了控球权和领土，但无法突破美国组织严密的防守。

paras.en: Instead, it was the hosts who took the lead just before the half-hour mark with a superbly worked goal from Hall.
paras.zh: 相反，主队在半小时前凭借霍尔的精彩进球取得了领先。

paras.en: Gio Reyna surged into the penalty area to collect a pass from Alex Freeman and ghosted past Mexico midfielder Erik Lira to reach the byline.
paras.zh: 吉奥·雷纳冲入禁区接亚历克斯·弗里曼的传球，鬼鬼祟祟地越过墨西哥中场球员埃里克·利拉到达边线。

paras.en: Reyna’s low cross was parried away by Mexico goalkeeper Raul Rangel, but only as far as Hall, who lashed in from close range to make it 1-0.
paras.zh: 雷纳的低传被墨西哥门将劳尔·兰格尔挡出，但只传到霍尔近距离射门，1-0。

paras.en: Mexico’s best chance came early in the second half when Roberto Alvarado’s rasping shot from the edge of the area was tipped over the bar by US goalkeeper Diego Kochen.
paras.zh: 墨西哥队的最佳机会出现在下半场初期，罗伯托·阿尔瓦拉多在禁区边缘的大力射门被美国门将迭戈·科亨击中横梁。

paras.en: Pochettino’s side doubled their lead on 62 minutes when Sullivan’s persistence in chasing down a long ball was rewarded after Rangel mishit a pass to the American outside his area.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺的球队在第 62 分钟将领先优势扩大了一倍，兰格尔在禁区外向美国人传球失误，沙利文坚持追赶长传球得到了回报。

paras.en: Sullivan coolly took his time and chipped home from long range to make it 2-0.
paras.zh: 沙利文冷静地从容地远射破门，将比分改写为2-0。

paras.en: “I just remember chipping the ball, hoping it didn’t hit the crossbar or go over,” Sullivan said of his strike. “I was getting nervous when it was in the air and then everything was a blur.”
paras.zh: “我只记得将球切入，希望它没有击中横梁或越过，”沙利文谈到他的进球时说道。 “当它在空中时，我感到很紧张，然后一切都变得模糊了。”

paras.en: A miserable night for Mexico got worse shortly afterwards when substitute Luis Chavez was shown a red card for shoving a hand into the face of Sebastian Berhalter in the 68th minute.
paras.zh: 墨西哥队的悲惨之夜不久之后变得更糟，替补出场的路易斯·查韦斯在第 68 分钟将手推到塞巴斯蒂安·贝哈尔特的脸上而被出示红牌。

paras.en: The United States completed the scoring in the 84th minute when Malik Tillman latched onto a poor Mexico backpass and smashed a shot into the top corner for 3-0.
paras.zh: 美国队在第84分钟完成进球，马利克·蒂尔曼接到墨西哥队糟糕的回传后将球射入球门上角，3-0。

articles.title: Air strike in Sudan kills UN aid truck driver: WFP

paras.en: An air strike on United Nations trucks has killed a driver in Sudan’s South Kordofan, according to the UN’s World Food Programme (WFP).
paras.zh: 据联合国世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）称，苏丹南科尔多凡州的联合国卡车空袭导致一名司机死亡。

paras.en: The WFP said in a statement released on Sunday that the trucks, carrying food aid, were “clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles” as they came under attack. The agency did not identify those responsible.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署在周日发布的一份声明中表示，这些运载粮食援助的卡车在受到攻击时“被明确标记为人道主义车辆”。该机构没有透露责任人的身份。

paras.en: The strike hit the convoy on Saturday as it was travelling between two cities controlled by the government’s Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) in South Kordofan state.
paras.zh: 周六，车队在南科尔多凡州政府苏丹武装部队（SAF）控制的两个城市之间行驶时遭到袭击。

paras.en: Fighting in the Kordofan region intensified in late 2025, turning the territory into a strategic battleground between the SAF and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF). The two have been fighting for control of Sudan in a civil war that has now lasted more than three years.
paras.zh: 2025 年底，科尔多凡地区的战斗愈演愈烈，该地区成为苏丹武装部队和准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间的战略战场。两国一直在争夺苏丹的控制权，内战已持续三年多。

paras.en: The extent of the damage and additional details regarding the attack on WFP aid trucks are still being assessed. The UN agency said that it has called for an investigation.
paras.zh: 损失程度和有关粮食计划署援助卡车遇袭的更多细节仍在评估中。该联合国机构表示，已要求进行调查。

paras.en: “These incidents underscore the increasingly challenging security environment in Sudan and the risks that aid workers face when delivering life-saving assistance to communities in need,” the statement reads.
paras.zh: 声明称：“这些事件凸显了苏丹日益严峻的安全环境，以及援助人员在向有需要的社区提供救生援助时面临的风险。”

paras.en: Since the war began in April 2023, one in five attacks in Sudan has occurred in the Kordofan region. The army has the upper hand in the north, having made a series of recent gains, while the RSF maintains control over much of the west. South Kordofan remains contested.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 4 月战争爆发以来，苏丹五分之一的袭击事件发生在科尔多凡地区。军队在北部占据上风，最近取得了一系列进展，而无国界医生组织则保持着对西部大部分地区的控制。南科尔多凡州仍然存在争议。

paras.en: Both the SAF and RSF have increasingly deployed drones in their war, with attacks on towns in North Kordofan growing more frequent and deadly, and civilian infrastructure coming under attack across the region.
paras.zh: 苏丹武装部队和无国界部队都越来越多地在战争中部署无人机，对北科尔多凡州城镇的袭击变得更加频繁和致命，整个地区的民用基础设施都受到攻击。

paras.en: The civil war has forcibly displaced 14 million people, plunging the country into one of the worst modern food crises and killing tens of thousands of people.
paras.zh: 内战迫使 1400 万人流离失所，使该国陷入现代最严重的粮食危机之一，并造成数万人死亡。

paras.en: Nearly 19.5 million people – about 41 percent of Sudan’s population – were struggling with acute food crises between February and May, according to an Integrated Food Security Phase Classification assessment, a leading authority on global hunger. More than five million faced extreme, life-threatening food shortages, and 135,000 were at risk of famine.
paras.zh: 全球饥饿问题权威机构综合粮食安全阶段分类评估显示，2 月至 5 月期间，近 1,950 万人（约占苏丹人口的 41%）陷入严重粮食危机。超过 500 万人面临严重的、危及生命的粮食短缺，135,000 人面临饥荒的风险。

articles.title: Lula or Bolsonaro? Some Brazilian voters say they don't want either
articles.author: Tara Neill

paras.en: Lula or Bolsonaro? Some Brazilian voters say they don't want either
paras.zh: 卢拉还是博尔索纳罗？一些巴西选民表示他们也不想要

paras.en: Brazil's election enters its final day of campaigning as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro make their last pitches to voters. Brazilians explain what worries them, and why some still can't choose.
paras.zh: 巴西大选进入竞选活动的最后一天，卢拉和弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗向选民进行最后的宣传。巴西人解释了他们担心的事情，以及为什么有些人仍然无法选择。

paras.en: Voters in Brazil go to the polls tomorrow. They face a familiar lineup on their ballots as they pick a president to lead Latin America's largest country. It's a rematch between a veteran leftist, the current president, and the son of a former far-right president who's trying to keep his conservative evangelical movement alive.
paras.zh: 巴西选民明天将前往投票站。当他们选出一位总统来领导这个拉丁美洲最大的国家时，他们的选票上面临着熟悉的阵容。这是一位资深左派、现任总统和一位前极右翼总统的儿子之间的重赛，后者试图保持保守的福音派运动的活力。

paras.en: The contest comes at a time when the Trump administration is exerting more influence and military might in Latin America, a region that has recently shifted to the right. If polls are correct, Brazil's presidential race is expected to be very close. For what's at stake for Brazil and for the world, we are joined by our South America correspondent Carrie Kahn, who is in Rio de Janeiro. Good evening, Carrie.
paras.zh: 这场竞赛正值特朗普政府在拉丁美洲这个最近右倾的地区施加更大的影响力和军事力量之际。如果民意调查正确，巴西总统竞选预计将非常接近。对于巴西和世界的利害关系，我们请驻里约热内卢的南美记者卡丽·卡恩 (Carrie Kahn) 与我们一起探讨。晚上好，嘉莉。

paras.en: NADWORNY: So on the eve of the vote, tell us what we should know about this election.
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：那么在投票前夕，请告诉我们关于这次选举我们应该了解什么。

paras.en: KAHN: First off, the weather isn't cooperating. It's been nonstop rain here, casting a bit of gray gloom in Rio. The Christ the Redeemer statue and the dramatic Sugarloaf Mountain that's just behind me have been shrouded in fog most of the day. So we're really hoping for sun on voting day.
paras.zh: KAHN：首先，天气不配合。这里一直下着雨，给里约蒙上了一层灰暗的气氛。基督救世主雕像和我身后引人注目的糖面包山一天大部分时间都笼罩在雾气中。所以我们真的希望投票日能有阳光。

paras.en: But back to the ballot, it is a big one. Brazilians will choose new governors, senators and a whole new lower house of Congress. But all eyes are on the presidential race. There are 12 candidates vying for the post in this first round - my favorite, the veterinarian promising free Botox for low-income women.
paras.zh: 但回到选票，这是一项重大选票。巴西人将选出新的州长、参议员和全新的国会下议院。但所有人的目光都集中在总统竞选上。第一轮竞争该职位的候选人有 12 名——我最喜欢的是那位承诺为低收入女性提供免费肉毒杆菌的兽医。

paras.en: NADWORNY: Wow. OK. Back to the front-runners - one is longtime leftist leader and incumbent. Can you tell us about him?
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：哇。好的。回到领先者——其中一位是长期左翼领导人和现任领导人。你能给我们介绍一下他吗？

paras.en: KAHN: Sure. That's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. He is almost 81, and if he wins, this would be his fourth nonconsecutive term as president. He's been posting videos of himself at the gym. He likes to ease voters' concerns about his age. And he has kept up quite a vigorous campaign schedule.
paras.zh: 卡恩：当然。他就是总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦。他已经快81岁了，如果他获胜，这将是他第四次连续担任总统。他一直在发布自己在健身房的视频。他喜欢缓解选民对他年龄的担忧。他一直保持着相当积极的竞选日程。

paras.en: His top rival is a familiar name too - Bolsonaro. But this is Flavio Bolsonaro. His dad, Jair, lost to Lula four years ago and is now under house arrest, convicted for attempting a coup. Jair Bolsonaro has been barred from any participation in this election, but he did appoint or anoint his eldest son, Flavio, to take over the Bolsonaro conservative movement.
paras.zh: 他的头号竞争对手也是一个熟悉的名字——博尔索纳罗。但这是弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。他的父亲贾尔四年前输给了卢拉，目前因企图政变而被软禁。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗被禁止参加这次选举，但他确实任命或指定了他的长子弗拉维奥来接管博尔索纳罗保守派运动。

paras.en: NADWORNY: OK, so the names are the same. But now take us through what voters, analysts and pollsters are telling you about this race.
paras.zh: NADWORNY：好的，所以名字是一样的。现在让我们了解一下选民、分析师和民意调查专家对这场竞选的看法。

paras.en: KAHN: Sure. A few things to keep in mind - Brazil has become, in recent years, a very polarized country, much like the U.S., and this is going to be a very close election. I spent much of last week in Brazil's largest city and financial capital, Sao Paulo, talking to voters.
paras.zh: 卡恩：当然。有几件事需要记住——近年来，巴西已经成为一个非常两极分化的国家，就像美国一样，这将是一场非常势均力敌的选举。上周我花了大部分时间在巴西最大的城市和金融之都圣保罗与选民交谈。

paras.en: KAHN: On Sundays, the main Paulista Avenue is closed to cars. Joggers and families take over, as well as campaigners for Bolsonaro and Lula alike.
paras.zh: 卡恩：周日，保利斯塔主大道禁止车辆通行。慢跑者和家庭以及博尔索纳罗和卢拉的活动人士都接手了。

paras.en: KAHN: The political crowds, however, are smaller than four years ago. Enthusiasm for tomorrow's contest is much lower, and cynicism is high, especially for 45-year-old Carlos Nacli (ph), standing on the large avenue's median.
paras.zh: 卡恩：然而，政治人群比四年前要少。人们对明天比赛的热情要低得多，而愤世嫉俗的情绪也很高，尤其是对于站在大道中央的 45 岁的卡洛斯·纳克利 (Carlos Nacli) 来说。

paras.en: CARLOS NACLI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·纳克利：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: "Voting for Lula and voting for Flavio is voting for the same person," he shouts through a bullhorn. "They're all corrupt," he says. Corruption is top on voters' minds, especially in the last weeks of the race, as revelations came to light that a jailed banker financially backed the Bolsonaros. Supreme Court justices also got caught up in the fray, including one seen as close to Lula.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“投票给卢拉和投票给弗拉维奥就是投票给同一个人，”他通过扩音器喊道。 “他们都很腐败，”他说。腐败是选民最关心的问题，尤其是在竞选的最后几周，因为有消息称一名被监禁的银行家在经济上支持博索纳罗家族。最高法院法官也卷入了这场争斗，其中包括一位被认为与卢拉关系密切的法官。

paras.en: MAURO CONCEPCION: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: MAURO CONCEPCION：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: Mauro Concepcion (ph) is retired and 61 and says he doesn't like either candidate. Neither does his wife, Sandra (ph).
paras.zh: Mauro Concepcion（博士）已退休，现年 61 岁，他表示他不喜欢这两位候选人。他的妻子桑德拉（博士）也没有。

paras.en: KAHN: "Yeah, we're going to have to choose the best one, even though it will still be the worst," she adds. Both say they will wait until they are in the polling booth to make their choice, but for sure, it will not be Lula. I spoke with pollster Yuri Sanches of the firm Atlas Intel based in Rio and asked him about this lack of enthusiasm for both candidates.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“是的，我们必须选择最好的，尽管它仍然是最差的，”她补充道。两人都表示，他们会等到投票站再做出选择，但可以肯定的是，不会是卢拉。我采访了位于里约热内卢的 Atlas Intel 公司的民意调查专家尤里·桑切斯 (Yuri Sanches)，并向他询问了两位候选人缺乏热情的原因。

paras.en: YURI SANCHES: There is not a novelty around Lula anymore, and he's not the Lula who excited people in his triumphal comeback in 2022. He also kind of fails to connect with younger generations or with people online.
paras.zh: 尤里·桑奇斯：卢拉已经不再有新鲜感，他也不再是 2022 年凯旋归来的那个让人们兴奋的卢拉。他也有点无法与年轻一代或网上的人建立联系。

paras.en: KAHN: What about Flavio Bolsonaro? Is he exciting Brazil's right wing?
paras.zh: 卡恩：弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗呢？他让巴西右翼兴奋吗？

paras.en: SANCHES: He was not the candidate that was desired, neither from the political system, -because also from Bolsonaristas (ph). And he's not the most charismatic of the Bolsonaros. Eduardo Bolsonaro, the son that is currently in the United States - he was, in fact, the one that was maybe groomed to be the next Bolsonaro president.
paras.zh: 桑奇斯：他不是政治体系所期望的候选人，因为他也是博索纳里斯塔（博士）的候选人。他并不是博索纳罗家族中最具魅力的人。爱德华多·博尔索纳罗（Eduardo Bolsonaro），目前在美国的儿子——事实上，他可能是被培养成为下一任博尔索纳罗总统的人。

paras.en: KAHN: Eduardo Bolsonaro is facing multiple investigations here in Brazil, which he says are politically motivated, and he's staying put in the U.S. So in the end, Sanchez says about 80% of the electorate is locked in on who they'll vote for, leaving a small group of voters deciding this election. He started calling them the elector pendulum, or Brazil's new swing voter. Thirty-eight-year-old Camila de Zuani (ph) is one of them.
paras.zh: 卡恩：爱德华多·博尔索纳罗在巴西面临多项调查，他说这些调查是出于政治动机，而他仍留在美国。所以最后，桑切斯说，大约 80% 的选民锁定了他们将投票给谁，留下一小部分选民决定这次选举。他开始称他们为选举钟摆，或者巴西的新摇摆选民。三十八岁的卡米拉·德·祖阿尼（Philadelphia de Zuani）就是其中之一。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #3: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#3：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: She's watching TV with her newborn baby girl asleep on her chest in her tiny two-room Sao Paulo apartment. She says she's always voted for conservatives but now is really turned off by how negative this election has been.
paras.zh: 卡恩：在她位于圣保罗的两居室狭小公寓里，她正在看电视，刚出生的女婴睡在胸前。她说她一直投票支持保守派，但现在对这次选举的负面影响感到非常沮丧。

paras.en: CAMILA DE ZUANI: (Non-English langauge spoken).
paras.zh: CAMILA DE ZUANI：（使用非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: "You don't really have a democracy anymore, just a lot of attacks and two individuals yelling at each other," she says. She wants to know how the candidates will tackle crime and stop the robberies in her working class neighborhood.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“现在已经不再是真正的民主国家，只有大量的攻击和两个人互相吼叫，”她说。她想知道候选人将如何解决工人阶级社区的犯罪问题并阻止抢劫。
