articles.title: Subtle change in how you speak could be early sign of dementia risk, new research suggests

paras.en: New research suggests that voice disorders, including shifts in vocal pitch, volume or clarity, could indicate a higher probability of developing dementia or cognitive impairment in the future.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，声音障碍，包括音高、音量或清晰度的变化，可能表明未来患痴呆症或认知障碍的可能性更高。

paras.en: A study involving 833,417 participants aged 50 and older examined the connection between a voice disorder, hearing loss, or both with the chance of developing cognitive impairment or dementia, including Alzheimer’s disease, beginning a year after the voice disorder and hearing loss diagnoses.
paras.zh: 一项涉及 833,417 名 50 岁及以上参与者的研究从诊断出声音障碍和听力损失一年后开始，研究了声音障碍、听力损失或两者兼而有之与罹患认知障碍或痴呆（包括阿尔茨海默病）的可能性之间的关系。

paras.en: The findings from the study, conducted by a team at the Drexel University College of Medicine in Philadelphia, were published in the Journal of Voice.
paras.zh: 这项研究由费城德雷克塞尔大学医学院的一个团队进行，结果发表在《声音杂志》上。

paras.en: Results showed that participants with a voice disorder but no hearing loss had a 58% increased likelihood of developing dementia or cognitive issues in the future, whereas participants with a voice disorder and hearing loss had a 104% chance.
paras.zh: 结果显示，患有发声障碍但没有听力损失的参与者未来患痴呆症或认知问题的可能性增加 58%，而患有发声障碍和听力损失的参与者则有 104% 的可能性。

paras.en: For all participants with voice disorders, with or without hearing loss, there was a 29% increased probability of developing dementia or cognitive impairment, whereas those with only hearing loss had a 27% greater risk.
paras.zh: 对于所有患有声音障碍的参与者，无论是否患有听力损失，患痴呆症或认知障碍的可能性增加了 29%，而仅听力损失的参与者的风险增加了 27%。

paras.en: "We found the strongest link with dementia among patients experiencing a voice disorder and hearing loss," said Robert Sataloff, a professor and chair at the Drexel University College of Medicine, Science Alert reported.
paras.zh: 据《科学警报》报道，德雷塞尔大学医学院教授兼院长罗伯特·萨塔洛夫 (Robert Sataloff) 表示：“我们发现，患有声音障碍和听力损失的患者与痴呆症的联系最为密切。”

paras.en: "Importantly, we found that those with a voice disorder and no hearing loss were at greater risk than patients who experience hearing loss only," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“重要的是，我们发现患有发声障碍但没有听力损失的患者比仅患有听力损失的患者面临更大的风险。”

paras.en: Examples of voice disorders include laryngitis, vocal cord paralysis, vocal cord lesions and spasmodic dysphonia (laryngeal dystonia), among others, according to the Cleveland Clinic.
paras.zh: 据克利夫兰诊所称，声音障碍的例子包括喉炎、声带麻痹、声带病变和痉挛性发声困难（喉肌张力障碍）等。

paras.en: Regardless of the possible correlation between vocal issues and dementia, researchers noted that seeking treatment for a voice disorder could also benefit a patient’s brain.
paras.zh: 不管声音问题和痴呆症之间可能存在相关性，研究人员指出，寻求声音障碍的治疗也可能有益于患者的大脑。

paras.en: Hearing loss and trouble speaking could discourage individuals from socializing with others, and studies have shown that social engagement can stimulate the brain and play a role in warding off dementia.
paras.zh: 听力损失和说话困难可能会阻碍个人与他人交往，研究表明，社交参与可以刺激大脑并在预防痴呆症方面发挥作用。

paras.en: Sataloff said that it’s "only natural" for voice disorders and hearing loss to be connected to cognitive impairment.
paras.zh: 萨塔洛夫说，声音障碍和听力损失与认知障碍有关是“很自然的”。

paras.en: Those who experience pain or discomfort when talking or singing might "participate less often in brain-supporting social or other engaging activities," he noted.
paras.zh: 他指出，那些在说话或唱歌时感到疼痛或不适的人可能“较少参与支持大脑的社交或其他参与活动”。

paras.en: Despite the study's findings, having a voice disorder doesn’t necessarily mean that future cognitive impairment is absolutely certain.
paras.zh: 尽管有研究结果，但患有嗓音障碍并不一定意味着未来肯定会出现认知障碍。

paras.en: Additionally, it’s not guaranteed that vocal issues indicate the beginning of a decline in brain function or the onset of dementia or Alzheimer’s.
paras.zh: 此外，不能保证声音问题表明大脑功能开始下降或痴呆症或阿尔茨海默氏症的发作。

articles.title: One southern state's rise is making it America's new 'economic center of gravity'

paras.en: DALLAS — As companies and capital flow away from traditional financial hubs like New York and California, one southern state is making an increasingly aggressive bid to become America's next financial powerhouse.
paras.zh: 达拉斯——随着公司和资本从纽约和加利福尼亚等传统金融中心流出，南方的一个州正在日益积极地努力成为美国下一个金融强国。

paras.en: Speaking with Fox News Digital from the Texas Stock Exchange's Dallas headquarters, former Congressman Jeb Hensarling, a strategic advisor to the exchange, said Texas is already becoming "the economic center of gravity in America."
paras.zh: 该交易所战略顾问、前国会议员 Jeb Hensarling 在德克萨斯证券交易所达拉斯总部接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时表示，德克萨斯州已经成为“美国的经济重心”。

paras.en: "Texas is really becoming the economic center of gravity in America," Hensarling said.
paras.zh: “德克萨斯州确实正在成为美国的经济重心，”亨萨林说。

paras.en: "As New York is increasingly shoving capital out, Texas is saying, 'You're welcome.' We put out the welcome mat, whereas New York, capital isn't really made to feel at home, and capital wants to go where it's made to feel at home."
paras.zh: “随着纽约越来越多地挤出资本，德克萨斯州却在说，‘不客气。’”我们铺出了欢迎垫，而在纽约，资本并没有真正让人有宾至如归的感觉，而资本却想去那些让人有宾至如归的感觉的地方。”

paras.en: The Texas Stock Exchange, which received Securities and Exchange Commission approval last year, is designed to compete with the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq by giving companies another venue to go public and list their shares.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯证券交易所去年获得美国证券交易委员会的批准，旨在为企业提供另一个上市和上市的场所，与纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克竞争。

paras.en: Supporters say the exchange is the latest sign the Lone Star State is evolving from a destination for corporate relocations into a financial center capable of challenging Wall Street.
paras.zh: 支持者表示，该交易所是孤星州正在从企业搬迁目的地转变为能够挑战华尔街的金融中心的最新迹象。

paras.en: "Texas has been a great place to do business for decades," Hensarling said. "But increasingly, it's a great place to headquarter your business. Over the last couple of legislative sessions, because of laws passed, it's a great place to incorporate your business. And really the last piece of that puzzle was the Texas Stock Exchange, which is now making Texas the best place to list your company and to go public."
paras.zh: “几十年来，德克萨斯州一直是经商的好地方，”亨萨林说。 “但是，它越来越成为企业总部的好地方。在过去的几次立法会议中，由于通过了法律，它是一个注册企业的好地方。实际上，这个难题的最后一块是德克萨斯证券交易所，它现在使德克萨斯州成为您的公司上市和上市的最佳地点。”

paras.en: The exchange has already secured primary listings from companies including Energy Transfer, Dillard's, Sunoco and Texas Capital Bank. Hensarling said backing from major financial firms such as JPMorgan and BlackRock, along with executives recruited from competing exchanges, demonstrates the venture is more than a branding exercise.
paras.zh: 该交易所已获得 Energy Transfer、Dillard's、Sunoco 和 Texas Capital Bank 等公司的主要上市。亨萨林表示，摩根大通和贝莱德等主要金融公司的支持，以及从竞争交易所招募的高管，表明该合资企业不仅仅是一次品牌推广活动。

paras.en: "They don't put their capital in places where they think it's going to lose money," Hensarling said. "It's a lot of validation from the market already."
paras.zh: “他们不会把资金投入到他们认为会亏损的地方，”亨萨林说。 “这已经得到了市场的大量验证。”

paras.en: Hensarling also dismissed criticism that "Y'all Street" is little more than a catchy slogan.
paras.zh: 亨萨林还驳斥了“Y'all Street”只不过是一个朗朗上口的口号的批评。

paras.en: "If it was gimmicky, I'm not really sure the competition would be all of a sudden setting up offices here," he said.
paras.zh: “如果这是噱头，我不太确定竞争对手会突然在这里设立办事处，”他说。

paras.en: Hensarling pointed to the exchange's financial backers, executives recruited from rival exchanges and companies that have chosen Texas as their primary listing as evidence that it has quickly become a credible competitor.
paras.zh: 亨萨林指出，该交易所的财务支持者、从竞争对手交易所招募的高管以及选择德克萨斯州作为主要上市地的公司，证明该交易所已迅速成为一个可靠的竞争对手。

paras.en: Hensarling said the exchange is simply the latest chapter in Texas' broader economic ascent.
paras.zh: 亨萨林表示，这次交流只是德克萨斯州更广泛的经济崛起的最新篇章。

paras.en: "People are coming to Texas because, again, capital is made to feel welcome," he said. "It's an economic juggernaut... all in all, they're coming here because this is where, economically, the action is."
paras.zh: “人们来到德克萨斯州是因为，资本再次受到欢迎，”他说。 “这是一个经济巨头......总而言之，他们来到这里是因为从经济角度来看，这里就是行动所在。”

articles.title: Texas Tech fan claims to find part of Colorado's playbook at hotel bar, shows plays that match opening drive

paras.en: A Texas Tech fan claimed to have found pages from Colorado's playbook left behind at a bar inside the hotel where the Buffaloes were reportedly staying ahead of their home matchup against the Red Raiders. Based on the photos shared on social media, the evidence is rather damning for the Colorado coaching staff.
paras.zh: 一名德克萨斯理工大学的球迷声称在酒店内的一家酒吧里发现了科罗拉多州队比赛手册的几页，据报道，水牛队当时正在酒店与红色袭击者队进行主场比赛。根据社交媒体上分享的照片，证据对科罗拉多州教练组来说是相当严厉的。

paras.en: The fan shared the claims to On3's Inside The Double T message board under the name 'VivaTerlingua' on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五，这位粉丝以“VivaTerlingua”的名义在 On3 的 Inside The Double T 留言板上分享了这一说法。

paras.en: "OK I’m not posting pics of it but a bunch of us are in the Colorado team hotel at the bar and we found a 25 page or so playbook that I would bet large amounts of money on is the actual CU playbook," VivaTerlingua posted. "It’s got opening plays, red zone info, our tendencies, etc., etc."
paras.zh: “好吧，我不会发布它的照片，但我们一群人在科罗拉多队酒店的酒吧里，我们发现了一本 25 页左右的剧本，我敢打赌这就是真正的科罗拉多队剧本，”VivaTerlingua 发帖道。 “它有开场比赛、红区信息、我们的倾向等等。”

paras.en: A person who identified themselves as a "buddy" to the group of people who found the alleged pages of the playbook was not as discreet and shared different videos to Instagram showing different pages that appeared to be the same plays Colorado called early on in the game against Texas Tech.
paras.zh: 一名自称是发现该战术手册页面的一群人的“好友”的人并不那么谨慎，他在 Instagram 上分享了不同的视频，显示了不同的页面，这些页面似乎与科罗拉多州在对阵德克萨斯理工大学的比赛初期所呼吁的战术相同。

paras.en: With photos and videos of the alleged playbook made public, another user on X shared a video early Sunday morning that showed the play sheet, and the first six plays of the game from Colorado's offense appeared to match the pages.
paras.zh: 随着所谓的战术手册的照片和视频被公开，X 上的另一位用户在周日早上分享了一段视频，其中显示了战术表，科罗拉多州进攻队的前六场比赛似乎与页面相符。

paras.en: There is no evidence that anyone on the Texas Tech staff received or even saw a copy of the pages from the alleged playbook, but the Red Raiders were lights out against the Buffaloes' offense on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 没有证据表明德克萨斯理工大学的工作人员中的任何人收到或什至看到了所谓剧本中的页面副本，但红色突袭者队在周六晚上对阵水牛队的进攻中表现不佳。

paras.en: Colorado managed to score on its opening drive of the game, but from then on, the Red Raiders' defense dominated the remainder of the contest.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多队在比赛的开局就取得了进球，但从那时起，红色突袭者队的防守就主导了剩下的比赛。

paras.en: The Buffaloes threw four interceptions in the second half alone, which helped Texas Tech ultimately cruise to a 29-7 victory to move to 5-0 on the season.
paras.zh: 水牛队仅在下半场就完成了四次拦截，帮助德克萨斯理工大学最终以 29-7 获胜，赛季战绩达到 5-0。

paras.en: Despite the fact that, again, there is zero evidence that a Colorado staffer did, in fact, leave a playbook sitting at the hotel bar, the story has taken on a life of its own, and it's not one that puts Colorado head coach Deion Sanders and his program in the brightest of lights amid serious struggles.
paras.zh: 尽管事实上，没有零证据表明科罗拉多州的一名工作人员确实在酒店酒吧留下了一本剧本，但这个故事已经有了自己的生命，并且这并没有让科罗拉多州主教练迪昂·桑德斯和他的计划在严峻的斗争中成为最耀眼的光芒。

paras.en: Colorado fell to 2-3 on the year with the loss to Texas Tech, and the Buffaloes have been outscored 93-27 over their last three games combined.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州今年输给德克萨斯理工大学，战绩为 2 胜 3 负，而水牛队在过去三场比赛中的总得分为 93 胜 27 负。

articles.title: Egyptian journalist faces terrorism charges after entire newsroom detained
articles.author: William Christou in Jerusalem

paras.en: An Egyptian journalist has been charged with joining a terrorist group, days after an entire newsroom was detained in what rights groups have said is a crackdown on press freedoms.
paras.zh: 一名埃及记者被指控加入恐怖组织，几天前整个新闻编辑室被拘留，人权组织称这是对新闻自由的镇压。

paras.en: Last week, authorities arrested six journalists from the independent fact-checking and investigative platform Matsadaash – literally meaning “don’t believe” – accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and publishing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.
paras.zh: 上周，当局逮捕了独立事实核查和调查平台 Matsadaash（字面意思是“不相信”）的六名记者，并在一份声明中指控他们没有执照，并代表被取缔的穆斯林兄弟会发布虚假新闻。

paras.en: The outlet’s six journalists, Abdallah Qadri, Mohamed Ashraf, Mohamed Adel, Islam Barakat, Mohamed Mahmoud and Omar Helal, were arrested by security forces over the course of two days.
paras.zh: 该媒体的六名记者阿卜杜拉·卡德里、穆罕默德·阿什拉夫、穆罕默德·阿德尔、伊斯兰·巴拉卡特、穆罕默德·马哈茂德和奥马尔·赫拉勒在两天内被安全部队逮捕。

paras.en: On Sunday, Egyptian authorities charged Ashraf with joining a terrorist group and spreading false news, according to a statement by the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, a NGO. The charges came after an interrogation that lasted from 10pm to 8am and focused exclusively on material published by Matsadaash, the rights group said.
paras.zh: 根据非政府组织埃及个人权利倡议的一份声明，埃及当局周日指控阿什拉夫加入恐怖组织并散布虚假消息。该权利组织表示，这些指控是在从晚上 10 点持续到早上 8 点进行的审讯之后提出的，审讯的重点是 Matsadaash 发布的材料。

paras.en: Ashraf was to be held for 15 days, pending investigation, while the whereabouts of the other five journalists were still unknown.
paras.zh: 阿什拉夫将被拘留 15 天，等待调查，而其他五名记者仍下落不明。

paras.en: Abdelrahman Mansour, the co-founder of the platform, denied having any association with the Muslim Brotherhood, a transnational movement that was designated a terrorist organisation by Egypt in 2013 after the former president Mohamed Morsi, a senior Brotherhood figure, was ousted in a coup. Mansour called the arrests “one of the gravest attacks on journalism in Egypt’s modern history”.
paras.zh: 该平台联合创始人阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·曼苏尔 (Abdelrahman Mansour) 否认与穆斯林兄弟会有任何关系。穆斯林兄弟会是一个跨国运动，在穆兄会高级人物、前总统穆罕默德·穆尔西 (Mohamed Morsi) 在政变中被赶下台后，该组织于 2013 年被埃及认定为恐怖组织。曼苏尔称这次逮捕是“埃及现代史上对新闻业最严重的攻击之一”。

paras.en: “My colleagues were doing what journalists should do: asking difficult questions, uncovering facts, and reporting on issues that affect people’s lives. They deserve recognition for their work. Instead, their homes were raided, and all six were taken away,” he said. “The government must answer this question: why have you arrested six journalists? What have they done beyond doing their jobs?”
paras.zh: “我的同事们正在做记者应该做的事情：提出难题、揭露事实、报道影响人们生活的问题。他们的工作值得认可。相反，他们的家遭到搜查，六个人全部被带走，”他说。 “政府必须回答这个问题：为什么逮捕六名记者？他们除了尽职之外还做了什么？”

paras.en: The Guardian contacted the Egyptian State Information Service for a comment but did not receive a reply by the time of publishing.
paras.zh: 《卫报》联系了埃及国家信息局请其置评，但截至发稿时尚未收到回复。

paras.en: Dozens of journalists staged a sit-in outside the Egyptian Journalists Syndicate (EJS) in Cairo on Saturday, demanding the release of the Matsadaash staff. Members said they would keep the sit-in open ended until the journalists were released, and the EJS said it would convene an emergency meeting on Monday.
paras.zh: 周六，数十名记者在开罗埃及记者辛迪加（EJS）外静坐，要求释放马萨达什的工作人员。成员们表示，他们将保持静坐，直到记者被释放为止，EJS 表示将在周一召开紧急会议。

paras.en: The EJS had filed a request with the ministry of interior and public prosecutor for the release of the journalists, as well as for information on their whereabouts.
paras.zh: EJS 已向内政部和检察官提出请求，要求释放这些记者并提供有关他们下落的信息。

paras.en: More than 80 rights groups, including Human Rights Watch and the Committee to Protect Journalists, condemned the arrests as a violation of freedoms, and demanded the immediate release of the Matsadaash staff.
paras.zh: 包括人权观察组织和保护记者委员会在内的 80 多个人权组织谴责此次逮捕行动是对自由的侵犯，并要求立即释放 Matsadaash 的工作人员。

paras.en: The arrests came little over a week after the US government waived its human rights conditions on $320m (£242m) in military aid to Egypt, citing Cairo’s “helpful role” to US national security after the US-Iran war.
paras.zh: 一周多前，美国政府放弃了向埃及提供 3.2 亿美元（2.42 亿英镑）军事援助的人权条件，理由是开罗在美伊战争后对美国国家安全发挥了“帮助作用”。

paras.en: The US gives about $1.3bn in aid to Egypt annually, but a portion is contingent upon the Egyptian government meeting certain human rights and democracy-related requirements. The US has withheld portions of aid several times since the 2013 coup owing to Egypt’s poor human rights record, but has largely kept funds flowing.
paras.zh: 美国每年向埃及提供约13亿美元的援助，但其中一部分取决于埃及政府满足某些人权和民主相关要求。自 2013 年政变以来，由于埃及人权记录不佳，美国多次扣留部分援助，但基本上保持了资金流动。

paras.en: This year, Washington waived the human rights requirement in total, as doing so was “essential for the US-Egypt relationship and US national security priorities”, according to a state department memo revealed by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社披露的一份国务院备忘录，今年，华盛顿完全放弃了人权要求，因为这样做“对于美埃关系和美国国家安全优先事项至关重要”。

paras.en: While saying that he was unsure whether the arrests were linked to the recent waiver, Mansour said: “The use of the national security waiver on human rights conditions by the US by many years, a willingness by other states to look the other way on Egypt’s human rights record … certainly enables violations like this to occur more easily.”
paras.zh: 曼苏尔表示，他不确定逮捕是否与最近的豁免有关，但他表示：“美国多年来对人权条件使用国家安全豁免，其他国家愿意对埃及的人权记录视而不见……肯定使此类侵犯行为更容易发生。”

paras.en: Cairo has for years faced criticism for its human rights abuses, with the rights monitor Freedom House saying Egyptian security forces “engage in human rights abuses and extrajudicial killing with impunity”.
paras.zh: 开罗多年来一直因其侵犯人权行为而受到批评，人权监测机构自由之家称埃及安全部队“从事侵犯人权和法外杀戮而不受惩罚”。

paras.en: Since the Egyptian president Abdel Fatah al-Sisi took power in the coup that ousted Morsi, civil liberties have been curbed and domestic political opposition has been violently crushed.
paras.zh: 自从埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西在推翻穆尔西的政变中上台以来，公民自由受到限制，国内政治反对派遭到暴力镇压。

paras.en: Egypt ranks 169th out of 180 countries on the Reporters Without Borders Press freedom index. Freedom of the press is tightly restricted in the country and independent platforms such as Matsadaash are rare. About 26 journalists are held in Egyptian prisons, according to the EJS.
paras.zh: 根据无国界记者组织的新闻自由指数，埃及在 180 个国家中排名第 169 位。该国的新闻自由受到严格限制，像 Matsadaash 这样的独立平台很少见。据 EJS 称，大约 26 名记者被关押在埃及监狱中。

articles.title: Russia strikes Kyiv bridge as German chancellor visits Ukraine in show of support
articles.author: Pjotr Sauer in Kyiv

paras.en: Russia has struck another major bridge in Kyiv as the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, arrived in the capital in a show of support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 随着德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨抵达基辅以表达对乌克兰的支持，俄罗斯撞上了基辅的另一座主要桥梁。

paras.en: A Russian drone hit Kyiv’s key Northern Bridge over the Dnipro River, marking the fourth consecutive day that Russia has targeted bridges used by tens of thousands of residents commuting between the city’s two banks. Video footage showed cars driving across the bridge as the drone plunged into the roadway and exploded in a burst of fire. Two people were injured in the strike, said Kyiv’s mayor, Vitali Klitschko.
paras.zh: 一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了基辅第聂伯河上的主要北桥，这标志着俄罗斯连续第四天袭击了该市两岸之间数万名居民通勤所使用的桥梁。视频片段显示，汽车驶过桥，无人机坠入道路并爆炸并起火。基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，罢工中有两人受伤。

paras.en: The attack came shortly after Merz arrived in the city on an unannounced visit intended to underline Germany’s backing of Ukraine, as the country enters one of the most precarious periods since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生在梅尔茨抵达该市进行一次未经宣布的访问后不久，旨在强调德国对乌克兰的支持，目前乌克兰正进入自俄罗斯 2022 年发动全面入侵以来最不稳定的时期之一。

paras.en: Germany has become Ukraine’s biggest provider of military aid since Merz entered office in May 2025, surpassing the US as American support has declined.
paras.zh: 自梅尔茨 2025 年 5 月上任以来，德国已成为乌克兰最大的军事援助提供者，随着美国支持的下降，德国超过了美国。

paras.en: Kyiv has come under near-constant attack from Russia’s new jet-powered drones in recent weeks, as an intensifying strike campaign increasingly disrupts everyday life in the capital and threatens to leave the city without power this winter.
paras.zh: 最近几周，基辅几乎不断受到俄罗斯新型喷气式无人机的攻击，愈演愈烈的袭击行动日益扰乱首都的日常生活，并有可能导致这座城市在今年冬天断电。

paras.en: On his visit, Merz announced that Germany would fund the joint production of drones designed to intercept Russia’s jet-powered drones, adding that “significant technical breakthroughs” in recent weeks were speeding up production.
paras.zh: 默茨在访问期间宣布，德国将资助联合生产旨在拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的无人机，并补充说，最近几周的“重大技术突破”正在加快生产速度。

paras.en: “This will quickly and tangibly strengthen Ukraine’s air defence,” he said. “And this strengthening is urgently needed.”
paras.zh: “这将迅速而切实地加强乌克兰的防空能力，”他说。 “而这种加强是迫切需要的。”

paras.en: The German leader got a taste of the new reality of daily life in the Ukrainian capital. Air-raid sirens sounded repeatedly during his visit, including as Volodymyr Zelenskyy showed him the badly damaged National Academy of Sciences building, where a Russian drone strike killed two people last week.
paras.zh: 这位德国领导人体验了乌克兰首都日常生活的新现实。在他访问期间，空袭警报不断响起，包括弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基向他展示了严重受损的国家科学院大楼，俄罗斯无人机上周袭击了该大楼，造成两人死亡。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president told Merz that people in Kyiv were suffering “terrible nights and days” from the relentless attacks, and called Ukraine’s Russian adversaries “absolute barbarians”.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统告诉梅尔茨，基辅人民正在遭受无情袭击的“可怕的日日夜夜”，并称乌克兰的俄罗斯对手是“绝对的野蛮人”。

paras.en: “We can see the entire pointlessness of this war at this place,” said Merz, adding as he arrived that Ukraine “needs all our support in the coming weeks”. “If Russia is not stopped, its war machine will sooner or later turn against us,” he said.
paras.zh: 默茨说：“我们可以在这个地方看到这场战争毫无意义。”他在抵达时补充道，乌克兰“在未来几周内需要我们的全力支持”。 “如果不阻止俄罗斯，它的战争机器迟早会反对我们，”他说。

paras.en: Russia had already damaged Kyiv’s Northern Bridge and repeatedly struck its Southern Bridge. Although the crossings remain standing, repeated attacks and the threat of further strikes have prompted the city’s authorities to restrict or suspend traffic on five of the city’s six road bridges over the Dnipro, causing temporary closures and large traffic jams.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯已经损坏了基辅的北桥，并多次袭击了南桥。尽管这些过境点仍然存在，但多次袭击和进一步罢工的威胁促使该市当局限制或暂停第聂伯河上的六座公路桥中的五座交通，造成暂时关闭和严重交通拥堵。

paras.en: If Moscow succeeds in seriously damaging Kyiv’s bridges, it could create a logistical nightmare for the city of 3 million people, whose crossings over the Dnipro were last destroyed on a large scale as Nazi German forces retreated in 1943. More than a third of residents live on the left bank while much of the city’s employment and infrastructure is concentrated on the right.
paras.zh: 如果莫斯科成功地严重破坏基辅的桥梁，可能会给这座拥有 300 万人口的城市带来后勤噩梦。上一次大规模摧毁第聂伯河渡口是在 1943 年纳粹德国军队撤退时。超过三分之一的居民居住在左岸，而该市的大部分就业和基础设施都集中在右岸。

paras.en: The attacks form part of a broader Russian campaign against civilian and industrial infrastructure inside Ukraine. In recent weeks, strikes have hit logistics hubs, railway lines, datacentres, medical storage facilities and steel plants, alongside a sustained assault on the country’s energy system that is expected to intensify over the winter.
paras.zh: 这些袭击是俄罗斯针对乌克兰境内民用和工业基础设施发起的更广泛行动的一部分。最近几周，罢工袭击了物流中心、铁路线、数据中心、医疗储存设施和钢铁厂，同时对该国能源系统的持续攻击预计将在冬季加剧。

paras.en: “He [Putin] is counting on constant escalation. He wants this very much,” Zelenskyy said at a press conference alongside Merz. “This is an answer to everyone – to those who believe that all you have to do is simply ask Putin and he will end the war for real. It won’t happen, simply.”
paras.zh: “他（普京）指望局势不断升级。他非常希望如此，”泽伦斯基在与梅尔茨一起举行的新闻发布会上表示。 “这是对每个人的答案——对那些相信只要问普京，他就会真正结束战争的人。这不会发生，简单地说。”

paras.en: Russia’s foreign ministry on Saturday warned foreign nationals and diplomatic staff against remaining in or travelling to Ukraine. “Responsibility for any possible adverse consequences lies entirely with those who choose to disregard this warning,” the ministry said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部周六警告外国公民和外交人员不要留在乌克兰或前往乌克兰。该部表示：“任何可能的不利后果的责任完全由那些选择无视这一警告的人承担。”

paras.en: A number of foreign ambassadors, including Germany’s, responded on social media that they intended to remain in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 包括德国大使在内的多位外国大使在社交媒体上回应称，他们打算留在基辅。

paras.en: “The EU delegation is staying,” the European Union ambassador, Katarína Mathernová, wrote on X on Sunday. “Threatening us will not stop Europe’s support for Ukraine. It only reminds us why that support matters.”
paras.zh: “欧盟代表团将留下来，”欧盟大使卡塔琳娜·马瑟诺娃 (Katarina Mathernová) 周日在 X 上写道。 “威胁我们不会阻止欧洲对乌克兰的支持。它只是提醒我们为什么这种支持很重要。”

paras.en: In Moscow, some pro-war commenters noted with glee that the Russian strikes had continued despite Merz’s arrival. “Russia used to pause strikes on Kyiv during visits by European politicians. Not any more,” wrote Sergei Markov, a prominent pro-war commentator.
paras.zh: 在莫斯科，一些支持战争的评论者高兴地指出，尽管梅尔茨抵达，俄罗斯的袭击仍在继续。 “俄罗斯过去常常在欧洲政客访问期间暂停对基辅的袭击。现在不再了，”著名的战争评论家谢尔盖·马尔科夫写道。

paras.en: The trip is Merz’s second to Ukraine since becoming chancellor. He has been among Kyiv’s most outspoken supporters in Europe and a leading voice warning about Russia’s hybrid campaign against other nations.
paras.zh: 这是默茨就任总理以来第二次访问乌克兰。他是基辅在欧洲最直言不讳的支持者之一，也是对俄罗斯针对其他国家的混合行动发出警告的主要声音。

paras.en: Last month, Germany formally accused Moscow of being behind a suspected plot targeting Leipzig/Halle airport, a key logistics hub for western military aid to Ukraine. But Merz is also facing growing discontent at home over his support for Ukraine, as his approval ratings fall.
paras.zh: 上个月，德国正式指责莫斯科涉嫌策划针对莱比锡/哈勒机场的阴谋，该机场是西方向乌克兰提供军事援助的重要后勤枢纽。但随着默茨的支持率下降，他在国内也面临着因支持乌克兰而日益增长的不满情绪。

paras.en: Germany’s far left and far right are sceptical of support for Ukraine and want Berlin to scale back aid. The pressure has intensified as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) has made big electoral gains.
paras.zh: 德国极左翼和极右翼人士对对乌克兰的支持持怀疑态度，并希望柏林减少援助。随着极右翼的德国另类选择党（AfD）在选举中取得巨大进展，压力也随之加剧。

paras.en: Alice Weidel, the AfD’s co-leader, wrote in a social media post: “Merz is travelling to Ukraine on Germany’s national holiday and promising further billions in German taxpayer money that is missing from the pension and health insurance funds, while Germany is mired in its worst energy crisis.”
paras.zh: 德国选择党联合领导人爱丽丝·韦德尔(Alice Weidel)在社交媒体帖子中写道：“默茨将在德国国庆节期间前往乌克兰，并承诺在德国深陷最严重的能源危机之际，向德国纳税人提供养老金和医疗保险基金中缺失的数十亿美元资金。”

articles.title: Israel condemns Green party passing ‘Zionism is racism’ as a ‘stain on history of UK’ – UK politics live
articles.author: Andrew Sparrow

paras.en: Israeli foreign ministry condemns Green party vote as 'stain on history of UK'
paras.zh: 以色列外交部谴责绿党投票是“英国历史上的污点”

paras.en: The Israeli foreign ministry has issued a statement condemning the Green party in the light of today’s vote, Tom Scotson from the Sun reports.
paras.zh: 据《太阳报》的汤姆·斯科特森（ Tom Scotson ）报道，以色列外交部根据今天的投票发表了一份声明，谴责绿党。

paras.en: In the statement, the foreign ministry said:
paras.zh: 外交部在声明中表示：

paras.en: The shocking resolution adopted today legitimises armed struggle, calls for a Palestinian state “from the river to the sea” - meaning the destruction of the State of Israel - and labels as “racist” the aspiration of the Jewish people for self-determination.
paras.zh: 今天通过的令人震惊的决议使武装斗争合法化，呼吁建立一个“从河流到海洋”的巴勒斯坦国--这意味着摧毁以色列国--并将犹太人民的自决愿望贴上“种族主义”的标签。

paras.en: This goes far beyond the boundaries of legitimate political debate. As long as this resolution remains in place, it will stand as a stain on the history of the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 这远远超出了合法政治辩论的界限。只要这项决议继续存在，它将成为英国历史上的污点。

paras.en: Kemi Badenoch, the Conservative leader, has opened her party’s conference by publishing a short book setting out her political philosophy. As the Press Association reports, a major line of thought throughout Badenoch’s new political bible appears to be that government should not spread its resources too thinly, but should be strong in the areas in which “the state is required”: defence, borders, public order, the rule of law and essential infrastructure. Badenoch told the conference:
paras.zh: 保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺赫（ Kemi Badenoch ）出版了一本简短的书，阐述了她的政治哲学。正如新闻协会报道的那样，贯穿巴德诺克新政治圣经的一个主要思路似乎是，政府不应该过分分散资源，而应该在“国家需要”的领域强大：国防、边境、公共秩序、法治和基本基础设施。Badenoch在会议上说：

paras.en: There is always an emergency. There is always a good reason to spend government money or time on something, but we don’t have unlimited resources. Government is about making tough choices, deciding how you will spread your resources, what you are going to focus your time on.
paras.zh: 总是有紧急情况。总是有充分的理由将政府资金或时间花在某些事情上，但我们没有无限的资源。政府需要做出艰难的选择，决定如何分配资源，将时间集中在哪些方面。

paras.en: The “fundamental analysis” at the heart of the document is that government needs to create the conditions for economic growth, and then get out of the way to allow businesses “the freedom to grow our economy”, the Tory leader added.
paras.zh: 这位保守党领导人补充说，该文件的核心“基本面分析”是，政府需要为经济增长创造条件，然后让步，允许企业“自由发展我们的经济”。

paras.en: Damian Green, the former first secretary of state, has told a fringe meeting that revising the pensions triple lock to make it less generous makes sense. He said:
paras.zh: 前第一任国务卿达米安·格林（ Damian Green ）在一次边缘会议上表示，修改养老金三重锁使其不那么慷慨是有道理的。他说：

paras.en: The mechanical straitjacket of the traditional triple lock seems to me no longer desirable.
paras.zh: 在我看来，传统三重锁的机械紧身衣已不再可取。

paras.en: And, of course, you have to look at the consequences for the public finances for everything we’re discussing - as we have a population more and more skewed towards those receiving the state pension, then it will become inexorably more expensive.
paras.zh: 当然，您必须考虑我们正在讨论的一切对公共财政的影响-因为我们的人口越来越倾向于领取国家养老金的人，那么它将变得无情地更加昂贵。

paras.en: So tax cuts, or desirable spending on, which I’m sure people in this room would like, on things like defence, become that much more difficult [if the triple lock stays].
paras.zh: 因此，减税，或理想的开支，我敢肯定，在座各位会喜欢的，在防御等事情上，变得更加困难[如果三重锁保持不变]。

paras.en: Adrian Ramsay, the former co-leader of the Greens, has issued this statement about today’s vote.
paras.zh: 绿党前联合领导人阿德里安·拉姆齐（ Adrian Ramsay ）就今天的投票发表了这份声明。

paras.en: I am deeply saddened the ‘Zionism is Racism’ motion has passed. It doesn’t reflect Green principles or my own view.
paras.zh: “犹太复国主义就是种族主义”运动已经通过，我对此深感悲痛。它不反映绿色原则或我自己的观点。

paras.en: The Green Party has long supported the principle of self-determination, and I stand by our 2024 manifesto commitment of equal rights of Israelis and Palestinians.
paras.zh: 绿党长期以来一直支持自决原则，我支持我们2024年关于以色列人和巴勒斯坦人平等权利的宣言承诺。

paras.en: The Board of Deputies of British Jews, the Community Security Trust and Jewish Leadership Council wrote a joint letter to the Green party before today’s vote saying that, if the ‘Zionism is racism’ motion were to pass, the party would place itself “on the extreme margins of democratic politics”.
paras.zh: 英国犹太人代表委员会、社区安全信托基金和犹太人领导委员会在今天的投票前给绿党写了一封联名信，称如果“犹太复国主义是种族主义”动议获得通过，该党将“处于民主政治的极端边缘”。

paras.en: The Lib Dem MP Tim Farronsays Green party members unhappy about the ‘Zionism is racism’ vote are welcome to join his party.
paras.zh: 自由民主党议员蒂姆·法伦斯（ Tim Farrons ）表示，绿党成员对“犹太复国主义就是种族主义”的投票感到不满，欢迎他们加入他的政党。

paras.en: That the antisemitic entryists who have captured the Green Party, are being antisemitic, is no surprise. That the Party Leader skipped this vote and failed to use his authority to argue against them, is an astonishing act of weakness. Real Greens are welcome in the Lib Dems…
paras.zh: 夺取绿党的反犹太主义入党者是反犹太主义的，这并不奇怪。党的领导人跳过这次投票，没有利用他的权威来反对他们，这是一个令人惊讶的软弱行为。真正的绿党在自由民主党中受到欢迎……

paras.en: Tories claim Green party's 'Zionism is racism' vote shows it's 'toxic to its core'
paras.zh: 保守党声称绿党的“犹太复国主义是种族主义”投票显示其“对其核心有毒”

paras.en: Chris Philp, the shadow home secretary, has issued this statement on behalf of the Conservative party about the Greens’ ‘Zionism is racism’ vote. He said:
paras.zh: 影子内政大臣克里斯·菲尔普（ Chris Philp ）代表保守党发表了关于绿党“犹太复国主义是种族主义”投票的声明。他说：

paras.en: British Jews should not have to disclaim a belief in Jewish self-determination and the existence of Israel in order to be accepted by a British political party.
paras.zh: 英国犹太人不应该为了被英国政党接受而放弃对犹太人自决和以色列存在的信仰。

paras.en: One look beneath the surface of Zack Polanski’s Green party shows a party toxic to its core. It is clear the Green party cannot bring itself to stand unambiguously against those who hate Jews.
paras.zh: 扎克·波兰斯基（ Zack Polanski ）的绿党表面之下的一个表情显示了一个对其核心有害的政党。很明显，绿党不能毫不含糊地反对那些仇恨犹太人的人。

paras.en: It’s hard to see how the Green party’s motion today will avoid an investigation by the EHRC, given Labour was previously found in breach.
paras.zh: 很难看出绿党今天的动议将如何避免EHRC的调查，因为工党此前被发现存在违规行为。

paras.en: From Adam Ramsay, the writer, journalist and Green party member
paras.zh: 亚当·拉姆齐（ Adam Ramsay ） ，作家、记者和绿党成员

paras.en: My brother just rang with a basic point: if you take the subjectivity of marginalised people seriously, then you have to accept the right of Palestinians to name the oppression they experience. Once we do that, it’s clear that Zionism is racism.
paras.zh: 我哥哥刚刚提出了一个基本观点：如果你认真对待被边缘化的人的主观性，那么你必须接受巴勒斯坦人命名他们所经历的压迫的权利。一旦我们这样做，很明显犹太复国主义就是种族主义。

paras.en: Senior party sources now admitted the Greens have been a plunged into chaos. Polanski and MPs way too late and weak in trying to oppose Zionism motion. New policy puts GPEW totally out of step with policy on ME elsewhere in Europe
paras.zh: 党内高级消息人士现在承认，绿党已经陷入混乱。波兰斯基和国会议员在试图反对犹太复国主义运动方面为时已晚且软弱无力。新政策使GPEW与欧洲其他地方的ME政策完全脱节

paras.en: This is fromPaul Ovenden, the former director of political strategy for Keir Starmer in No 10, on the Green party’s vote.
paras.zh: 这是来自保罗·奥文登（ Paul Ovenden ） ，他是基尔·斯塔默（ Keir Starmer ）第10号的前政治战略总监，关于绿党的投票。

paras.en: Last week, the Green Party were offered the biggest opportunity they’ve ever had, in the shape of electoral reform. Today, they’ve made it impossible for them to be accommodated in any administration.
paras.zh: 上周，绿党以选举改革的形式获得了有史以来最大的机会。如今，他们不可能在任何政府中安置他们。

paras.en: The Green party has sent out an updated news release saying that the statement issued by the five MPs earlier saying is there “no conflict between supporting the rights of Palestinians and the rights of Jewish people” has now also been endorsed by Zack Polanski, the Green leader, and Rachel Millward and Mothin Ali, the two co-deputy leaders.
paras.zh: 绿党发布了一份更新的新闻稿，称五名议员早些时候发表的声明称， “支持巴勒斯坦人的权利和犹太人的权利之间没有冲突” ，现在也得到了绿党领袖扎克·波兰斯基（ Zack Polanski ）以及两位副领袖雷切尔·米尔沃德（ Rachel Millward ）和莫辛·阿里的支持。

paras.en: Earlier I described the statement as the five MPs implicitly disassociating themselves from the motion. (See 3.53pm.) Given that Ali has now backed it, it would be fair to conclude any implict criticism is quite well hidden; Ali was in favour of the motion.
paras.zh: 早些时候，我将这一声明描述为五名议员含蓄地与该动议划清界限。 （见下午 3 点 53 分。）考虑到阿里现在已经支持了，可以公平地得出结论，任何含蓄的批评都被隐藏得很好；阿里赞成这项动议。

articles.title: Indian police accused of sexual harassment against journalists at protest

paras.en: Three female journalists have accused police officers in India of sexual harassment during street protests in the capital Delhi.
paras.zh: 三名女记者指控印度警察在首都德里的街头抗议活动中进行性骚扰。

paras.en: The claims were made on Saturday after the force detained scores of young people calling for the resignation of the chief election commissioner.
paras.zh: 这些指控是在该部队拘留了数十名要求首席选举专员辞职的年轻人后于周六提出的。

paras.en: Thousands of protesters gathered in Delhi and Mumbai cities for a third day on Sunday demanding that Gyanesh Kumar step down over large-scale changes to voter rolls.
paras.zh: 周日，成千上万的抗议者在德里和孟买城市聚集了三天，要求Gyanesh Kumar因选民名册的大规模变化而下台。

paras.en: In a post on social media, Delhi Police said its New Delhi District had received the complaint, and it had been transferred to its crime branch for a "fair and impartial" inquiry.
paras.zh: 德里警方在社交媒体上发帖称，其新德里区已收到投诉，并已将其移交给犯罪部门进行“公平和公正”的调查。

paras.en: The Election Commission says the exercise is intended to remove duplicate and ineligible entries - and so far, 130 million names have been struck off the voters' list.
paras.zh: 选举委员会表示，这项工作旨在删除重复和不合格的条目-到目前为止，已有1.3亿个名字从选民名单中删除。

paras.en: Videos online show people being physically dragged away from the Jantar Mantar protest site in central Delhi.
paras.zh: 在线视频显示，人们被从德里市中心的Jantar Mantar抗议现场拖走。

paras.en: The accusations by the women journalists include inappropriate touching by some police.
paras.zh: 女记者的指控包括一些警察不恰当的触摸。

paras.en: Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi said women fear for their safety and the home ministry must "answer for this".
paras.zh: 反对党领袖拉胡尔·甘地（ Rahul Gandhi ）表示，女性担心自己的安全，内政部必须“对此负责”。

paras.en: "Police dragged me by my hair," Aahna Singh, an activist and student at Jawaharlal Nehru University told Reuters news agency during the protests.
paras.zh: “警察拽着我的头发，”尼赫鲁贾瓦哈拉尔大学的活动家和学生Aahna Singh在抗议期间告诉路透社。

paras.en: She said the police were resorting to "brutality".
paras.zh: 她说，警方正在诉诸“暴行”。

paras.en: The protesters say the voter-roll revision will benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party.
paras.zh: 抗议者表示，选民名册的修订将使总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（ Narendra Modi ）的印度人民党（ Bharatiya Janata Party ）受益。

paras.en: The Election Commission says the exercise is intended to remove duplicate and ineligible entries.
paras.zh: 选举委员会表示，这项工作旨在删除重复和不合格的参赛作品。

paras.en: The protesters have included supporters of the influential Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) that began as an online satirical movement.
paras.zh: 抗议者包括有影响力的蟑螂党（ CJP ）的支持者，该党最初是一场在线讽刺运动。

paras.en: The pressure group recorded its first major victory in July when it forced the then Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign after weeks of protests calling for education reforms.
paras.zh: 该压力集团在7月份取得了首次重大胜利，迫使当时的教育部长达曼德拉·普拉丹（ Dharmendra Pradhan ）在数周的抗议活动要求教育改革后辞职。

paras.en: The CJP called for the latest protest after a report in The Indian Express, external said that Kumar's two fellow election commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, had formally objected at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders they said had been issued without their knowledge.
paras.zh: 《印度快报》外部报道称，库马尔的两名选举专员苏赫比尔·辛格·桑德胡（ Sukhbir Singh Sandhu ）和维韦克·乔希（ Vivek Joshi ）在10个月内至少14次正式反对他们在不知情的情况下发布的决定和命令， CJP呼吁进行最新的抗议活动。

paras.en: The differences were reported to be mostly over the controversial revision of the country's electoral rolls known as the Special Intensive Revision, or SIR, which began last year.
paras.zh: 据报道，这些分歧主要是因为去年开始对该国选民名册进行有争议的修订，称为特别密集修订，或SIR。

paras.en: The Election Commission has defended its way of working and said in a statement that "differing views" were part of the "decision-making process" and that all the decisions were taken unanimously.
paras.zh: 选举委员会为自己的工作方式辩护，并在一份声明中表示， “不同的观点”是“决策过程”的一部分，所有决定都是一致做出的。

paras.en: But the revelations sparked a furore, with opposition leaders demanding Kumar's resignation.
paras.zh: 但这一消息引发了轩然大波，反对派领导人要求库马尔辞职。

articles.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says

paras.en: US murderer Christa Pike remains critically ill in hospital and her prognosis is still unclear following her failed execution, her lawyer has said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 她的律师周日表示，美国凶手克里斯塔·派克（ Christa Pike ）仍在医院病危，在处决失败后，她的预后仍然不明朗。

paras.en: Speaking to CNN on Sunday morning, Pike's lawyer Stephen Ferrell said doctors were still trying to clear two doses of pentobarbital from her body.
paras.zh: 派克的律师斯蒂芬·费雷尔（ Stephen Ferrell ）周日上午在接受美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）采访时表示，医生仍在试图从她的体内清除两剂戊巴比妥。

paras.en: Pike, 50, was sentenced to death following her conviction for murdering Colleen Slemmer in 1995.
paras.zh: 50岁的派克在1995年因谋杀科琳·斯莱默（ Colleen Slemmer ）而被定罪后被判处死刑。

paras.en: She survived two execution attempts on Wednesday, and was transferred to a hospital in Nashville, Tennessee.
paras.zh: 她在周三的两次处决尝试中幸存下来，并被转移到田纳西州纳什维尔的一家医院。

paras.en: Ferrell said: "She's still in the hospital, on a ventilator, critically ill, we really don't know the prognosis yet, and may not know for several days."
paras.zh: Ferrell说： “她还在医院，在呼吸机上，病情危重，我们真的还不知道预后，可能几天都不知道。”

paras.en: He didn't believe she had regained consciousness at any point, adding that he has been receiving updates through her medical power of attorney rather than consulting directly with doctors.
paras.zh: 他不相信她在任何时候都恢复了意识，并补充说，他一直在通过她的医疗授权书接收更新，而不是直接咨询医生。

paras.en: He has not been in to see her. "She is guarded. I'm not sure who may have seen her," he said.
paras.zh: 他没有来看她。“她很警惕，我不知道谁见过她，”他说。

paras.en: Authorities have not yet said whether they will try again to execute Pike. They have also not offered an explanation for what went wrong. But Tennessee Governor Bill Lee suspended all executions for the rest of the year - and the head of prisons in the state said he would resign on Saturday.
paras.zh: 当局尚未表示是否会再次尝试处决派克。他们也没有对出现的问题做出解释。但田纳西州州长比尔·李（ Bill Lee ）在今年剩余时间内暂停了所有处决，该州监狱长表示他将于周六辞职。

paras.en: "If she recovers - she may not fully recover - and there may be issues about her competence. I mean, we just don't know any of this," Ferrell said. "We have had no discussions about this. The Tennessee attorney general's office so far has not given us any indications of what their intentions will be."
paras.zh: “如果她康复-她可能无法完全康复-并且她的能力可能存在问题。我的意思是，我们对此一无所知，” Ferrell说。“我们没有就此进行讨论。到目前为止，田纳西州总检察长办公室还没有给我们任何迹象表明他们的意图是什么。”

paras.en: He called on the governor to commute her death sentence to a life sentence "at the very least". "She has endured a torturous attempt at executing her," he said. "She's spent over 30 years in prison, most of that in solitary confinement."
paras.zh: 他呼吁州长“至少”将她的死刑改判为无期徒刑。“她忍受了处决她的折磨，”他说。“她在狱中度过了30多年，其中大部分是单独监禁。”

paras.en: "We don't know right now - and we may never know - what sort of torture she endured during [her failed execution]."
paras.zh: “我们现在还不知道--我们可能永远也不会知道--她在[处决失败]期间遭受了什么样的折磨。”

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Slemmer in 1995.
paras.zh: 派克18岁时，她和当时的男友塔达里尔·希普（ Tadaryl Shipp ）在1995年殴打、折磨并杀害了19岁的斯莱默（ Slemmer ）。

paras.en: She was sentenced to death the following year after a media frenzy around the killing in Knoxville, Tennessee.
paras.zh: 第二年，在田纳西州诺克斯维尔的杀戮事件引发媒体狂热后，她被判处死刑。

paras.en: Slemmer's mother May Martinez travelled to Nashville for the execution, which moved ahead despite last-minute legal challenges.
paras.zh: Slemmer的母亲May Martinez前往纳什维尔执行死刑，尽管面临最后一刻的法律挑战，处决仍继续进行。

paras.en: Martinez, who supported Pike's death sentence, told local news outlet WJXX that she "broke down in tears" after finding out it was not successful.
paras.zh: 支持判处派克死刑的马丁内斯告诉当地新闻媒体WJXX ，她在发现不成功后“泪流满面”。

paras.en: "I think that the state owes me a big apology," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为国家欠我一个大道歉，”她说。

paras.en: The state's Department of Correction has defended the use of lethal injections, saying "the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out".
paras.zh: 该州矫正部为使用致命注射进行辩护，称“该协议不允许超出已执行范围的额外程序”。

paras.en: Pike's lawyers previously warned that her medical history and anatomy - including thrombocytosis (a blood-clotting condition) and small veins - meant there was a risk she would experience "unnecessary" pain and suffering during a lethal injection.
paras.zh: 派克的律师此前警告说，她的病史和解剖结构-包括血小板增多（一种血液凝固性疾病）和小静脉-意味着她在注射致命药物期间可能会经历“不必要的”疼痛和痛苦。

articles.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis

paras.en: The head of Yemen's internationally recognised government has announced it will wage an all out war in an effort to take all territory held by the Houthis.
paras.zh: 也门国际公认的政府首脑宣布，将发动一场全面战争，以夺取胡塞武装占领的所有领土。

paras.en: It follows an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition in recent days.
paras.zh: 此前，胡塞武装和沙特领导的联盟在最近几天发生了罢工。

paras.en: The Iran-backed group said it had struck sites belonging to Saudi national oil company Aramco, in response to what it described as 50 Saudi-led coalition strikes in 12 hours. Saudi Arabia has yet to comment.
paras.zh: 伊朗支持的这个组织表示，它已经袭击了沙特阿拉伯国家石油公司阿美石油公司的工厂，以回应它所说的沙特领导的联军在12小时内发动的50次袭击。沙特阿拉伯尚未置评。

paras.en: The Yemeni government's fierce statement was expected after the Houthis' offensive last month, which saw them seize control of the country's coastline, including the vital shipping lane of the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
paras.zh: 也门政府在上个月胡塞武装发动进攻后发表了激烈的声明，他们夺取了对该国海岸线的控制权，包括曼达布海峡的重要航道。

paras.en: On Sunday, Yemeni President Rashad al-Alimi said in a televised address: "Today, I announce the start of military operations to retake the remaining territory of the republic and extend the authority of the state and its institutions across the entire national territory."
paras.zh: 也门总统拉沙德·阿利米（ Rashad al-Alimi ）周日在电视讲话中说： “今天，我宣布开始军事行动，重新夺回共和国剩余的领土，并将国家及其机构的权力扩展到整个国家领土。”

paras.en: Yemen's capital, Sanaa, which has been held by the Houthis for more than a decade, has come under sustained attack as government forces try to weaken the group's military capabilities.
paras.zh: 也门的首都萨那（ Sanaa ）被胡塞武装控制了十多年，由于政府军试图削弱该组织的军事能力，它受到了持续的攻击。

paras.en: Attacks on the Houthis have also spread across Yemen, including to the Saada region, the group's northern heartland.
paras.zh: 对胡塞武装的袭击也蔓延到整个也门，包括该组织北部中心地带萨达地区。

paras.en: But security sources say the Iran-backed Houthis have continued to make gains.
paras.zh: 但安全消息人士称，伊朗支持的胡塞武装继续取得进展。

paras.en: The frontline in Yemen remains focused around the key city of Taiz, which is still controlled by the internationally recognised government.
paras.zh: 也门的前线仍然集中在主要城市塔伊兹周围，塔伊兹仍然由国际公认的政府控制。

paras.en: On Sunday, the Houthis cut a vital supply route linking Taiz with Aden, the interim capital of the Yemeni government, AFP news agency reports.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，周日，胡塞武装切断了一条连接塔伊兹和也门政府临时首都亚丁的重要补给线。

paras.en: Citing three Yemeni military sources, AFP also reports that the Houthis now control the area and supply route, effectively encircling Taiz.
paras.zh: 法新社援引三名也门军方消息人士的话说，胡塞武装现在控制着该地区和补给路线，有效地包围了塔伊兹。

paras.en: "They've achieved the military objective of isolating Taiz from Aden, even if they haven't fully taken control of it," Farea Al-Muslimi, a research fellow at the Chatham House think tank, told AFP.
paras.zh: “他们已经实现了将塔伊兹从亚丁隔离出来的军事目标，即使他们还没有完全控制它，” Chatham House智库的研究员Farea Al-Muslimi告诉法新社。

paras.en: Al-Alimi was unlikely to have made the fierce announcement without the green light from Saudi Arabia, which remains the key backer of his government.
paras.zh: 如果没有沙特阿拉伯的绿灯， Al-Alimi不太可能做出激烈的声明，沙特阿拉伯仍然是其政府的主要支持者。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has been under constant attack as the Houthis try to target the country's economic lifeblood - oil.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯一直受到攻击，因为胡塞武装试图瞄准该国的经济命脉--石油。

paras.en: On Sunday, Yemen's Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the group had launched a ballistic missile and drone attack on Aramco sites in the capital, Riyadh, and the oil-rich Khurais area in the kingdom's east.
paras.zh: 周日，也门胡塞军方发言人叶海亚·萨里（ Yahya Saree ）表示，该组织已经向沙特阿美在首都利雅得和该国东部石油资源丰富的胡莱斯地区发动了弹道导弹和无人机袭击。

paras.en: "Both operations successfully achieved their objectives," the spokesman said in a statement. "The strikes were precise, causing large fires at the targeted sites."
paras.zh: “两次行动都成功实现了他们的目标，”发言人在一份声明中说。“罢工很精确，导致目标地点发生大火。”

paras.en: It is not the first time the group has said it has hit Saudi oil sites. Saudi Arabia has yet to comment on Sunday's claimed attack, but has previously dismissed some claims as misleading, mocking the Houthis for "chasing imaginary victories".
paras.zh: 这不是该组织第一次表示它已经袭击了沙特的油田。沙特阿拉伯尚未就周日声称的袭击发表评论，但此前曾驳斥了一些误导性的说法，嘲笑胡塞武装“追逐想象中的胜利”。

paras.en: But it has once again shown the price Saudi Arabia - and, as a consequence, the global economy - could pay if it launched a new all-out war against the Houthis.
paras.zh: 但它再次表明，如果沙特对胡塞武装发动一场新的全面战争，沙特--以及全球经济--可能会付出代价。

paras.en: In retaliation, Saudi Arabia has also been striking Houthi targets, according to the Houthi-run Al-Masirah TV channel. It said at least two people had been wounded in strikes on Sunday.
paras.zh: 据胡塞运营的Al-Masirah电视频道报道，沙特阿拉伯也一直在打击胡塞目标。它说，周日至少有两人在罢工中受伤。

paras.en: On Saturday, Yemen's government also said its forces had hit Houthi targets across the country, including in Sanaa, Saada and the group's positions near Taiz in the south-west.
paras.zh: 周六，也门政府还表示，其部队袭击了全国各地的胡塞目标，包括萨那、萨达和该组织在西南部塔伊兹附近的阵地。

paras.en: Yemen is one of the poorest countries in the world and remains gripped by a vast humanitarian crisis.
paras.zh: 也门是世界上最贫穷的国家之一，仍面临巨大的人道主义危机。

paras.en: A war erupted in 2014, when the Houthis seized the capital city from the Saudi-backed government, before going on to take control of swathes of the country's north.
paras.zh: 2014年爆发了一场战争，当时胡塞武装从沙特支持的政府手中夺取了首都，然后继续控制该国北部的大片地区。

paras.en: Riyadh intervened in the war the following year, leading an international coalition.
paras.zh: 次年，利雅得介入了战争，领导了一个国际联盟。

paras.en: After several years of relative calm, the war reignited in July amid the widening conflict in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 经过几年的相对平静，战争于7月在中东不断扩大的冲突中重新点燃。

paras.en: Last month, a lightning offensive enabled the Houthis to seize the country's entire Red Sea coast, stopping Saudi Arabia from using it as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 上个月，一场闪电攻势使胡塞武装夺取了该国整个红海海岸，阻止沙特阿拉伯将其用作通往霍尔木兹海峡的替代石油出口路线。

paras.en: The strategy benefited the Houthis' main sponsor, Iran. But it has also forced Saudi Arabia back into direct military confrontation with the Houthis.
paras.zh: 该战略使胡塞武装的主要赞助商伊朗受益。但它也迫使沙特阿拉伯重新与胡塞武装直接军事对抗。

articles.title: Nostalgic Board Game ‘Guess Who?’ Drops NFL Edition Featuring Travis Kelce: Buy It Here
articles.author: Tim Chan

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: Just in time for the start of the 2026-27 NFL season, Hasbro has re-stocked its football-themed edition of the popular Guess Who? board game.
paras.zh: 恰逢 2026-27 NFL 赛季开始，孩之宝重新补货了流行的猜猜谁？棋盘游戏。

paras.en: Just like the beloved original, players work to identify the characters — or in this case, the football players — on their opponent’s board and race to be the first one to close all their tabs once they guess correctly.
paras.zh: 就像深受喜爱的原作一样，玩家要努力识别对手棋盘上的角色（或者在本例中为足球运动员），并在猜对后竞相成为第一个关闭所有选项卡的人。

paras.en: The NFL-edition of “Guess Who?” features players from all 32 teams in the league, including superstars like Travis Kelce, Patrick Mahomes, Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts. This is an officially-licensed release from the NFL and Hasbro.
paras.zh: NFL 版“猜猜谁？”拥有来自联盟所有 32 支球队的球员，包括 Travis Kelce、Patrick Mahomes、Josh Allen、Lamar Jackson 和 Jalen Hurts 等超级巨星。这是 NFL 和 Hasbro 官方授权的版本。

paras.en: While the recently-married Kelce is perhaps the most famous face in the pack, there are 48 athletes in total to guess from — 24 from the AFC and 24 from the NFC, though they’re randomly divided between the two boards. Each square has a photo of the football player in their team jersey, along with their position.
paras.zh: 虽然最近结婚的凯尔斯可能是这群人中最著名的面孔，但总共有 48 名运动员可供猜测——其中 24 名来自 AFC，24 名来自 NFC，尽管他们是随机分配在两个委员会之间的。每个方块都有一张穿着球队球衣的足球运动员的照片以及他们的位置。

paras.en: Just like the original Guess Who? game, players can only ask “yes” or “no” questions to try to figure out the mystery NFL star’s identity (hint: start by asking about their team conference or division, then jersey color or playing position).
paras.zh: 就像原来的猜猜谁？游戏中，玩家只能问“是”或“否”问题来尝试找出神秘 NFL 球星的身份（提示：首先询问他们的球队联盟或分区，然后询问球衣颜色或比赛位置）。

paras.en: What we like: the two sides fold out for game-play but then snap together into a single case for easy storage.
paras.zh: 我们喜欢的是：两侧可折叠起来以供玩游戏，但随后可卡入一个盒子中以方便存放。

paras.en: Suitable for kids ages six and up (though really it’s great for all ages), this Guess Who? edition is a great gift idea for sports fans and makes for a fun family game night activity too.
paras.zh: 适合六岁及以上的孩子（虽然真的适合所有年龄段），这个猜猜是谁？版本是送给体育迷的绝佳礼物，也可作为有趣的家庭游戏之夜活动。

paras.en: Hasbro has another fun release for the new football season: a series of Bop It! games featuring the likes of Allen, Mahomes, Justin Jefferson, Saquon Barkley and more.
paras.zh: 孩之宝为新足球赛季推出了另一个有趣的产品：一系列 Bop It!艾伦、马霍姆斯、贾斯汀·杰斐逊、萨昆·巴克利等人的比赛。

paras.en: Hasbro Gaming Bop It! Josh Allen Edition Game
paras.zh: 孩之宝游戏 Bop It！乔什·艾伦版游戏

paras.en: While the original Bop It! involved a wheel-style contraption that players raced to twist, push, pull and spin, the NFL version challenges players to “bop” the football star’s chest, twist his arm with the ball, or pull on his foot, all in random sequences.
paras.zh: 而原来的 Bop It! NFL 版本要求玩家用随机的顺序“击打”橄榄球明星的胸部、用球扭转他的手臂或拉动他的脚，其中包括一个轮式装置，玩家可以竞相扭转、推、拉和旋转。

paras.en: The commands are shouted out by a sports announcer-style voice through the device’s built-in speakers. This is a fun coordination and reaction game for the whole family. When not in use, the figurines stand about seven inches tall and make for a great desktop collectible or shelf display piece.
paras.zh: 这些命令是通过设备的内置扬声器以体育播音员风格的声音喊出的。这是一款适合全家人一起玩的有趣的协调和反应游戏。不使用时，这些雕像高约七英寸，可作为绝佳的桌面收藏品或架子展示品。

paras.en: The NFL Bop It! game requires two AAA batteries (not included). I’ve kept mine in the office for when I need a little break from work or need to re-focus. The figurines make a great gift idea too.
paras.zh: NFL 击球吧！游戏需要两节 AAA 电池（不包含在供货范围内）。当我需要从工作中休息一下或需要重新集中注意力时，我就把它放在办公室里。这些小雕像也是一个很棒的礼物创意。

paras.en: The NFL season began on Sept. 9, 2026. The Seattle Seahawks are the reigning Super Bowl champions after defeated the New England Patriots in last year’s championship game.
paras.zh: NFL 赛季于 2026 年 9 月 9 日开始。西雅图海鹰队在去年的冠军赛中击败新英格兰爱国者队，成为超级碗卫冕冠军。

articles.title: Dakota Johnson & Turnstile on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: On Saturday (Oct. 3), Saturday Night Live returns with the second episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps Verity and Fifty Shades of Grey actress Dakota Johnson to host, while Baltimore hardcore punk band Turnstile serves as musical guest.
paras.zh: 周六（10 月 3 日），《周六夜现场》携第 52 季第二集回归。这部喜剧小品节目由《Verity》和《五十度灰》女演员达科塔·约翰逊 (Dakota Johnson) 主持，巴尔的摩硬核朋克乐队 Turnstile 担任音乐嘉宾。

paras.zh: 这是达科塔·约翰逊第二次主持，而 Turnstile 则是《周六夜现场》的首次亮相。

paras.en: How to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Live Online, at a Glance:
paras.zh: 如何在线观看“周六夜现场”直播，概览：

paras.en: SNL airs live on Saturday (Oct. 3), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.
paras.zh: SNL 于周六（10 月 3 日）直播，开始时间为晚上 11:30。 ET/PT。

paras.en: What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?
paras.zh: 哪个电视网络有“周六夜现场”？

paras.en: In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the variety sketch show is available to livestream on Peacock.
paras.zh: 2026 年，SNL 在 NBC 电视上播出。同时，综艺小品秀也可在孔雀直播。

paras.en: Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?
paras.zh: 今晚谁出现在“周六夜现场”？

paras.en: SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Since Dakota Johnson is hosting, it’s likely that Anne Hathaway and Josh Hartnett might appear.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》以名人在节目中客串而闻名，因此很可能会有许多著名男女演员和唱片艺术家出席。由于达科塔·约翰逊担任主持人，安妮·海瑟薇和乔什·哈奈特很可能会出现。

paras.en: Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past, include Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Mariska Hargitay, Meryl Streep, Harry Styles and others.
paras.zh: 其他已知曾出现在《周六夜现场》的艺术家包括蒂莫西·柴勒梅德、本·斯蒂勒、亚历克·鲍德温、玛莉丝卡·哈吉塔、梅丽尔·斯特里普、哈里·斯泰尔斯等。

paras.en: Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看“周六夜现场”

paras.en: For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch SNL online, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial, while other streaming services, like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV, also offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
paras.zh: 对于掐线者来说，如果您没有有线电视，特别是如果您想免费观看，可以通过多种方式在线观看 SNL。 DirecTV 有五天免费试用期，而 Fubo 和 Hulu + Live TV 等其他流媒体服务也提供免费试用，因此您可以免费观看。

paras.en: Sling TV offers the Blue plan, which comes with NBC. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month. All plans come with a free cloud DVR and an extra 600 or so free channels too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.
paras.zh: Sling TV 提供 Blue 套餐，该套餐随 NBC 一起提供。流媒体套餐拥有 40 多个频道，每月价格为 54.99 美元。所有套餐都附带免费的云 DVR 和额外的 600 个左右的免费频道。请注意：定价和渠道可用性因市场而异。

paras.en: Broadcast and cable networks NBC is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV. Prices for the cable alternative start at $49.99 for the first month ($89.99 per month afterward) for more than 100 live channels, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package.
paras.zh: 广播和有线网络 NBC 可通过 Hulu + Live TV 观看。有线替代方案的价格从第一个月 49.99 美元起（之后每月 89.99 美元），可观看 100 多个直播频道，而每个套餐都附带 Hulu、Disney+ 和 ESPN Unlimited，无需额外付费。对于那些希望将所有这些流媒体服务集中在一个包中的人来说，Hulu + 直播电视可能是最好的选择。

If you’re looking to save, you can get 17% off when you do the annual plan for $129.99 per year or $199.99 per year, respectively. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

paras.en: Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan, no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.
paras.zh: Peacock 的 Premium Plus 套餐包含 Premium 套餐中的所有内容，无广告、本地 NBC 频道直播以及离线下载和流式传输的功能。

paras.en: On Saturday (Oct. 3), SNL with host Dakota Johnson and musical guest Turnstile broadcasts live on NBC. One of the best ways to watch is with DirecTV.
paras.zh: 周六（10 月 3 日），SNL 与主持人达科塔·约翰逊 (Dakota Johnson) 和音乐嘉宾 Turnstile 在 NBC 进行现场直播。最好的观看方式之一是使用 DirecTV。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Makes Surprise ‘SNL’ Cameo in Dakota Johnson’s Monologue
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance on Saturday Night Live this weekend, crashing host Dakota Johnson’s opening monologue.
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特本周末出人意料地出现在《周六夜现场》中，打破了主持人达科塔·约翰逊的开场独白。

paras.en: Johnson, hosting for the third time on the eve of her birthday (Oct. 4), spent much of the monologue joking about her history of dating musicians, saying she has supportive friends who “don’t judge me for dating these men.”
paras.zh: 约翰逊在生日前夕（10 月 4 日）第三次主持节目，在独白中大部分时间都在开玩笑地谈论她与音乐家约会的历史，并表示她有支持她的朋友，他们“不会因为我和这些男人约会而评判我”。

paras.en: She then introduced “my literal therapist” — cuing Swift, who walked on to correct her. “I’m not your therapist, actually,” Swift said.
paras.zh: 然后她介绍了“我的文字治疗师”——暗示斯威夫特，后者走上前纠正了她。 “实际上，我不是你的治疗师，”斯威夫特说。

paras.en: “You just show up once a week at my house with an empty bottle of wine and ask if I want some.” She continued: “You flop on my couch and overshare, and every so often I just say, ‘Damn, that’s crazy.'” The bit ended with Swift noting she sends Johnson home with “a Pedialyte” and a security escort.
paras.zh: “你每周只需要带着一瓶空酒来我家一次，问我是否想要一些。”她继续说道：“你在我的沙发上摔倒，过度分享，我时常只是说，‘该死，这太疯狂了。’”在这段视频的结尾，斯威夫特指出，她送约翰逊回家，带着“一名儿童电解液”和一名保安护送。

paras.en: The monologue also worked in a nod to Swift’s husband, Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce, as Johnson referenced “England and parts of Ireland and Cleveland” among the places tied to her romantic misadventures — a wink at Kelce’s Cleveland-area roots — prompting a “Woo-woo!” from Swift.
paras.zh: 这段独白也向斯威夫特的丈夫、堪萨斯城酋长队球星特拉维斯·凯尔斯致敬，约翰逊在与她的浪漫不幸经历有关的地方中提到了“英格兰、爱尔兰和克利夫兰的部分地区”——对凯尔斯的克利夫兰地区根源眨了眨眼——引发了“呜呜！”来自斯威夫特。

paras.en: The cameo reunited the pair weeks after they appeared together in the video for “Patient Zero,” the single from Swift’s The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore that she directed and co-starred in. The clip, which premiered at the MTV Video Music Awards, stars Johnson and Colin Farrell as a wealthy couple whose marriage is unraveling, with Swift appearing as a spectral figure. Earlier Saturday, Swift released an expanded eight-minute version of the “Patient Zero” video exclusively on Apple Music.
paras.zh: 几周后，两人在《零号病人》的视频中再次客串，这是斯威夫特执导并联合主演的《歌舞女郎的一生：安可》中的单曲。这段视频在 MTV 音乐录影带大奖上首映，约翰逊和科林·法雷尔饰演一对婚姻破裂的富有夫妇，斯威夫特则以幽灵般的形象出现。周六早些时候，斯威夫特在 Apple Music 上独家发布了“零号病人”视频的八分钟扩展版本。

paras.en: It marked Swift’s first SNL appearance since October 2023, when she introduced musical guest Ice Spice; she has a long history with the show, having hosted in 2009 and appeared as musical guest multiple times.
paras.zh: 这是斯威夫特自 2023 年 10 月以来首次亮相《周六夜现场》，当时她介绍了音乐嘉宾 Ice Spice；她在该节目中有着悠久的历史，曾于 2009 年担任主持人，并多次作为音乐嘉宾出现。

paras.en: The cameo caps a busy stretch for Swift, who released The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore — an expanded edition of her chart-topping 2025 album with four new tracks — on Sept. 25.
paras.zh: 这次客串为斯威夫特忙碌的一段时光画上句号，她于 9 月 25 日发行了《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》——这是她 2025 年排行榜冠军专辑的扩展版，其中包含四首新曲目。

paras.en: Describing the genesis of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore in an Instagram post, Swift said, “About a year ago, you guys did a truly unfathomable thing. Something that completely blew my mind… You gave The Life of a Showgirl the biggest first week for an album in history,” of the LP that debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 thanks to a record-smashing 4.002 million album-equivalent units moved.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特在 Instagram 帖子中描述《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》的起源时说道，“大约一年前，你们做了一件真正深不可测的事情。这件事完全让我大吃一惊……你们为《The Life of a Showgirl》带来了历史上最伟大的首周专辑”，这张唱片凭借创纪录的 400.2 万专辑当量销量在 Billboard 200 上排名第一。

articles.title: Jeremy Strong Says He Doesn’t “Need to Apologize” for Method Acting: “It’s in Service of the Material”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Jeremy Strong says it’s “never my intention to interfere” with the people he works with when method acting, but he doesn’t believe he “need[s] to apologize” for his approach.
paras.zh: 杰里米·斯特朗表示，在方法表演时，“我从来没有打算干涉”与他一起工作的人，但他认为自己“不需要为自己的做法道歉”。

paras.en: The Succession actor is a known method actor, which he has led to criticism from his peers in the past. When speaking with David Remnick for The New Yorker Radio Hour podcast, the host asked Strong if he feels his tendency to do research on his characters and bring that knowledge into his performance is “appreciated by the people around you.” Remnick specifically cited his Oscar-nominated turn in The Apprentice, where he added a scene to the film that wasn’t in the original script.
paras.zh: 《继承》演员是一位众所周知的方法演员，他过去曾因此而受到同行的批评。在《纽约客广播一小时》播客节目中与大卫·雷姆尼克交谈时，主持人问斯特朗，他是否认为自己对角色进行研究并将这些知识带入表演中的倾向“受到周围人的赞赏”。雷姆尼克特别提到了他在《学徒》中获得奥斯卡提名的表演，他在电影中添加了原剧本中没有的场景。

paras.en: “I think I can’t really speak to that,” the actor said. “Of course, some people seem to have been… it is never my intention to interfere with anyone else’s experience or anyone else’s way of working. First, do no harm, right? But commit to fucking what you’re doing, and utterly.”
paras.zh: “我想我真的不能谈论这个，”演员说。 “当然，有些人似乎……我从来没有打算干涉别人的经历或别人的工作方式。首先，不要造成伤害，对吧？但要致力于他妈的你正在做的事情，而且要彻底。”

paras.en: He was then asked if he gets frustrated by others who are not at the same level of commitment, to which Strong responded, “No, just meaning that I’m just there to commit utterly to serving the material.”
paras.zh: 然后他被问到是否会因为其他人没有达到同样的承诺水平而感到沮丧，斯特朗回答说：“不，只是意味着我只是完全致力于为材料提供服务。”

paras.en: “So, if some people feel that I’m taking it too seriously, or it changes the molecules in the room in a way that makes something uncomfortable, I guess that’s something that I don’t feel that I need to apologize for,” he said. “Because I believe, and I think the directors that I work with all believe, that it’s in service of the material, and I personally think that a lot of the reactions to it are of a personal nature.”
paras.zh: “所以，如果有人觉得我把这件事看得太认真了，或者它改变了房间里的分子，让某些东西变得不舒服，我想我觉得我不需要为此道歉，”他说。 “因为我相信，而且我认为与我合作的导演都相信，它是为材料服务的，而且我个人认为，对它的很多反应都是个人性质的。”

paras.en: Strong will next star in Aaron Sorkin‘s The Social Reckoning as Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg. The director recently told The New York Times that Strong treated his co-stars “the way he imagines Mark [Zuckerberg] treats the people around him.”
paras.zh: 斯特朗接下来将在艾伦·索金 (Aaron Sorkin) 执导的《社会清算》(The Social Reckoning) 中饰演 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg)。这位导演最近告诉《纽约时报》，斯特朗对待他的联合主演“就像他想象中的马克[扎克伯格]对待他周围的人一样”。

paras.en: Sorkin explained, “Jeremy does a lot of his own work. He does a tremendous amount of work before he shows up on your set. He did not speak in his own voice on the set or walk the way Jeremy walks.”
paras.zh: 索金解释说，“杰里米自己做了很多工作。在出现在你们的片场之前，他做了大量的工作。他没有在片场用自己的声音说话，也没有像杰里米那样走路。”

paras.en: “I told all the other actors in his scenes: ‘Guys, he’s not going to be hanging out with you at craft service. He’s not going to be yucking it up with you between takes. He’s probably not going to speak to you at all. He is going to treat you the way he imagines Mark treats the people around him,’” he added. “And that’s what happened. You cannot argue with the results.”
paras.zh: “我告诉他场景中的所有其他演员：‘伙计们，他不会在工艺服务中和你们一起出去玩。他不会在拍摄间隙和你们一起吐槽。他可能根本不会和你们说话。他会像马克对待他周围的人一样对待你们，’”他补充道。 “这就是发生的事情。你无法否认结果。”

paras.en: Brian Cox, Strong’s former Succession co-star, shared his criticism of his method acting in a viral New Yorker profile, where he said, “I’ve worked with intense actors before. It’s a particularly American disease, I think, this inability to separate yourself off while you’re doing the job.”
paras.zh: 斯特朗在《继承之战》中的前搭档布莱恩·考克斯在《纽约客》的一篇热门人物简介中分享了他对斯特朗表演方法的批评，他说：“我以前曾与紧张的演员合作过。我认为，这是一种特别的美国通病，就是在工作时无法将自己与自己分开。”

paras.en: The Troy actor has made many remarks about Strong’s method, saying previously, “It’s not good for the ensemble. It creates hostility. That’s the problem.”
paras.zh: 这位特洛伊演员对斯特朗的方法发表了很多评论，他之前曾表示，“这对乐团没有好处。它会产生敌意。这就是问题所在。”

paras.en: Of his reaction to the profile, Strong previously told The Hollywood Reporter, “It was painful for it to be put out to the world, maybe in a less compassionate way than I would’ve hoped.” He added, “I felt that I had a safe forum at The New Yorker. I felt that I had a safe forum to share those things — and ultimately that experience was put in doubt.”
paras.zh: 谈到他对这篇个人资料的反应，斯特朗此前告诉《好莱坞报道》，“将其发布给全世界是令人痛苦的，也许是以一种比我希望的更不富有同情心的方式。”他补充道，“我觉得我在《纽约客》有一个安全的论坛。我觉得我有一个安全的论坛来分享这些事情——最终，这种经历受到了质疑。”

paras.en: When asked if he was hurt by his co-stars coming off as being dismissive of his process, Strong said, “Yeah,” adding, “But a lot of that is just things that are presented out of context or with a certain agenda. I know what everybody said, and there was an angle and a narrative that was being presented. Which is not to say that there was never friction between my co-stars. We’re a family in every sense of the word. But foundationally, there’s deep respect and even love.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他的搭档们对他的制作过程不屑一顾时，他是否感到受伤，斯特朗说：“是的，”他补充道，“但很多事情只是断章取义或有特定议程的东西。我知道每个人都说什么，而且有一个角度和叙述。这并不是说我的搭档之间从来没有摩擦。我们在任何意义上都是一家人。但从根本上来说，我们是深深的尊重，甚至是爱。”

articles.title: How ‘Freaks’ Sent Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein to Hollywood: “That Film Changed Our Lives”
articles.author: Etan Vlessing

paras.en: Zach Lipovsky has done good business with gory horror movies.
paras.zh: 扎克·利波夫斯基在血腥恐怖片方面做得很好。

paras.en: Lipovsky and longtime collaborator Adam B. Stein’s 2018 dark sci-fi thriller Freaks, starring Emile Hirsch and Bruce Dern, was an unlikely box office hit, having made over $375 million worldwide during its theatrical run. “That film changed our lives,” he tells The Hollywood Reporter from the Sony Pictures studio lot in Culver City, California.
paras.zh: 2018 年，利波夫斯基和长期合作者亚当·B·斯坦因 (Adam B. Stein) 执导的黑暗科幻惊悚片《怪胎》(Freaks) 由埃米尔·赫希 (Emile Hirsch) 和布鲁斯·邓恩 (Bruce Dern) 主演，出人意料地取得了票房成功，在全球上映期间获得了超过 3.75 亿美元的票房收入。 “那部电影改变了我们的生活，”他在加利福尼亚州卡尔弗城的索尼影业工作室告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: Freaks effectively transformed the filmmaking duo from B-movie mavens to hot commodities in Hollywood after the dystopian drama world premiered at the Vancouver Film Festival (VIFF). “I grew up in Vancouver. We made the first film in Vancouver. And as a teenager I went to the Vancouver Film Festival, and got a super pass to not only see five films a day, but go to press screenings for three weeks before the festival,” Lipovsky recalled.
paras.zh: 这部反乌托邦剧情片在温哥华电影节 (VIFF) 上进行全球首映后，《怪胎》有效地将电影制作二人组从 B 级电影专家转变为好莱坞的热门商品。 “我在温哥华长大。我们在温哥华制作了第一部电影。十几岁的时候，我参加了温哥华电影节，并获得了一张超级通行证，不仅可以每天看五部电影，还可以在电影节前三周参加新闻发布会，”利波夫斯基回忆道。

paras.en: That festival play gave a young Lipovsky a crash course in world cinema. “I remember seeing filmmakers up on the stage, presenting their films and wishing one day that would be me,” he added. After Freaks –— which featured 7-year-old Chloe (Lexy Kolker) being locked in a ramshackle suburban home by her protective and paranoid father, played by Hirsch — Lipovsky and Stein are returning to Vancouver with their follow-up Freak 2 to screen on Saturday night at the Rio Theatre.
paras.zh: 这部节日戏剧给年轻的利波夫斯基上了世界电影的速成课。 “我记得看到电影制片人在舞台上展示他们的电影，并希望有一天是我，”他补充道。 《怪胎》讲述了 7 岁的克洛伊（莱克西·科尔克饰）被她的保护欲强、偏执的父亲（赫希饰演）锁在一个摇摇欲坠的郊区家里的故事。继《怪胎》之后，利波夫斯基和斯坦将带着他们的续作《怪胎 2》返回温哥华，并于周六晚上在里约剧院上映。

paras.en: “The first film was very much about a girl who can’t leave her house, and really wants a mom. And in the second film, she’s now much older. So she doesn’t want a mom. What she wants is a friend,” he explained. “And how do you find a friend, and how do you build a relationship in a world where society wants you dead,” Lipovsky adds as he teases Freaks 2.
paras.zh: “第一部电影讲述的是一个不能离开家的女孩，她真的想要一个妈妈。而在第二部电影中，她现在老了很多。所以她不需要妈妈。她想要的是一个朋友，”他解释道。 “在一个社会希望你死的世界里，你如何找到朋友，如何建立关系，”利波夫斯基在调侃《怪胎 2》时补充道。

paras.en: Paramount Pictures has already picked up the sequel where Amanda Crew is a mother and Lorelei Olivia Mote plays her daughter, as both look to survive a world that wants to wipe out “freaks” like them as they seek vengeance for their family. Freaks 2 also follows hot on the heels of Lipovsky and Stein directing Final Destination Bloodlines, the sixth installment of the supernatural horror franchise that grossed over $285 million at the worldwide box office.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙影业已经拍摄了续集，阿曼达·克鲁 (Amanda Crew) 饰演一位母亲，罗蕾莱·奥利维亚·莫特 (Lorelei Olivia Mote) 饰演她的女儿，两人都希望在一个想要消灭像她们这样的“怪胎”的世界中生存下去，同时为家人报仇。 《怪胎 2》紧随利波夫斯基和斯坦执导的《死神血统》之后，这是超自然恐怖系列的第六部，全球票房收入超过 2.85 亿美元。

paras.en: “It’s very hard to believe I’m sitting here on the Sony lot where we have our first look [deal] now. And we have a whole building of people now working with us to make movies, which is very surreal,” Lipovsky adds as he and Stein met nearly 20 years ago as rival competitors on On the Lot, the Fox filmmaking competition series from Steven Spielberg and Mark Burnett.
paras.zh: “很难相信我现在正坐在索尼的片场，我们在这里进行了第一次观看（交易）。现在有一整栋大楼的人正在与我们一起制作电影，这非常超现实，”利波夫斯基补充道，他和斯坦因在近 20 年前作为竞争对手在《On the Lot》中相识，这是由史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格和马克·伯内特制作的福克斯电影制作竞赛系列节目。

paras.en: “We didn’t win, and we were off the lot,” Lipovsky recounted. But, two decades later, he and Stein are in-demand movie directors at work on projects like the Long Lost short story adaptation for Amblin and Universal, as writers on Chris Columbus’ Gremlins 3 and for Sony the animated Venom movie and Metal Gear Solid.
paras.zh: “我们没有获胜，我们也被淘汰了，”利波夫斯基回忆道。但二十年后，他和斯坦因成为炙手可热的电影导演，为安培林 (Amblin) 和环球影业 (Universal) 制作了《失落已久》(Long Lost) 短篇小说改编作品，担任克里斯·哥伦布 (Chris Columbus) 的《小魔怪 3》(Gremlins 3) 的编剧，以及为索尼 (Sony) 制作的动画电影《毒液》(Venom) 和《合金装备》(Metal Gear Solid)。

paras.en: Getting known around Hollywood still has Lipovsky pinching himself. “Over 20 years of making movies, you get very used to things not happening, and very used to people saying something’s happening, and then it doesn’t happen. So when things start to click into place, your brain has a very hard time trying to accept that it’s actually real,” he added.
paras.zh: 在好莱坞出名仍然让利波夫斯基掐自己。 “在制作电影 20 多年的时间里，你会非常习惯那些没有发生的事情，也非常习惯人们说某件事正在发生，然后它就没有发生。所以当事情开始发生时，你的大脑很难接受它实际上是真实的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Lipovsky also puts himself and Stein becoming bankable in Hollywood after Freaks and Final Destination Bloodlines down to the recent summer box office success of breakout horror pics Backrooms and Obsession. “Horror is one of the few genres where it’s normal for audiences to show up in theaters for original movies,” Lipovsky argues. “It’s the voice of the authors that are creating the work that audiences are becoming attracted to, and even more so when the work is original, and Hollywood is definitely starting to pay attention to that.”
paras.zh: 利波夫斯基还将自己和斯坦因在《怪胎》和《死神血统》之后在好莱坞的票房收入归功于最近夏季突破性恐怖片《密室》和《痴迷》的票房成功。 “恐怖片是少数几种观众经常到影院观看原创电影的类型之一，”利波夫斯基说道。 “正是创作者的声音吸引了观众，当作品是原创时更是如此，好莱坞肯定开始关注这一点。”

paras.en: Lipovsky will be accompanied at the VIFF screenings for Freaks 2 by his mother, who as a single parent cast aside her own aspirations to become a movie director to work as a TV producer at Knowledge Network, a local Vancouver network. “Becoming a director back in the [19]80s wasn’t really a career path for many women, and she’s always been there by my side, and for her to see the kind of levels to which I’ve been able to create movies has been amazing,” he recalled.
paras.zh: Lipovsky 的母亲将陪同他的母亲参加 VIFF 放映《怪胎 2》。作为单亲家长，她放弃了自己成为电影导演的愿望，在温哥华当地的知识网络 (Knowledge Network) 担任电视制片人。 “对于许多女性来说，在[19]80年代成为一名导演并不是真正的职业道路，但她一直在我身边，让她看到我能够创作电影的水平真是令人惊叹，”他回忆道。

paras.en: One of the VIFF screenings for Freak 2 will also be at the city’s historic Park Theatre, an art deco movie house that Lipovsky helped save from closure as a private investor along with Osgood Perkins, Mike Flanagan, Sean Baker and Finn Wolfhard.
paras.zh: 《怪胎 2》的 VIFF 放映之一也将在该市历史悠久的公园剧院 (Park Theatre) 进行，这是一家装饰艺术电影院，利波夫斯基与奥斯古德·帕金斯 (Osgood Perkins)、迈克·弗拉纳根 (Mike Flanagan)、肖恩·贝克 (Sean Baker) 和芬恩·沃尔夫哈德 (Finn Wolfhard) 一起作为私人投资者帮助挽救了这家装饰艺术电影院。

paras.en: “It’s very special to be able to do the screening there, with a lot of the people that made the movie and a lot of my old friends in the audience and within minutes of where we shot the movie,” he insisted.
paras.zh: “能够在那里进行放映是非常特别的，观众中有很多制作这部电影的人和我的很多老朋友，距离我们拍摄电影的地方只有几分钟的时间，”他坚持说。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Crashes Dakota Johnson’s ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hosting Stint: “My Literal Therapist!”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Dakota Johnson got a special visit from Patient Zero on Saturday Night Live.
paras.zh: 达科塔·约翰逊在《周六夜现场》中受到了零号病人的特别拜访。

paras.en: Taylor Swift joined the Verity actress during her opening monologue on Saturday night’s episode, marking quite the surprise appearance. Johnson joked about having “two very public, very lame breakups with two very awesome musicians” since she’d last been on SNL, and how she had the most supportive friends who “don’t judge me for dating these men.”
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特在周六晚上的剧集开场独白中加入了这位《Verity》女演员的表演，这标志着她的出现相当令人惊讶。约翰逊开玩笑说，自从她上次参加《周六夜现场》以来，她与两位非常出色的音乐家发生了“两次非常公开、非常蹩脚的分手”，以及她如何拥有最支持她的朋友，他们“不会因为我和这些男人约会而评判我”。

paras.en: Cut to Swift! Johnson joked that the singer was “my literal therapist,” to which the Grammy winner responded, “I’m not your therapist. Actually, you just show up once a week at my house with an empty bottle of wine and ask if I want some.”
paras.zh: 切到斯威夫特！约翰逊开玩笑说这位歌手是“我的文字治疗师”，这位格莱美奖得主回应道，“我不是你的治疗师。实际上，你每周只需要带着一瓶空酒到我家来一次，问我是否想要一些。”

paras.en: “Yeah, well I have manners,” the actress said, as Swift continued, “And then you flop on my couch and overshare, and every so often I just say, ‘Damn, that’s crazy.'”
paras.zh: “是的，我很有礼貌，”这位女演员说道，斯威夫特继续说道，“然后你倒在我的沙发上，过度分享，时不时我只是说，‘该死，这太疯狂了。’”

paras.en: “Is that not a therapist?” the Fifty Shades of Grey actress questioned.
paras.zh: “那不是治疗师吗？” 《五十度灰》女主角受到质疑。

paras.en: On Sunday, Swift released the music video for her new single “Patient Zero,” starring none other than Johnson and Colin Farrell. The two debuted the video at the MTV VMAs on Sunday, with the track serving as one of four new songs the musician released as part of The Life of a Showgirl: Encore Edition last Friday.
paras.zh: 周日，斯威夫特发布了她的新单曲《零号病人》的音乐视频，由约翰逊和科林·法雷尔主演。两人于周日在 MTV VMA 上首次亮相了该视频，该歌曲是这位音乐家上周五在《歌舞女郎的一生：安可版》中发布的四首新歌之一。

paras.en: To close out her monologue, Johnson concluded, “Well, just quickly, while we’re on the subject of musicians, I think actually I’m doing a public service by dating them, because ladies, I am saving you a lot of money on Zoloft. So, you’re welcome, America! And also England and parts of Ireland and Cleveland, allegedly,” Johnson said, as Swift added in a quick, “Woo-woo!”
paras.zh: 为了结束她的独白，约翰逊总结道：“好吧，很快，当我们谈论音乐家的话题时，我认为实际上我正在通过与他们约会来提供公共服务，因为女士们，我在左洛复上为你们节省了很多钱。所以，不客气，美国！据说还有英国以及爱尔兰和克利夫兰的部分地区，”约翰逊说，斯威夫特快速补充道，“呜呜！”

paras.en: “Cleveland” is another new track from Showgirl: Encore, where Swift sings about her husband Travis Kelce and their marriage. “Now I’m wearing white (Yeah), so hate all you like (Uh-huh) / This is the love of my life (Hey, hey, hey),” Swift sings at the end of the song.
paras.zh: 《Cleveland》是《Showgirl: Encore》的另一首新歌，斯威夫特在其中唱出了她的丈夫特拉维斯·凯尔斯 (Travis Kelce) 和他们的婚姻。 “现在我穿着白色的衣服（是的），所以讨厌你喜欢的一切（嗯哼）/这是我一生的挚爱（嘿，嘿，嘿），”斯威夫特在歌曲结尾唱道。

paras.en: At the top of her monologue, the Verity actress also addressed the box office bomb Madame Web, while noting that her last SNL appearance was tied to promotion for the film. She joked, “The last time I was here, I was promoting a movie called Madame Web. And tonight, I’m still promoting it. Because the movie hasn’t made any money yet.”
paras.zh: 在独白的开头，这位《Verity》女演员还谈到了《韦伯夫人》的票房炸弹，同时指出她最后一次出现在《周六夜现场》与电影的宣传有关。她开玩笑说：“上次我来的时候，我正在宣传一部叫《韦伯夫人》的电影。今晚，我还在宣传它。因为这部电影还没有赚到钱。”

paras.en: The cold open saw a group of “Republican heavy hitters” get together to film ads ahead of the midterms. Among those who appeared were Marco Rubio, portrayed by Marcello Hernández. Mikey Day also joined as Mitch McConnell, and Jeremy Culhane as J.D. Vance.
paras.zh: 冷开场时，一群“共和党重量级人物”聚集在一起，在中期选举前拍摄广告。出席者包括由马塞洛·埃尔南德斯 (Marcello Hernández) 饰演的马可·鲁比奥 (Marco Rubio)。麦奇·戴 (Mikey Day) 也加入，饰演米奇·麦康奈尔 (Mitch McConnell)，杰里米·卡尔哈恩 (Jeremy Culhane) 饰演 J.D. 万斯 (J.D. Vance)。

paras.en: The last guest before James Austin Johnson’s Trump also joined was Pete Hegseth (Colin Jost). He joined the sketch with a Bero in hand, which he described as “Spider-Man’s new non-alcoholic bitch beer.”
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊饰演的特朗普加入之前的最后一位嘉宾是皮特·赫格斯（科林·乔斯特饰）。他手里拿着一杯 Bero 加入了素描，他将其描述为“蜘蛛侠的新型无酒精母狗啤酒”。

paras.en: “Now listen up, OK, ’cause I need all you patriots at home to do the gayest thing ever and vote,” Jost’s Hegseth said. “Thanks to me, the military finally has its priorities — and sexuality — straight.”
paras.zh: “现在听着，好吧，因为我需要你们所有的爱国者在家里做有史以来最快乐的事情并投票，”约斯特的赫格斯说。 “多亏了我，军队终于明确了自己的优先事项和性取向。”

paras.en: Saturday night’s episode marks Johnson’s third time hosting SNL. She made her debut in February 2015, and returned once more in January 2024. She’s made several appearances throughout the years, including for the 40th anniversary special and a cameo during Josh O’Connor’s hosting stint last December.
paras.zh: 周六晚上的这一集标志着约翰逊第三次主持 SNL。她于 2015 年 2 月首次亮相，并于 2024 年 1 月再次回归。这些年来，她多次露面，包括在 40 周年纪念特别节目中以及去年 12 月在乔什·奥康纳 (Josh O’Connor) 主持期间客串。

paras.en: Season 52 of SNL premiered last week with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson and Katseye. Later this season, Shane Gillis will host on Oct. 10 with musical guest Rosalia, while Obsession star Inde Navarrette makes her SNL hosting debut on the Halloween episode with Gracie Abrams.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》第 52 季于上周首播，由纽约尼克斯队球星贾伦·布伦森 (Jalen Brunson) 和凯西 (Katseye) 主演。本季晚些时候，肖恩·吉利斯 (Shane Gillis) 将于 10 月 10 日与音乐嘉宾罗莎莉亚 (Rosalia) 一起主持，而《痴迷》(Obsession) 明星因德·纳瓦雷特 (Inde Navarrette) 则与格雷西·艾布拉姆斯 (Gracie Abrams) 一起在万圣节剧集中首次亮相 SNL。

articles.title: Ukraine will hit Russian refineries in response to Moscow's 'new doctrine' of airstrikes, Zelenskyy says

paras.en: Ukraine will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries in response to a new policy of airstrikes by Moscow designed to force people to abandon Kyiv and other cities, but will not target civilians, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 总统泽连斯基表示，乌克兰将加大力度攻击俄罗斯炼油厂，以回应莫斯科新的空袭政策，旨在迫使人们放弃基辅和其他城市，但不会针对平民。

paras.en: Ukraine's intelligence services have obtained documents showing that Russian leader Vladimir Putin had issued a "new doctrine" of military attacks on a much broader range of civilian targets ahead of this winter, Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基说，乌克兰情报部门获得的文件显示，俄罗斯领导人普京已发布“新学说”，将在今年冬天之前对更广泛的民用目标进行军事攻击。

paras.en: "We saw documents and we know that they allow them to attack infrastructure, logistics, and especially to attack in the cities, in the villages, everywhere, roads, schools, hospitals," Zelenskyy told Reuters in an interview. "To pressure people to leave the capital, leave different cities: this is the goal of the operation."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在接受路透社采访时表示：“我们看到了文件，我们知道这些文件允许他们攻击基础设施、后勤设施，特别是在城市、村庄、各处、道路、学校、医院进行攻击。” “迫使人们离开首都，离开不同的城市：这就是行动的目标。”

paras.en: Driving the shift in policy, Zelenskyy said, was Putin's desire to appear strong at a time when his military was losing ground in a key frontline region and sustaining higher levels of casualties.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，推动政策转变的原因是，普京希望在其军队在关键前线地区节节败退、伤亡人数不断增加之际表现出强大的态度。

paras.en: The Kremlin was not available to comment on Saturday. But in a statement urging foreign nationals to leave Kyiv, the Russian Foreign Ministry said Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia in recent months.
paras.zh: 周六未能联系到克里姆林宫发表评论。但俄罗斯外交部在一份敦促外国人离开基辅的声明中表示，莫斯科将继续系统性地打击目标，据称是对乌克兰近几个月来对俄罗斯的袭击进行报复。

paras.en: Both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians.
