paras.en: It wasn’t a sophisticated system that made the difference in this case, but a quick decision to evacuate. “I thought that even if the warning turned out to be wrong, the worst it would cost us was one day of study,” Dawadi told the New York Times. “But taking it lightly could mean the loss of hundreds of lives.”
paras.zh: 在这起案件中，发挥作用的并不是复杂的系统，而是快速的疏散决定。达瓦迪告诉《纽约时报》：“我认为，即使这个警告最终被证明是错误的，最糟糕的结果就是让我们损失一天的学习时间。” “但掉以轻心可能意味着数百人丧生。”

articles.title: A medieval remedy could offer ideas for beating antibiotic resistance
articles.author: Hannah Thomasy

paras.en: A look one thousand years into the past is revealing clues about how to develop the bacteria-fighting drugs of the future.
paras.zh: 回顾一千年的过去，揭示了如何开发未来抗菌药物的线索。

paras.en: A concoction from a 10th century medical manuscript damaged cell membranes, altered the expression of disease-promoting genes and interfered with interbacterial communication when added to bacterial cultures, researchers report September 3 in mSphere. What’s more, three kinds of harmful bacteria developed resistance to the medicinal mixture much more slowly compared with conventional single-molecule antibiotics.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 3 日在 mSphere 上报告称，来自 10 世纪医学手稿的混合物在添加到细菌培养物中时会损坏细胞膜，改变致病基因的表达，并干扰细菌间的通讯。此外，与传统的单分子抗生素相比，三种有害细菌对药物混合物产生耐药性的速度要慢得多。

paras.en: “The difference is remarkable,” says Omar El-Halfawy, a microbiologist at the University of Regina in Canada who was not involved in the research. This impaired ability to develop resistance may occur because the medieval medicine affects several bacterial targets, says Freya Harrison, a microbiologist at the University of Warwick in England. For bacterial colonies to survive, “they’ve potentially got to mutate multiple targets, and that’s difficult.”
paras.zh: “差异是显着的，”未参与这项研究的加拿大里贾纳大学微生物学家 Omar El-Halfawy 说道。英国华威大学微生物学家弗雷娅·哈里森 (Freya Harrison) 表示，这种产生耐药性的能力可能会受到损害，因为中世纪药物会影响多种细菌靶标。为了让细菌菌落生存，“它们可能必须突变多个目标，这很困难。”

paras.en: The modern adaptation of the 10th century recipe (shown) involves combining garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine, then brewing the pungent mixture in a brass vessel for nine days.
paras.zh: 现代对 10 世纪配方的改编（如图所示）包括将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和葡萄酒混合，然后在黄铜容器中将这种刺激性混合物酿造九天。

paras.en: Currently, antibiotic-resistant infections kill more than 1 million people each year. But humans have been battling the minuscule enemies that cause diseases like plague, leprosy and tuberculosis for millennia. Sometime in the 10th century, Anglo-Saxon scribes compiled several sometimes-dubious treatments into a medical text known as Bald’s Leechbook.
paras.zh: 目前，抗生素耐药性感染每年导致超过 100 万人死亡。但几千年来，人类一直在与引起鼠疫、麻风病和结核病等疾病的微小敌人作斗争。在 10 世纪的某个时候，盎格鲁撒克逊抄写员将几种有时可疑的治疗方法汇编成一本医学著作，称为《巴尔德的水蛭书》。

paras.en: In 2015, Harrison and a team of microbiologists and historians brewed a remedy from the Leechbook, called Bald’s eyesalve, in the lab. They mixed garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine in a brass vessel, then allowed it to stand for nine days. In laboratory tests, Bald’s eyesalve displayed surprisingly effective antimicrobial activity against both Staphylococcus aureus and its drug-resistant form, MRSA.
paras.zh: 2015年，哈里森和一群微生物学家和历史学家在实验室里根据水蛭书酿造了一种药物，称为秃头眼药水。他们将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和酒混合在一个黄铜容器中，然后静置九天。在实验室测试中，Bald 的眼药对金黄色葡萄球菌及其耐药形式 MRSA 表现出令人惊讶的有效抗菌活性。

paras.en: This time, the scientists set out to determine how the eyesalve affected pathogens, measuring how the brew altered gene expression in bacterial cultures. After eyesalve treatment, hundreds of S. aureus genes were expressed differently, including ones related to cell membrane composition and disease-causing potential.
paras.zh: 这一次，科学家们着手确定眼药如何影响病原体，测量这种饮料如何改变细菌培养物中的基因表达。眼药治疗后，数百个金黄色葡萄球菌基因表达不同，包括与细胞膜组成和致病潜力相关的基因。

paras.en: The remedy also damaged bacterial membranes, a possibly lethal maneuver. Furthermore, very low concentrations of the eyesalve reduced S. aureus’ ability to create hardy antibiotic-resisting colony formations called biofilms. It also inhibited bacterial cell communication, which pathogens use to coordinate activities and become more harmful.
paras.zh: 这种疗法还会破坏细菌膜，这可能是致命的。此外，极低浓度的眼药水会降低金黄色葡萄球菌产生耐抗生素菌落形成（称为生物膜）的能力。它还抑制细菌细胞通讯，病原体利用这种通讯来协调活动并变得更加有害。

paras.en: Finally, the team dosed cultures of S. aureus and two other pathogens with increasing concentrations of the eyesalve or commonly used antibiotics to see how quickly resistance developed. After two weeks, the microbes often flourished despite exposure to eight to sixteen times the amount of the traditional antibiotic that had stymied their growth at the beginning. In contrast, they could only tolerate slightly higher eyesalve concentrations.
paras.zh: 最后，研究小组向金黄色葡萄球菌和其他两种病原体的培养物中加入浓度不断增加的眼药水或常用抗生素，以观察耐药性发展的速度。两周后，尽管接触的传统抗生素的量是一开始阻碍微生物生长的八到十六倍，但微生物仍然经常繁殖。相比之下，他们只能忍受稍高的眼药浓度。

paras.en: Harrison says she’s not expecting people to whip up their own batches of eyesalve to treat infections. “It would be really impractical to do that, and also potentially really unreliable and dangerous because it’s going to be so variable.”
paras.zh: 哈里森说，她并不指望人们自己制作一批眼药水来治疗感染。 “这样做确实不切实际，而且可能非常不可靠和危险，因为它会变得如此多变。”

paras.en: Instead, she says, researchers could recapitulate the eyesalve’s multipronged attack in a clinically suitable way with a lab-made cocktail containing a handful of the potion’s active ingredients. “Somewhere in there, there’s this combination of molecules that’s responsible for most of this effect — so, can we find out what they are?”
paras.zh: 相反，她说，研究人员可以用一种实验室制造的含有少量药水活性成分的鸡尾酒，以临床上合适的方式重现眼药水的多管齐下的作用。 “在那里的某个地方，有这种分子组合造成了大部分这种效应——那么，我们能找出它们是什么吗？”

articles.title: Exhaling may speed up reaction times
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: A sprinter’s first task is to react to the starting pistol. Now, a button-clicking experiment suggests that how quickly people respond to a cue may depend in part on whether they’re breathing in or out.
paras.zh: 短跑运动员的首要任务是对发令枪做出反应。现在，一项点击按钮的实验表明，人们对提示的反应速度可能部分取决于他们是吸气还是呼气。

paras.en: Volunteers’ reaction times were faster when they exhaled or held their breath compared with when they inhaled, researchers report September 28 in iScience.
paras.zh: 研究人员 9 月 28 日在《iScience》杂志上报告称，与吸气时相比，志愿者呼气或屏住呼吸时的反应速度更快。

paras.en: Ken Paller and Erika Yamazaki, then both cognitive neuroscientists at Northwestern University, made their discovery while studying breathing patterns to find treatments for sleep apnea. Yamazaki graduated from her PhD earlier this year.
paras.zh: 肯·帕勒（Ken Paller）和埃里卡·山崎（Erika Yamazaki）当时都是西北大学的认知神经科学家，他们在研究呼吸模式以寻找睡眠呼吸暂停的治疗方法时发现了这一点。山崎今年早些时候从博士学位毕业。

paras.en: Paller and Yamazaki determined how sleepy 35 volunteers were with a simple reaction-time test. The volunteers were tasked with clicking a button when an on-screen red square turned yellow.
paras.zh: Paller 和 Yamazaki 通过简单的反应时间测试确定了 35 名志愿者的困倦程度。志愿者的任务是当屏幕上的红色方块变成黄色时点击按钮。

paras.en: Yamazaki realized that, because the volunteers’ breathing was recorded through short tubes in the nose throughout the task, the researchers could also check whether inhaling or exhaling influenced reaction times.
paras.zh: 山崎意识到，由于在整个任务过程中志愿者的呼吸都是通过鼻子里的短管记录的，因此研究人员还可以检查吸气或呼气是否影响反应时间。

paras.en: Reaction times were, on average, 41 milliseconds faster during exhalation than during inhalation. This finding held regardless of how sleepy or alert the volunteers were.
paras.zh: 呼气时的反应时间比吸气时平均快 41 毫秒。无论志愿者有多困或多警觉，这一发现都成立。

paras.en: That might not sound like a huge difference, but Noah Lyles won the 2024 Olympic men’s 100-meter final by five thousandths of a second. Those 41 milliseconds would have made the difference between Lyles winning and finishing fourth.
paras.zh: 这听起来可能不是一个巨大的差异，但诺亚·莱尔斯 (Noah Lyles) 以千分之五秒的优势赢得了 2024 年奥运会男子 100 米决赛。这 41 毫秒将决定莱尔斯能否获胜和获得第四名。

paras.en: But the relationship between breath and brain appears to be complex. A 2016 study found that reaction times were faster during inhalation than exhalation in tests of recall and facial recognition. But these tasks differed from the hair-trigger change Paller and Yamazaki studied. Those tasks required more cognitive processing, Paller says, because they required the participants to judge whether, for example, a face look fearful or surprised, rather than waiting for a simple cue. “That may or may not have the same relationship with respiration.”
paras.zh: 但呼吸和大脑之间的关系似乎很复杂。 2016 年的一项研究发现，在回忆和面部识别测试中，吸气时的反应时间比呼气时更快。但这些任务与帕勒和山崎研究的一触即发的变化不同。帕勒说，这些任务需要更多的认知处理，因为它们要求参与者判断一张脸是否看起来害怕或惊讶，而不是等待一个简单的提示。 “这可能与呼吸有相同的关系，也可能没有。”

paras.en: The mechanism behind these findings isn’t clear, although Paller points to studies, like the one from 2016, that suggest our breath is synced to the ebb and flow of our brain waves.
paras.zh: 这些发现背后的机制尚不清楚，尽管帕勒指出，2016 年的一项研究表明，我们的呼吸与脑电波的潮起潮落是同步的。

paras.en: In a race decided by thousandths of a second, every factor matters, even a single breath.
paras.zh: 在千分之一秒决定胜负的比赛中，每一个因素都很重要，甚至是一次呼吸。

articles.title: Scientists Tested Whether Leftovers Really Taste Better The Next Day. One Dish Stood Out.
articles.author: Rebecca Dyer

paras.en: There's a specific kind of joy in opening the fridge to find leftovers waiting for you like a gift from your past self. Many people insist that they taste better than the original.
paras.zh: 打开冰箱，发现剩菜正等着你，就像是过去的自己送来的礼物，这是一种特殊的快乐。许多人坚持认为它们的味道比原来的更好。

paras.en: Some might accept this as one of life's little quirks, similar to how one sock disappears in the wash.
paras.zh: 有些人可能会认为这是生活中的小怪事之一，类似于一只袜子在洗涤中消失。

paras.en: But scientists like to investigate quirks, and a team at Deakin University in Australia did just that. To see whether this kitchen myth is backed by evidence, they recruited people to blind-test fresh dishes against their day-old counterparts.
paras.zh: 但科学家们喜欢研究怪癖，澳大利亚迪肯大学的一个团队正是这样做的。为了看看这个厨房神话是否有证据支持，他们招募了一些人来对新鲜菜肴与一天前的同行进行盲测。

paras.en: Their study is posted as a preprint (it hasn't yet undergone peer review) and concludes that 'leftovers taste better' is not entirely a myth. But it isn't as universal as we might think.
paras.zh: 他们的研究以预印本形式发布（尚未经过同行评审），并得出结论：“剩菜味道更好”并不完全是一个神话。但它并不像我们想象的那么普遍。

paras.en: In fact, only one of their test dishes lived up to the reputation.
paras.zh: 事实上，他们的测试菜肴中只有一种名副其实。

paras.en: "Few culinary beliefs are as persistent as the idea that some foods taste better the next day," the team writes.
paras.zh: 研究小组写道：“很少有烹饪信仰能像某些食物第二天味道更好的想法一样持久。”

paras.en: First author Russell Keast has a personal history with this phenomenon. Before becoming a food and sensory scientist, he trained as a chef and heard the claim many times, even experiencing it himself.
paras.zh: 第一作者拉塞尔·凯斯特（Russell Keast）就曾经历过这种现象。在成为食品和感官科学家之前，他接受过厨师培训，多次听到这种说法，甚至亲自经历过。

paras.en: "You have a takeaway curry one night, then eat the leftovers for breakfast the next morning, and somehow it seems even better," Keast told James Woodford at New Scientist.
paras.zh: “一天晚上你吃一份外卖咖喱，然后第二天早上吃剩菜作为早餐，不知怎的，这似乎更好，”凯斯特告诉《新科学家》杂志的詹姆斯·伍德福德。

paras.en: Starting with a list of 25 dishes, the researchers asked 30 university staff and students to rank the four they most strongly believed improved overnight.
paras.zh: 研究人员从 25 道菜肴开始，要求 30 名大学教职员工和学生对他们最坚信一夜之间有所改善的四道菜肴进行排名。

paras.en: The winners were a familiar lineup: beef lasagna, butter chicken, dhal, and apple crumble.
paras.zh: 获胜者都是熟悉的阵容：牛肉烤宽面条、黄油鸡肉、木豆和苹果酥。

paras.en: For the experiment, a separate group of 65 adults received randomly coded samples of each of the four dishes over two sessions. Some were freshly made that day; others were prepared 24 hours earlier, refrigerated, and reheated.
paras.zh: 在实验中，由 65 名成年人组成的单独小组在两次实验中收到了四道菜中每道菜的随机编码样本。有些是当天新鲜制作的；有些是当天新鲜制作的。其他的则提前 24 小时准备好，冷藏并重新加热。

paras.en: Crucially, nobody was told which was which, so there was less chance of anyone's 'leftovers are better' bias influencing their taste buds.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，没有人知道哪个是哪个，因此任何人的“剩菜更好”偏见影响他们的味蕾的可能性较小。

paras.en: Participants took three challenges for each food: could they distinguish between fresh and day-old versions; if they tasted both side by side, which one they preferred; and, sampled on its own, how much they liked each sample.
paras.zh: 参与者对每种食物提出了三个挑战：他们能否区分新鲜的和一天前的版本？如果他们同时品尝了两种口味，他们更喜欢哪一种？并在单独采样时了解他们对每个样本的喜爱程度。

paras.en: In terms of simply detecting a difference, dhal was the most obvious – people responded "different" 83 percent of the time when the samples were actually different, compared to just over half of the time when given identical samples.
paras.zh: 就简单地检测差异而言，dhal 是最明显的——当样本实际上不同时，人们有 83% 的时间做出“不同”的反应，而当给出相同的样本时，这一比例略高于一半。

paras.en: Butter chicken and apple crumble were also distinguishable after a night in the fridge.
paras.zh: 黄油鸡和苹果酥在冰箱里放了一夜后也能区分出来。

paras.en: Beef lasagna hid its true identity best: The study found no statistically reliable evidence that people could tell the fresh and day-old versions apart.
paras.zh: 牛肉千层面最能隐藏其真实身份：研究发现，没有统计上可靠的证据表明人们可以区分新鲜版本和隔天的版本。

paras.en: However, noticing a change and actually liking something better are two different things. Of the four dishes, only butter chicken was clearly preferred as a day-old leftover, with nearly 64 percent of taste comparisons favoring it.
paras.zh: 然而，注意到变化和实际上更喜欢某件事是两件不同的事情。在这四道菜中，只有黄油鸡显然更受欢迎，因为它是一天的剩菜，近 64% 的口味比较都喜欢它。

paras.en: Although dhal and apple crumble were detectably different, people were about as likely to prefer the fresh version as the leftovers. Lasagna also showed no meaningful preference either way.
paras.zh: 尽管木豆和苹果酥明显不同，但人们更喜欢新鲜的木豆和剩下的木豆。烤宽面条也没有表现出任何有意义的偏好。

paras.en: And when it came to overall liking scores, rated without a side-by-side comparison, there was no statistically significant difference between fresh and day-old for any of the four foods.
paras.zh: 在没有并排比较的情况下进行总体喜好评分时，这四种食物中的任何一种在新鲜和日间之间都没有统计学上的显着差异。

paras.en: Apple crumble was the most popular dish overall, but that only tells us people really like apple crumble. And we're not surprised.
paras.zh: 苹果酥是最受欢迎的菜肴，但这只能告诉我们人们真的很喜欢苹果酥。我们并不感到惊讶。

paras.en: "These findings show that the next-day effect is modest, food-specific, and dependent on the sensory outcome measured," Keast and colleagues write.
paras.zh: Keast 及其同事写道：“这些研究结果表明，第二天的效果是适度的、特定于食物的，并且取决于测量的感官结果。”

paras.en: You can even run your own tests on the same foods if you're feeling adventurous, since the researchers included their exact recipes in their supplementary materials.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢冒险，您甚至可以对相同的食物进行自己的测试，因为研究人员在其补充材料中包含了他们的确切食谱。

paras.en: The study can't say why butter chicken improves overnight, since it measured what people tasted, not the chemistry behind it. But a few established food science mechanisms are worth considering.
paras.zh: 这项研究无法解释为什么黄油鸡一夜之间就会改善，因为它测量的是人们的味道，而不是其背后的化学成分。但一些已建立的食品科学机制值得考虑。

paras.en: One is that food flavor is a complex, multi-sense experience.
paras.zh: 一是食品风味是一种复杂的、多感官的体验。

paras.en: Aroma, taste, texture, temperature, and even memory all fold together in your brain before it registers deliciousness, according to a perspective article by experimental psychologist Charles Spence from the University of Oxford.
paras.zh: 牛津大学实验心理学家查尔斯·斯彭斯 (Charles Spence) 发表的一篇观点文章指出，香气、味道、质地、温度，甚至记忆都会在你的大脑中融合在一起，然后才会记录出美味。

paras.en: A sauce-rich dish like butter chicken may have more moving parts for flavor and aroma compounds to redistribute overnight than a more structured dish like lasagna, the researchers suggest.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，与烤宽面条等结构更丰富的菜肴相比，黄油鸡等酱汁丰富的菜肴可能具有更多的风味和香气化合物的移动部分，可以在一夜之间重新分配。

paras.en: There is a less appealing possibility. When you store and then reheat meaty dishes, you can get what's called warmed-over flavor, a slightly stale or cardboard-like note caused by fats in the meat reacting with oxygen while sitting in the fridge.
paras.zh: 还有一种不太吸引人的可能性。当你储存并重新加热肉类菜肴时，你会得到所谓的“热味”，这是一种稍微陈旧或类似纸板的味道，是由于肉中的脂肪在冰箱中与氧气发生反应而产生的。

paras.en: Researchers have studied warmed-over flavor since at least the 1950s, and a 1977 review linked it to fat breakdown in stored cooked meat. A more recent study using sensitive aroma-detecting equipment on reheated pork identified several of the specific compounds responsible for it.
paras.zh: 至少从 20 世纪 50 年代起，研究人员就开始研究加热后的味道，1977 年的一篇评论将其与储存熟肉中的脂肪分解联系起来。最近的一项研究使用灵敏的香气检测设备对再加热的猪肉进行了研究，确定了几种造成这种情况的特定化合物。

paras.en: The Deakin team suggests that butter chicken's spiced, fatty sauce might actually help to mask or counteract those less tasty changes. But they stress that they didn't test this.
paras.zh: 迪肯团队建议，黄油鸡的五香、脂肪酱实际上可能有助于掩盖或抵消那些不太美味的变化。但他们强调他们没有对此进行测试。

paras.en: Today's rice and pasta may be firmer or grainier tomorrow due to retrogradation, when starch molecules reform more rigid structures after cooling and storing. That could be one reason why lasagna's pasta-cheese-meat structure didn't get a next-day glow-up.
paras.zh: 今天的大米和面食明天可能会由于回生而变得更坚硬或更有颗粒感，淀粉分子在冷却和储存后会重新形成更坚硬的结构。这可能是烤宽面条的意大利面-奶酪-肉结构第二天没有焕发光彩的原因之一。

paras.en: In the real world, there's also the psychological 'seasoning': our own anticipations.
paras.zh: 在现实世界中，还有心理“调味料”：我们自己的预期。

paras.en: Research shows that believing a food will taste a certain way can measurably shift how good we judge it to be, sometimes even altering our brain's response to it.
paras.zh: 研究表明，相信某种食物的味道会显着改变我们对它的判断，有时甚至会改变我们大脑对它的反应。

paras.en: This experiment was blind, but in your actual kitchen, with your expectations fully switched on, the effect might well be more powerful than these results suggest.
paras.zh: 这个实验是盲目的，但在你的实际厨房中，当你的期望完全开启时，效果很可能比这些结果显示的更强大。

paras.en: There are other limitations. The research hasn't been peer-reviewed yet, and 65 people testing four recipes is hardly a sweeping verdict on all foods.
paras.zh: 还有其他限制。这项研究尚未经过同行评审，65 人测试了四种食谱并不能对所有食物做出全面的结论。

paras.en: It does seem that leftovers aren't always better.
paras.zh: 看来剩菜并不总是更好。

paras.en: But the findings support a more precise version of the story.
paras.zh: 但调查结果支持了更精确的故事版本。

paras.en: "The next-day effect should therefore be understood as a product-specific sensory outcome rather than a general property of meat-based, curry-style, or savory foods," Keast and team write.
paras.zh: “因此，第二天的效果应该被理解为特定产品的感官结果，而不是肉类、咖喱类或咸味食品的一般特性，”凯斯特和团队写道。

paras.en: Perhaps the next time someone insists that their curry is scientifically better the next day, you can tell them it depends on the curry.
paras.zh: 也许下次有人坚持认为第二天他们的咖喱在科学上更好时，你可以告诉他们这取决于咖喱。

paras.en: The research is available on Preprints.org.
paras.zh: 该研究可在 Preprints.org 上获取。

articles.title: This Dangerous Fungus Has Become Resistant to Every Major Antifungal Drug We Have… Twice
articles.author: Starre Vartan

paras.en: There's a new fungus amongus, and it's raising red flags among health care experts because it resists all the major antifungal treatments.
paras.zh: 我们中间出现了一种新真菌，它引起了医疗保健专家的警惕，因为它对所有主要的抗真菌治疗都有抵抗力。

paras.en: The discovery involves Candidozyma auris (formerly known as Candida auris), an emerging fungal pathogen that has already become a serious problem in hospitals around the world.
paras.zh: 这一发现涉及耳念珠菌（以前称为耳念珠菌），这是一种新兴的真菌病原体，已成为世界各地医院的一个严重问题。

paras.en: Since it was first described in 2009, this fungus has spread to more than 60 countries across six continents, causing healthcare-associated outbreaks and invasive infections, with mortality rates of 30–50 percent reported in some situations.
paras.zh: 自 2009 年首次被描述以来，这种真菌已传播到六大洲的 60 多个国家，引起与医疗保健相关的疫情和侵袭性感染，据报道在某些情况下死亡率高达 30-50%。

paras.en: The fungus can persist in healthcare environments and spread easily between patients. Because of its combination of antifungal resistance and potential for wider spread, the World Health Organization designated C. auris a critical-priority fungal pathogen in 2022.
paras.zh: 这种真菌可以在医疗环境中持续存在，并且很容易在患者之间传播。由于耳念珠菌具有抗真菌耐药性和更广泛传播的潜力，世界卫生组织于 2022 年将耳念珠菌指定为关键优先真菌病原体。

paras.en: But the particular strain of this fungus described in a new paper has something especially troubling going for it: laboratory testing found it resistant to all four major classes of antifungal drugs.
paras.zh: 但一篇新论文中描述的这种真菌的特殊菌株有一些特别令人不安的地方：实验室测试发现它对所有四种主要抗真菌药物都有耐药性。

paras.en: The isolate was recovered from a 28-year-old woman who developed a hospital-acquired surgical-site infection after elective surgery at a hospital in Nairobi, Kenya. It's the first such case in Africa.
paras.zh: 该分离物是从一名 28 岁女性身上发现的，她在肯尼亚内罗毕一家医院接受择期手术后出现医院获得性手术部位感染。这是非洲首例此类病例。

paras.en: The woman's wound swab eventually grew C. auris, and genomic testing confirmed that the fungus belonged to one of the clades associated with high levels of antifungal resistance.
paras.zh: 该妇女的伤口拭子最终长出了耳念珠菌，基因组测试证实该真菌属于与高水平抗真菌耐药性相关的分支之一。

paras.en: The researchers call this particular strain pan-drug-resistant, or PDR–meaning it was resistant to the antifungals in familiar drugs like fluconazole, caspofungin, micafungin, amphotericin B, and flucytosine.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种特殊菌株称为泛耐药菌株（PDR），意思是它对氟康唑、卡泊芬净、米卡芬净、两性霉素 B 和氟胞嘧啶等常见药物中的抗真菌药物具有耐药性。

paras.en: Pan-drug resistance like this is exceptionally rare. The researchers describe their Kenyan isolate as the first PDR C. auris identified in Africa and only the second globally documented case; another had previously been reported in New York in 2022.
paras.zh: 像这样的泛耐药性极为罕见。研究人员将他们在肯尼亚分离的菌株描述为在非洲发现的第一个 PDR 耳念珠菌，也是全球记录的第二个病例；此前曾报道过另一起 2022 年在纽约发生的事件。

paras.en: To better understand this resistance, the team sequenced its entire genome.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解这种抵抗力，研究小组对其整个基因组进行了测序。

paras.en: They found several mutations already associated with antifungal resistance, including changes in the genes ERG11 and CDR1, which are linked to resistance to azole drugs, an alteration in the FKS1 gene associated with resistance to echinocandins, and a "stop-gain" mutation in FUR1, a gene involved in processing the drug flucytosine.
paras.zh: 他们发现了一些与抗真菌耐药性相关的突变，包括与唑类药物耐药性相关的基因 ERG11 和 CDR1 的变化、与棘白菌素耐药性相关的 FKS1 基因的变化，以及参与加工药物氟胞嘧啶的基因 FUR1 的“停止增益”突变。

paras.en: The strain's genetic profile may provide clues about how its resistance arose.
paras.zh: 该菌株的遗传图谱可能提供有关其耐药性如何产生的线索。

paras.en: The researchers note that the mutations differ from those found in previously reported strains in New York, raising the possibility that pan-drug resistance evolved independently rather than simply being imported from the United States to Kenya.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，这些突变与先前报道的纽约菌株中发现的突变不同，这增加了泛耐药性独立进化的可能性，而不是简单地从美国输入到肯尼亚。

paras.en: Nor can they determine whether the patient's previous exposure to antifungal drugs helped select for resistance. Her clinical history shows that she received several antifungal medications during her illness, but the researchers didn't have enough information about doses and treatment durations to establish whether those drugs drove the evolution of resistance in this particular infection.
paras.zh: 他们也无法确定患者之前接触过抗真菌药物是否有助于选择耐药性。她的临床病史显示，她在患病期间接受了多种抗真菌药物，但研究人员没有足够的有关剂量和治疗持续时间的信息来确定这些药物是否推动了这种特定感染的耐药性进化。

paras.en: The authors call this finding alarming, especially in regions where access to newer antifungal drugs can be limited.
paras.zh: 作者称这一发现令人震惊，尤其是在获得新型抗真菌药物的机会受到限制的地区。

paras.en: The authors point to the "escalating threat of untreatable fungal infections" and call for stronger surveillance of fungal genomes, as well as "rapid diagnostic capacity to mitigate the spread of highly resistant C. auris lineages in healthcare settings," as they write in the paper.
paras.zh: 作者在论文中写道，他们指出“无法治疗的真菌感染的威胁不断升级”，并呼吁加强对真菌基因组的监测，以及“快速诊断能力，以减轻高耐药性耳念珠菌谱系在医疗机构中的传播”。

paras.en: For now, the highly resistant C. auris is super-rare. But it has already demonstrated its ability to move through hospitals, acquire resistance, and evolve in response to treatment.
paras.zh: 目前，高度耐药的耳念珠菌极为罕见。但它已经证明了它能够在医院中传播、获得抵抗力并根据治疗而进化。

paras.en: A fungus that can survive nearly every standard antifungal weapon is a reminder that, in the microbial arms race, the enemy doesn't have to be common to be consequential.
paras.zh: 一种能够在几乎所有标准抗真菌武器中存活下来的真菌提醒我们，在微生物军备竞赛中，敌人不一定是常见的才具有重要意义。

paras.en: The research has been published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学报告》上。

articles.title: We May Have Been Wrong About Fasting Before Blood Tests, Study Reveals
articles.author: Russell McLendon

paras.en: Fasting is a common requirement for many routine laboratory blood tests, with patients often instructed to avoid eating or drinking anything except water for 8 to 12 hours before their sample is taken.
paras.zh: 禁食是许多常规实验室血液检查的常见要求，患者通常会被告知在取样前 8 至 12 小时内不要吃或喝除水以外的任何东西。

paras.en: According to a new study, however, this step may be unnecessary for a wide range of tests.
paras.zh: 然而，根据一项新的研究，对于多种测试来说，这一步可能是不必要的。

paras.en: Aside from a few notable exceptions, the findings suggest many patients could eat and drink in the hours before their tests without throwing off the results.
paras.zh: 除了一些值得注意的例外之外，研究结果表明，许多患者可以在测试前的几个小时内进食和饮水，而不会影响结果。

paras.en: These results alone may not yet warrant changing the pre-test fasting standard, nor do they mean you should disregard medical instructions to fast. But they do provide compelling evidence for re-evaluating the wisdom of default fasting before routine bloodwork.
paras.zh: 仅凭这些结果可能还不足以改变测试前的禁食标准，也不意味着您应该忽视禁食的医疗指示。但它们确实为重新评估常规抽血前默认禁食的明智性提供了令人信服的证据。

paras.en: "Our comprehensive analysis suggests that most routine blood tests are minimally affected by short-term fasting, and fasting beyond 12 hours was not associated with meaningful additional differences for any test examined," the study's authors write.
paras.zh: 该研究的作者写道：“我们的综合分析表明，大多数常规血液检查受短期禁食的影响微乎其微，并且禁食超过 12 小时与所检查的任何检查的有意义的额外差异无关。”

paras.en: "These findings suggest that traditional rigid fasting requirements may warrant reconsideration in favor of a more nuanced, analyte-specific approach to pretest preparation."
paras.zh: “这些发现表明，传统的严格禁食要求可能需要重新考虑，以支持采用更细致、针对特定分析物的测试前准备方法。”

paras.en: Those rigid fasting rules originally grew from concerns that patients' diets might jeopardize clinical accuracy. Results of blood tests often provide the basis for important medical decisions, and some measurements really are significantly sensitive to variables that occur before the test, such as food intake.
paras.zh: 这些严格的禁食规则最初是出于对患者饮食可能会损害临床准确性的担忧。血液测试的结果通常为重要的医疗决策提供基础，并且某些测量结果确实对测试前发生的变量（例如食物摄入量）非常敏感。

paras.en: To minimize this variability, clinicians began broadly instructing patients to fast for eight to 12 hours before blood sampling – "a practice that originated with lipid and glucose testing," the researchers explain, "but is now applied by default to much broader test panels."
paras.zh: 为了尽量减少这种变异性，临床医生开始广泛指导患者在采血前禁食 8 至 12 小时——研究人员解释说，“这种做法起源于血脂和血糖测试，但现在默认应用于更广泛的测试组。”

paras.en: Yet despite the prevalence of this practice, recommendations for optimal fasting duration remain inconsistent. Research suggests fasting helps with certain tests, but its value across a diverse panel of tests hasn't been systematically studied with clinical data.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管这种做法很普遍，但最佳禁食时间的建议仍然不一致。研究表明禁食有助于某些测试，但其在多种测试中的价值尚未通过临床数据进行系统研究。

paras.en: Research on pre-test fasting comes largely from lipid tests, while comparable data are limited for tests focused on metrics such as liver enzymes, pancreatic enzymes, hematologic indices, hormones, and vitamins, the authors note.
paras.zh: 作者指出，关于测试前禁食的研究主要来自血脂测试，而针对肝酶、胰酶、血液学指数、激素和维生素等指标的测试，可比数据有限。

paras.en: As such, fasting recommendations can vary from one lab to another.
paras.zh: 因此，不同实验室的禁食建议可能有所不同。

paras.en: Given the limitations of existing research on the subject – plus the burden fasting can impose on patients – the authors of the new study took a closer look at this clinical tradition.
paras.zh: 考虑到该主题现有研究的局限性，加上禁食可能给患者带来的负担，这项新研究的作者仔细研究了这一临床传统。

paras.en: Led by Sunghwan Shin, a laboratory medicine physician at the University of Ulsan's Asan Medical Center in Seoul, the researchers conducted a retrospective cross-sectional study using lab data collected between 2021 and 2023 from a single 670-bed university hospital.
paras.zh: 在首尔蔚山大学牙山医学中心的检验医学医师 Sunghwan Shin 的带领下，研究人员利用 2021 年至 2023 年从一家拥有 670 个床位的大学医院收集的实验室数据进行了一项回顾性横断面研究。

paras.en: Study subjects were all adult outpatients with documented pre-bloodwork fasting durations, which the authors of the new study divided into three categories: less than eight hours, eight to 12 hours, or more than 12 hours.
paras.zh: 研究对象都是有记录的抽血前禁食持续时间的成年门诊患者，新研究的作者将其分为三类：少于 8 小时、8 至 12 小时或超过 12 小时。

paras.en: Their final data set included over 9.7 million test results from more than 101,000 patients, which the researchers scoured for signs of fasting-related differences that exceed established analytical performance specifications (APS).
paras.zh: 他们的最终数据集包括来自 101,000 多名患者的超过 970 万个测试结果，研究人员在这些结果中寻找与禁食相关的差异迹象，这些差异超出了既定的分析性能规范 (APS)。

paras.en: After performing between-group comparisons and within-person analyses, they found a link between fasting duration and APS-exceeding differences for just 10 of the 121 analytes targeted by the blood tests.
paras.zh: 在进行组间比较和个人分析后，他们发现，在血液检测的 121 种分析物中，只有 10 种的禁食时间与 APS 超出差异之间存在联系。

paras.en: Fasting does seem to help for those few analytes – mainly glucose, triglycerides, gamma-glutamyl transferase, and lipase, all of which were higher in patients who fasted for less than eight hours.
paras.zh: 禁食似乎确实对那些少数分析物有帮助——主要是葡萄糖、甘油三酯、γ-谷氨酰转移酶和脂肪酶，所有这些在禁食少于八小时的患者中都较高。

paras.en: For many of the other analytes, however, the findings suggest fasting for eight hours or more might be a needless burden.
paras.zh: 然而，对于许多其他分析物来说，研究结果表明禁食八小时或更长时间可能是不必要的负担。

paras.en: "These findings support analyte-specific rather than uniform fasting requirements," the authors write.
paras.zh: “这些发现支持针对特定分析物的要求，而不是统一的禁食要求，”作者写道。

paras.en: In an accompanying commentary, clinical biochemist Liv Tybjærg Nordestgaard of Copenhagen University Hospital and her colleagues note the study "provides strong support for accumulating evidence that fasting blood sampling is not necessary."
paras.zh: 在随附的评论中，哥本哈根大学医院的临床生物化学家 Liv Tybjærg Nordestgaard 和她的同事指出，这项研究“为积累证据提供了强有力的支持，证明空腹抽血是不必要的。”

paras.en: The research has been published in JAMA Internal Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《美国医学会内科学》杂志上。

articles.title: Chang’e-6 lunar soil contains a surprising magnetic time capsule

paras.en: Changâe-6 lunar soil contains a surprising magnetic time capsule
paras.zh: 嫦娥六号月球土壤含有令人惊讶的磁性时间胶囊

paras.en: - Chinese Academy of Sciences Headquarters
paras.zh: - 中国科学院本部

paras.en: - Scientists studying Changâe-6 lunar soil have discovered a previously unknown magnetic mineral in natural Moon samples: a form of metallic iron called Î³-Fe. Found inside tiny impact-glass particles, the nanoscale iron can preserve a stable magnetic signal, potentially acting like a microscopic fossil of the Moonâs long-lost magnetic field.
paras.zh: - 研究嫦娥六号月球土壤的科学家在月球天然样本中发现了一种以前未知的磁性矿物：一种称为γ-Fe的金属铁。纳米级铁存在于微小的冲击玻璃颗粒中，可以保存稳定的磁信号，可能像月球失落已久的磁场的微观化石一样。

paras.en: The Moon no longer generates a global magnetic field, but traces of its ancient magnetism remain locked inside lunar rocks and soil. By studying the magnetic minerals preserved in these materials, scientists can reconstruct how the Moon's magnetic environment changed over time.
paras.zh: 月球不再产生全球磁场，但其古代磁性的痕迹仍然被锁在月球岩石和土壤中。通过研究这些材料中保存的磁性矿物，科学家可以重建月球的磁性环境如何随时间变化。

paras.en: Researchers analyzing metallic iron inside impact glass from Chang'e-6 lunar soil have now identified face-centered cubic γ-Fe for the first time in natural lunar samples.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析嫦娥六号月壤撞击玻璃内的金属铁，首次在天然月球样品中发现了面心立方γ-Fe。

paras.en: The study was led by Prof. Haifeng Du of the High Magnetic Field Laboratory at the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science (HFIPS) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). The findings were published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS) on September 16.
paras.zh: 该研究由中国科学院（CAS）合肥物质科学研究院（HFIPS）强磁场实验室杜海峰教授领导。研究结果发表在 9 月 16 日的《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）上。

paras.en: "This tiny magnetic fossil may help us better understand the Moon's ancient magnetic history," said Dr. Long Li from HFIPS, a member of the team.
paras.zh: “这个微小的磁性化石可能有助于我们更好地了解月球的古代磁性历史，”该团队成员、来自 HFIPS 的李龙博士说。

paras.en: To examine the samples, the researchers used focused ion beam preparation, transmission electron microscopy, and chemical analysis. These techniques revealed numerous nanoscale iron particles embedded throughout the glassy material.
paras.zh: 为了检查样品，研究人员使用聚焦离子束制备、透射电子显微镜和化学分析。这些技术揭示了玻璃材料中嵌入的大量纳米级铁颗粒。

paras.en: Closer examination showed that some of the particles consisted of face-centered cubic γ-Fe. In fact, γ-Fe was the dominant form of iron in the two impact-glass samples studied.
paras.zh: 仔细检查表明，一些颗粒由面心立方 γ-Fe 组成。事实上，γ-Fe 是所研究的两个冲击玻璃样品中铁的主要形式。

paras.en: Under normal conditions, γ-Fe is stable only at high temperatures. As the material cools, it typically changes into another form known as α-Fe. The researchers found evidence that the unusual conditions produced by impacts on the Moon may allow γ-Fe to survive at the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 在正常条件下，γ-Fe仅在高温下稳定。当材料冷却时，它通常会转变为另一种形式，称为 α-Fe。研究人员发现的证据表明，月球撞击产生的异常条件可能使γ-Fe能够在月球表面生存。

paras.en: They proposed that several factors could help stabilize the structure, including small amounts of carbon and other elements, the rapid cooling of molten material created during an impact, and protection from the surrounding glassy matrix.
paras.zh: 他们提出，有几个因素可以帮助稳定结构，包括少量的碳和其他元素、撞击过程中产生的熔融材料的快速冷却，以及免受周围玻璃基质的影响。

paras.en: Tiny Particles That Can Preserve Magnetism
paras.zh: 可以保持磁性的微小颗粒

paras.en: The team also used off-axis electron holography to investigate the magnetic behavior of individual γ-Fe nanoparticles.
paras.zh: 该团队还使用离轴电子全息术来研究单个 γ-Fe 纳米颗粒的磁性行为。

paras.en: They found that relatively large γ-Fe particles could form a stable single-vortex magnetic state. The particles also retained a consistent magnetic response when exposed to an external magnetic field.
paras.zh: 他们发现相对较大的γ-Fe颗粒可以形成稳定的单涡磁态。当暴露于外部磁场时，颗粒还保持一致的磁响应。

paras.en: That stability suggests γ-Fe could act as a previously unrecognized recorder of magnetic information in lunar material, preserving clues about conditions that existed during the Moon's past.
paras.zh: 这种稳定性表明γ-Fe可以充当月球物质中以前未被识别的磁信息记录器，保留有关月球过去存在的条件的线索。

paras.en: A New Window Into the Moon's Magnetic Past
paras.zh: 了解月球磁性过去的新窗口

paras.en: The discovery broadens the known variety of magnetic minerals found in lunar samples. Because γ-Fe and α-Fe form under different conditions and behave differently magnetically, each could potentially record information from separate stages of lunar impact events.
paras.zh: 这一发现扩大了月球样本中发现的磁性矿物的已知种类。由于 γ-Fe 和 α-Fe 在不同的条件下形成，并且磁性表现不同，因此每种物质都可能记录月球撞击事件不同阶段的信息。

paras.en: Future research will be needed to determine exactly how much these minerals can reveal about the Moon's ancient magnetic field and how that field evolved over time.
paras.zh: 未来的研究将需要确定这些矿物到底能在多大程度上揭示月球的古代磁场以及该磁场如何随着时间的推移而演变。

paras.en: Materials provided by Chinese Academy of Sciences Headquarters. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由中国科学院总部提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Pengfei Liu, Ziliang Jin, Zheng Gong, Long Li, Kang Wang, Xiandi Zeng, Jing Liu, Dongsheng Song, Haifeng Du, Kelei Zhu, Chuanxin Yan, Jinhua Li, Keke Zhang, Wyn Williams, Ann M. Hirt. Magnetic vortex state of natural lunar Î³-Fe. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 2026; 123 (38) DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2608395123
paras.zh: - 刘鹏飞、金子良、龚正、李龙、王康、曾宪迪、刘静、宋东升、杜海峰、朱克雷、严传鑫、李金华、张可克、Wyn Williams、Ann M. Hirt。天然月球γ-Fe的磁涡状态。美国国家科学院院刊，2026 年； 123 (38) DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2608395123

articles.title: ESA’s Juice just used Earth as a slingshot to Jupiter

paras.en: ESAâs Juice just used Earth as a slingshot to Jupiter
paras.zh: ESA 的 Juice 刚刚将地球用作通往木星的弹弓

paras.en: - ESAâs Juice spacecraft raced past Earth on September 28, using our planetâs gravity to dramatically reshape its path toward Jupiter without burning much fuel. The flyby changed its direction by 20 degrees and increased its speed by 3.5 km/s, while also giving scientists a rare chance to test its instruments on Earth and the Moon.
paras.zh: - 9 月 28 日，欧空局的 Juice 航天器飞越地球，利用地球的引力极大地改变了其飞往木星的路径，而无需燃烧太多燃料。这次飞越改变了方向 20 度，速度增加了 3.5 公里/秒，同时也给了科学家一个难得的机会在地球和月球上测试其仪器。

paras.en: The European Space Agency's Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (Juice) made a close pass by Earth on September 28, skimming the outer reaches of the atmosphere and using our planet's gravity to reshape its path toward Jupiter while consuming very little fuel.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局的木星冰卫星探测器（Juice）于 9 月 28 日近距离掠过地球，掠过大气层外层，利用地球引力重塑其飞往木星的路径，同时消耗很少的燃料。

paras.en: The carefully planned gravity assist changed Juice's direction by 20° relative to its previous trajectory and increased its speed by 3.5 km/s. During the four weeks leading up to the encounter, mission controllers needed to make only one small course correction (out of six opportunities set aside) to place the spacecraft on the precise approach needed to take full advantage of Earth's gravity.
paras.zh: 精心策划的重力辅助使 Juice 的方向相对于之前的轨迹改变了 20°，并将速度提高了 3.5 公里/秒。在相遇前的四个星期内，任务控制人员只需要进行一次小的航向修正（在预留的六次机会中），以使航天器处于充分利用地球引力所需的精确位置。

paras.en: Controllers began monitoring Juice particularly closely on August 17 and will continue that intensive tracking through October 10.
paras.zh: 管制人员从 8 月 17 日起开始对 Juice 进行特别密切的监控，并将持续到 10 月 10 日。

paras.en: Juice reached its closest point to Earth at 13:45 CEST (11:45 UTC) on September 28. At that moment, the spacecraft passed just 8640 km above the Indian Ocean while taking a sequence of images with its onboard monitoring cameras.
paras.zh: Juice 于 9 月 28 日欧洲夏令时间 13:45（世界标准时间 11:45）到达距地球最近的地点。此时，航天器在印度洋上空仅 8640 公里处飞过，同时用机载监控摄像头拍摄了一系列图像。

paras.en: "The flyby required ultra-precise navigation in real time. Thanks to our very careful planning, we used only a small amount of the propellant reserved for this flyby," says Angela Dietz, Juice's Spacecraft Operations Manager. "This gives us more to use at Jupiter to carry out observations of the planet's icy moons."
paras.zh: “这次飞越需要超精确的实时导航。由于我们非常仔细的规划，我们只使用了为这次飞越保留的少量推进剂，”Juice 航天器运营经理安吉拉·迪茨 (Angela Dietz) 说道。 “这使我们可以在木星上使用更多的东西来对木星的冰卫星进行观测。”

paras.en: Preserving that fuel is especially valuable because Juice will eventually need it while carrying out its ambitious scientific campaign around Jupiter and its moons.
paras.zh: 保存这种燃料特别有价值，因为果汁公司在围绕木星及其卫星开展雄心勃勃的科学活动时最终将需要它。

paras.en: Changing the spacecraft's trajectory was the primary purpose of the flyby, but the encounter also gave the mission team a valuable chance to test Juice's science instruments using a real planetary target.
paras.zh: 改变航天器的轨道是这次飞越的主要目的，但这次遭遇也给了任务团队一个宝贵的机会，可以使用真实的行星目标来测试 Juice 的科学仪器。

paras.en: This was the third such opportunity during the mission. The first came during Juice's 2024 lunar-Earth gravity assist, followed by the spacecraft's 2025 observations of Comet 3I/ATLAS.
paras.zh: 这是任务期间第三次有这样的机会。第一次是在 Juice 2024 年月球-地球重力辅助期间进行的，随后是该航天器在 2025 年对彗星 3I/ATLAS 进行的观测。

paras.en: Teams from ESA's spacecraft operations, science operations and technical centers spent months coordinating with the outside groups responsible for Juice's 10 scientific instruments. Their goal was to carefully schedule when each instrument could operate and extract as much science and calibration time as possible from the spacecraft's limited resources.
paras.zh: 来自 ESA 航天器运营、科学运营和技术中心的团队花了数月时间与负责 Juice 10 台科学仪器的外部团队进行协调。他们的目标是仔细安排每个仪器何时可以运行，并从航天器有限的资源中提取尽可能多的科学和校准时间。

paras.en: "Juice's journey to Jupiter provides only a few opportunities to calibrate and validate the instruments under well-understood environmental conditions," explains Juice project scientist Claire Vallat, who led the effort.
paras.zh: “Juice 的木星之旅只提供了一些在充分了解的环境条件下校准和验证仪器的机会，”领导这项工作的 Juice 项目科学家 Claire Vallat 解释道。

paras.en: "Given the limited time available and operational constraints, instrument activities sometimes have to be prioritized, for example when Juice was in Earth's shadow this morning, and relying on battery power alone. During this flyby, calibration activities were prioritized based on their relevance to preparing the instruments for their work at Jupiter, while also considering whether an opportunity is unique or can be scheduled later in the journey."
paras.zh: “鉴于可用时间有限和操作限制，有时必须对仪器活动进行优先排序，例如，当 Juice 今天早上处于地球阴影中时，并且仅依赖电池供电。在这次飞越期间，根据校准活动与为木星工作准备仪器的相关性来确定校准活动的优先顺序，同时还考虑机会是否是独一无二的或可以在旅程的后期安排。”

paras.en: Although the Earth encounter required extensive preparation, it is relatively simple compared with what awaits Juice at Jupiter. The spacecraft is scheduled to carry out 35 flybys of the giant planet's large moons Ganymede, Callisto and Europa.
paras.zh: 尽管与地球的相遇需要大量的准备工作，但与在木星等待的果汁相比，它相对简单。该航天器计划对这颗巨行星的大卫星木卫三、木卫四和木卫二进行 35 次飞越。

paras.en: Planning for those encounters began years in advance. For the Europa flybys, discussions about how the instruments will operate began about 10 years ago and will continue until Juice finally passes the moon in the early 2030s.
paras.zh: 这些遭遇的计划提前几年就开始了。对于木卫二的飞越，有关仪器如何运行的讨论大约在 10 年前就开始了，并将持续到 Juice 在 2030 年代初最终飞越月球为止。

paras.en: Earth therefore serves as an important rehearsal. Scientists can use the flyby to calibrate the instruments, learn how they behave once they are operating in space (where they always work a little differently to on Earth!), and refine the tools that will later be used to analyze the data.
paras.zh: 因此，地球是一次重要的预演。科学家可以利用飞越来校准仪器，了解它们在太空中运行后的行为方式（它们的工作方式总是与地球上略有不同！），并改进随后用于分析数据的工具。

paras.en: The encounters with Jupiter's icy moons will be much more scientifically demanding. By then, Juice will need to be ready to capture as much high-quality information as possible during each precious flyby.
paras.zh: 与木星冰冷卫星的相遇在科学上要求更高。届时，Juice 将需要做好准备，在每次珍贵的飞越过程中捕获尽可能多的高质量信息。

paras.en: The spacecraft also spent several days traveling through Earth's magnetotail, the long extension of Earth's magnetic field that stretches away from the Sun.
paras.zh: 该航天器还花了几天时间穿过地球的磁尾，这是地球磁场远离太阳的延伸部分。

paras.en: That gave Juice an opportunity to measure magnetic fields and electrically charged particles far from Earth. At the same time, the European-Chinese Smile mission has been observing the northern lights while measuring magnetic fields and particles much closer to the planet.
paras.zh: 这让 Juice 有机会测量远离地球的磁场和带电粒子。与此同时，欧洲-中国微笑任务一直在观测北极光，同时测量距离地球更近的磁场和粒子。

paras.en: Combining measurements from Juice and Smile could give scientists a rare way to link activity deep in Earth's magnetotail with events occurring around the planet's polar regions.
paras.zh: 将“果汁”和“微笑”的测量结果结合起来，可以为科学家提供一种罕见的方法，将地球磁尾深处的活动与地球极地地区发生的事件联系起来。

paras.en: Scientists expect to release images and spectra from some of Juice's instruments in the coming weeks, once the data have reached Earth and instrument teams have had time to evaluate them. Among the anticipated results are high-resolution images of Earth and the Moon taken by JANUS, Juice's scientific camera.
paras.zh: 一旦数据到达地球并且仪器团队有时间对其进行评估，科学家们预计将在未来几周内发布 Juice 的一些仪器的图像和光谱。预期结果包括 Juice 的科学相机 JANUS 拍摄的地球和月球的高分辨率图像。

paras.en: Juice Will Return to Earth One More Time
paras.zh: 果汁将再次返回地球

paras.en: In January 2029, the spacecraft will return for a third and final flyby of our planet. That encounter will place Juice on the final trajectory needed to reach Jupiter in 2031.
paras.zh: 2029 年 1 月，航天器将第三次也是最后一次飞越我们的星球。这次相遇将使 Juice 走上 2031 年到达木星所需的最终轨道。

paras.en: ESA's Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, 'Juice', is humankind's next bold mission to the outer Solar System. It will make detailed observations of gas giant Jupiter and its three large ocean-bearing moons - Ganymede, Callisto and Europa. This ambitious mission will characterise these moons with a powerful suite of remote sensing, geophysical and in situ instruments to discover more about these compelling destinations as potential habitats for past or present life.
paras.zh: 欧空局的木星冰卫星探测器“果汁”是人类前往太阳系外层的下一个大胆任务。它将对气态巨行星木星及其三颗大型海洋卫星——木卫三、木卫四和木卫二进行详细观测。这项雄心勃勃的任务将利用一套强大的遥感、地球物理和现场仪器来描述这些卫星的特征，以更多地了解这些引人注目的目的地作为过去或现在生命的潜在栖息地。

paras.en: Juice will monitor Jupiter's complex magnetic, radiation and plasma environment in depth and its interplay with the moons, studying the Jupiter system as an archetype for gas giant systems across the Universe.
paras.zh: Juice将深入监测木星复杂的磁场、辐射和等离子体环境及其与卫星的相互作用，研究木星系统作为整个宇宙气体巨行星系统的原型。

paras.en: Juice launched on an Ariane 5 from Europe's Spaceport in Kourou in April 2023. It has an eight-year cruise with flybys of Earth and Venus to slingshot it to Jupiter. It will make 35 flybys of the three large moons while orbiting Jupiter, before changing orbits to Ganymede.
paras.zh: Juice 于 2023 年 4 月在阿丽亚娜 5 号上从位于库鲁的欧洲太空港发射升空。它进行了为期八年的巡航，飞越地球和金星，然后弹射到木星。它将在绕木星运行时飞越三颗大卫星 35 次，然后改变轨道前往木卫三。

paras.en: Materials provided by European Space Agency (ESA). Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲航天局 (ESA) 提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: This protective enzyme could help stop fatty liver disease from getting worse

paras.en: This protective enzyme could help stop fatty liver disease from getting worse
paras.zh: 这种保护酶可以帮助阻止脂肪肝疾病恶化

paras.en: - Scientists have identified an enzyme that may act as a natural defense against the worsening of fatty liver disease, which affects an estimated 100 million Americans. The enzyme, called UBE2N, helps liver cells clear away damaged mitochondria and break down fat, potentially preventing the inflammation, scarring, and cell damage associated with the more dangerous condition MASH.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了一种酶，可以作为对抗脂肪肝疾病恶化的天然防御手段，这种疾病影响着大约一亿美国人。这种名为 UBE2N 的酶可以帮助肝细胞清除受损的线粒体并分解脂肪，从而有可能预防与更危险的 MASH 病症相关的炎症、疤痕和细胞损伤。

paras.en: Researchers co-led by Cedars-Sinai Health Sciences University have identified an enzyme that may help protect the liver from the damage that can occur as the most common form of liver disease becomes more severe. The findings, from a preclinical study published in Nature Metabolism, could eventually support new strategies for preventing serious liver injury and progression toward liver failure.
paras.zh: 由雪松-西奈健康科学大学共同领导的研究人员发现了一种酶，可以帮助保护肝脏免受最常见的肝病变得更加严重时可能发生的损害。该研究结果来自发表在《自然代谢》杂志上的一项临床前研究，最终可能支持预防严重肝损伤和肝衰竭进展的新策略。

paras.en: An estimated 100 million people in the U.S. have metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), formerly called nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, according to the American Liver Foundation. Roughly 20% to 25% of those affected go on to develop metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a more serious form of the condition in which excess liver fat is accompanied by inflammation, cell injury and scarring.
paras.zh: 据美国肝脏基金会称，估计美国有 1 亿人患有代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病 (MASLD)，以前称为非酒精性脂肪肝病。大约 20% 到 25% 的受影响者会发展为代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝炎 (MASH)，这是一种更严重的疾病，肝脏脂肪过多，并伴有炎症、细胞损伤和疤痕。

paras.en: Current care mainly centers on lifestyle changes and efforts to limit additional liver damage. Although medications are available, treatment options are still limited, and there is currently no cure for MASH.
paras.zh: 目前的护理主要集中在改变生活方式和努力限制额外的肝损伤。尽管有药物可用，但治疗选择仍然有限，而且目前尚无治愈 MASH 的方法。

paras.en: Earlier research has suggested that damaged mitochondria, the structures that produce energy for cells, may contribute to the development and progression of MASH. In the new multicenter study, Cedars-Sinai researchers found that levels of an enzyme called UBE2N decline in liver cells as the disease becomes more advanced.
paras.zh: 早期研究表明，受损的线粒体（为细胞产生能量的结构）可能有助于 MASH 的发生和进展。在这项新的多中心研究中，Cedars-Sinai 的研究人员发现，随着疾病的进展，肝细胞中一种名为 UBE2N 的酶的水平会下降。

paras.en: "The UBE2N enzyme appears to protect the liver from the inflammation and damage associated with MASH by helping remove damaged mitochondria and supporting the breakdown of fat," said Ekihiro Seki, MD, PhD, professor of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences at Cedars-Sinai and co-corresponding author of the study. "When levels of the enzyme fell, we saw more damaged cells and injury to the liver."
paras.zh: “UBE2N 酶似乎可以通过帮助去除受损的线粒体和支持脂肪分解来保护肝脏免受与 MASH 相关的炎症和损伤，”Cedars-Sinai 医学和生物医学科学教授、该研究的共同通讯作者 Ekihiro Seki 博士说。 “当酶水平下降时，我们看到更多受损细胞和肝脏损伤。”

paras.en: Restoring UBE2N Reduced Liver Damage in Mice
paras.zh: 恢复 UBE2N 减少小鼠肝脏损伤

paras.en: The researchers then restored UBE2N to normal levels in the livers of laboratory mice. After doing so, they observed reductions in fat accumulation, inflammation and scarring.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后将实验室小鼠肝脏中的 UBE2N 恢复至正常水平。这样做后，他们观察到脂肪堆积、炎症和疤痕减少。

paras.en: Those results suggest that UBE2N could become a potential treatment target for preventing MASLD from advancing to MASH.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明，UBE2N 可能成为防止 MASLD 进展为 MASH 的潜在治疗靶点。

paras.en: "The identification of this enzyme's role in regulating mitochondria in the liver is an important advance in understanding steatotic liver disease," said Shelly Lu, MD, the Women's Guild Chair in Gastroenterology and director of the Karsh Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Cedars-Sinai. "Future studies can test whether enhancing this protective pathway can complement existing treatments, identify patients most likely to benefit and lead to new therapeutic approaches for preventing advanced disease."
paras.zh: “确定这种酶在调节肝脏线粒体中的作用是了解脂肪肝病的重要进展，”胃肠病学妇女协会主席兼 Cedars-Sinai 胃肠病学和肝病科卡什科主任 Shelly Lu 医学博士说。 “未来的研究可以测试增强这种保护途径是否可以补充现有的治疗方法，确定最有可能受益的患者，并找到预防晚期疾病的新治疗方法。”

paras.en: Additional Cedars-Sinai authors include Michitaka Matsuda, So Yeon Kim, Takashi Tsuchiya and Yoon Seok Roh.
paras.zh: Cedars-Sinai 的其他作者包括 Michitaka Matsuda、So Yeon Kim、Takashi Tsuchiya 和 Yoon Seok Roh。

paras.en: Additional authors include: Feng Wang, Jin Lee, Jeong-Su Park, Meizhou Huang, Hwan Ma, Guoyan Sui, Zixiong Zhou, Xufeng Wu, Haram Lee, Soohwan Oh, Hanseul Park, Key-Hwan Lim, Chun-Woong Park, Sang-Bae Han, Jin Tae Hong and Michael Karin.

articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

articles.title: Rains Swamp the Gandak River

paras.en: Storms drenched Nepal’s mountainous Lumbini and Gandaki provinces with waves of torrential rain between September 24 and 27. The deluge, arriving late in the monsoon season, triggered landslides and pushed the Gandak River, also called the Narayani, to record levels in both Nepal and India.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日至 27 日期间，暴风雨给尼泊尔多山的蓝毗尼省和甘达基省带来了倾盆大雨。洪水在季风季节末期到来，引发山体滑坡，推动甘达克河（也称为纳拉亚尼河）的水位在尼泊尔和印度创下历史新高。

paras.en: With runoff streaming into the braided river system, water overtopped and breached embankments in several areas, inundating farmland and settlements along the river for hundreds of kilometers. As authorities assessed the full extent of the damage, news reports indicated that flooding and landslides had affected hundreds of villages and displaced thousands of people.
paras.zh: 随着径流流入辫状河系统，一些地区的水漫过并冲破堤坝，淹没了沿河数百公里的农田和定居点。当当局评估受损程度时，新闻报道显示洪水和山体滑坡影响了数百个村庄，导致数千人流离失所。

paras.en: Images captured by MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on NASA’s Terra and Aqua satellites on September 20, 2026 (left), and September 29, 2026 (right), show the extent of the flooding. The false-color images combine observations of infrared and visible light (MODIS bands 7-2-1) to make it easier to distinguish the water. Floodwater appears blue; vegetation is bright green; clouds are light blue.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局 Terra 和 Aqua 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）于 2026 年 9 月 20 日（左）和 2026 年 9 月 29 日（右）拍摄的图像显示了洪水的程度。假彩色图像结合了红外光和可见光（MODIS 波段 7-2-1）的观测结果，更容易区分水。洪水呈蓝色；植被呈鲜绿色；云是浅蓝色的。

paras.en: In many areas, water inundated seasonal fields on low-lying deposits of sand and silt within the river's channel, called diara, where flooding is expected. However, it also breached embankments and flooded several settled areas, including parts of Bagaha, Areraj, and Fulia Khand.
paras.zh: 在许多地区，水淹没了河道内低洼的沙子和淤泥沉积物上的季节性农田（称为迪亚拉），预计会发生洪水。然而，它也冲破了堤坝，淹没了几个定居区，包括巴加哈、阿雷拉吉和富利亚坎德的部分地区。

paras.en: Data from Nepal's Department of Hydrology and Meteorology indicated that a gauge in Devghāṭ reached as high as 11.94 meters on September 27, the highest since measurements began there in the 1960s. According to news reports, gauges in India along the Gandak that set new high-water marks included Bagaha, Dumariaghat, Rewaghat, and Lalganj.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔水文和气象部门的数据显示，9月27日Devghāṭ的水位高达11.94米，这是自20世纪60年代开始测量以来的最高水平。据新闻报道，印度甘达克河沿岸创下新高水位的水位包括 Bagaha、Dumariaghat、Rewaghat 和 Lalganj。

paras.en: NASA has several tools and datasets available for tracking rainfall and flooding. Among them are Worldview, FLOOD Viewer, and the GPM IMERG Global Viewer.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局有多种工具和数据集可用于跟踪降雨和洪水。其中包括 Worldview、FLOOD Viewer 和 GPM IMERG Global Viewer。
