articles.title: NASA Opens Applications for Next Class of Flight Directors
articles.author: Lauren E. Low

paras.en: NASA is seeking leaders for one of the most esteemed positions on Earth for human spaceflight: flight director in mission control at the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. This role is critical to advancing American leadership in space exploration, as NASA paves the way for a sustained human presence on the Moon.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在寻找地球上载人航天最受尊敬的职位之一的领导者：该机构位于休斯顿的约翰逊航天中心的任务控制飞行总监。这一角色对于提升美国在太空探索领域的领导地位至关重要，因为美国宇航局为人类在月球上的持续存在铺平了道路。

paras.en: Applications for new flight directors are open now through Monday, Oct. 12. U.S. citizens can apply at:
paras.zh: 新飞行指挥员的申请现已开放，截止日期为 10 月 12 日星期一。美国公民可以通过以下地址申请：

paras.en: Those chosen as NASA flight directors will lead human spaceflight missions to the International Space Station, Artemis missions to the Moon, and, eventually, the first human missions to Mars.
paras.zh: 那些被选为美国宇航局飞行指挥的人将领导国际空间站的载人航天任务、阿尔忒弥斯的月球任务，以及最终的首次人类火星任务。

paras.en: Flight directors lead teams of flight controllers, astronauts, and commercial and international partners in real-time mission execution and risk management. In preparation for a mission, flight directors collaborate with engineering, safety, and program partners to ensure operational plans align with spacecraft capabilities and mission objectives.
paras.zh: 飞行指挥员领导由飞行控制员、宇航员以及商业和国际合作伙伴组成的团队进行实时任务执行和风险管理。在准备任务时，飞行指挥员与工程、安全和项目合作伙伴合作，确保运营计划符合航天器的能力和任务目标。

paras.en: “We are working in an exciting, pivotal time as we continue supporting operations to the International Space Station while building the next phase of human spaceflight with Artemis and Moon Base missions, preparing to go farther than ever before,” said Emily Nelson, chief flight director at Johnson. “Accomplishing these ambitious goals requires flight directors who are expert integrators, bringing together a broad range of teams and disciplines into a clear, unified mission effort. This integral role exemplifies the best of innovation and teamwork.”
paras.zh: 约翰逊首席飞行总监艾米丽·尼尔森表示：“我们正处于一个激动人心的关键时刻，我们将继续支持国际空间站的运营，同时通过阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地任务建设载人航天的下一阶段，准备走得比以往更远。” “要实现这些雄心勃勃的目标，飞行指挥员必须是专业的整合者，将广泛的团队和学科聚集在一起，共同完成明确、统一的任务。这一不可或缺的角色体现了最佳的创新和团队合作。”

paras.en: To be considered, flight director candidates must be U.S. citizens with a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in engineering, biological science, physical science, computer science, or mathematics. They also will need substantial related, progressively responsible professional experience, including time-critical decision-making experience in high-stress, high-risk environments. Although many NASA flight directors have previously been flight controllers working in mission control, it is not a prerequisite to apply.
paras.zh: 要获得考虑，飞行指挥候选人必须是美国公民，拥有经过认可的工程、生物科学、物理科学、计算机科学或数学机构的学士学位。他们还需要大量相关的、逐步负责的专业经验，包括在高压力、高风险环境中的时间紧迫的决策经验。尽管许多NASA飞行指挥员此前曾是在任务控制部门工作的飞行控制员，但这并不是申请的先决条件。

paras.en: NASA plans to announce selections by the end of the year. The new flight directors will receive extensive training in flight control and spacecraft systems, as well as operational leadership and risk management.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局计划在今年年底前宣布选择。新的飞行指挥将接受飞行控制和航天器系统以及运营领导和风险管理方面的广泛培训。

paras.en: Learn more about NASA flight directors and the application process at:
paras.zh: 了解有关 NASA 飞行指挥员和申请流程的更多信息：

paras.en: anna.c.schneider@nasa.gov / mary.m.pfister@nasa.gov
paras.zh: anna.c.schneider@nasa.gov / mary.m.pfister@nasa.gov

articles.title: ‘I have not lost my dreams’: Refugee education funding cuts threaten millions

paras.en: ‘I have not lost my dreams’: Refugee education funding cuts threaten millions
paras.zh: “我没有失去我的梦想”：难民教育经费削减威胁数百万人

paras.en: A teenage girl who fled war-torn Sudan for neighbouring Egypt and hopes to pursue a technology degree is an example of why countries must ensure that young refugees can continue to learn.
paras.zh: 一名少女逃离饱受战争蹂躏的苏丹前往邻国埃及，希望攻读技术学位，这就是为什么各国必须确保年轻难民能够继续学习的一个例子。

paras.en: “When we left Sudan, I was worried that my education would stop,” said Jamila Mostafa, 19, one of the estimated 13.1 million refugee children of school age worldwide in 2025.
paras.zh: “当我们离开苏丹时，我担心我的教育会停止，”19 岁的贾米拉·莫斯塔法 (Jamila Mostafa) 说，她是预计到 2025 年全球将有 1,310 万学龄难民儿童之一。

paras.en: Yet nearly half – 5.8 million – remain out of school as funding cuts threaten to roll back years of progress in educating children and adolescents forced to flee their homelands due to war, conflict, violence or persecution.
paras.zh: 然而，近一半（580 万人）仍然失学，因为资金削减可能会导致多年来因战争、冲突、暴力或迫害而被迫逃离家园的儿童和青少年在教育方面取得的进展出现倒退。

paras.en: The warning comes in a new report by the UN refugee agency, UNHCR.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署难民署在一份新报告中发出了这一警告。

paras.en: “At a time of severe pressure on humanitarian and development financing, cuts to education risk reversing decades of collective investment and closing opportunities for a generation of young people,” said UN High Commissioner for Refugees Barham Salih, a former refugee from Iraq.
paras.zh: 前伊拉克难民、联合国难民事务高级专员巴勒姆·萨利赫表示：“在人道主义和发展融资面临严峻压力之际，削减教育可能会扭转几十年来的集体投资，并导致一代年轻人失去机会。”

paras.en: The transition to secondary education remains one of the biggest challenges for refugee children, according to the report. Only 32 per cent were enrolled in high school in 2025, compared to 65 per cent at the primary level.
paras.zh: 报告称，向中等教育的过渡仍然是难民儿童面临的最大挑战之一。到 2025 年，高中入学率仅为 32%，而小学入学率为 65%。

paras.en: However, many young refugees arrive at primary school unprepared. Two in three lack the foundational learning that prepares them for the classroom.
paras.zh: 然而，许多年轻难民在毫无准备的情况下进入小学。三分之二的人缺乏为课堂做好准备的基础学习。

paras.en: Even though refugee girls and boys attend primary school at similar rates, the gap widens sharply in secondary education. Increasing numbers of adolescent girls leave school due to poverty, early marriage, safety concerns and other pressures.
paras.zh: 尽管难民女孩和男孩的小学入学率相似，但中学教育中的差距急剧扩大。由于贫困、早婚、安全问题和其他压力，越来越多的少女辍学。

paras.en: Meanwhile, progress in higher education underscores the value of sustained investment. Refugee enrollment at the tertiary level reached a record 11 per cent in 2025, with more than 450,000 students attending university or undertaking technical and vocational training.
paras.zh: 与此同时，高等教育的进步凸显了持续投资的价值。 2025 年，难民高等教育入学率达到创纪录的 11%，超过 45 万名学生进入大学或接受技术和职业培训。

paras.en: This means UNHCR and partners are on track to ensure that 15 per cent of refugee youth can access higher education by the end of the decade, known as the 15x30 pledge.
paras.zh: 这意味着难民署和合作伙伴有望确保到本十年结束时 15% 的难民青年能够接受高等教育，即“15x30 承诺”。

paras.en: Faiza Qudrati from Afghanistan grew up in Kazakhstan and studied medicine before switching to psychology.
paras.zh: 来自阿富汗的 Faiza Qudrati 在哈萨克斯坦长大，在转向心理学之前学习了医学。

paras.en: “For me, higher education gives me a chance to grow, learn and one day help other people in the same way that support was once provided to me,” she said.
paras.zh: “对我来说，高等教育给了我一个成长、学习的机会，有一天我会像曾经为我提供支持一样帮助其他人，”她说。

paras.en: Although higher education can significantly improve the lives of refugee women and girls, providing them with access to skills, qualifications, employment and greater financial independence, access is still deeply unequal.
paras.zh: 尽管高等教育可以显着改善难民妇女和女童的生活，为她们提供获得技能、资格、就业和更大的经济独立的机会，但机会仍然严重不平等。

paras.en: Refugee enrollment remains below the national average in more than 80 per cent of reporting countries. In low-income and conflict-affected countries, only two per cent of refugees were enrolled in higher education, compared to 13 per cent of nationals.
paras.zh: 在超过 80% 的报告国中，难民入学率仍低于全国平均水平。在低收入和受冲突影响的国家，只有 2% 的难民接受高等教育，而国民的这一比例为 13%。

paras.en: UNHCR stressed that improving refugee education also means strengthening national education systems by investing more in teachers, classrooms, learning materials and financing to benefit both refugees and host communities.
paras.zh: 难民署强调，改善难民教育还意味着加强国家教育体系，加大对教师、教室、学习材料和资金的投资，使难民和收容社区受益。

paras.en: UNHCR called for the international community and development partners to safeguard education funding and invest in the national systems of countries hosting refugees.
paras.zh: 难民署呼吁国际社会和发展伙伴保障教育经费并对收容难民国家的国家系统进行投资。

paras.en: “Education gives young people the tools to shape their own future,” said Mr. Salih. “Our responsibility is to make sure they have that chance.”
paras.zh: “教育为年轻人提供了塑造自己未来的工具，”萨利赫先生说。 “我们的责任是确保他们有这个机会。”

paras.en: Jamila, the young Sudanese woman in Egypt, is continuing her high school education through UNHCR-backed support. She has developed a particular interest in artificial intelligence (AI) and how it can help address social and economic challenges. She hopes to study technology at university.
paras.zh: 贾米拉是埃及的年轻苏丹妇女，她在联合国难民署的支持下继续完成高中学业。她对人工智能 (AI) 及其如何帮助解决社会和经济挑战产生了特别的兴趣。她希望在大学学习技术。

paras.en: “School gives me confidence,” she said. “It reminds me that even though I lost my home because of the war, I have not lost my dreams.”
paras.zh: “学校给了我信心，”她说。 “它提醒我，尽管我因战争失去了家园，但我并没有失去我的梦想。”

articles.title: Collective action needed to tackle global information crisis, UN-led dialogue hears

paras.en: Collective action needed to tackle global information crisis, UN-led dialogue hears
paras.zh: 联合国主导的对话认为需要采取集体行动应对全球信息危机

paras.en: Governments, UN entities, civil society, media, academia and the private sector have called for stronger cooperation and practical action to respond to a rapidly changing global information landscape.
paras.zh: 各国政府、联合国实体、民间社会、媒体、学术界和私营部门呼吁加强合作并采取实际行动，应对迅速变化的全球信息格局。

paras.en: The call came at the high-level Information Integrity Solutions Dialogue at UN Headquarters in New York during the high-level week of the 81st session of the General Assembly.
paras.zh: 这一呼吁是在联合国大会第 81 届会议高级别周期间在纽约联合国总部举行的高级别信息完整性解决方案对话中发出的。

paras.en: Co-hosted by Brazil, the UN Secretariat, the UN development Programme (UNDP) and the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), the event brought together practitioners and policymakers from across regions and sectors to examine how the UN Global Principles for Information Integrity and the Global Digital Compact can be put into practice.
paras.zh: 该活动由巴西、联合国秘书处、联合国开发计划署（UNDP）和联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO）共同主办，来自不同地区和部门的从业者和政策制定者齐聚一堂，探讨如何将联合国信息完整性全球原则和全球数字契约付诸实践。

paras.en: Information integrity means ensuring reliable and accurate information is available to all, allowing people to make informed decisions, participate meaningfully in public life, and exercise their right to freedom of expression.
paras.zh: 信息完整性意味着确保所有人都能获得可靠和准确的信息，使人们能够做出明智的决定，有意义地参与公共生活，并行使其言论自由权。

paras.en: Participants warned that the rapid transformation of the information ecosystem, including the growing use of unregulated and untested artificial intelligence systems and other emerging technologies, is deepening existing risks.
paras.zh: 与会者警告说，信息生态系统的快速转型，包括越来越多地使用不受监管和未经测试的人工智能系统和其他新兴技术，正在加深现有风险。

paras.en: “Today, a handful of companies still dominate and shape our global information architecture,” said Melissa Fleming, UN Under-Secretary-General for Global Communications.
paras.zh: “如今，少数公司仍然主导并塑造着我们的全球信息架构，”联合国主管全球传播事务的副秘书长梅丽莎·弗莱明 (Melissa Fleming) 表示。

paras.en: “Their priorities remain the same: engagement, profit. Always placed above the public interest,” she said. “Today, information defenders – civil society, journalists, scientists and others – are still underfunded and under attack.”
paras.zh: “他们的优先事项保持不变：参与、利润​​。始终置于公共利益之上，”她说。 “如今，信息捍卫者——民间社会、记者、科学家和其他人——仍然资金不足并受到攻击。”

paras.en: “In short, we are deep into a global information crisis. The crisis has grown but so has our resolve.”
paras.zh: “简而言之，我们深陷全球信息危机。危机已经加剧，但我们的决心也在加剧。”

paras.en: The Dialogue also showcased how governments, organizations and communities are responding, with an emphasis on turning shared principles into solutions at national and regional levels.
paras.zh: 对话还展示了政府、组织和社区的应对方式，重点是将共同原则转化为国家和地区层面的解决方案。

paras.en: Climate information integrity was a central focus. Participants highlighted the Global Initiative for Information Integrity on Climate Change as a model for connecting global norms with national realities and placing the Global South at the centre of solutions.
paras.zh: 气候信息完整性是一个焦点。与会者强调，气候变化信息完整性全球倡议是连接全球规范与国家现实并将全球南方置于解决方案中心的典范。

paras.en: Projects supported by the Initiative include efforts to improve public access to evidence-based research, strengthen information literacy and community communications, and advance platform accountability.
paras.zh: 该倡议支持的项目包括努力改善公众获得循证研究的机会、加强信息素养和社区沟通以及推进平台问责制。

paras.en: Participants said many of these approaches could also be applied to other priorities, including elections, peace and security, child online safety, the protection of human rights defenders and disaster response.
paras.zh: 与会者表示，其中许多方法也可以应用于其他优先事项，包括选举、和平与安全、儿童上网安全、保护人权维护者和灾难应对。

paras.en: The private sector also came under scrutiny, including business models that can incentivize harmful practices online. Speakers highlighted work with advertisers to promote human-rights-responsible advertising and reduce the inadvertent funding of harmful content and practices.
paras.zh: 私营部门也受到审查，包括可能激励网上有害行为的商业模式。发言者强调与广告商合作，促进对人权负责的广告，并减少对有害内容和做法的无意资助。

paras.en: Trust was another recurring theme, with participants highlighting the growing difficulty of determining what is real and identifying accurate, reliable information. Proposed solutions emphasized community outreach and direct human engagement.
paras.zh: 信任是另一个反复出现的主题，参与者强调确定什么是真实的以及识别准确、可靠的信息越来越困难。拟议的解决方案强调社区外展和直接的人员参与。

paras.en: “The solutions we have are as wide-ranging as the threats we face,” Ms. Fleming said. “From climate to health, to democratic governance. From prevention to response. Together, we’re pursuing those solutions.”
paras.zh: “我们拥有的解决方案与我们面临的威胁一样广泛，”弗莱明女士说。 “从气候到健康，再到民主治理。从预防到应对。我们正在共同寻求这些解决方案。”

paras.en: Participants reaffirmed information integrity and the UN Global Principles as a common framework for bringing diverse actors together in support of a safer, more humane information ecosystem.
paras.zh: 与会者重申信息完整性和联合国全球原则是一个共同框架，可以将不同的参与者聚集在一起，支持更安全、更人性化的信息生态系统。

paras.en: They also called for greater exchanges of knowledge and experience across regions and sectors, as well as increased investment to sustain and expand solutions that are already working.
paras.zh: 他们还呼吁加强跨地区和跨部门的知识和经验交流，并增加投资以维持和扩展已经有效的解决方案。

paras.en: As a concrete next step, the UN is developing the Global Information Integrity Exchange (GIIEx), which will connect practitioners, researchers, policymakers and other stakeholders working on solutions to information threats.
paras.zh: 作为具体的下一步，联合国正在开发全球信息完整性交换（GIIEx），它将连接从业者、研究人员、政策制定者和其他致力于解决信息威胁的利益相关者。

paras.en: It will facilitate the sharing of research, tools, training materials, and policy developments, while connecting people working towards common information-integrity goals. The UN Centres of Excellence for Information Integrity and related initiatives will feed into the Exchange.
paras.zh: 它将促进研究、工具、培训材料和政策制定的共享，同时将致力于实现共同信息完整性目标的人们联系起来。联合国信息完整性卓越中心和相关举措将纳入该交换中心。

paras.en: Participants also called for a pan-African UN-African Union conference on information integrity, greater availability of research tools and stronger protections for information integrity defenders.
paras.zh: 与会者还呼吁召开一次泛非联合国-非洲联盟会议，讨论信息完整性、提供更多研究工具以及加强对信息完整性维护者的保护。

paras.en: The Dialogue was held during the Assembly’s high-level week in which artificial intelligence featured prominently in discussions on multilateralism, human rights, development, and global governance.
paras.zh: 此次对话是在大会高级别周期间举行的，人工智能在有关多边主义、人权、发展和全球治理的讨论中占据突出地位。

paras.en: Opening the annual General Debate on 22 September, Secretary-General António Guterres highlighted the speed of AI development and called for reliable guardrails to limit potential harm while allowing innovation to continue. He also stressed the need to involve governments, businesses, scientists, civil society, and academia.
paras.zh: 9 月 22 日，秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在年度一般性辩论开幕式上强调了人工智能的发展速度，并呼吁建立可靠的护栏以限制潜在危害，同时允许创新继续进行。他还强调需要政府、企业、科学家、民间社会和学术界的参与。

paras.en: The impact of AI on children was also in focus. On 22 September, the Coalition for Children’s Rights and Protection in the Age of Artificial Intelligence brought together global leaders to strengthen cooperation on protecting children’s rights and safety in the digital age.
paras.zh: 人工智能对儿童的影响也是人们关注的焦点。 9月22日，人工智能时代儿童权利与保护联盟汇聚全球领导人，加强在数字时代保护儿童权利和安全方面的合作。

paras.en: That meeting launched a roadmap covering safety by design, protection of children’s data, action against AI-enabled sexual abuse material, age assurance, AI literacy and stronger evidence on how children use AI.
paras.zh: 那次会议推出了一份路线图，涵盖设计安全、保护儿童数据、针对人工智能性虐待材料的行动、年龄保证、人工智能素养以及关于儿童如何使用人工智能的更有力证据。

paras.en: Against this backdrop, the Information Integrity Solutions Dialogue examined AI as part of the wider information ecosystem and how technological change is affecting trust, access to reliable information and people’s ability to participate meaningfully in public life.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，信息完整性解决方案对话探讨了人工智能作为更广泛的信息生态系统的一部分，以及技术变革如何影响信任、获取可靠信息以及人们有意义地参与公共生活的能力。

paras.en: Participants closed with a call for greater collaboration across sectors and regions, so that the principles underpinning information integrity can translate into measurable action ahead of COP31, the next edition of the UN climate conference, as well as the Internet Governance Forum and beyond.
paras.zh: 与会者最后呼吁加强跨部门和地区的合作，以便支撑信息完整性的原则能够在 COP31、下一届联合国气候会议以及互联网治理论坛及其他会议之前转化为可衡量的行动。

paras.en: Find the Chair's Summary of the event here.
paras.zh: 在此查找主席对活动的总结。

articles.title: Uganda’s UN-supported wildlife forensics lab turns ivory seizures into convictions

paras.en: Uganda’s UN-supported wildlife forensics lab turns ivory seizures into convictions
paras.zh: 乌干达联合国支持的野生动物法医实验室将查获的象牙定罪

paras.en: The package originated in Entebbe, Uganda, bound for Cairo, containing 10 kilograms of thumb-sized pieces that could have been either bone or elephant ivory.
paras.zh: 该包裹源自乌干达恩德培，运往开罗，其中装有 10 公斤拇指大小的碎片，可能是骨头或象牙。

paras.en: When detectives from the Uganda Police Force and investigators from the Uganda Wildlife Authority intercepted the package in January 2025, they needed more than suspicion to investigate the person who sent the package.
paras.zh: 当乌干达警察部队的侦探和乌干达野生动物管理局的调查员于 2025 年 1 月截获该包裹时，他们需要的不仅仅是怀疑来调查寄件人。

paras.en: The police sent a sample to the Uganda Wildlife Forensics and Timber Laboratory in Entebbe, a facility that has been supported since 2019 by the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC).
paras.zh: 警方将样本送往位于恩德培的乌干达野生动物法证和木材实验室，该实验室自 2019 年以来一直得到联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 的支持。

paras.en: Scientists found a distinctive cross-hatched pattern associated with elephant ivory. DNA testing later confirmed that the material came from an elephant, lab manager Patrick Chiyo told UN News.
paras.zh: 科学家发现了与象牙相关的独特的交叉阴影图案。实验室经理帕特里克·千代 (Patrick Chiyo) 告诉《联合国新闻》，DNA 测试后来证实该材料来自大象。

paras.en: Two months later, police arrested the man who sent the package. At his residence, investigators found additional elephant ivory, along with warthog ivory. He was charged with attempted trafficking and illegal possession and sentenced to 15 years in prison or a fine equivalent to 140 million Ugandan shillings – or more than $35,000 USD.
paras.zh: 两个月后，警方逮捕了寄包裹的男子。在他的住所，调查人员发现了更多的象牙和疣猪象牙。他被指控企图贩运和非法占有，并被判处 15 年监禁或相当于 1.4 亿乌干达先令（即超过 35,000 美元）的罚款。

paras.en: For Mr. Chiyo, the case illustrates why forensic evidence matters in the fight against wildlife crime: it can establish what an animal product is when traffickers have cut it into small pieces or removed the physical characteristics that would make it easy to identify.
paras.zh: 对于千代先生来说，此案说明了为什么法医证据在打击野生动物犯罪方面很重要：当贩运者将动物产品切成小块或去除易于识别的物理特征时，它可以确定动物产品是什么。

paras.en: “Poachers are removing identification features from wildlife carcasses to evade detection,” Mr. Chiyo said.
paras.zh: “偷猎者正在去除野生动物尸体上的识别特征，以逃避检测，”千代先生说。

paras.en: He added that DNA reports are increasingly being required by Uganda’s wildlife court and that suspects are pleading guilty more often thanks to the lab.
paras.zh: 他补充说，乌干达野生动物法庭越来越需要 DNA 报告，而且由于实验室的帮助，嫌疑人认罪的情况也越来越多。

paras.en: Evidence from the UN’s 2024 World Wildlife Report shows that Uganda is as a significant hub of organised wildlife trafficking networks – especially of elephant ivory but also pangolin, a scaly anteater.
paras.zh: 联合国《2024 年世界野生动物报告》的证据表明，乌干达是有组织的野生动物贩运网络的重要中心，尤其是象牙和穿山甲（一种有鳞食蚁兽）。

paras.en: In April, the Uganda Wildlife Forensics and Timber Laboratory opened with support from Denmark, the European Union and UNODC to help address the ivory issue.
paras.zh: 4 月，乌干达野生动物取证和木材实验室在丹麦、欧盟和毒品和犯罪问题办公室的支持下成立，以帮助解决象牙问题。

paras.en: It builds on a national training and technical support centre established in 2019 as a pilot wildlife forensics facility through a partnership involving UNODC, the TRACE Wildlife Forensics Network and the Ugandan Government. The earlier facility has assisted hundreds of investigations and prosecutions connected to illegal wildlife trade.
paras.zh: 它建立在 2019 年作为试点野生动物取证设施的国家培训和技术支持中心的基础上，该中心是通过毒品和犯罪问题办公室、TRACE 野生动物取证网络和乌干达政府合作建立的。早期的设施已协助数百起与非法野生动物贸易有关的调查和起诉。

paras.en: The lab’s work often begins far from Entebbe. Officers may seize sacks containing ivory pieces, pangolin scales or smoked bushmeat. Because these seizures can be bulky, scientists collect samples at police stations, documenting each step along the way.
paras.zh: 该实验室的工作通常从远离恩德培的地方开始。警察可能会没收装有象牙碎片、穿山甲鳞片或熏丛林肉的麻袋。由于这些缉获量可能很大，科学家们在警察局收集样本，记录沿途的每一步。

paras.en: Evidence is photographed before it is opened, and again after sampling. The original exhibit is returned to police custody, while sealed samples are transported to the lab for analysis.
paras.zh: 证据在打开之前和采样后都会被拍照。原始展品被送回警方保管，而密封的样本则被运送到实验室进行分析。

paras.en: The process can take a significant amount of time, Mr. Chiyo said, but it can be decisive, especially when animal remains are incomplete, altered or difficult to identify.
paras.zh: 千代先生说，这个过程可能需要很长的时间，但它可能是决定性的，特别是当动物遗骸不完整、被改变或难以识别时。

paras.en: In one case in 2023, Mr. Chiyo travelled about four hours north of Kampala after a suspect was arrested with six skins, six heads, two sacks of meat, 24 hoofed legs and a fetus believed to be from wildlife. The skins appeared to come from antelope, but their exact identity could not be confirmed from appearance alone.
paras.zh: 在 2023 年发生的一起案件中，千代先生在坎帕拉以北约四个小时内逮捕了一名嫌疑人，该嫌疑人携带六张皮、六个头、两袋肉、24条有蹄的腿和一个据信来自野生动物的胎儿。这些皮似乎来自羚羊，但仅从外观无法确认其确切身份。

paras.en: Mr. Chiyo and his team collected samples from the skins and fetus, then used DNA analysis to determine that they came from bushbucks. Mr. Chiyo later testified in court, and the suspect was sentenced to three years in prison.
paras.zh: 千代先生和他的团队收集了皮肤和胎儿的样本，然后通过 DNA 分析确定它们来自羚羊。千代先生后来出庭作证，嫌疑人被判处三年徒刑。

paras.en: The lab most commonly receives evidence involving elephant ivory, bushmeat and pangolin scales, Mr. Chiyo said.
paras.zh: 千代先生说，实验室最常收到的证据涉及象牙、丛林肉和穿山甲鳞片。

paras.en: Bashir Hangi, from the Uganda Wildlife Authority, told UN News that elephants, pangolins, primates and some bird species are among the animals most threatened by illegal poaching and trade in Uganda.
paras.zh: 乌干达野生动物管理局的巴希尔·汉吉告诉《联合国新闻》，大象、穿山甲、灵长类动物和一些鸟类是乌干达受非法偷猎和贸易威胁最严重的动物。

paras.en: Some people hunt animals for household consumption, while others kill wildlife for commercial gain, Mr. Chiyo said. Commercial trade is the larger threat for wildlife conservation, he added.
paras.zh: 千代先生说，有些人捕猎动物是为了家庭消费，而另一些人则为了商业利益而捕杀野生动物。他补充说，商业贸易是野生动物保护面临的更大威胁。

paras.en: Although Mr. Chiyo said Uganda does not have a domestic market for ivory and pangolin scales, there is a thriving market for poached bushmeat. Authorities have encountered cases involving nearly a tonne of meat, he said.
paras.zh: 尽管千代先生表示，乌干达国内没有象牙和穿山甲鳞片市场，但水煮丛林肉的市场却很繁荣。他说，当局遇到过涉及近一吨肉类的案件。

paras.en: Mr. Hangi said wildlife crime is driven both by organised criminal networks and by local communities facing economic hardship.
paras.zh: 汉吉先生说，野生动物犯罪是由有组织的犯罪网络和面临经济困难的当地社区推动的。

paras.en: The impacts can also fall heavily on communities living near protected areas, where wildlife-related conflict and crop raiding have caused significant problems.
paras.zh: 这些影响也可能严重影响保护区附近的社区，那里与野生动物有关的冲突和农作物掠夺造成了严重问题。

paras.en: Mr. Chiyo said enforcement must reach the person who kills or captures an animal and those higher up in criminal networks who also profit. Prosecuting higher-ups requires more investment in interagency networks, he added.
paras.zh: 千代先生表示，执法行动必须涉及到杀害或捕获动物的人以及那些在犯罪网络中也从中获利的高层人士。他补充说，起诉高层需要对跨部门网络进行更多投资。

paras.en: At the same time, he said, criminal justice is not enough. Alternative livelihoods are important, although they may not eliminate poaching linked to cultural values. He suggested a combined approach of livelihood support, preventive patrols and legal deterrence.
paras.zh: 与此同时，他说，刑事司法还不够。替代生计很重要，尽管它们可能无法消除与文化价值观相关的偷猎行为。他建议采取民生支持、预防性巡逻和法律威慑相结合的方式。

paras.en: “A living wildlife is worth more benefits for many more people than a dead one,” Mr. Chiyo said.
paras.zh: “对于更多的人来说，活着的野生动物比死去的野生动物更有价值，”千代先生说。

paras.en: The Entebbe lab expanded into timber forensics in April, adding a new capability as Uganda confronts the environmental consequences of illegal logging and timber trafficking.
paras.zh: 恩德培实验室于四月份扩展到木材法证领域，在乌干达面临非法采伐和木材贩运造成的环境后果之际，增加了新的能力。

paras.en: According to Ugandan authorities, Uganda’s forest cover has fallen from 24 per cent in 1990 to roughly 13 per cent in 2025, in large part due to timber trafficking. The new forensic capacity is intended to strengthen efforts to investigate illegal logging.
paras.zh: 据乌干达当局称，乌干达的森林覆盖率已从 1990 年的 24% 下降到 2025 年的约 13%，这在很大程度上是由于木材贩运造成的。新的法证能力旨在加强对非法采伐的调查力度。

paras.en: Timber cases are more complicated than wildlife cases, Mr. Chiyo said, because harvesting is also permitted and regulated in many circumstances. Determining whether a piece of wood was obtained illegally can require additional steps and presents different challenges from identifying animal products.
paras.zh: 千代先生说，木材案件比野生动物案件更为复杂，因为在许多情况下砍伐也是被允许和监管的。确定一块木材是否是非法获得可能需要额外的步骤，并且与识别动物产品相比面临着不同的挑战。

paras.en: The lab is only beginning to handle timber cases and has not yet seen evidence that illegal timber is moving through the same networks or routes as wildlife products, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，该实验室才刚刚开始处理木材案件，尚未发现非法木材与野生动物产品通过相同网络或路线流动的证据。

paras.en: Still, the lab’s expansion reflects an increased recognition of the role of cracking down on wildlife and timber trafficking on protecting the environment.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，该实验室的扩张反映出人们越来越认识到打击野生动物和木材贩运对保护环境的作用。

paras.en: Gladys Kamasanyu, the chief magistrate of the Uganda Wildlife Court, told UNODC in April that criminal justice and law enforcement can play a key role in these efforts.
paras.zh: 乌干达野生动物法院首席法官 Gladys Kamasanyu 四月份告诉毒品和犯罪问题办公室，刑事司法和执法可以在这些努力中发挥关键作用。

paras.en: “The forensic laboratory is critical to the criminal justice system, significantly enhancing the court’s ability to hold offenders accountable by providing objective, scientifically validated evidence to protect Uganda’s natural heritage for future generations,” Ms. Kamasanyu said.
paras.zh: 卡马桑尤女士说：“法医实验室对于刑事司法系统至关重要，通过提供客观、经过科学验证的证据，显着增强法院追究罪犯责任的能力，为子孙后代保护乌干达的自然遗产。”

paras.en: Recognising the same relationship between law enforcement and conservation, Mr. Chiyo said his benchmark for success in the next few years would be “a sustainable and fully government supported wildlife and timber forensic laboratory in Uganda.”
paras.zh: 千代先生认识到执法与保护之间存在同样的关系，他表示，未来几年他的成功基准将是“在乌干达建立一个可持续且得到政府全面支持的野生动物和木材法医实验室”。

paras.en: At the current lab, however, each confirmed DNA sequence and seizure can help close the gap between a suspicion of trafficking and a prosecutable crime.
paras.zh: 然而，在目前的实验室中，每一项确认的 DNA 序列和缉获都可以帮助缩小贩运嫌疑与可起诉犯罪之间的差距。

paras.en: “Enhancing criminal justice through wildlife and timber forensics is an important pillar in environment protection,” Mr. Chiyo said. “Environmental justice will usually benefit the very vulnerable in society.”
paras.zh: “通过野生动物和木材取证加强刑事司法是环境保护的重要支柱，”千代先生说。 “环境正义通常会让社会中的弱势群体受益。”

articles.title: Humphries to face Price in World Grand Prix final in 2023 repeat

paras.en: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries to face Gerywn Price in Sunday's final in Leicester, live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 世界飞镖大奖赛：卢克·汉弗莱斯将在周日于莱斯特举行的决赛中对阵格鲁文·普莱斯，天空体育直播

paras.en: Luke Humphries reaches fourth straight World Grand Prix final after beating two-time champion James Wade in semis; Gerwyn Price defeats Nathan Aspinall as he targets first major title since 2022; watch live on Sky Sports+ and Sky Sports Main Event from 8pm Sunday
paras.zh: 卢克·汉弗莱斯在半决赛中击败两届冠军詹姆斯·韦德，连续第四次进入世界大奖赛决赛；格温·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 击败内森·阿斯皮纳尔 (Nathan Aspinall)，目标是 2022 年以来首个大满贯冠军；周日晚上 8 点开始观看天空体育+和天空体育主赛事直播

paras.en: Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries will look for their second World Grand Prix titles when they meet in Sunday's final of the double-start event in Leicester.
paras.zh: 格温·普莱斯和卢克·汉弗莱斯将于周日在莱斯特举行的双发赛事决赛中相遇，争夺他们的第二个世界大奖赛冠军。

paras.en: Price, the 2020 champion, beat Nathan Aspinall 5-2 in Saturday's first semi-final before 2023 winner Luke Humphries defeated James Wade 5-3 to reach his fourth straight final and set up a repeat of the showpiece game three years ago - when he saw off Price 5-2.
paras.zh: 2020 年冠军普莱斯在周六的第一场半决赛中以 5-2 击败内森·阿斯皮纳尔，随后 2023 年冠军卢克·汉弗里斯以 5-3 击败詹姆斯·韦德，连续第四次进入决赛，并重演了三年前的那场精彩比赛——当时他以 5-2 击败了普莱斯。

paras.en: A major drought will end either way at the Mattioli Arena, with Humphries going over a year since his last premier title - the 2025 Premier League - and Price's previous elite silverware coming way back in 2022 at the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam.
paras.zh: 无论哪种方式，马蒂奥利竞技场的严重干旱都将结束，汉弗莱斯距离上一个冠军头衔——2025 年英超联赛已经过去一年多了，而普莱斯之前的精英奖杯要追溯到 2022 年阿姆斯特丹世界飞镖系列赛决赛上。

paras.en: The final, in which the winner will earn £150,000 and runner-up £80,000, will be first to six sets, with Humphries hoping to fare better than he did in 2024 and 2025, when he lost 6-4 to Mike De Decker and 6-1 to Luke Littler respectively.
paras.zh: 决赛将先进行六盘比赛，获胜者将获得 15 万英镑，亚军将获得 8 万英镑，汉弗莱斯希望能比他在 2024 年和 2025 年的表现更好，当时他分别以 6-4 输给了迈克·德·德克尔 (Mike De Decker)，以 6-1 输给了卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler)。

paras.en: Price prevails after being frustrated by Aspinall antics
paras.zh: 因阿斯皮诺尔的滑稽动作而受挫后，价格占上风

paras.en: Price romped into a 3-0 lead over Aspinall, peeling off two 13-darters and then a 15-darter to sweep the opener before he broke The Asp in the deciding leg of set two.
paras.zh: 普莱斯以 3-0 领先阿斯皮诺尔，先是投出两记 13 镖，随后又投出一记 15 镖，横扫首局，随后在第二盘的决定性回合中破掉了阿斯皮诺尔。

paras.en: The third set went on throw until the fourth leg, when Aspinall missed six darts to hold, including two at double one, and Price subsequently pinned D10 to move 3-0 up.
paras.zh: 第三盘一直持续到第四回合，阿斯皮纳尔错过了六镖，其中两镖为双一，普莱斯随后锁定了D10，以3-0领先。

paras.en: Things seemed bleak for Aspinall when Price broke in 14 darts at the start of the fourth set, only for The Asp to win back-to-back legs with well-thrown darts at D16 around failed ones before pulling back a set with a stunning 132 finish featuring two bullseyes.
paras.zh: 第四盘开始时，普莱斯在 14 镖中破发，阿斯皮诺尔的处境似乎很黯淡，但阿斯皮诺尔在 D16 的投镖中以失败的飞镖赢得了背靠背的比赛，然后以令人惊叹的 132 分并有两个靶心完成了扳回一盘。

paras.en: The 2022 runner-up won the fifth set against the throw but Price did likewise in the sixth to move one away from victory and then broke Aspinall twice in a row in the seventh set, after being broken himself, to qualify for a fourth Grand Prix final following 2020, 2021 and 2023.
paras.zh: 这位2022年亚军在第五盘中通过掷球获胜，但普莱斯在第六盘中也以同样的方式赢得了胜利，然后在第七盘中连续两次破发阿斯皮诺尔，在自己被破发后，获得了继2020年、2021年和2023年之后第四次参加大奖赛决赛的资格。

paras.en: Speaking afterwards, Price said he had been annoyed by Aspinall complaining about the rowdy crowd, telling Sky Sports: "I was upset with him a little bit. I said, 'they're on your side bud, I'm up against it'.
paras.zh: 普莱斯赛后表示，阿斯皮诺尔抱怨人群吵闹，这让他很恼火，他告诉天空体育：“我对他有点生气。我说，‘他们站在你这边，伙计，我反对’。”

paras.en: "As good as the crowd is for me, they were all for him. He's performing a little bit on stage. I'm good friends with Nathan, but sometimes you've got to let your darts go. It did [affect my game]."
paras.zh: “尽管观众对我来说很好，但他们都是为了他。他在舞台上表演了一点。我和内森是好朋友，但有时你必须放开你的飞镖。这确实[影响了我的比赛]。”

paras.en: 'Controlled' Humphries into another Leicester final
paras.zh: “控制”汉弗莱斯再次进入莱斯特城决赛

paras.en: Later, Humphries ended Wade's hopes of a third World Grand Prix crown, and first since 2010.
paras.zh: 后来，汉弗莱斯终结了韦德第三次夺得世界大奖赛冠军的希望，这也是自 2010 年以来的第一次。

paras.en: 'Cool Hand' won the sixth set on throw after the first five had been taken 3-1 by the player throwing second.
paras.zh: 在前五局被第二个投球选手以 3-1 拿下后，“酷手”赢得了第六盘的投球。

paras.en: Wade, who produced the checkout of the game with a 141 in the second set but largely struggled to hit the mandatory leg-opening double, took the next stanza, but Humphries was not to be denied, firing in back-to-back 137s to break 'The Machine' in the eighth set around two holds of throw.
paras.zh: 韦德在第二盘中打出了141分，但在打出开局双打时表现不佳，他在接下来的一节中取得了胜利，但汉弗莱斯的表现也不可否认，他在第八盘中连续两次击球，打出137分，打破了“机器”的局面。

paras.en: Humphries, who had beaten Dave Chisnall, Jermaine Wattimena and Niels Zonneveld prior to knocking out Wade, told Sky Sports: "I did say I was going to play a lot better and I did - I felt a lot more relaxed.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯在击败韦德之前曾击败过戴夫·奇斯纳尔、杰梅因·瓦蒂梅纳和尼尔斯·佐内维尔德，他告诉天空体育：“我确实说过我会打得更好，而且我确实做到了——我感觉轻松多了。

paras.en: "That was the real me there today and I'm really proud of myself for performing like that. It's been a long time since I've felt that control and not like I was going to flounder a little bit.
paras.zh: “这就是今天真正的我，我为自己的表现感到非常自豪。我已经很长时间没有感受到那种控制力了，而且我不会再陷入困境了。”

paras.en: "To make four Grand Prix finals on the trot is super special. It's history and I'm proud of that but unless I pick that trophy up, unfortunately that history doesn't mean anything.
paras.zh: “快速进入四次大奖赛决赛是非常特别的。这是历史，我为此感到自豪，但除非我拿起那个奖杯，否则不幸的是，这段历史没有任何意义。

paras.en: "I've got to do it again [on Sunday] because there's so many major finals I've let slip. Gezzy [Price] is playing well but if I play like that again, it's going to be a cracking game."
paras.zh: “我必须（周日）再做一次，因为我错过了很多重要的决赛。Gezzy [Price]打得很好，但如果我再次像那样打球，这将是一场精彩的比赛。”

paras.en: Watch the World Grand Prix final between Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries live on Sky Sports+ and Sky Sports Main Event from 8pm on Sunday. Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with NOW.
paras.zh: 周日晚上 8 点，在天空体育+和天空体育主赛事上观看格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 和卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 之间的世界大奖赛决赛直播。最新的天空体育优惠或通过 NOW 进行直播。

articles.title: Wakefield's Walmsley lives out Grand Final dream but uncertainty lies ahead

paras.en: The Super League Grand Final winner without a contract for 2027: Wakefield Trinity's Lachlan Walmsley lives out dream but uncertainty lies ahead
paras.zh: 没有2027年合同的超级联赛总决赛冠军：韦克菲尔德三一队的拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利实现了梦想，但未来充满不确定性

paras.en: Lachlan Walmsley came up with an assist in the Super League Grand Final but is without a contract for 2027; he was part of the Wakefield side that made history and ended a 58-year top-flight trophy drought
paras.zh: 拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利在中超总决赛中送出助攻，但他没有 2027 年的合同；他是韦克菲尔德队的一员，创造了历史，结束了长达 58 年的顶级联赛冠军荒

paras.en: Lachlan Walmsley is potentially in the most unique position of all. A Super League Grand Final winner with Wakefield Trinity and without a contract for 2027.
paras.zh: 拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利（Lachlan Walmsley）可能处于最独特的位置。韦克菲尔德三一队的超级联赛总决赛冠军，但没有 2027 年的合同。

paras.en: Walmsley was part of the Wakefield side that made history with their 23-10 victory over Warrington Wolves in the Super League Grand Final to become only the sixth winners of the competition.
paras.zh: 沃姆斯利所在的韦克菲尔德队在超级联赛总决赛中以23比10战胜沃灵顿狼队，创造了历史，成为该赛事的第六支获胜者。

paras.en: It ended a 58-year top-flight trophy drought for a side that have gone through everything Super League has had to offer. From at one point struggling to keep the lights on, they are now at the top of the sport.
paras.zh: 对于这支经历过超级联赛一切的球队来说，它结束了长达 58 年的顶级联赛奖杯荒。从一度为保持比赛状态而苦苦挣扎，到现在他们已处于这项运动的巅峰。

paras.en: During that game, winger Walmsley came up with an audacious no-look flick pass to set up Wakefield's opening try for Cam Scott. It was his farewell to a club that have given him so much.
paras.zh: 在那场比赛中，边锋沃姆斯利大胆地无视轻弹传球，为韦克菲尔德为卡姆·斯科特的开球创造了机会。这是他告别一个给了他如此多的俱乐部的人。

paras.en: Prior to living out his dream, Walmsley made a handful of appearances in the second division of Australian rugby before deciding to chase the dream on the other side of the world.
paras.zh: 在实现自己的梦想之前，沃姆斯利在澳大利亚橄榄球二级联赛中出场过几次，然后决定去世界的另一边追逐梦想。

paras.en: He gambled on a move to the UK with Championship side Whitehaven before joining Halifax Panthers were he scored 68 tries in 54 games and earned recognition.
paras.zh: 在加盟哈利法克斯黑豹队之前，他曾赌注要加盟英冠球队白天堂队前往英国，他在 54 场比赛中射门 68 次并赢得了认可。

paras.en: That caught the eye of Wakefield as they entered the Championship following their relegation in 2023. It was Walmsley's first full-time contract.
paras.zh: 当韦克菲尔德在 2023 年降级后进入英冠球队时，这一点引起了他们的注意。这是沃姆斯利的第一份全职合同。

paras.en: Three seasons later, he is a Grand Final champion.
paras.zh: 三个赛季后，他成为总决赛冠军。

paras.en: But now, once emotions subside his focus will have to turn to trying to get a contract for next season. Part of Walmsley's problem is he takes up a quota spot for clubs.
paras.zh: 但现在，一旦情绪消退，他的注意力将不得不转向争取下赛季的合同。沃姆斯利的部分问题是他占据了俱乐部的配额。

paras.en: "Hopefully something will come through in the next couple of weeks," Walmsley said.
paras.zh: 沃姆斯利说：“希望在接下来的几周内能有所进展。”

paras.en: "I have already had a dig at both Matt [Ellis] and Powelly [Daryl Powell] and said surely one more year won't hurt.
paras.zh: “我已经挖苦过马特（埃利斯）和鲍威利（达里尔·鲍威尔），并表示再多一年肯定不会有什么坏处。

paras.en: "I don't know. I haven't really thought about it. I have kind of put it in the back of my mind because, obviously, the Grand Final's coming up.
paras.zh: “我不知道。我还没有真正考虑过它。我已经把它放在脑后了，因为很明显，总决赛即将到来。

paras.en: "I will leave it to my agent and see what he can get. I have got a good mate in France who wants me to come play there. I might go play a bit, but we'll see what happens.
paras.zh: “我会把它留给我的经纪人，看看他能得到什么。我在法国有一个好朋友，他希望我去那里踢球。我可能会去踢球，但我们会看看会发生什么。”

paras.en: "If I wasn't on a quota spot, I'd probably get a few offers. It is just because I'm a quota. It just is what it is, isn't it?"
paras.zh: “如果我没有获得配额，我可能会收到一些报价。这只是因为我是一个配额。事情就是这样，不是吗？”

paras.en: Despite the uncertainty around his future, Walmsley knows he is a perfect example of someone taking a leap, putting the work in, and it paying off.
paras.zh: 尽管沃姆斯利的未来充满不确定性，但他知道自己是一个跨越式发展、投入工作并获得回报的完美典范。

paras.en: "Obviously chase your dreams and anything can happen. A bit of luck involved, but you take what you get," Walmsley added.
paras.zh: “显然，追逐你的梦想，任何事情都有可能发生。这涉及到一点运气，但你会得到你所得到的，”沃姆斯利补充道。

paras.en: "Coming from Whitehaven and then Halifax for a couple of years and just to be here now and have that ring on my finger.
paras.zh: “我从怀特黑文来到哈利法克斯几年了，现在来到这里，把戒指戴在了我的手指上。

paras.en: Whatever happens, Walmsley will forever be one of Wakefield's immortals.
paras.zh: 无论发生什么，沃姆斯利都将永远是韦克菲尔德的不朽人物之一。

articles.title: Daryz seeks historic Arc double

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Daryz seeks historic Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe double
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：达里兹寻求历史性的凯旋门双冠王

paras.en: Daryz - last year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner - looks to become the first colt to retain the prize since 1978 when he goes to post for Europe's premier race at 3.05pm, live on Sky Sports Racing; The race is the feature of eight from Paris, alongside domestic racing from Uttoxeter.
paras.zh: 达里兹（Daryz）是去年凯旋门大奖赛的冠军，他有望成为自 1978 年以来第一匹卫冕该奖项的小马，当时他将于下午 3 点 05 分在天空体育赛车直播的欧洲顶级比赛中发帖；这场比赛是巴黎八场比赛的一大特色，另外还有尤托克西特的国内比赛。

paras.en: Daryz seeks to retain his Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe crown in the 2026 renewal of Europe's richest race - live on Sky Sports Racing at 3.05pm.
paras.zh: 达里兹力求在 2026 年欧洲最富有的比赛中保住自己的凯旋门大奖赛桂冠，天空体育赛车直播将于下午 3 点 05 分直播。

paras.en: 3.05 ParisLongchamp - Daryz bids for historic Arc double
paras.zh: 3.05 ParisLongchamp - Daryz 竞标历史性的 Arc 双打

paras.en: Daryz will look for an historic back-to-back double in Europe's biggest race, bidding to be the first colt since Alleged in 1978 to achieve this feat.
paras.zh: 达里兹将在欧洲最大的比赛中寻求历史性的背靠背双冠，力争成为自1978年据称实现这一壮举的第一匹小马。

paras.en: Francis-Henri Graffard's colt looked as good as ever when he returned in the Prix Ganay, which was then followed up with an equally sparkling performance in the Prix Aga Khan IV. A trip to Royal Ascot in June for the Prince Of Wales' Stakes didn't go to plan as he was third, although it transpired blood issues were found following the race.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德（Francis-Henri Graffard）的小马在加奈大奖赛（Prix Ganay）中回归时看起来一如既往地出色，随后在阿加汗四世赛（Prix Aga Khan IV）中也有同样出色的表现。六月，威尔士亲王锦标赛前往皇家阿斯科特赛马会的行程并未按计划进行，因为他获得了第三名，尽管赛后发现了血液问题。

paras.en: After a break, Graffard's star made light work of Coronation Cup winner Bay City Roller - who he reopposes today - in the Prix Foy, with the trainer saying he was only 75 per cent fit. Having been drawn in stall five, this short priced favourite will take all the beating with connections very confident.
paras.zh: 休息后，格拉法德的球星在福伊大奖赛上对加冕杯冠军贝城罗勒（Bay City Roller）进行了轻松的训练，教练称他的健康状况只有 75%。在第五号摊位上抽签后，这款价格低廉的热门产品将以非常自信的方式承受所有打击。

paras.en: - Kevin Blake's Arc day tips: Three fancies on star-studded undercard
paras.zh: - 凯文·布莱克 (Kevin Blake) 的 Arc Day 秘诀：对明星云集的底牌的三种幻想

paras.en: - Who wins the Arc? Sky Sports Racing team tips
paras.zh: - 谁赢得了弧线？天空体育赛车队提示

paras.en: Kalpana was seventh in this contest last year and connections are keen for redemption as she returns to ParisLongchamp looking to emulate Juddmonte filly Bluestocking, who two-years ago took this famous prize. The King George winner looks good as ever this year and has racked up two Group 1s. Drawn in stall six, conditions look well-suited and with Colin Keane having had another year of riding her, she could go very close.
paras.zh: Kalpana 去年在这项比赛中获得第七名，当她重返巴黎 Longchamp 并希望效仿 Juddmonte 母马 Bluestocking 时，人们都渴望得到救赎，后者两年前获得了这一著名奖项。这位乔治国王冠军今年看起来一如既往地出色，并且已经两次获得一级联赛冠军。在六号摊位上绘制的，条件看起来很合适，而且科林·基恩又骑了一年，她可以非常接近。

paras.en: Maltese Cross looks to give William Haggas his first Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as this progressive three-year-old looks to continue progressing in notching up his second Group 1. After finishing second in the Derby, this son of Sea The Stars went on to win the Grand Prix de Paris and backed that up with a win in the Great Voltigeur Stakes. His chances have been dealt a blow though, having being drawn in stall 11.
paras.zh: 马耳他·十字 (Maltese Cross) 希望为威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 带来他的首个凯旋门大奖赛，这位进步的三岁马希望在他的第二个一级赛中继续取得进步。在德比中获得第二名后，这支海星之子继续赢得巴黎大奖赛，并在伏尔蒂格锦标赛 (Great Voltigeur Stakes) 中获胜。不过，他的机会受到了打击，因为他在第 11 号档位被抽签。

paras.en: Aidan O'Brien runs three Classic winners in Europe's premier race, with Ryan Moore opting to ride Irish Derby winner Benvenuto Cellini over Diamond Necklace, who has been allocated the dreaded stall 16. Last year's runner-up Minnie Hauk completes the trio and will be partnered by William Buick in a bid to go one better.
paras.zh: 艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 在欧洲顶级赛事中获得了三场经典赛冠军，瑞恩·摩尔 (Ryan Moore) 选择骑乘爱尔兰德比冠军本韦努托·切利尼 (Benvenuto Cellini)，而不是钻石项链 (Diamond Necklace)，钻石项链被分配到可怕的第 16 档位。去年的亚军米妮·豪克 (Minnie Hauk) 完成了三人组的比赛，并将与威廉·别克 (William Buick) 搭档，争取取得更好的成绩。

paras.en: 3.50 ParisLongchamp - Star mare Aventure headlines field of nine
paras.zh: 3.50 ParisLongchamp - 明星母马冒险头条九场

paras.en: Aventure looks to add to her impressive record against her own sex when she headlines this field of nine in the Group 1 Prix de l'Opera Longines.
paras.zh: 当她在浪琴表歌剧院大奖赛第一组的九场比赛中成为头条新闻时，Aventure 似乎会为她与同性的令人印象深刻的记录再添一笔。

paras.en: Christophe Ferland's star mare has contested the Arc in the last two years, finishing second and eleventh respectively. This year she returns to racing against fillies and mares, against whom her record reads eight victories from 12 starts - including two Group 1s.
paras.zh: 克里斯托弗·费兰 (Christophe Ferland) 的明星母马在过去两年中参加了弧形赛，分别获得第二名和第十一名。今年，她重返赛场，与母马和母马比赛，她在 12 场比赛中赢得了 8 场胜利，其中包括两次一级赛。

paras.en: She bounced back from defeat at the hands of Daryz in the Prix Ganay when downing Sunly in the Prix Corrida. Calandagan proved too good for her in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud but her big day came when she subsequently took out the Prix Jean et Louis Romanet at Deauville in the summer, defeating the unbeaten Diamond Necklace.
paras.zh: 她在 Prix Corrida 比赛中击败 Sunly，从在 Prix Ganay 比赛中输给 Daryz 的失利中恢复过来。卡兰甘在圣克劳德大奖赛中证明了自己的实力，但当她随后在夏天的多维尔举行的让·路易·罗曼内大奖赛中击败不败的钻石项链队时，她的大日子到来了。

paras.en: Three-year-old Pink Panthera appears to be the best of the rest. She has hit the crossbar twice at Group 1 level this season - firstly in the Prix de Diane and then last time out in the Prix Vermeille. Three-year-olds have a fabulous record in this contest, having won eight out of the last 10 renewals.
paras.zh: 三岁的粉红豹似乎是其余中最好的。本赛季，她在一级联赛中两次击中横梁，第一次是在黛安大奖赛，最后一次是在维梅耶大奖赛。三岁孩子在这场比赛中取得了惊人的战绩，在过去的 10 场比赛中赢得了 8 场。

paras.en: Irish 1000 and Coronation Stakes winner Precise has been highly tried this year and takes the set up in trip for the first time, with Ryan Moore taking the ride.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰 1000 和 Coronation Stakes 冠军 Precise 今年经过了严格的考验，并首次在比赛中进行设置，由 Ryan Moore 驾驶。

paras.en: 4.25 ParisLongchamp - Samangan and Thesecretadversary clash again in the Foret
paras.zh: 4.25 ParisLongchamp - Samangan 和 Thesecretadversary 再次在 Foret 发生冲突

paras.en: Samangan and Thesecretadversary meet again, this time in the Group 1 Qatar Prix de la Foret over seven furlongs.
paras.zh: 萨曼根和秘密对手再次相遇，这次是在 1 级卡塔尔拉福雷大奖赛上，赛段超过 7 弗隆。

paras.en: Thesecretadversary got the better of the Francis-Henri Graffard trained Samangan in the Prix Jean Prat, which followed victory in the Jersey Stakes at Royal Ascot. The son of St Mark's Basilica then went up in trip to the Prix Jacques le Marois, which saw him beaten three lengths by Rayif - another Aga Khan colt trained by Francis-Henri Graffard.
paras.zh: 在皇家阿斯科特赛马会的泽西锦标赛中获胜后，秘密对手在让·普拉特大奖赛中击败了由弗朗西斯·亨利·格拉法德训练的萨曼根。圣马可大教堂的儿子随后参加了雅克·勒·马鲁瓦大奖赛，比赛中他被拉伊夫（另一匹由弗朗西斯·亨利·格拉法德训练的阿迦汗小马）击败了三马位。

paras.en: Samangan was in fourth that day with (the also re-opposing) True Love in second. He then went down in trip to the Prix Maurice de Gheest and brought up his first Group 1, seeing off the fast-finishing Divison to score.
paras.zh: 萨曼根当天排名第四，（同样反对的）真爱排名第二。随后，他在莫里斯·德·盖斯特大奖赛中失利，并首次在第一组中脱颖而出，击败了快速完成比赛的部门并取得了进球。

paras.en: True Love hasn't won since she became a classic winner in Newmarket's 1000 Guineas in May. She has since ran creditably in defeat, placing three times in Group 1 company. Nighttime looks to bounce back to form for Christopher Head, whilst Marvelman flies the flag for Andrew Balding.
paras.zh: 自五月份成为纽马克特 1000 坚尼赛的经典赢家以来，True Love 还没有获奖过。此后，她在竞选中表现出色，屡战屡败，三次获得第一组连队的名次。克里斯托弗·海德 (Christopher Head) 的夜间表现似乎有所恢复，而安德鲁·鲍丁 (Andrew Balding) 则在 Marvelman 的旗帜下飘扬。
