articles.title: Trump defiant about midterm chances as he rallies for Republicans in Ohio

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has continued rallying for Republican candidates while visiting Ohio, proposing a defiant outlook on his party’s chances in the November 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在访问俄亥俄州期​​间继续为共和党候选人集会，并对共和党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中的机会提出了挑衅性的看法。

paras.en: Trump told a rally in Vandalia, Ohio, that he believes there will be a “big surprise” in the upcoming elections, claiming his Democratic opponents do not know what is happening.
paras.zh: 特朗普在俄亥俄州万达利亚的一次集会上表示，他相信即将到来的选举将会出现“大惊喜”，并声称他的民主党对手不知道发生了什么。

paras.en: Polls have suggested that Democrats could gain ground in the midterms, but the US president said Republicans would do better than critics expect.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示民主党可能在中期选举中取得进展，但美国总统表示共和党的表现会比批评者预期的更好。

paras.en: “Just get out and vote,” Trump said as he rallied for US Senator Jon Husted, gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy and other Republicans.
paras.zh: “出去投票吧，”特朗普在为美国参议员乔恩·赫斯特德、州长候选人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米和其他共和党人集会时说道。

paras.en: “If you do that, we’re going to win, and we’re going to win big,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果你做到了，我们就会赢，而且我们会赢得巨大的胜利，”他说。

paras.en: Multiple incumbent Republican senators across the country face tough political headwinds, with Trump’s popularity falling in recent months as higher petrol prices and those for other staples persist amid the US-Israel war on Iran.
paras.zh: 全国多位现任共和党参议员面临着严峻的政治阻力，近几个月来，随着美以对伊朗战争期间汽油和其他主要消费品价格持续上涨，特朗普的支持率有所下降。

paras.en: Husted, a Republican in a competitive Ohio race against Democrat Sherrod Brown, hopes the president can motivate supporters who might otherwise skip midterm elections.
paras.zh: 赫斯特德是一名共和党人，正在与民主党人谢罗德·布朗进行激烈的俄亥俄州竞选，他希望总统能够激励那些可能会跳过中期选举的支持者。

paras.en: Trump garnered more than 55 percent of the Ohio vote in the 2024 presidential election, but economic concerns since then have sunk his approval ratings.
paras.zh: 特朗普在 2024 年总统选举中获得了超过 55% 的俄亥俄州选票，但此后的经济担忧导致他的支持率下降。

paras.en: Ohio petrol prices increased 35 percent over the past year to $4.16 per gallon (3.8 litres) on average, according to the American Automobile Association (AAA), which compiles data on automobile travel. Trump’s trade policy with Canada has also led to retaliatory Canadian tariffs that affect about $3bn worth of Ohio exports, based on 2025 figures, Canadian broadcaster CBC reported.
paras.zh: 根据汇总汽车旅行数据的美国汽车协会 (AAA) 的数据，俄亥俄州汽油价格在过去一年中上涨了 35%，平均达到每加仑（3.8 升）4.16 美元。据加拿大广播公司 CBC 报道，特朗普对加拿大的贸易政策还导致加拿大征收报复性关税，根据 2025 年的数据，俄亥俄州的出口额受影响约 30 亿美元。

paras.en: Talking to reporters shortly before addressing Saturday’s rally, Husted said the US has to win the Iran war “on our terms” and, in the interim, he is “showing people that I’m fighting for lower prices”.
paras.zh: 赫斯特德在周六的集会上发表讲话前不久对记者表示，美国必须“按照我们的条件”赢得伊朗战争，在此期间，他“向人们表明我正在为更低的价格而战”。

paras.en: Trump extensively promoted his administration’s action on data centres, mainly those built for AI, during the rally, saying he was seeking to ensure they “benefit local communities” and praising Husted for an unsuccessful attempt to push forward legislation on the issue.
paras.zh: 特朗普在集会上广泛宣传了他的政府对数据中心的行动，主要是那些为人工智能而建的数据中心，称他正在寻求确保这些数据中心“造福当地社区”，并赞扬赫斯特德推动有关该问题的立法的不成功尝试。

paras.en: “Look, there’s so much money to be made for Ohio. You can’t just turn them off. They’ll go to China,” he said, repeating his defence of data centres.
paras.zh: “看，俄亥俄州可以赚很多钱。你不能就这样关闭它们。它们会去中国，”他说，并重申了他对数据中心的辩护。

paras.en: Data centres have become a hot political issue, drawing bipartisan opposition in races across the country, with voters concerned about their impact on electricity prices, farmland and water supplies.
paras.zh: 数据中心已成为一个热门政治问题，在全国各地的竞选中引起了两党的反对，选民担心其对电价、农田和供水的影响。

paras.en: The issue became especially acute in Ohio, where Husted has been repeatedly attacked for his role in attracting data centres to the Midwestern state as lieutenant governor.
paras.zh: 这个问题在俄亥俄州变得尤其严重，赫斯特德因其作为副州长在中西部州吸引数据中心方面所发挥的作用而多次受到攻击。

paras.en: The Republican-controlled Senate tried to advance legislation this past week sponsored by Husted that would ask utility regulators to effectively charge large power users more, as consumers struggle with high energy costs. But it was blocked by nearly all Democrats.
paras.zh: 共和党控制的参议院上周试图推进由赫斯特德发起的立法，要求公用事业监管机构有效地向大型电力用户收取更高的费用，因为消费者正在努力应对高能源成本。但它遭到了几乎所有民主党人的阻止。

paras.en: “Senator Jon Husted gave billions in tax breaks to Big Tech to make sure they would build their data centres in Ohio,” Brown wrote on X on Friday, ahead of Trump’s visit. “Now, he’s making Ohioans foot the bill.”
paras.zh: “参议员乔恩·赫斯特德向大型科技公司提供了数十亿美元的税收减免，以确保他们能够在俄亥俄州建立数据中心，”布朗周五在特朗普访问之前在 X 上写道。 “现在，他让俄亥俄州人买单。”

articles.title: Bosnia general election 2026 explained in maps and charts

paras.en: Bosnians are heading to the polls to choose the next government at all three of the state, entity and canton levels. It may seem complicated, but for a country divided into two entities – the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and Republika Srpska, along with Brcko District – this is nothing new.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚人即将参加投票，选举下届州、实体和州三级政府。这似乎很复杂，但对于一个分为两个实体的国家——波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦、塞族共和国以及布尔奇科区——这并不是什么新鲜事。

paras.en: The general elections are scheduled for Sunday, October 4. More than 3.4 million people are eligible to vote.
paras.zh: 大选定于 10 月 4 日星期日举行。超过 340 万人有资格投票。

paras.en: This year, new election technology will be used. Voters will be identified using biometric devices, while ballot papers will be scanned rather than simply placed in ballot boxes.
paras.zh: 今年，将使用新的选举技术。选民将使用生物识别设备进行身份识别，而选票将被扫描，而不是简单地放入投票箱。

paras.en: The use of scanners, however, does not mean voting will be fully electronic. Votes will still be cast and recorded on paper, but verification and counting should be faster and more transparent, while voter identification should be more accurate.
paras.zh: 然而，扫描仪的使用并不意味着投票将完全电子化。投票仍将在纸上进行和记录，但验证和计票应该更快、更透明，选民身份识别也应该更准确。

paras.en: Candidates for the Bosniak representative include current Presidency member Denis Becirovic of the Social Democratic Party (SDP), Bakir Izetbegovic of the Party of Democratic Action (SDA), Semir Efendic of the Party for Bosnia and Herzegovina (Stranka za BiH), and Fahrudin Radoncic of the Union for a Better Future of BiH (SBB).
paras.zh: 波黑代表候选人包括社会民主党（SDP）现任主席成员丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇、民主行动党（SDA）的巴基尔·伊泽特贝戈维奇、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那党（Stranka za BiH）的塞米尔·埃芬迪奇以及波黑美好未来联盟（SBB）的法赫鲁丁·拉东契奇。

paras.en: Izetbegovic, the president of the centre-right SDA, the biggest Bosniak party in the country, is running for his third term after being defeated by Becirovic in 2022.
paras.zh: 伊泽特贝戈维奇是该国最大的波斯尼亚克族政党中右翼社会民主党的主席，在 2022 年被贝西罗维奇击败后，他正在竞选第三个任期。

paras.en: Three candidates will run for the Croat seat in the Presidency: Darijana Filipovic of the Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina (HDZ BiH), Slaven Kovacevic of the Democratic Front (DF), and Zdenko Lucic, a candidate supported by a coalition of five Croat parties.
paras.zh: 三名候选人将竞选克罗地亚总统席位：波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那克罗地亚民主联盟（HDZ BiH）的达里贾娜·菲利波维奇（Darijana Filipovic）、民主阵线（DF）的斯拉文·科瓦切维奇（Slaven Kovacevic）和由五个克罗地亚政党联盟支持的候选人兹登科·卢西奇（Zdenko Lucic）。

paras.en: The current Serb member of the Presidency, Zeljka Cvijanovic from the right-wing Alliance of Independent Social Democrats (SNSD), is running for a second term. During her term on the country’s top state body, which began in November 2022, just a few months after Russia’s war in Ukraine started, she maintained close and continuous cooperation with Russia and its president, Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 现任总统职位的塞族成员、来自右翼独立社会民主党联盟（SNSD）的泽利卡·奇维贾诺维奇（Zeljka Cvijanovic）正在竞选第二个任期。 2022 年 11 月，即俄罗斯乌克兰战争爆发后几个月，她在该国最高国家机构的任期开始，期间与俄罗斯及其总统弗拉基米尔·普京保持着密切、持续的合作。

paras.en: SNSD is led by Milorad Dodik, the former president of Republika Srpska, best known for his separatist moves and for challenging the Constitution of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the decisions of former High Representative Christian Schmidt.
paras.zh: 少女时代运动由塞族共和国前总统米洛拉德·多迪克领导，他以分裂主义行动、挑战波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那宪法以及前高级代表克里斯蒂安·施密特的决定而闻名。

paras.en: Cvijanovic will face Marinko Bozovic of the Serb Democratic Party (SDS) and Nebojsa Vukanovic of the List for Justice and Order.
paras.zh: 奇维扬诺维奇将对阵塞尔维亚民主党（SDS）的马林科·博佐维奇（Marinko Bozovic）和正义与秩序名单的内博伊萨·武卡诺维奇（Nebojsa Vukanovic）。

paras.en: Voters will be choosing representatives for 14 governments, as well as members of the country’s three-member Presidency.
paras.zh: 选民将选出 14 个政府的代表，以及该国三人总统府的成员。

paras.en: Each entity has its own president, assembly, prime minister and ministers. The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina is further divided into 10 cantons, each with its own government.
paras.zh: 每个实体都有自己的总统、议会、总理和部长。波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦进一步分为 10 个州，每个州都有自己的政府。

paras.en: For all this to happen, the Central Election Commission (CIK), the main body responsible for overseeing the voting process, earlier said that 75 political parties and four independent candidates were registered and eligible to participate.
paras.zh: 为了实现这一切，负责监督投票过程的主要机构中央选举委员会（CIK）早些时候表示，已有 75 个政党和四名独立候选人注册并有资格参加。

paras.en: When registered voters go to the polls, they do not elect one president, but choose one of three members of the country’s collective head of state. They are the representatives of the three constituent peoples – Bosniaks, Croats and Serbs.
paras.zh: 当登记选民去投票时，他们不会选举一位总统，而是选出该国集体国家元首的三名成员之一。他们是三个组成民族——波斯尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人的代表。

paras.en: The Bosniak and Croat members are elected from the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, while the Serb member is elected from Republika Srpska.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚克族和克罗地亚族成员从波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦选举产生，而塞尔维亚族成员从斯普斯卡共和国选举产生。

paras.en: This is because the majority of Bosniaks and Croats live in the Federation, while most Serbs live in Republika Srpska.
paras.zh: 这是因为大多数波斯尼亚人和克罗地亚人居住在联邦，而大多数塞尔维亚人居住在塞族共和国。

paras.en: The election of the Croat member has weighed on Bosniak-Croat relations for years and has often been used as a reason for political blockades.
paras.zh: 克罗地亚成员的选举多年来一直影响着波什尼亚克族与克罗地亚族的关系，并经常被用作政治封锁的理由。

paras.en: Parties gathered around the centre-right Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina (HDZ BiH) are demanding changes to the Election Law, saying they want to prevent Bosniak voters from influencing the election of the Croat member of the Presidency.
paras.zh: 围绕中右翼波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那克罗地亚民主联盟（HDZ BiH）聚集的政党要求修改选举法，称他们希望阻止波斯尼亚选民影响克罗地亚总统成员的选举。

paras.en: But that would also require changes to the Constitution, which allows all citizens in the Federation to choose whether they want to vote for the Bosniak or the Croat member.
paras.zh: 但这还需要修改宪法，允许联邦所有公民选择投票给波斯尼亚人还是克罗地亚人。

paras.en: What about citizens who live outside their constituent group’s voting area?
paras.zh: 居住在其选民群体投票区之外的公民怎么办？

paras.en: A Serb living in the Federation, or a Bosniak or Croat living in Republika Srpska, who wants to run would not be able to do so, nor can they vote for those they consider to be their own representatives.
paras.zh: 居住在联邦的塞族人，或居住在斯普斯卡共和国的波斯尼亚人或克罗地亚人，如果想要参选，将无法这样做，他们也不能投票给他们认为是自己代表的人。

paras.en: That is one of the many paradoxes of Bosnia and Herzegovina’s electoral system.
paras.zh: 这是波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那选举制度的众多悖论之一。

paras.en: How is the state-level government chosen?
paras.zh: 州级政府是如何选出的？

paras.en: Citizens elect representatives to the Parliamentary Assembly, which consists of two houses.
paras.zh: 公民选举议会代表，议会由两院组成。

paras.en: Forty-two representatives will be elected to the House of Representatives.
paras.zh: 四十二名代表将被选入众议院。

paras.en: Two-thirds are directly elected from the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and one-third from Republika Srpska.
paras.zh: 三分之二是从波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦直接选举产生的，三分之一是从塞族共和国直接选举产生的。

paras.en: A quorum consists of a majority of all members elected to the House of Representatives.
paras.zh: 法定人数由当选众议院议员的多数组成。

paras.en: The second chamber – the House of Peoples – has 15 delegates and is elected indirectly through the institutions. It consists of Bosniaks, Croats and Serbs – five from each group.
paras.zh: 第二院——人民院——有 15 名代表，通过各机构间接选举产生。它由波斯尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人组成——每组五人。

paras.en: The election of entity-level authorities works somewhat differently.
paras.zh: 实体级权力机构的选举运作方式有所不同。

paras.en: In Republika Srpska, citizens directly elect the National Assembly, as well as the entity president and vice presidents.
paras.zh: 在塞族共和国，公民直接选举国民议会以及实体主席和副主席。

paras.en: They do not directly elect the government – it is confirmed by the National Assembly.
paras.zh: 他们不直接选举政府——由国民议会确认。

paras.en: In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, citizens directly elect the House of Representatives of the Federation Parliament and the cantonal assemblies.
paras.zh: 在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦，公民直接选举联邦议会众议院和州议会。

paras.en: Those cantonal assemblies then elect delegates to the Federation’s House of Peoples.
paras.zh: 然后，这些州议会选举联邦人民院的代表。

paras.en: The president of the Federation, the entity government and the cantonal governments are formed after the elections, through parliamentary majorities and political agreements.
paras.zh: 联邦主席、实体政府和州政府在选举后通过议会多数票和政治协议产生。

paras.en: Why is it a challenge to form the government?
paras.zh: 为什么组建政府是一个挑战？

paras.en: It is difficult not only because the electoral system is complex, but also because of the lack of agreement among representatives of the three different ethnic communities.
paras.zh: 这不仅是因为选举制度复杂，而且还因为三个不同种族社区的代表之间缺乏共识。

paras.en: Frequent blockades and obstruction make decision-making difficult at all levels, even though many politicians invoke the politics of compromise.
paras.zh: 尽管许多政治家援引妥协政治，但频繁的封锁和阻碍使各级决策变得困难。

paras.en: Elections in Bosnia and Herzegovina, therefore, are not only about who wins, but about whether a system designed to represent everyone can serve its citizens.
paras.zh: 因此，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的选举不仅关乎谁获胜，而且关乎一个旨在代表所有人的制度能否为其公民服务。

paras.en: New election technologies might reduce potential fraud, but much more will be needed for the country’s path towards the European Union.
paras.zh: 新的选举技术可能会减少潜在的欺诈行为，但该国在加入欧盟的道路上还需要更多技术。

paras.en: The outcome of the election could unblock, or further slow down, the adoption of key laws needed for the country’s progress towards EU membership.
paras.zh: 选举结果可能会阻碍或进一步减缓该国加入欧盟所需的关键法律的通过。

paras.en: The EU granted Bosnia and Herzegovina candidate status in December 2022 and opened accession negotiations in 2024.
paras.zh: 欧盟于2022年12月授予波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那候选国地位，并于2024年开启入盟谈判。

paras.en: However, the country’s progress has since been assessed as very limited and slowed by political blockades.
paras.zh: 然而，该国的进展被评估为非常有限，并因政治封锁而放缓。

paras.en: These elections will also be a test for the ruling coalition, which promised to focus on social and economic issues amid the rising cost of living.
paras.zh: 这些选举也将是对执政联盟的考验，该联盟承诺在生活成本上升的情况下关注社会和经济问题。

paras.en: The first preliminary results are traditionally published by CIK late on election night, on October 4, and are updated every few hours.
paras.zh: 按照传统，CIK 会在 10 月 4 日选举之夜深夜发布第一份初步结果，并每隔几个小时更新一次。

paras.en: In the days after the elections, CIK gradually enters votes from the remaining polling stations, mobile voting teams, as well as ballots received by mail and from diplomatic and consular missions.
paras.zh: 在选举后的几天里，CIK 逐渐输入来自剩余投票站、流动投票队以及通过邮件和外交领事使团收到的选票。

paras.en: The official results will be known no later than November 20.
paras.zh: 正式结果最迟将于11月20日公布。

articles.title: West Indies beat India in record chase as Hope hits 162 in third ODI

paras.en: Captain Shai Hope’s unbeaten 162 led West Indies to a record run-chase win against India in one-day international cricket in Chandigarh.
paras.zh: 船长谢·霍普 (Shai Hope) 打出 162 杆不败战绩，带领西印度群岛队在昌迪加尔举行的一日国际板球比赛中以追球赛的成绩战胜印度队。

paras.en: The West Indies achieved their highest ODI run chase on Saturday, reaching 352-5 and winning by five wickets with 10 balls to spare after India made 351-7, featuring Lokesh Rahul’s 129 not out.
paras.zh: 周六，西印度群岛队取得了最高的 ODI 跑动追击战绩，达到 352-5，并在印度队取得 351-7 的成绩（其中洛克什·拉胡尔 (Lokesh Rahul) 的 129 分未出局）之后，以 5 个三柱门的优势获胜，还剩 10 个球。

paras.en: India had already won the three-match series after eight-wicket wins in Thiruvananthapuram and Guwahati. But the West Indies, chasing for the first time in the series, overcame India for the first time since 2023.
paras.zh: 印度在特里凡得琅和古瓦哈提取得八场胜利后，已经赢得了三场系列赛的胜利。但西印度群岛队在系列赛中首次追击，自 2023 年以来首次战胜了印度队。

paras.en: Hope promoted himself to opening batter after Jewel Andrew reportedly injured a finger making a catch and had to go to hospital. After keeping wicket for all of India’s 50 overs in high humidity, he batted brilliantly to score his second successive hundred in the series but struggled in the last overs.
paras.zh: 据报道，朱厄尔·安德鲁接球时手指受伤，不得不去医院，霍普将自己提升为开垒打手。在高湿度的情况下，他在印度 50 轮的所有比赛中都保持了三柱门，他的击球出色，在系列赛中连续第二个百分百得分，但在最后几轮中表现不佳。

paras.en: “Felt something around the groin area but wanted to fight through till the end,” Hope said.
paras.zh: “在腹股沟区域感觉到有什么东西，但想坚持到底，”霍普说。

paras.en: His second-highest ODI score, from 143 balls, included 17 boundaries and three sixes. Amir Jangoo added 67 off 56 and Keemo Paul 44 off 35.
paras.zh: 他的 ODI 得分第二高，共有 143 个球，其中包括 17 个界外球和 3 个六球。阿米尔·詹古 (Amir Jangoo) 56 投 67 分，基莫·保罗 (Keemo Paul) 35 投 44 分。

paras.en: “[Chasing is] always a lot easier in India, especially with the dew,” Hope said. “Glad we got over the line.”
paras.zh: “在印度，[追逐]总是容易得多，尤其是在有露水的情况下，”霍普说。 “很高兴我们越过了界限。”

paras.en: Hope and Jangoo added 109 off 99 balls for the second wicket to defy an India bowling attack that recalled Mohammed Siraj and all-rounder Nitish Reddy and included debutant pacer Anshul Kamboj, who went wicketless.
paras.zh: 霍普和詹古在第二个三柱门的 99 个球中投进 109 个球，以抵抗印度保龄球的进攻，印度保龄球进攻召回了穆罕默德·西拉杰和全能选手尼蒂什·雷迪，其中包括首次亮相的步行者安舒尔·坎博伊，后者没有三柱门。

paras.en: Jangoo was run out in the 21st over, but Sherfane Rutherford (24) did not let the momentum slip. He added 56 with Hope, who reached 50 off 46 balls and 100 off 104 in his 21st ODI hundred and fifth against India.
paras.zh: Jangoo 在第 21 回合被淘汰，但 Sherfane Rutherford（24 岁）并没有让势头下滑。他与霍普一起打进了 56 球，霍普在对阵印度的第 21 场 ODI 百零 5 场比赛中，46 球命中 50 球，104 球命中 100 球。

paras.en: Paul’s cameo included five fours as he added 65 off 61 balls with his skipper. Hope shifted gears after Paul was dismissed in the 41st over, caught off Gurnoor Brar.
paras.zh: 保罗的客串包括 5 个四分球，他与队长一起打进了 61 个球中的 65 个。保罗在第 41 回合被淘汰后，霍普的态度发生了转变，追上了古努尔·布拉尔 (Gurnoor Brar)。

paras.en: Hope hit seven more fours and two sixes after his milestone, taking 62 off the last 39 balls faced to rush West Indies to victory.
paras.zh: 在取得里程碑之后，霍普又击中了 7 个四分球和两个六分球，在最后 39 个球中拿下 62 个球，帮助西印度群岛取得了胜利。

paras.en: India had to serve a slow over rate penalty for the last four overs, with an additional fielder inside the 30-yard circle, as Hope and Gudakesh Motie (19 not out) added 62 off 29 balls for the sixth wicket.
paras.zh: 印度队在最后四轮比赛中不得不接受缓慢的超率处罚，在 30 码圈内增加了一名外野手，霍普和古达克什·莫蒂（19 岁未出局）在第六个边门的 29 个球中投进了 62 个球。

paras.en: India won the toss again but skipper Shubman Gill was caught behind on 1 and Virat Kohli was bowled for a golden duck. Both fell to Jayden Seales.
paras.zh: 印度再次赢得了掷骰子，但船长舒布曼·吉尔 (Shubman Gill) 在 1 号球上落后，而维拉特·科利 (Virat Kohli) 则获得了金鸭子。两人均落败于杰登·西尔斯 (Jayden Seales) 之手。

paras.en: Only 28 runs came in the first 10 overs, then Rohit Sharma and Rahul propelled the hosts.
paras.zh: 前 10 回合只得 28 分，然后罗希特·夏尔马 (Rohit Sharma) 和拉胡尔 (Rahul) 推动主队前进。

paras.en: Sharma resurrected the innings with 92 off 85 balls, adding 137 for the third wicket with Ruturaj Gaikwad.
paras.zh: 夏尔马以 85 个球中的 92 个球复活了局局，并与鲁图拉吉·盖克瓦德 (Ruturaj Gaikwad) 在第三个三柱门上增加了 137 个球。

paras.en: Sharma took his time and was unlucky to miss a second consecutive hundred in the series; he was caught off Paul in the 25th over.
paras.zh: 夏尔马慢慢来，不幸的是连续第二次错过了系列赛的百场比赛。第25局，他被保罗拦住了。

paras.en: Four overs later, Gaikwad — 57 off 69 — was Seales’s third wicket.
paras.zh: 四轮后，盖克瓦德（69 投 57 分）成为西尔斯的第三个三柱门。

paras.en: That brought Rahul to the crease, and he led the charge past 350.
paras.zh: 这将拉胡尔带到了折痕处，他带领冲锋超过了 350。

paras.en: Rahul hit six sixes and 10 fours. He scored 50 off 41 balls and his second 50 off 39 balls. He enjoyed good partnerships with Naman Dhir and Brar and finished 129 not out off only 87 balls.
paras.zh: 拉胡尔打出了 6 个六杆和 10 个四杆。他在 41 球中攻入 50 球，第二次在 39 球中攻入 50 球。他与纳曼·迪尔 (Naman Dhir) 和布拉尔 (Brar) 有着良好的合作关系，最终打出 129 个球，而不是只打出 87 个球。

paras.en: The teams begin a five-match Twenty20 series on Tuesday, starting in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
paras.zh: 周二，两支球队将在北方邦勒克瑙开始一场五场比赛的 Twenty20 系列赛。

articles.title: U.S. withdrawal from Iraq is complete
articles.author: Jane Arraf

paras.en: Twenty-three years after President George W. Bush's campaign of "shock and awe," the U.S. military has completed its withdrawal from Iraq.
paras.zh: 在乔治·W·布什总统发动“震惊与敬畏”行动二十三年后，美国军队完成了从伊拉克的撤军。

paras.en: The U.S. military withdrew from Iraq this week 23 years after its invasion toppled Saddam Hussein and led to a security vacuum, insurgency, civil war and the rise of ISIS that kept the U.S. there for two decades. NPR's Jane Arraf, who has reported from Iraq since the 1990s, joins us from Baghdad. Hi, Jane.
paras.zh: 美国军队本周从伊拉克撤军，23年前，伊拉克入侵伊拉克推翻了萨达姆·侯赛因，并导致了安全真空、叛乱、内战和伊斯兰国的崛起，这些都让美国在伊拉克停留了二十年。 NPR 的简·阿拉夫 (Jane Arraf) 自 20 世纪 90 年代以来一直在伊拉克进行报道，现在从巴格达加入我们。嗨，简。

paras.en: NADWORNY: So the Iraqi government declared a national holiday and held celebrations. Tell us about the significance of U.S. forces withdrawing.
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：因此伊拉克政府宣布全国放假并举行庆祝活动。请告诉我们美军撤军的意义。

paras.en: ARRAF: Well, there weren't a lot of troops left. You know, at the height of the U.S. military presence here, there were 170,000, and recently, that was down to about 1,500. And the U.S. military had left once before in 2011, when it was relatively stable here. Iraq wanted them to leave. But then they invited them back three years later to help fight the militant group ISIS. And that's what they've been doing here until this week.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：嗯，剩下的部队不多了。要知道，在美军驻扎最多的时候，这里有17万人，而最近，这个数字下降到了1500人左右。而美军此前曾在2011年撤离过一次，当时这里局势相对稳定。伊拉克希望他们离开。但三年后，他们又邀请他们回来帮助打击激进组织“伊斯兰国”。这就是他们本周之前一直在这里做的事情。

paras.en: NADWORNY: So Iran had demanded that U.S. forces withdraw from neighboring Iraq. It wasn't happy about having U.S. bases right on its doorstep. What's been the reaction there?
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：伊朗要求美军从邻国伊拉克撤军。它对美国基地就在其家门口感到不高兴。那里有什么反应？

paras.en: ARRAF: Well, Iran has painted it as a victory, as have Iran-backed militias who have been attacking U.S. forces and diplomatic missions here in Iraq. So there are two big developments here. One is that departure of the U.S. military, and the other is the Iraqi prime minister's promise to President Trump that he'll disarm those militias. That deadline has moved into next year. It's a very tall order. But - and this is also really significant - the hardest line militias announced this week that they would halt attacks, apart from shooting at enemy aircraft. Disarming, though, is a step further.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：伊朗将其描绘成一场胜利，伊朗支持的民兵一直在袭击驻伊拉克的美军和外交使团。所以这里有两个重大进展。一是美军撤离，二是伊拉克总理向特朗普总统承诺解除这些民兵武装。该截止日期已移至明年。这是一个非常艰巨的任务。但是——这也非常重要——最强硬的前线民兵本周宣布，除了向敌机射击之外，他们将停止袭击。不过，解除武装又向前迈进了一步。

paras.en: NADWORNY: And what's been the reaction among Iraqis?
paras.zh: NADWORNY：伊拉克人的反应是什么？

paras.en: ARRAF: Well, they like the idea, certainly, of foreign troops out, for the most part. At the tourist site of Babylon yesterday, we spoke with an Iraqi schoolteacher, Eshwa Saoud (ph). She was there with her family.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：嗯，当然，他们在很大程度上喜欢外国军队撤离的想法。昨天在巴比伦旅游景点，我们采访了伊拉克教师埃什瓦·萨乌德（博士）。她和她的家人在那里。

paras.en: ESHWA SAOUD: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: ESHWA SAOUD：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: ARRAF: She said, "we think it's better for Iraq. It's our country, after all."
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：她说，“我们认为这对伊拉克更好。毕竟这是我们的国家。”

paras.en: NADWORNY: Are there any worries about the U.S. withdrawal and where that basically leaves Iraq's ability to even defend itself?
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：对于美国撤军是否存在任何担忧？这基本上会让伊拉克失去自卫能力吗？

paras.en: ARRAF: A lot of worries in the Kurdistan region, the semi-autonomous region of Iraq, which has been hit hard by Iranian attacks. They host opposition bases there, armed Iranian opposition bases. So there's a lot of uncertainty there and a feeling of betrayal. And we have to remember the U.S. still has a lot of power over Iraq - financially, politically, even down to determining who the prime minister is here. President Trump boasted about that. We spoke with former foreign minister and Deputy Prime Minister Ali Allawi. Among his books is one called "The Occupation Of Iraq: Winning The War, Losing The Peace." Here's his take on the United States.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：伊拉克半自治区库尔德斯坦地区受到伊朗袭击的严重打击，令人担忧。他们在那里设有反对派基地，伊朗反对派武装基地。所以那里有很多不确定性和被背叛的感觉。我们必须记住，美国对伊拉克仍然拥有很大的权力——在经济上、政治上，甚至可以决定谁是这里的总理。特朗普总统对此吹嘘不已。我们与前外交部长兼副总理阿里·阿拉维进行了交谈。他的著作中有一本名为《占领伊拉克：赢得战争，失去和平》。这是他对美国的看法。

paras.en: ALI ALLAWI: I mean, I accuse it of being indifferent and incompetent - indifferent to the outcome, incompetent in managing it. I mean, don't go around invading a country and send your troops, you know, thousands of miles and then wash your hands of the whole affair like punch a spider (ph).
paras.zh: 阿里·阿拉维：我的意思是，我指责它冷漠和无能——对结果漠不关心，在管理它方面无能。我的意思是，不要四处入侵一个国家，派遣你的军队，你知道，数千英里，然后像打蜘蛛一样对整个事件撒手不管（ph）。

paras.en: ARRAF: So the U.S. toppling of Saddam Hussein dismantled the Iraqi military and then opened the door for Iran, destroying government institutions here, encouraging staggering levels of corruption. Allawi says that we'll need a generational shift to address that.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：因此，美国推翻萨达姆侯赛因解散了伊拉克军队，然后为伊朗打开了大门，摧毁了这里的政府机构，助长了惊人程度的腐败。阿拉维说，我们需要一代人的转变来解决这个问题。

paras.en: NADWORNY: A generational shift - that was NPR's Jane Arraf, who joined us from Baghdad. Thank you.
paras.zh: NADWORNY：代际转变 - 那是 NPR 的简·阿拉夫 (Jane Arraf)，她从巴格达加入我们。谢谢。

articles.title: France arrests 5,000 people, mostly teens, as school protests spread
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: France arrests 5,000 people, mostly teens, as school protests spread
paras.zh: 随着学校抗议活动蔓延，法国逮捕了 5,000 人，其中大部分是青少年

paras.en: High school students say their classrooms are overcrowded, teachers are missing and buildings need repairs. The protests have spread to cities across France, and some 5,000 people have been arrested.
paras.zh: 高中生表示，他们的教室过于拥挤，老师失踪，建筑物需要维修。抗议活动已蔓延至法国各地城市，约有 5,000 人被捕。

paras.en: A French high school protest movement has degenerated into violence with young people clashing with police. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley reports.
paras.zh: 法国高中抗议运动已演变成年轻人与警察发生冲突的暴力事件。 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利报道。

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: France has a tradition of student protests, and the latest are about overcrowded classrooms and rundown facilities. But the country was shocked at how quickly this nationwide protest movement, which started late last month, morphed into what looks more like urban riots.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：法国有学生抗议的传统，最近的一次抗议是关于教室过度拥挤和设施破旧。但全国震惊的是，这场上个月底开始的全国性抗议运动竟然如此迅速地演变成看起来更像是城市骚乱。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTER: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: For the past few days, TV news footage has shown lines of riot police with shields and tear gas charging young people, hooded youths chasing and kicking a downed officer, all while vehicles, trash cans and schools burn. Sarah Knafo, a member of Parliament from the extreme-right party Reconquete, denounced the students on news channel LCI.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：过去几天，电视新闻画面显示，防暴警察手持盾牌和催泪瓦斯，向年轻人冲锋，蒙面青年追逐并踢倒一名被击倒的警察，与此同时，车辆、垃圾桶和学校都在燃烧。极右翼政党收复失地党的议员萨拉·克纳福 (Sarah Knafo) 在新闻频道 LCI 上谴责了这些学生。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "We see young rioters, savages who are supposed to be protesting a lack of material, destroying what the state has given them," she said. Knafo said what's needed is authority. More than 5,000 people have been arrested, according to the interior ministry.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“我们看到年轻的暴徒、野蛮人，他们本应抗议物资匮乏，却破坏了国家给予他们的东西，”她说。 Knafo 说我们需要的是权威。据内政部称，已有 5000 多人被捕。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #1: (Speaking French).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#1：（说法语）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: But people also pointed to what they saw as police aggression.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：但人们也指出了他们所看到的警察的侵略行为。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #2: (Speaking French).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#2：（说法语）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "Stop this," a woman wails at police as she watches from the street in a news broadcast from France, too. "These are just kids. You don't need to use all this force."
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“停下来，”一名妇女在法国的新闻广播中在街上观看时向警察哀嚎。 “这些只是孩子。你不需要使用所有的力量。”

paras.en: SONIA BENAMEUR: Yes, yes. I am in the train.
paras.zh: 索尼娅·贝纳穆尔： 是的，是的。我在火车上。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: I call longtime educator Sonia Benameur, who teaches in a poor Paris suburb. She's on her way home after her high school and hundreds of others were closed Friday.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：我给长期教育家索尼娅·贝纳穆尔打电话，她在巴黎一个贫穷的郊区教书。周五，她的高中和其他数百所高中都放假后，她正在回家的路上。

paras.en: BENAMEUR: The students are very serious, and they want to protest about their rights. (Speaking French).
paras.zh: BENAMEUR：学生们非常严肃，他们想抗议自己的权利。 （说法语）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Switching to French, she tells me how stifling their un-air-conditioned classrooms are and how they can go weeks without a substitute if a teacher is sick.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：她用法语告诉我，他们没有空调的教室是多么令人窒息，如果老师生病了，他们如何可以在没有替补的情况下度过数周。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Young France Unbowed Parliamentarian Louis Boyard made an Instagram video with the students before the violence started.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：年轻的法国不屈服议员路易斯·博亚德在暴力事件发生前与学生们制作了一段 Instagram 视频。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "You are legitimate," he tells them. "High schools have everything in the rich neighborhoods of Paris, but in the suburbs and countryside, you have nothing."
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“你们是合法的，”他告诉他们。 “在巴黎的富裕社区，高中拥有一切，但在郊区和乡村，你什么都没有。”

paras.en: Teacher Benameur says she hopes the tensions cool over the weekend.
paras.zh: 贝纳穆尔老师说，她希望紧张局势在周末得到缓解。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: But what's most upsetting, she says, is how politicians on the left and right are using the students' plight to campaign for next year's presidential election. Eleanor Beardsley, NPR News, Paris.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：但她说，最令人不安的是左右政客如何利用学生的困境来竞选明年的总统选举。埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)，NPR 新闻，巴黎。

articles.title: For some Brazilians, this election is a vote on Trump
articles.author: Tara Neill

paras.en: For some Brazilians, this election is a vote on Trump
paras.zh: 对于一些巴西人来说，这次选举是对特朗普的投票

paras.en: President Trump says he's been having success winning races in Latin America. As Brazilian voters go to the polls, they're also deciding how much influence Trump should have in their country.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他在拉丁美洲的竞选中取得了成功。当巴西选民参加投票时，他们也在决定特朗普在他们的国家应该有多大的影响力。

paras.en: CARRIE KAHN, BYLINE: Apart from the economy and issues at home, also at stake is Brazil's increasingly complicated relationship with the United States. President Trump has been flexing his power both politically and militarily in Latin America. And since coming back to office, the last seven presidential elections in the region have all gone to conservative or far-right leaders. Trump likes to take credit for the region's shift to the right, like during this recent exchange with reporters in the Oval Office.
paras.zh: 卡里·卡恩连线：除了经济和国内问题之外，巴西与美国日益复杂的关系也受到威胁。特朗普总统一直在拉丁美洲展示其政治和军事权力。自重新执政以来，该地区最近七次总统选举均由保守派或极右翼领导人胜出。特朗普喜欢将该地区的右倾归功于自己，就像最近在椭圆形办公室与记者的交流中那样。

paras.en: PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP: Lots of people that I got elected - and the - that part of our hemisphere is really turning out to be very much different than it was. They've gone from being left to going right. They're all going right.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统：我当选的很多人以及我们半球的那一部分确实与以前大不相同。他们已经从左转变成了右转​​。他们一切都进展顺利。

paras.en: KAHN: This week, he said he's watching the Brazilian elections very carefully. While he's yet to explicitly endorse Bolsonaro, the Trump administration has revoked visas for officials it says unfairly treated the conservative family, and many of President Trump's steepest tariffs are still levied against some Brazilian exports to the U.S.
paras.zh: 卡恩：本周，他说他正在非常仔细地关注巴西选举。虽然他尚未明确支持博尔索纳罗，但特朗普政府已吊销了其认为不公平对待保守派家庭的官员的签证，并且特朗普总统的许多最严厉的关税仍然针对巴西对美国的一些出口征收。

paras.en: KAHN: There are few workers on the floor of the machinery shop at the Dupps Company in the industrial corridor outside Sao Paulo. Plant manager Leandro Ferreira says his company used to export about $15 million a year in products to the U.S.
paras.zh: 卡恩：圣保罗郊外工业走廊杜普斯公司机械车间的地板上几乎没有工人。工厂经理 Leandro Ferreira 表示，他的公司过去每年向美国出口约 1500 万美元的产品。

paras.en: LEANDRO FERREIRA: After the tariffs, we dropped down to zero completely.
paras.zh: LEANDRO FERREIRA：关税之后，我们完全降至零。

paras.en: KAHN: He had to close down an entire shift and lay off 40% of the workforce. They make heavy machinery here used in rendering animal parts for feed and other byproducts. Ferreira says it's not fair that a small company is caught up in Trump's global politics.
paras.zh: 卡恩：他不得不关闭整个班次并解雇 40% 的员工。他们在这里制造重型机械，用于将动物器官加工成饲料和其他副产品。费雷拉表示，一家小公司卷入特朗普的全球政治是不公平的。

paras.en: FERREIRA: It should not do anything. That's the first thing. Yeah, because we are independent. Other people in other country out of our contact (ph) should not be putting fingers here. But I also agree that we're not handling well.
paras.zh: 费雷拉：它不应该做任何事情。这是第一件事。是的，因为我们是独立的。与我们没有联系的其他国家的其他人不应该在这里指手画脚。但我也同意我们处理得不好。

paras.en: KAHN: He's referring to Lula's economic policies, which he blames for a lot of his company's financial ills, especially Brazil's high interest rates. For his small business, that's put borrowing out of reach and him squarely in Bolsonaro's camp.
paras.zh: 卡恩：他指的是卢拉的经济政策，他将公司的许多财务问题归咎于卢拉的经济政策，尤其是巴西的高利率。对于他的小企业来说，这使得借贷变得遥不可及，而他完全属于博尔索纳罗的阵营。

paras.en: Trump's intervention in Brazilian politics is a big crowd pleaser at Bolsonaro rallies. At one recent gathering, supporters launched a huge inflatable doll of Trump clutching a Lula likeness dressed in prison garb. Flavio Bolsonaro says, if he wins, he will align Brazil more closely with the U.S. That doesn't sit well with Lula's base and energizes them, as well. Trump's interventions have become a vote winner for Lula.
paras.zh: 特朗普对巴西政治的干预是博尔索纳罗集会上的一大亮点。在最近的一次聚会上，支持者推出了一个巨大的特朗普充气娃娃，里面抱着穿着囚服的卢拉肖像。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗表示，如果他获胜，他将让巴西与美国更加紧密地结盟。这与卢拉的支持者并不一致，但也激发了他们的活力。特朗普的干预为卢拉赢得了选票。

paras.en: JOEL PEDRO: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 乔尔·佩德罗：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KAHN: Seventy-year-old Joel Pedro (ph) shows off watches to fellow retirees nearby. They gather at this informal market in a rundown outdoor plaza in the industrial city of Maua. All but one of the men are voting for Lula. Pedro says, that's because he'll defend us against Trump.
paras.zh: 卡恩：七十岁的乔尔·佩德罗（博士）向附近的退休人员展示手表。他们聚集在工业城市毛阿一个破旧的户外广场上的这个非正式市场。除一名男子外，所有人都投票给卢拉。佩德罗说，那是因为他会保护我们免受特朗普的侵害。

paras.en: KAHN: "We will end up like Venezuela - slaves to the U.S. and at their mercy - if Bolsonaro wins," he says.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“如果博尔索纳罗获胜，我们最终将像委内瑞拉一样——成为美国的奴隶并受其摆布，”他说。

paras.en: OK, wow. A lot to think about there, Carrie. What are you going to be looking for as the results come in?
paras.zh: 好的，哇。那里有很多值得思考的事情，嘉莉。当结果出来时，你会寻找什么？

paras.en: KAHN: To me, Elissa, the results tomorrow will tell us a lot about how divided Brazil has become and also how disillusioned voters are with the political class here. That's a dynamic that will sound familiar to many in the U.S. The polls open tomorrow at 8 a.m. Brasilia Time and close at 5 p.m. I'm going to sign off from an unusually gray Rio. Hoping for some sun when we talk again tomorrow after Brazilians have cast their votes.
paras.zh: 卡恩：艾丽莎，对我来说，明天的结果将告诉我们很多关于巴西的分裂程度以及选民对这里的政治阶层的失望程度。这种动态对于许多美国人来说听起来很熟悉。投票将于巴西利亚时间明天上午 8 点开始，下午 5 点结束。我要从一辆异常灰色的里约车上签字。希望明天巴西人投票后我们再次谈话时能有一些阳光。

paras.en: NADWORNY: Thank you, Carrie. We look forward to more of your coverage and your analysis tomorrow.
paras.zh: 纳德沃尼：谢谢你，嘉莉。我们期待您明天更多的报道和分析。

paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它拥有市场上最长的 0% 年利率优惠期之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Texas mother facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons to death

paras.en: A Texas mother is facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons before appearing to harm herself, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，德克萨斯州一名母亲因涉嫌枪杀自己的两个儿子，然后自残而面临死刑谋杀指控。

paras.en: Colleen Nichole Lemmon, 42, was taken into custody and charged with two counts of capital murder, according to the Ellis County Sheriff's Office.
paras.zh: 据埃利斯县治安官办公室称，42 岁的科琳·尼科尔·莱蒙 (Colleen Nichole Lemmon) 已被拘留，并被指控犯有两项死刑谋杀罪。

paras.en: Authorities said they received a call about an "unknown emergency" just before 4:15 a.m. Thursday on Big Sky Drive in Waxahachie.
paras.zh: 当局表示，周四凌晨 4 点 15 分左右，他们在沃克西哈奇的 Big Sky Drive 接到了有关“未知紧急情况”的电话。

paras.en: Upon arriving at the scene, deputies discovered two male victims with gunshot wounds inside the residence.
paras.zh: 到达现场后，警员们在住所内发现了两名受枪伤的男性受害者。

paras.en: Christopher Scott Pitre, 21, was pronounced dead at the scene. The second victim, a 15-year-old boy, was taken to a hospital in critical condition, where he later died.
paras.zh: 21 岁的克里斯托弗·斯科特·皮特 (Christopher Scott Pitre) 被宣布当场死亡。第二名受害者是一名 15 岁男孩，他被送往医院，情况危急，后来不治身亡。

paras.en: Deputies said they also found Lemmon suffering from non-life-threatening injuries.
paras.zh: 代表们表示，他们还发现莱蒙受伤，没有生命危险。

paras.en: Evidence recovered during the investigation gave law enforcement probable cause to believe Lemmon was responsible for shooting both of her children.
paras.zh: 调查过程中找到的证据使执法部门有可能相信莱蒙对射杀她的两个孩子负有责任。

paras.en: Deputies found Lemmon covered in blood with what appeared to be self-inflicted lacerations on her wrists and a handgun nearby, according to an arrest affidavit obtained by FOX 4.
paras.zh: 根据福克斯 4 台获得的一份逮捕证词，警员们发现莱蒙浑身是血，手腕上有疑似自伤的伤口，附近还有一把手枪。

paras.en: Lemmon allegedly told officers, "I shot both my kids."
paras.zh: 据称莱蒙告诉警察，“我射杀了我的两个孩子。”

paras.en: She was arrested and transported to a local hospital for treatment, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，她被捕并被送往当地医院接受治疗。

paras.en: Scott Pitre, the boys' father, told NBC 5 that his younger son had recently celebrated his 15th birthday. He said he wants justice for his sons.
paras.zh: 男孩的父亲斯科特·皮特 (Scott Pitre) 告诉 NBC 5，他的小儿子最近刚刚庆祝了 15 岁生日。他说他希望为他的儿子们伸张正义。

paras.en: Ida Brown, a neighbor, described the killings as "heartbreaking."
paras.zh: 邻居艾达·布朗 (Ida Brown) 形容这次杀戮“令人心碎”。

paras.en: "It's heartbreaking, and I'm praying for them," she told FOX 4.
paras.zh: 她告诉福克斯四台：“这令人心碎，我为他们祈祷。”

paras.en: Sheriff Brad Norman offered his condolences to the family.
paras.zh: 警长布拉德·诺曼向这家人表示哀悼。

paras.en: "My deepest sympathies go out to the victims' father, family members, and loved ones involved in this tragic incident," Norman said in a statement. "They will remain in our prayers during this difficult time."
paras.zh: 诺曼在一份声明中说：“我向参与这起悲惨事件的受害者的父亲、家人和亲人表示最深切的同情。” “在这个困难时期，我们将继续为他们祈祷。”

paras.en: Lemmon is being held on a $2.5 million bond.
paras.zh: 莱蒙持有 250 万美元的债券。

articles.title: Shooting near Baltimore youth football event leaves 12-year-old girl dead, 3 adults wounded

paras.en: A 12-year-old girl was killed and three adults were wounded after two gunmen allegedly opened fire during a dispute near a youth football game in Baltimore, Maryland, authorities said Saturday.
paras.zh: 当局周六称，马里兰州巴尔的摩一场青年足球比赛附近发生争执，两名枪手据称开枪，导致一名 12 岁女孩死亡，三名成人受伤。

paras.en: The preteen girl was apparently caught in the crossfire at Leon Day Park, where a youth football league was holding its homecoming event, Baltimore Police Commissioner Richard Worley said during a news conference.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩警察局长理查德·沃利在新闻发布会上说，这名青春期前的女孩显然是在莱昂戴公园的交火中被捕的，当时一个青少年橄榄球联盟正在那里举行返校节活动。

paras.en: The two men are believed to have been in a dispute that started over a parking space, according to Worley.
paras.zh: 沃利表示，据信这两人因停车位问题发生争执。

paras.en: "What we know is that there was some type of argument between two cowards, and of course, they both opened fire on each other," Worley said.
paras.zh: 沃利说：“我们所知道的是，两个胆小鬼之间发生了某种类型的争论，当然，他们都互相开枪。”

paras.en: "In the crossfire, a 12-year-old little girl who was probably down there watching football was shot and killed," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“在交火中，一名 12 岁的小女孩可能正在下面观看足球比赛，被枪杀。”

paras.en: As of Saturday evening, police said they were searching for at least two suspects, whom authorities described as adult men. No arrests had been announced as of late Saturday night.
paras.zh: 截至周六晚上，警方表示，他们正在寻找至少两名嫌疑人，当局称他们为成年男子。截至周六深夜，尚未宣布逮捕任何人。

paras.en: Baltimore police told Fox News Digital that officers responded to the 1200 block of North Franklintown Road at approximately 6:15 p.m. after receiving multiple reports of gunfire.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩警方告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，警方于下午 6 点 15 分左右对北富兰克林敦路 1200 街区做出了反应。在收到多起枪击报告后。

paras.en: Officers found a 25-year-old woman suffering from an apparent gunshot wound and the 12-year-old girl, who was transported to a hospital but later pronounced dead.
paras.zh: 警方发现一名 25 岁妇女明显受枪伤，另一名 12 岁女孩被送往医院，但后来被宣布死亡。

paras.en: A 28-year-old man and a 23-year-old man separately walked into area hospitals seeking treatment for gunshot wounds, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，一名 28 岁男子和一名 23 岁男子因枪伤分别走进地区医院寻求治疗。

paras.en: All three surviving victims were listed in stable condition.
paras.zh: 所有三名幸存受害者均情况稳定。

paras.en: Baltimore Mayor Brandon Scott gave an emotionally charged reaction to the incident, which he said unfolded because two adults couldn't resolve an argument without guns.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩市市长布兰登·斯科特对这起事件做出了情绪激动的反应，他说，之所以发生这一事件，是因为两个成年人在没有枪的情况下无法解决争吵。

paras.en: "Two grown men got into an argument and now a 12-year-old is gone," he said.
paras.zh: “两个成年男子发生了争执，现在一个 12 岁的孩子已经走了，”他说。

paras.en: "What happened out here today is one of the most disgusting things I've ever seen in my life," Scott added.
paras.zh: “今天发生的事情是我一生中见过的最恶心的事情之一，”斯科特补充道。

paras.en: Scott said the girl's death would have a profound impact on the community before offering his condolences to her family.
paras.zh: 斯科特表示，女孩的去世将对社区产生深远影响，然后向她的家人表示哀悼。

paras.en: "We're never gonna see her full potential," he said. "Her family's gonna be hurting for this for the rest of their life. Her classmates are going to be hurting, her community's going to be hurting."
paras.zh: “我们永远不会看到她的全部潜力，”他说。 “她的家人将因此受到终生伤害。她的同学会受到伤害，她的社区也会受到伤害。”

paras.en: Anyone with information is asked to call homicide detectives at 410-396-2100 or Metro Crime Stoppers at 1-866-7LOCKUP. Anonymous tips can also be submitted through Metro Crime Stoppers of Maryland.
paras.zh: 任何有线索的人请拨打凶杀案侦探电话 410-396-2100 或拨打地铁灭罪热线 1-866-7LOCKUP。匿名举报也可以通过马里兰州地铁犯罪制止者提交。

articles.title: Brewers take Game 1 of NLDS after a controversial call on sure-fire home run ball that hit the stadium roof

paras.en: The best-of-five NLDS between the Milwaukee Brewers and San Diego Padres is one of the most anticipated of the MLB postseason.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基酿酒人队和圣地亚哥教士队之间的五局四胜制全国联赛是 MLB 季后赛中最受期待的比赛之一。

paras.en: And boy, did Game 1 — a 3-2 Brewers win — not disappoint, even ending with one of the most bizarre, unlucky things you will ever see in a Major League Baseball game.
paras.zh: 天哪，第一场比赛——酿酒人队 3-2 获胜——没有让人失望，甚至以美国职业棒球大联盟比赛中最奇怪、最不幸的事情之一结束。

paras.en: The Brewers were the best team in baseball this season, while the Padres went on a tear down the stretch to make the playoffs, and then made short work of the Chicago Cubs in the Wild Card Round.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队是本赛季棒球队中最好的球队，而教士队则在最后时刻奋力闯入季后赛，然后在外卡赛中短暂击败了芝加哥小熊队。

paras.en: Presumptive NL Cy Young favorite Jacob Misiorowski took the hill for the Brewers in what was the first postseason start of the hard-throwing righty's career. Meanwhile, lefty Robbie Ray got the nod for San Diego.
paras.zh: 国联赛扬的最爱雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基 (Jacob Misiorowski) 为酿酒人队登上了山丘，这是这位投球右撇子职业生涯的第一次季后赛开局。与此同时，左撇子罗比·雷 (Robbie Ray) 获得了圣地亚哥的认可。

paras.en: Misiorowski set the tone early, striking out Padres star and lead-off hitter Fernando Tatis Jr., which helped keep the raucous crowd at American Family Field in a frenzy.
paras.zh: 米西奥罗夫斯基一早就定下了基调，三振了教士队明星球员、主打击球手小费尔南多·塔蒂斯，这让美国家庭球场喧闹的观众保持着狂热。

paras.en: However, in the second inning, something seemed to click for the Padres when DH Luis Campusano poked a single into right field with two on, which brought in a run to open the scoring.
paras.zh: 然而，在第二局，教士队似乎突然灵机一动，DH路易斯·坎帕萨诺(DH Luis Campusano)在两人上场的情况下将一垒安打打入右外野，从而带来了开局得分。

paras.en: The Padres added another on a fielder's choice to go up 2-0.
paras.zh: 教士队在外野手的选择上再进一球，以 2-0 领先。

paras.en: In the third, the Brewers got on the board thanks to a Jackson Chourio two-run shot, which happened to be the hardest-hit homer of his career.
paras.zh: 在第三局中，酿酒人队凭借杰克逊·乔里奥的两分击球进入了董事会，这恰好是他职业生涯中最受打击的本垒打。

paras.en: The game remained tied through six innings, with Misiorowski exiting the game after four innings of work in which he gave up 6 hits, 2 runs, and a walk while striking out 6 hitters.
paras.zh: 比赛在六局比赛中保持平局，米西奥罗夫斯基在四局比赛后退场，他在其中放弃了 6 个安打、2 分和四坏球，同时三振了 6 个击球手。

paras.en: In the seventh inning, Milwaukee brought in relief pitcher Abner Uribe to face Tatis and Manny Machado; however, both managed to get on base. Then with the two on first and third respectively, Uribe hit first baseman Ty France to load the bases.
paras.zh: 第七局，密尔沃基队派上替补投手阿布纳·乌里韦迎战塔蒂斯和曼尼·马查多；然而，两人都成功登上了基地。然后，两人分别在一垒和三垒时，乌里韦击中一垒手泰·弗朗斯上垒。

paras.en: Uribe got the hook, with lefty DL Hall coming in to face left-handed-hitting Padres center fielder Jackson Merrill.
paras.zh: 乌里韦（Uribe）获得了勾手，左撇子DL霍尔（DL Hall）迎战教士队中外野手杰克逊·梅里尔（Jackson Merrill）的左手击球。

paras.en: Fortunately for the Brewers, Merrill flew out to left field, getting them out of a big jam.
paras.zh: 对于酿酒人队来说幸运的是，梅里尔飞到了左外野，使他们摆脱了困境。

paras.en: That was key, because after retiring two batters on two pitches to start the bottom of the seventh, Brewers catcher William Contreras took the 3-2 offering from Adrian Morejon and sent it into the seats in right-center field.
paras.zh: 这是关键，因为在第七局下半场开始时，在两个投球上退掉两名击球手后，酿酒人接球手威廉·孔特雷拉斯接过了阿德里安·莫雷洪的 3-2 投球，并将其送入右中场的座位。

paras.en: That solo home run was just Contreras' second hit all season against San Diego pitching.
paras.zh: 那支单人本垒打只是孔特雷拉斯整个赛季对阵圣地亚哥投手的第二支安打。

paras.en: The Brewers got out of another jam in the top of the eighth with the Padres leaving several runners on base, something that was a theme for both teams throughout the night.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队在第八局上半场摆脱了另一场困境，教士队留下了几名跑垒员，这是两支球队整个晚上的主题。

paras.en: The top of the 9th brought the strangest moment of the game when Ty France nearly hit the cover of the ball for what looked like a go-ahead, two-run home run.
paras.zh: 第九局上半场出现了本场比赛最奇怪的时刻，泰·弗朗斯几乎击中了球的掩护，打出了看似领先的两分全垒打。

paras.en: However, the ball hit one of the trusses in the stadium's roof. The ball then bounced nearly straight down and was caught by Jackson Chourio.
paras.zh: 然而，球击中了体育场屋顶的一根桁架。然后球几乎垂直向下弹起并被杰克逊·乔里奥接住。

paras.en: The rule is that if the ball hits the roof in fair territory, it's still live. Chourio made a clutch play to track it down and keep the tying run from scoring.
paras.zh: 规则是，如果球击中公平区域的屋顶，则它仍然是活球。乔里奥（Chourio）做出了关键的一击，将球追上并阻止平局得分。

paras.en: The Padres challenged, but the call stood for the second out of the inning.
paras.zh: 教士队提出了挑战，但这一判罚代表了第二局的比赛。

paras.en: Jackson Merrill was the next batter and lined out to right field to end the game.
paras.zh: 杰克逊·梅里尔（Jackson Merrill）是下一个击球手，他出线到右外野结束了比赛。

paras.en: It was a good game from start to finish, but with so many strong performances on display, who would have thought the Brewers' biggest play would come from the roof at American Family Field?
paras.zh: 这场比赛自始至终都是一场精彩的比赛，但在如此多的精彩表现中，谁会想到酿酒人队最精彩的表演会来自美国家庭球场的屋顶呢？

paras.en: Game 2 is Sunday afternoon in Milwaukee, and you can catch it on FS1.
paras.zh: 第 2 场比赛将于周日下午在密尔沃基举行，您可以通过 FS1 观看比赛。

paras.en: If it's even half as entertaining as Game 1, it'll be must-see TV.
paras.zh: 如果它的娱乐性甚至只有第一场游戏的一半，那么它将成为必看的电视节目。

articles.title: US Coast Guard searches for missing air ambulance off coast of Massachusetts
articles.author: Keely Aouga

paras.en: The US Coast Guard said late on Saturday it had found debris from a medical transport aircraft off the shore of Massachusetts’ Nantucket Island and was searching for the six people who were on board.
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队周六晚间表示，在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特岛海岸附近发现了一架医疗运输机的残骸，并正在寻找机上六人。

paras.en: The jet lost contact with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) during a flight from Bermuda to Boston on Saturday morning. In a statement to the Guardian, an FAA spokesperson said that the agency issued a search-and-rescue alert notice for a Gulfstream G-100 at about 1.20am local time Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六早上，这架飞机在从百慕大飞往波士顿的航班上与美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）失去了联系。 FAA 发言人在给《卫报》的一份声明中表示，该机构于当地时间周六凌晨 1 点 20 分左右发布了针对一架湾流 G-100 的搜救警报通知。

paras.en: The Canadian-registered air ambulance jet had four crew members and two passengers onboard when it departed Bermuda’s LF Wade international airport overnight for the flight to Massachusetts, according to a statement from the Bermuda airport’s operator, Skyport, obtained by the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据美联社获得的百慕大机场运营商 Skyport 的一份声明称，这架在加拿大注册的空中救护飞机连夜从百慕大 LF 韦德国际机场出发飞往马萨诸塞州时，机上有四名机组人员和两名乘客。

paras.en: Four Canadians were on the plane, the Canadian minister of transport Steven MacKinnon posted. “We are closely monitoring the situation and are working with the relevant authorities as search and rescue efforts continue.”
paras.zh: 加拿大交通部长史蒂文·麦金农(Steven MacKinnon)发布消息称，飞机上有四名加拿大人。 “我们正在密切关注事态发展，并正在与有关当局合作，继续进行搜救工作。”

paras.en: The other two passengers were Bermudian nationals, the coast guard said. Searches would continue throughout the night near Nantucket, an island community south of mainland Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 海岸警卫队说，另外两名乘客是百慕大国民。在马萨诸塞州大陆以南的一个岛屿社区楠塔基特附近，搜索工作将持续整夜。

paras.en: The Bermuda government was in contact with US authorities and the families of the passengers, the Bermuda premier, David Burt, posted.
paras.zh: 百慕大总理戴维·伯特表示，百慕大政府正在与美国当局和乘客家属保持联系。

paras.en: The aircraft, registered to Latitude Air Ambulance, departed Bermuda at 12.41am on Saturday according to data from flight tracking website FlightAware. The plane was flying at 24,000 feet (7,300 metres) for much of the journey before descending 13,000 feet in about two minutes shortly before flight controllers lost contact, data showed.
paras.zh: 根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 的数据，这架注册为 Latitude Air Ambulance 的飞机于周六凌晨 12 点 41 分离开百慕大。数据显示，这架飞机在大部分旅程中都在 24,000 英尺（7,300 米）的高度飞行，然后在飞行控制人员失去联系前不久，在大约两分钟内下降了 13,000 英尺。

paras.en: TV station Boston 25 posted an audio clip from Boston Logan international airport in which an air traffic controller can be heard asking the Gulfstream pilot: “You said you’re coming in blind? Is that what you said?”
paras.zh: 波士顿 25 电视台发布了一段来自波士顿洛根国际机场的音频片段，其中可以听到一名空中交通管制员询问湾流飞行员：“你说你是盲人而来？是你说的吗？”

paras.en: The controller then asked whether the plane was declaring an emergency. No response was heard.
paras.zh: 管制员随后询问飞机是否正在宣布紧急情况。没有听到任何回应。

paras.en: Latitude is based in Ontario, Canada, and provides medical evacuation services.
paras.zh: Latitude 总部位于加拿大安大略省，提供医疗后送服务。
