paras.en: NBC News reported that the plane was carrying out a medical evacuation in Bermuda, citing a statement from Clarence Togeretz, the director of flight operations at Latitude.
paras.zh: 美国全国广播公司新闻 (NBC News) 援引 Latitude 飞行运营总监克拉伦斯·托格雷茨 (Clarence Togeretz) 的声明称，这架飞机当时正在百慕大执行医疗后送任务。

paras.en: “We always get rather concerned when our crew doesn’t report to us in a timely manner,” he told NBC News. “But I will say that again, optimistically and positively, that doesn’t mean that the worst has happened.”
paras.zh: “当我们的工作人员没有及时向我们报告时，我们总是非常担心，”他告诉 NBC 新闻。 “但我会乐观、积极地再次重申，这并不意味着最坏的情况已经发生。”

paras.en: NBC also reported that the Massachusetts port authority, which operates Boston Logan international airport, said the aircraft did not arrive as scheduled. A port authority spokesperson said: “Our thoughts are with those onboard and their loved ones as the search continues.”
paras.zh: 美国全国广播公司还报道称，负责运营波士顿洛根国际机场的马萨诸塞州港务局表示，这架飞机没有按计划抵达。港务局发言人表示：“随着搜索的继续，我们的心与船上的人和他们的亲人同在。”

paras.en: The FAA is coordinating with the Rescue Coordination Center and the US Coast Guard to locate the aircraft.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局正在与救援协调中心和美国海岸警卫队协调寻找飞机的位置。

articles.title: UK car industry faces ‘difficult trade-off’ between Chinese and EU markets
articles.author: Alex Daniel

paras.en: Britain’s car industry is grappling with a “difficult trade-off” between China and Europe, as manufacturers struggle to balance the benefits of both markets ahead of looming trade measures that could restrict UK exports to the EU.
paras.zh: 英国汽车行业正在努力应对中国和欧洲之间的“艰难权衡”，因为在可能限制英国对欧盟出口的贸易措施即将出台之前，制造商们正在努力平衡两个市场的利益。

paras.en: The UK is an outlier in choosing not to put import taxes on Chinese vehicles, even as the US has shut them out almost entirely, and the EU imposes duties of up to 45%.
paras.zh: 英国是一个例外，它选择不对中国车辆征收进口税，尽管美国几乎完全将它们拒之门外，欧盟也征收高达 45% 的关税。

paras.en: EU officials reportedly warned Andy Burnham last month that the UK must put tariffs on cheap Chinese vehicles otherwise Brussels would impose protectionist “made in Europe” barriers on British exports to the bloc, hitting British carmakers in their largest market.
paras.zh: 据报道，欧盟官员上个月警告安迪·伯纳姆，英国必须对廉价的中国汽车征收关税，否则布鲁塞尔将对英国向欧盟的出口施加保护主义的“欧洲制造”壁垒，从而打击英国最大市场的汽车制造商。

paras.en: Ministers have so far resisted such calls, with Jonathan Reynolds, the business secretary, arguing any levies would “probably be reciprocated” – costing UK manufacturers sales in China.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，部长们一直抵制此类呼吁，英国商务大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹 (Jonathan Reynolds) 辩称，任何征税“都可能会得到回报” — — 从而导致英国制造商在中国的销售受到损失。

paras.en: Tariffs would also raise prices for British drivers, who have flocked to cheaper Chinese models, and could deter brands such as Chery, which is in talks to build cars at Nissan’s Sunderland plant, from investing further in the UK.
paras.zh: 关税还将提高英国司机的价格，他们会涌向更便宜的中国车型，并可能阻止奇瑞等品牌在英国进一步投资，奇瑞正在就日产桑德兰工厂生产汽车进行谈判。

paras.en: “There is a difficult trade-off,” said Emily Sawicz, of the consultancy RSM UK, adding that the UK “cannot afford to drift between the two indefinitely”. Chinese investment could be a “lifeline” for carmakers, while access to Europe would also be “crucial” for smaller manufacturers.
paras.zh: “这是一个艰难的权衡，”咨询公司 RSM UK 的艾米丽·萨维茨 (Emily Sawicz) 表示，她补充说，英国“不能无限期地在两者之间徘徊”。中国投资可能是汽车制造商的“生命线”，而进入欧洲对于小型制造商来说也“至关重要”。

paras.en: “Being excluded risks UK suppliers becoming increasingly shut out of those European opportunities,” she added. “Manufacturers need clarity on which direction the government intends to take so they can make long-term investment decisions.”
paras.zh: 她补充说：“被排除在外的风险是，英国供应商将越来越被排除在欧洲的机会之外。” “制造商需要明确政府打算采取的方向，以便他们能够做出长期投资决策。”

paras.en: Ian Plummer, commercial director at Autotrader, said competition from Chinese brands had made cars more affordable and “is encouraging more people to go and buy a new car”.
paras.zh: Autotrader商务总监伊恩·普卢默(Ian Plummer)表示，来自中国品牌的竞争使汽车变得更加便宜，并且“正在鼓励更多的人去购买新车”。

paras.en: Brands such as BYD, Omoda and Jaecoo more than tripled their share of the UK new car market in the first eight months of 2026, reaching 12% of sales, according to industry figures.
paras.zh: 行业数据显示，2026 年前 8 个月，比亚迪、Omoda 和 Jaecoo 等品牌在英国新车市场的份额增加了两倍多，达到销量的 12%。

paras.en: Figures released on Friday showed that British new car registrations rose 12% in the year to September, the best month for annual growth since 2017. The preliminary data from the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT) showed the boom was powered by a demand for electric vehicles and Chinese brands, with the Jaecoo 7 and BYD’s Sealion 7 among the top sellers.
paras.zh: 周五公布的数据显示，截至 9 月份，英国新车注册量增长了 12%，是自 2017 年以来年度增长最好的月份。汽车制造商和贸易商协会 (SMMT) 的初步数据显示，这一热潮是由对电动汽车和中国品牌的需求推动的，其中 Jaecoo 7 和比亚迪的 Sealion 7 是最畅销的汽车。

paras.en: The trade body said on Wednesday that the European Commission’s made in Europe rules, which restrict subsidies, tax breaks and public procurement contracts to vehicles built within the EU, pose an existential threat to British car production. The EU accounted for 58% of UK car exports in the first half of the year, compared with about 4% for China.
paras.zh: 该贸易机构周三表示，欧盟委员会在欧洲制定的规则限制了对欧盟境内制造的车辆的补贴、税收减免和公共采购合同，这对英国汽车生产构成了生存威胁。今年上半年，欧盟占英国汽车出口的58%，而中国这一比例约为4%。

paras.en: Mike Hawes, the SMMT’s chief executive, said: “The UK and EU automotive industries are deeply integrated, so effectively excluding British-produced vehicles from their largest market would assure mutual damage.”
paras.zh: SMMT 首席执行官迈克·霍斯 (Mike Hawes) 表示：“英国和欧盟汽车行业深度融合，因此有效地将英国生产的汽车排除在其最大市场之外将确保相互损害。”

paras.en: Massimiliano Messina, Nissan’s chair in Europe, said last month: “Europe cannot have a Trojan horse where the Chinese are going to flood the market through the UK.”
paras.zh: 日产汽车欧洲区主席马西米利亚诺·梅西纳(Massimiliano Messina)上个月表示：“欧洲不能出现中国人通过英国涌入市场的特洛伊木马。”

paras.en: Victor Zhang, the deputy UK chief of Chery, which owns the Jaecoo and Omoda brands, rejected that claim, saying: “Most of what we sell are super-hybrids, not the cars that those tariffs are about, and the cars we sell here stay here.”
paras.zh: 拥有 Jaecoo 和 Omoda 品牌的奇瑞公司英国副总裁维克多·张 (Victor Zhang) 拒绝了这一说法，他说：“我们销售的大部分产品都是超级混合动力车，而不是那些关税所涉及的汽车，我们在这里销售的汽车就留在这儿。”

paras.en: He added: “Tariffs can come and go, but we won’t change our ongoing investment in the UK.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“关税可能会改变，但我们不会改变我们在英国的持续投资。”

paras.en: Brussels raised its own tariffs on Chinese EVs in 2024, triggering a decline in what was then an accelerating sales trajectory. It is now facing calls for fresh barriers to be imposed on importing hybrid electric vehicles, potentially quotas or price floors.
paras.zh: 布鲁塞尔于 2024 年提高了对中国电动汽车的关税，导致当时加速的销售轨迹下降。目前，该国面临着要求对进口混合动力电动汽车设置新壁垒、可能实行配额或底价的呼声。

paras.en: Imports of plug-in and battery hybrid cars rocketed after the EU tariffs were imposed on EVs, underlining China’s ability to pivot its export efforts when hit by trade barriers.
paras.zh: 欧盟对电动汽车征收关税后，插电式和电池混合动力汽车的进口猛增，突显了中国在受到贸易壁垒打击时调整出口努力的能力。

paras.en: Others in the industry believe tariffs could help protect the UK’s manufacturers, whose market share in Britain continues to be eroded Chinese firms.
paras.zh: 业内其他人士认为，关税可能有助于保护英国制造商，他们在英国的市场份额继续受到中国企业的侵蚀。

paras.en: Tim Tozer, a former chair of Vauxhall, said that tariffs were “vital” to stop Britain’s car sector “atrophying”. He said: “We are at last knockings now, trying to save the industry.”
paras.zh: 沃克斯豪尔前董事长蒂姆·托泽表示，关税对于阻止英国汽车行业“萎缩”“至关重要”。他说：“我们现在终于要努力拯救这个行业了。”

paras.en: He added that Reynolds was “whistling in the wind” with hopes of continuing to export to China en masse, arguing the market had become “fiercely nationalistic,” with buyers increasingly loyal to domestic brands “because they’re bloody good”.
paras.zh: 他补充说，雷诺兹“在风中呼啸”，希望继续向中国大规模出口，认为市场已经变得“强烈的民族主义”，买家越来越忠诚于国内品牌，“因为它们非常好”。

articles.title: Polish activists launch abortion pill locker to bypass near-total ban
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam European community affairs correspondent

paras.en: They call it the “world’s first parcel locker for abortion pills”. Polish campaigners have launched a new means of distribution as part of their ongoing effort to skirt the country’s near-total ban on abortion.
paras.zh: 他们称之为“世界上第一个堕胎药包裹储物柜”。波兰活动人士推出了一种新的分发方式，作为他们持续努力规避该国近乎全面的堕胎禁令的一部分。

paras.en: Painted pink and framed by zebra-striped curtains, the 22-compartment “AbortOmat” in Warsaw allows women to access the pills swiftly and anonymously using a six-digit code. The service was envisaged for those who cannot or do not want to wait days for mail delivery due to a missed miscarriage or health complications, or who worry about receiving the pills at home.
paras.zh: 华沙的“AbortOmat”有 22 个隔间，漆成粉红色，周围有斑马条纹窗帘，女性可以使用六位数代码快速、匿名地获取药物。这项服务是为那些因错过流产或健康并发症而不能或不想等待几天的邮件递送的人，或者担心在家收到药丸的人提供的。

paras.en: “And why not?” said Kinga Jelinska, the director of the Women Help Women foundation and co-founder of the Abortion Dream Team, the two groups behind this week’s launch.
paras.zh: “那为什么不呢？”金加·杰林斯卡 (Kinga Jelinska) 说道，她是妇女帮助妇女基金会 (Women Help Women Foundation) 的主任，也是堕胎梦之队 (Abortion Dream Team) 的联合创始人，这两个组织是本周推出的两个组织。

paras.en: “You can order underwear, cosmetics, mascara, whatever and receive it practically the same or next day,” she said. “Why not abortion pills, where in some cases there might be more urgency?”
paras.zh: “你可以订购内衣、化妆品、睫毛膏等，几乎在同一天或第二天就能收到，”她说。 “为什么不使用堕胎药，在某些情况下可能会更加紧迫呢？”

paras.en: The innovation comes six years after people across Poland took to the streets to protest against the tightening of abortion laws that already ranked among the strictest in Europe, setting off the country’s largest demonstrations since the fall of communism. In 2023, the protests were credited with helping to propel Donald Tusk, and his promises to overhaul the laws within 100 days, into power.
paras.zh: 六年前，波兰各地的人们走上街头抗议收紧堕胎法，该法已经是欧洲最严格的堕胎法之一，引发了该国自共产主义垮台以来最大规模的示威活动。 2023 年，抗议活动被认为有助于推动唐纳德·图斯克上台，并兑现了他在 100 天内彻底修改法律的承诺。

paras.en: Since then, political stagnation has set in, said Jelinska, citing comments made last year by Tusk in which the prime minister said there was “simply no majority” to change the laws to allow abortions until the 12th week of pregnancy. Tusk instead hinted that his government was intent on doing things differently, telling reporters that it would not prosecute those who helped to facilitate abortions.
paras.zh: 耶林斯卡援引图斯克去年的言论表示，从那时起，政治陷入停滞，图斯克总理表示，“根本没有多数人”愿意修改法律，允许在怀孕第 12 周之前堕胎。图斯克反而暗示，他的政府打算采取不同的做法，并告诉记者，不会起诉那些帮助堕胎的人。

paras.en: While the possession or ingestion of abortion pills is not outlawed in Poland, provision of the medication or helping someone to obtain it is considered a crime punishable by up to three years in prison.
paras.zh: 虽然在波兰持有或摄入堕胎药并不违法，但提供药物或帮助他人获取堕胎药被视为犯罪，可判处最高三年监禁。

paras.en: The locker offers a novel way to challenge these restrictions, said Jelinska. “It’s a little bit of a hack on the law,” she said. “The law is about directly giving to someone. So here we have a machine in between, which makes the legality of everything much more vague.”
paras.zh: 杰林斯卡说，储物柜提供了一种挑战这些限制的新颖方式。 “这有点违法，”她说。 “法律是直接给予某人。所以我们在两者之间有一台机器，这使得一切的合法性变得更加模糊。”

paras.en: The locker sits inside the abortion centre that was opened in March 2025 by the Abortion Dream Team. Described as the first of its kind in democratic Poland, it offers a safe space for people to consult on abortion options or receive support while they take the pill.
paras.zh: 该储物柜位于堕胎梦之队于 2025 年 3 月开设的堕胎中心内。它被称为民主波兰的第一个此类机构，为人们提供了一个安全的空间，可以咨询堕胎选择或在服用避孕药时获得支持。

paras.en: Symbolically located across the street from the Polish parliament, the centre has allowed campaigners to shine a spotlight on the continued need for abortion access in Poland while also providing services to a wide array of people, said Jelinska. “It has exceeded our expectations.”
paras.zh: 杰林斯卡说，该中心象征性地位于波兰议会的街对面，它让活动人士能够关注波兰对堕胎的持续需求，同时也为广大人民提供服务。 “这超出了我们的预期。”

paras.en: But it had also laid bare how few in power were willing to stand up for them, she said. “The one thing that has surprised us, and it speaks to the political situation, is that there are protests in front of the centre; three, sometimes four times a week.”
paras.zh: 但她说，这也暴露出愿意为他们挺身而出的掌权者是多么少。 “令我们惊讶的一件事是，中心前发生了抗议活动，并且它反映了政治局势；每周三次，有时四次。”

paras.en: While usually less than a dozen people turn up, the protesters regularly use sirens and vuvuzelas to make their point, leaving campaigners worried that the noise levels would eventually result in neighbours asking the centre to relocate. “Neither the city or the police have reacted. So that has been a big disappointment to us,” said Jelinska.
paras.zh: 虽然通常不到十几人出席，但抗议者经常使用警报器和呜呜祖拉来表达自己的观点，这让活动人士担心噪音水平最终会导致邻居要求中心搬迁。 “市政府和警方都没有做出反应。所以这让我们非常失望，”杰林斯卡说。

paras.en: It was a glimpse of how these organisations had increasingly felt abandoned by politicians, even as about 50,000 people in Poland contacted the wider network of pro-choice organisations last year seeking help, said Jelinska. “I think in Poland, abortion access won’t be solved by politics but by women and communities,” she said. “We cannot trust politicians with our own bodies.”
paras.zh: 耶林斯卡表示，尽管去年约有 5 万名波兰人联系了更广泛的支持堕胎组织网络寻求帮助，但这也让人们看到这些组织越来越感到被政客抛弃。 “我认为在波兰，堕胎问题不会由政治解决，而是由妇女和社区解决，”她说。 “我们不能用自己的身体来信任政客。”

articles.title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people have protested across Spain calling for greater protections for tenants after the government failed to pass emergency housing legislation.
paras.zh: 在政府未能通过紧急住房立法后，西班牙各地数万人举行抗议活动，呼吁加强对租户的保护。

paras.en: About 50 marches took place on Saturday in cities including Madrid, Valencia and Barcelona.
paras.zh: 周六，马德里、巴伦西亚和巴塞罗那等城市举行了约 50 场游行。

paras.en: "There is a lot of anger in the streets," a spokesperson for the Valencia Tenants' Union said. Clashes have taken place between some protesters and police in the city.
paras.zh: 瓦伦西亚租户联盟发言人表示：“街上有很多愤怒的人。”该市一些抗议者和警察之间发生了冲突。

paras.en: The measures put forward by Pedro SÃ¡nchez's leftist coalition government on Friday followed public outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home last month after she was unable to afford a sharp rent increase.
paras.zh: 佩德罗·桑切斯的左翼联合政府周五提出了这些措施，此前，上个月一名 87 岁的妇女因无力承担大幅上涨的房租而被驱逐出家，引发了公众的强烈抗议。

paras.en: Her eviction triggered nationwide protests across Spain with protesters demanding lower rents, an end to evictions, and a ban on investment funds - or "vulture funds" as the government has termed them - buying property.
paras.zh: 她的驱逐引发了西班牙全国范围内的抗议活动，抗议者要求降低租金、停止驱逐，并禁止投资基金（政府称之为“秃鹫基金”）购买房产。

paras.en: Sanchez's defeat in Congress on Friday heightens speculation that he might call an early general election, which was not due until next summer.
paras.zh: 桑切斯周五在国会的失败加剧了人们对他可能提前举行大选的猜测，而大选要到明年夏天才能举行。

paras.en: His coalition government, made up of his ruling Socialist party and junior partner the Sumar alliance, does not command a majority in parliament.
paras.zh: 他的联合政府由执政的社会党和初级伙伴苏马尔联盟组成，在议会中并不占多数。

paras.en: Photographs showed protesters in the east coast city of Valencia clashing with police officers on Saturday near arts centre Palau de les Arts Reina SofÃa, which was hosting a real estate summit.
paras.zh: 照片显示，周六，东海岸城市巴伦西亚的抗议者在索法王后艺术中心附近与警察发生冲突，该中心正在举办一场房地产峰会。

paras.en: Several protesters removed barriers and threw objects at officers, who responded with rubber bullets, Spanish media reported. Public broadcaster RTVE said nine police officers were injured and five people were arrested.
paras.zh: 据西班牙媒体报道，几名抗议者拆除障碍物并向警察投掷物品，警察用橡皮子弹回应。公共广播公司 RTVE 称，九名警察受伤，五人被捕。

paras.en: One of the biggest demonstration happened in the capital, Madrid, where estimates of the number of participants varied widely. The city's Tenants' Union said there were 500,000, while officials put the figure at 70,000.
paras.zh: 最大规模的示威活动之一发生在首都马德里，当地对参与者人数的估计差异很大。该市租户联盟称有 50 万人，而官方称这一数字为 7 万人。

paras.en: Demonstrators held banners reading "There won't be peace for rentism" and "I study to have a future, not to have a tiny apartment". They shook the keys they were holding and chanted: "We have the keys of all the city".
paras.zh: 示威者举着横幅，上面写着“租金主义不会有和平”和“我学习是为了拥有未来，而不是为了拥有一间小公寓”。他们摇晃手中的钥匙，高呼：“我们拥有全城的钥匙”。

paras.en: Some had also camped in one of the city's main squares, Puerta del Sol, for days.
paras.zh: 有些人还在该市的主要广场之一太阳门广场露营了好几天。

paras.en: One protester, David, told RTVE ahead of the protest: "We're not here for pleasure or comfort. We're here out of conviction."
paras.zh: 一名抗议者大卫在抗议前告诉 RTVE：“我们来这里不是为了快乐或安慰。我们来这里是出于信念。”

paras.en: Another protester, 26-year-old librarian Marcos Sainz, told AFP news agency that he used to share a two-bedroom flat with friends, paying 900 euros (Â£766) a month in rent. Today, he said a one-bedroom flat often costs 1,000 euros.
paras.zh: 另一位抗议者、26 岁的图书管理员马科斯·塞恩斯 (Marcos Sainz) 告诉法新社，他曾经与朋友合住一套两居室公寓，每月支付 900 欧元（766 英镑）的租金。如今，他说一间卧室的公寓通常要花费 1,000 欧元。

paras.en: Sainz said he would protest against rent rises "until someone dares to regulate it all", or "we'll all have to leave Madrid".
paras.zh: 塞恩斯表示，他将抗议租金上涨，“直到有人敢于监管这一切”，否则“我们都必须离开马德里”。

paras.en: Spanish police said they had arrested three members of a far-right group, some of whom had performed Nazi salutes, as they tried to reach demonstrators in the square.
paras.zh: 西班牙警方表示，他们逮捕了一个极右团体的三名成员，其中一些人在试图接近广场上的示威者时行了纳粹礼。

paras.en: On Friday night, Madrid's Tenants' Union said that although the government's proposed measures were insufficient, the rejection of the proposed legislation "exacerbates the housing crisis which is costing the working class their lives".
paras.zh: 周五晚上，马德里租户联盟表示，尽管政府提出的措施还不够，但拒绝拟议的立法“加剧了住房危机，导致工人阶级丧生”。

paras.en: It is calling for a general strike over the housing crisis.
paras.zh: 它呼吁针对住房危机进行总罢工。

paras.en: The legislation put forward in Congress on Friday was divided into two decrees.
paras.zh: 周五在国会提出的立法分为两项法令。

paras.en: The first included the suspension of evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, a two-year extension to rental leases due to expire before 2028, tax increases for tourist apartments, and a restriction on the purchase of residential properties by so-called "vulture funds".
paras.zh: 第一个措施包括暂停驱逐弱势租户直至 2030 年、将 2028 年之前到期的租赁租约延长两年、增加旅游公寓的税收，以及限制所谓的“秃鹫基金”购买住宅物业。

paras.en: The second decree included the automatic renewal of rental contracts, a major demand of many on the left and the Tenants' Union.
paras.zh: 第二项法令包括自动续签租赁合同，这是许多左翼人士和租户联盟的主要要求。

paras.en: MPs rejected the first decree by 178 votes to 172 and voted against the second by 184 to 166.
paras.zh: 议员们以 178 票对 172 票否决了第一项法令，并以 184 票对 166 票反对了第二项法令。

paras.en: Prior to the vote, the conservative People's Party (PP) and far-right Vox had already said they would vote against both initiatives, leaving the minority government depending on the support of smaller nationalist parties in Catalonia and the Basque Country.
paras.zh: 在投票之前，保守派人民党（PP）和极右翼Vox已经表示，他们将投票反对这两项倡议，从而使少数派政府依赖于加泰罗尼亚和巴斯克地区较小民族主义政党的支持。

paras.en: However, by the eve of the parliamentary session, the centre-right, pro-independence Together for Catalonia (JxCat) had signalled its opposition to both laws, condemning them to failure.
paras.zh: 然而，在议会会议前夕，支持加泰罗尼亚独立的中右翼组织（JxCat）表示反对这两项法律，并谴责它们失败。

paras.en: SÃ¡nchez's ruling coalition hurriedly drew up the decree laws in an effort to defuse the housing protests that were sparked when 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal was evicted in September.
paras.zh: 桑切斯的执政联盟匆忙制定了法令，以平息因 87 岁的马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔 (Marcarmen Abascal) 9 月被驱逐而引发的住房抗议活动。

paras.en: The social backlash led to the company that owns Abascal's flat, UrbagestiÃ³n, negotiating her return to the flat on a low rent. However, protests have continued.
paras.zh: 社会的强烈反对导致阿巴斯卡公寓的所有者 Urbagestión 与她进行谈判，以较低的租金让她重返公寓。然而，抗议活动仍在继续。

paras.en: The Bank of Spain estimates the country is short of 700,000 homes, based on the gap between demand and new construction.
paras.zh: 根据需求与新建房屋之间的差距，西班牙央行估计该国住房短缺 70 万套。

paras.en: House prices have risen by 12.2% in the past year, according to figures for the second quarter of 2026 from national statistics institute INE.
paras.zh: 根据国家统计局 INE 2026 年第二季度的数据，过去一年房价上涨了 12.2%。

paras.en: The shortage in rental housing means that costs rose by 8.5% in 2025, according to real estate firm Idealista, with Madrid alone seeing an increase of 9.7% in rents.
paras.zh: 根据房地产公司 Idealista 的数据，出租房短缺意味着 2025 年成本将上涨 8.5%，仅马德里的租金就上涨 9.7%。

paras.en: It said Barcelona and Madrid were Spain's most expensive cities to rent a home, at â¬23.80 per square metre and â¬22.70 per square metre respectively.
paras.zh: 报告称，巴塞罗那和马德里是西班牙房屋租金最昂贵的城市，分别为每平方米 23.80 英镑和每平方米 22.70 英镑。

articles.title: Debris found from plane that went missing off US coast

paras.en: US authorities have found debris from a medical transport aircraft that went missing with six people on board.
paras.zh: 美国当局发现了一架失踪的医疗运输机残骸，机上有六人。

paras.en: The Federal Aviation Administration told the BBC it had lost contact with the Gulfstream G-100 plane just after 01:00 local time (05:00 GMT) on Saturday, while it was travelling from Bermuda to Boston, Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局告诉 BBC，当地时间周六 01:00（格林尼治标准时间 05:00）刚过，这架湾流 G-100 飞机在从百慕大飞往马萨诸塞州波士顿的途中与该飞机失去了联系。

paras.en: The search for survivors continues off the coast of Nantucket, a Massachusetts island, the US Coast Guard said.
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队表示，在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特岛海岸继续搜寻幸存者。

paras.en: Authorities have notified the next of kin of those on the flight, four Canadian nationals and two Bermudian nationals.
paras.zh: 当局已通知机上人员的近亲，其中包括四名加拿大国民和两名百慕大国民。

paras.en: "Search crews located a debris field confirmed to be from the aircraft off the coast of Nantucket," the US Coast Guard said in an update on Saturday night. It added that ships, helicopters and planes were involved in searches that would through continue the night.
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队在周六晚上的最新消息中表示：“搜索人员在楠塔基特岛海岸发现了一片残骸场，确认是飞机残骸。”它补充说，船只、直升机和飞机都参与了搜查，搜查将持续到晚上。

paras.en: The plane departed from Bermuda's L.F. Wade International Airport at 23:40 local time, according to flight data from FlightAware, and was due to land at Boston's Logan International at 01:30 EDT (05:30 GMT).
paras.zh: 根据 FlightAware 的航班数据，这架飞机于当地时间 23:40 从百慕大 L.F. 韦德国际机场起飞，预计于美国东部时间 01:30（格林尼治标准时间 05:30）降落在波士顿洛根国际机场。

paras.en: According to the tail number released by the Coast Guard, the plane belonged to Latitude Air Ambulances, a company that provides international medical flights for patients returning home.
paras.zh: 根据海岸警卫队公布的尾号，这架飞机属于Latitude Air Ambulances公司，该公司为回国的患者提供国际医疗航班。

paras.en: Among those on board were two pilots and two medical staff, both Canadian, Clarence Togeretz, director of flight operations at Latitude, told CBC News.
paras.zh: Latitude 飞行运营总监克拉伦斯·托格雷茨 (Clarence Togeretz) 告诉 CBC 新闻，机上人员包括两名飞行员和两名医务人员，均为加拿大人。

paras.en: The crew flew to Bermuda to collect a patient and their relative, who are not Canadian, Togeretz said.
paras.zh: 托格雷茨说，机组人员飞往百慕大去接一名患者及其亲属，他们不是加拿大人。

paras.en: FlightAware's tracker shows the aircraft significantly dropped in altitude before its communications went dark, plummeting from around 7,300m (24,000ft) to 3,300m (11,000ft).
paras.zh: FlightAware 的跟踪器显示，在通信中断之前，飞机的高度大幅下降，从约 7,300m（24,000 英尺）骤降至 3,300m（11,000 英尺）。

paras.en: Radio transmissions shows trouble with communications between the air traffic controller and the pilot, the Boston Globe reported based on transmissions provided by LiveATC.net.
paras.zh: 据《波士顿环球报》根据 LiveATC.net 提供的传输信息报道，无线电传输显示空中交通管制员和飞行员之间的通信存在问题。

paras.en: "You're coming in blind? Is that what you said?," the air traffic controller asked. "Are you declaring an emergency, or no?"
paras.zh: “你盲目地进来？你是这么说的吗？”空中交通管制员问道。 “你是宣布紧急状态，还是不宣布紧急状态？”

paras.en: "You're coming in a little weak so I didn't hear what your response was, if you were declaring an emergency or not," the air traffic controller said, according to the Globe.
paras.zh: 据《环球报》报道，空中交通管制员说：“你来的时候有点虚弱，所以我没有听到你的反应，无论你是否宣布紧急情况。”

paras.en: The air traffic controller later confirmed the pilot had declared an emergency.
paras.zh: 空中交通管制员后来证实飞行员已宣布进入紧急状态。

paras.en: An area fire dispatcher asked emergency crews just after 01:00 EDT to prepare to meet a plane with an "electrical issue".
paras.zh: 美国东部时间 01:00 刚过，一名地区消防调度员要求紧急救援人员准备迎接一架出现“电气问题”的飞机。

paras.en: The dispatcher later said "the aircraft has lost radio and radar".
paras.zh: 调度员后来说“飞机失去了无线电和雷达”。

paras.en: The Coast Guard said it would provide an update on Sunday morning local time.
paras.zh: 海岸警卫队表示将在当地时间周日上午提供最新情况。

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says

paras.en: The co-pilot who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel attacked the pilot with a crash axe, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general has said.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国总检察长表示，试图控制一架飞往以色列的迪拜航空飞机的副驾驶用一把坠毁斧袭击了飞行员。

paras.en: The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv carrying more than 170 people plunged 17,000ft (5,200m) two and a half hours into its journey, before passengers managed to overpower the attacker and successfully take control of the plane.
paras.zh: 这架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班载有 170 多人，在飞行两个半小时后从 17,000 英尺（5,200m）的高度坠落，随后乘客们成功制服了袭击者并成功控制了飞机。

paras.en: Capt Smit Machchhar said he was lying on the floor injured when he realised the plane was sinking and he had to act, explaining: "I told myself to go for one last push to open the door from inside", which allowed the passengers in.
paras.zh: 斯密特·马赫恰尔机长表示，当他意识到飞机正在下沉时，他受伤地躺在地板上，他必须采取行动，并解释说：“我告诉自己要最后一推，从里面打开舱门”，这才让乘客进来。

paras.en: Two reserve pilots then landed the plane safely in Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 随后，两名预备飞行员将飞机安全降落在沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: A crash axe is usually kept âin the cockpit in case of emergencies.
paras.zh: 驾驶舱内通常会放置一把防撞斧，以备紧急情况使用。

paras.en: The weapon used has been a key question for investigators, given the stringent security on such a sensitive route. Early reports from passengers on board had suggested it might have been a knife.
paras.zh: 鉴于如此敏感的路线上有严格的安全措施，所使用的武器一直是调查人员的一个关键问题。机上乘客的早期报告表明这可能是一把刀。

paras.en: The UAE attorney general told state media that investigations were ongoing to determine the full circumstances and motives of the incident.
paras.zh: 阿联酋总检察长告诉官方媒体，调查正在进行中，以确定事件的全部情况和动机。

paras.en: The co-pilot who launched the attack was an Omani national, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡称，发动袭击的副驾驶是一名阿曼国民。

paras.en: Multiple media outlets including Reuters, CNN and The New York Times have named him as Hamam al-Hammami. There has been no official confirmation of this.
paras.zh: 路透社、美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）和《纽约时报》等多家媒体将他命名为哈马姆·哈马米（Hamam al-Hammami）。此事尚未得到官方证实。

paras.en: While working at another airline, Oman Air, US media reported that Al-Hammami was removed from flight training because of concerns over his radical views, and was given another role at Oman's national airline.
paras.zh: 美国媒体报道称，哈马米在另一家航空公司阿曼航空公司工作期间，因担心其激进观点而被取消飞行训练，并在阿曼国家航空公司担任另一个职务。

paras.en: Australian authorities confirmed on Sunday they were investigating his "links" to the country, but did not provide any details.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚当局周日证实，他们正在调查他与该国的“联系”，但没有提供任何细节。

paras.en: The Australian Broadcasting Corporation, citing sources, reported he was issued a student visa in 2014 and studied in Australia between 2015 and 2017 before leaving the country.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司援引消息人士的话说，他于 2014 年获得学生签证，并于 2015 年至 2017 年在澳大利亚学习，然后离开该国。

paras.en: The ABC said his student visa was cancelled in 2019 as he was not enrolled in a course at that time.
paras.zh: ABC 表示，他的学生签证于 2019 年被取消，因为当时他没有注册课程。

paras.en: Counter-terrorism officials will look at whether the man was radicalised in Australia, the ABC reported.
paras.zh: 据美国广播公司报道，反恐官员将调查该男子在澳大利亚是否激进。

paras.en: He then completed a three-year distance-learning course run by Buckinghamshire New University in the UK and graduated with a degree in aviation management in 2023, the university said. It added he did not take any pilot training at the school.
paras.zh: 该大学表示，他随后完成了英国白金汉郡新大学开设的为期三年的远程学习课程，并于 2023 年毕业，获得了航空管理学位。它还补充说，他没有在学校接受任何飞行员培训。

paras.en: Speaking to Fox News, Netanyahu said that after the attacker was subdued on the flight, he called out to the crew "Kill me, kill me!"
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，袭击者在飞机上被制服后，他​​向机组人员喊道“杀了我，杀了我！”

paras.en: The Israeli prime minister added: "So, it's clear that he was suicidalâ¦ It looks very likely that he was going to down the plane."
paras.zh: 以色列总理补充道：“所以，很明显他有自杀倾向……看起来他很可能会击落飞机。”

paras.en: He also said the attacker "underwent Islamist radical indoctrination".
paras.zh: 他还表示，袭击者“受到了伊斯兰激进主义的洗脑”。

paras.en: The UAE's attorney general, Hamad Saif Al Shamsi, said investigations into the incident revealed that the co-pilot attempted to carry out a "terrorist act", according to the country's state news agency.
paras.zh: 据阿联酋国家通讯社报道，阿联酋总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西表示，对该事件的调查显示，副驾驶试图实施“恐怖行为”。

paras.en: He also said investigations were under way to establish the circumstances, motives and any links related to the incident.
paras.zh: 他还表示，正在进行调查以确定事件的情况、动机以及与事件相关的任何联系。

paras.en: Machchhar, who was stabbed in the attack, was taken to a nearby hospital before being airlifted to Abu Dhabi, where he is reported to be in a stable condition.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔在袭击中被刺伤，他被送往附近的一家医院，然后被空运到阿布扎比，据报道他的情况稳定。

paras.en: The pilot, who is from India, was in "good health and recovering well", the Indian embassy in the UAE said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 印度驻阿联酋大使馆周四表示，这名来自印度的飞行员“健康状况良好，康复情况良好”。

paras.en: "I am confident that the recovery will be there and I will become fit and healthy again," Machchhar said.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说：“我相信我会康复，我会再次变得健康。”

paras.en: About two and half hours after the plane took off from Dubai International Airport it begun to plunge sharply.
paras.zh: 飞机从迪拜国际机场起飞后约两个半小时，开始急剧下降。

paras.en: The plane signalled a "general emergency" code, squawk 7700, before switching to squawk 7500, a code reporting "unlawful interference", or hijacking.
paras.zh: 飞机发出“一般紧急情况”代码“squak 7700”，然后切换到“squak 7500”，该代码报告“非法干扰”或劫持。

paras.en: In an interview with the BBC, one passenger described the moment he realised that something was wrong.
paras.zh: 在接受 BBC 采访时，一名乘客描述了他意识到出问题的那一刻。

paras.en: Almog Itali said: "Suddenly the aeroplane started to, like a rollercoaster, to drop down [with] a massive G-force. It was falling down for 20 or 30 seconds, rapidly, and then balanced, and then started once again to fall down."
paras.zh: 阿尔莫格·伊塔利说：“突然间，飞机像过山车一样，在巨大的重力作用下开始坠落。飞机快速坠落了 20 或 30 秒，然后平衡，然后再次开始坠落。”

paras.en: People then began to rush to the cockpit, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，然后人们开始冲向驾驶舱。

paras.en: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said on Thursday that the alarm was raised onboard by an Israeli woman, Tali Manes, who heard a commotion coming from the cockpit.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格周四表示，机上一名以色列妇女塔利·马内斯（Tali Manes）听到驾驶舱内传来骚动声后发出了警报。

paras.en: Her husband, Zvika, along with three other men - Yaniv Hayun, Dr Shota Musayev and Asaf Rajuan - entered the cockpit after Capt Machchhar managed to open the door despite his injuries.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔上尉尽管受伤，仍设法打开舱门，她的丈夫兹维卡和另外三名男子——亚尼夫·哈云、肖塔·穆萨耶夫博士和阿萨夫·拉胡安——进入了驾驶舱。

paras.en: Hayun said, in a video released by the prime minister's office, that the attacker was "trying to destroy the instruments in order to disable the plane".
paras.zh: 哈云在总理办公室发布的一段视频中表示，袭击者“试图摧毁仪器以使飞机瘫痪”。

paras.en: Hayun then described putting the attacker in a chokehold and pulling him outside the cockpit before other passengers helped to pin him down.
paras.zh: 海云随后描述了他掐住袭击者的脖子并将他拉到驾驶舱外，然后其他乘客帮助将他压住。

paras.en: He added that he "pulled the controls" of the plane. "The plane started to level out, a bit more, and then [another] pilot told me he was taking control from there," he said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他“拉动了飞机的控制装置”。 “飞机开始趋于平稳，然后（另一位）飞行员告诉我他正在从那里控制飞机，”他说。

paras.en: In an interview with CNN on Wednesday evening, Netanyahu said the stabbed pilot, passengers and second crew had "managed to prevent a 9/11 disaster".
paras.zh: 周三晚间，内塔尼亚胡在接受 CNN 采访时表示，被刺伤的飞行员、乘客和第二机组人员“成功阻止了 9/11 灾难”。

articles.title: Drake Responds to Karol G Starring as Bruno Mars’ ‘Juliet’ in Romantic ‘Dance With Me’ Video: ‘This Guy Works Fast’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: There’s some sort of public love triangle brewing between Drake, Karol G and Bruno Mars. It appears to be playful and not anything serious, as the trio are fans of one another, but fans are wondering: Could this all be leading up to a seismic blockbuster collaboration?
paras.zh: Drake、Karol G 和 Bruno Mars 之间正在酝酿某种公开的三角恋。这看起来很有趣，并不严肃，因为三人都是彼此的粉丝，但粉丝们想知道：这一切是否会导致一场轰动一时的合作？

paras.en: Earlier this week, Bruno cast Karol G to play his love interest in the romantic “Dance With Me” music video, which saw the 6 God pop up with a response on Instagram.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，布鲁诺选择卡罗尔·G 在浪漫的《与我共舞》音乐视频中扮演他的爱人，该视频在 Instagram 上引起了热烈反响。

paras.en: “Holy this guy works fast,” he quipped Thursday. The comment has amassed more than 34,000 likes, while Bruno’s post itself has north of a million.
paras.zh: “天哪，这家伙工作得真快，”他周四打趣道。该评论已获得超过 34,000 个点赞，而布鲁诺的帖子本身也有超过 100 万个点赞。

paras.en: This all heated up pretty quickly this week. Drake made a guest appearance at Karol G’s Houston show on Sunday, which saw him passionately dancing with the Colombian superstar as he performed his 2016 Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hit “One Dance.”
paras.zh: 本周这一切都迅速升温。周日，Drake 客串 Karol G 的休斯敦演出，与这位哥伦比亚巨星一起热情地跳舞，表演了 2016 年 Billboard Hot 100 排名第一的单曲《One Dance》。

paras.en: They also teamed up for the live debut of their “Ahí” collaboration, which reached No. 44 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the Hot Latin Songs chart in August.
paras.zh: 他们还合作首次现场演唱了《Ahí》，该歌曲在 Billboard Hot 100 中排名第 44，并在 8 月份登上了热门拉丁歌曲排行榜的榜首。

paras.en: Bruno was left a little jealous after seeing what transpired at Reliant Stadium. The Grammy-winning artist posted a photo from his private jet looking out into the clouds, vowing to make a play to one-up Drizzy and win Karol G back.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺在看到信实体育场发生的事情后感到有点嫉妒。这位格莱美奖得主发布了一张从他的私人飞机上眺望云层的照片，并发誓要与 Drizy 上演一场单挑比赛，赢回 Karol G 的心。

paras.en: That happened to be the steamy “Dance With Me” video, which Bruno knew he had up his sleeve and ready to launch on Thursday. He gushed about Karol G in his heartfelt caption, championing her work ethic and called her the “Juliet” to his Romeo.
paras.zh: 这恰好是热辣的“与我共舞”视频，布鲁诺知道他已经做好了准备，准备在周四推出。他在真诚的标题中滔滔不绝地谈论了 Karol G，拥护她的职业道德，并称她为罗密欧中的“朱丽叶”。

paras.en: “Watching you work has been so inspiring. For those that don’t know this beautiful woman works so hard and loves her fans so much. She calls me and tells me how blessed we both are and reminds me to never forget that,” Bruno wrote on IG. “I’m honored to say we made music together, performed together and now starred in a high drama telenovela together. The world needs your light and your voice Carolina. Thank you for being my Juliet in this music video.”
paras.zh: “看着你工作真是太鼓舞人心了。对于那些不知道这位美丽的女人工作如此努力、如此热爱她的粉丝的人来说。她打电话给我，告诉我我们俩是多么幸福，并提醒我永远不要忘记这一点，”布鲁诺在 IG 上写道。 “我很荣幸地说，我们一起创作音乐，一起表演，现在一起主演了一部精彩的电视剧。世界需要你的光芒和你的声音卡罗莱纳。感谢你在这段音乐视频中成为我的朱丽叶。”

paras.en: There could be something in the works, or perhaps this was all a marketing ploy leading up to the “Dance With Me” visual and Drake just played along. A collaboration would be a first from the trio, and boast some of the most potent star power a song has seen, while taking artists from different genres.
paras.zh: 作品中可能有一些东西，或者这可能只是“与我共舞”视觉效果的营销策略，而德雷克只是配合而已。此次合作将是三人组的首次合作，并拥有歌曲中最强大的明星力量，同时吸引了来自不同流派的艺术家。

paras.en: Like Drake, Bruno Mars also appeared on Karol G’s No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto album in August, as the duo tangled on “Still,” which peaked at No. 41 on the Hot 100. Bruno hit the stage at Karol G’s Aug. 15 show in L.A. at SoFi Stadium, where they performed the live debut of “Still” as well as his The Romatic opener “Risk It All.”
paras.zh: 和 Drake 一样，Bruno Mars 也在 8 月份出现在 Karol G 的 No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto 专辑中，两人在单曲《Still》中纠缠不清，该歌曲在 Hot 100 中最高排名第 41 名。Bruno Mars 于 8 月 15 日在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场举行的 Karol G 演出中登上舞台，在那里他们表演了现场首秀《Still》以及他的 The Romatic 开场曲《Risk It All》。

articles.title: Ye’s Two Russian Stadium Concerts Canceled, Promoters Announce: ‘Sincere Regret’
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: After months of back-and-forth, two planned stadium gigs by Ye at Gazprom Arena in St. Petersburg, Russia have reportedly been canceled. Ye (formerly Kanye West) was slated to perform on Oct. 10 and 11 at the venue, though the reportedly sold-out shows were in question from the time they were announced.
paras.zh: 据报道，经过几个月的反复，叶原计划在俄罗斯圣彼得堡俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司体育场举行的两场体育场演出已被取消。叶（原坎耶·韦斯特）原定于 10 月 10 日至 11 日在该场地演出，但据报道，演出门票自宣布之日起就受到质疑。

paras.en: On Aug. 24, the venue posted on social media that the 80,000-capacity stadium “did not sign any contracts for the stadium rent for the event.” The post adamantly stated that there was “no such agreement” for the shows and that they would not take place at the venue. That came despite the venue hyping the shows on Instagram just a week earlier.
paras.zh: 8月24日，场馆在社交媒体上发文称，这座可容纳8万人的体育场“没有签署任何赛事场馆租金合同”。该帖子坚决表示，演出“没有这样的协议”，并且演出不会在该场地举行。尽管场地一周前还在 Instagram 上大肆宣传演出，但还是出现了这种情况。

paras.en: “Kanye West is at Gazprom Arena! Whaaat??? The legendary artist will be coming to Russia for the first time, performing a world-shaking show at the blue-white-and-blue stadium,” read the post earlier post. “This is no joke! Kanye West, the most influential music artist of our time, will perform two exclusive concerts at Gazprom Arena in St. Petersburg on October 10th and 11th as part of his record-breaking world tour.”
paras.zh: “坎耶·韦斯特来到了俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司体育场！哇？？？这位传奇艺术家将首次来到俄罗斯，在蓝白蓝体育场上演震撼世界的表演，”早些时候的帖子中写道。 “这不是开玩笑！坎耶·韦斯特，我们这个时代最有影响力的音乐艺术家，将于 10 月 10 日和 11 日在圣彼得堡的俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司竞技场举办两场独家音乐会，作为他破纪录的世界巡演的一部分。”

paras.en: According to a Reuters report, the Moscow-based promoter Say Agency expressed its “sincere regret” about the cancellation in a message on Telegram, adding, “The Ye concerts in St Petersburg will not be able to take place on the scheduled dates.”
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，总部位于莫斯科的主办方 Say Agency 在 Telegram 上对取消表示“诚挚的遗憾”，并补充道，“叶在圣彼得堡的演唱会将无法如期举行。”

paras.en: At press time, spokespeople for promoter Say Agency and touring agency Access Opera had not returned Billboard‘s request for confirmation on the cancellation of the concerts.
paras.zh: 截至发稿时，主办方 Say Agency 和巡演机构 Access Opera 的发言人尚未回复 Billboard 确认取消演唱会的请求。

paras.en: If the shows had gone on as planned, Ye would have been the first Western rap star to perform in Russia amid a global cultural boycott enacted in response to the launch in 2022 of Russian dictator Vladimir Putin’s war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 如果演出按计划进行，叶将成为第一位在俄罗斯演出的西方说唱明星，当时俄罗斯独裁者弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 2022 年对乌克兰发动战争，引发了全球文化抵制。

paras.en: Newsweek, citing Russian media reports, said that the decision to pull the plug on the Ye shows was made by Russian authorities, with the Kommersant newspaper reportedly saying that the organizers of the gigs were being investigated for fraud. It also said that local media reported that government officials had not approved the shows and that some politicians had expressed outrage at Ye’s past embrace of Nazi symbols and support for Adolf Hitler, which is a criminal offense in the country.
paras.zh: 《新闻周刊》援引俄罗斯媒体的报道称，俄罗斯当局决定取消叶秀的演出，据报道，《生意人报》称演出的组织者正在接受欺诈调查。报道还称，当地媒体报道说，政府官员并未批准这些演出，一些政界人士对叶过去拥抱纳粹标志和支持阿道夫·希特勒表示愤慨，这在该国是一种刑事犯罪。

paras.en: West has not said much this year as he’s mounted his ambitious stadium show across the world, playing gigs in Turkey, the Netherlands, Georgia, Albania, Portugal, Spain and Kazakhstan this year, as well as U.S. shows in Los Angeles, Tampa Bay, San Antonio, New Orleans and Chicago. Despite playing to huge crowds, West is still dealing with the backlash from years of antisemitic remarks and an embrace of Nazi symbolism and rhetoric which began in 2022 and led to the meltdown of the rapper’s once-formidable music, fashion and design portfolio.
paras.zh: 韦斯特今年没有多说什么，因为他在世界各地举办了雄心勃勃的体育场演出，今年在土耳其、荷兰、格鲁吉亚、阿尔巴尼亚、葡萄牙、西班牙和哈萨克斯坦进行演出，并在美国洛杉矶、坦帕湾、圣安东尼奥、新奥尔良和芝加哥进行演出。尽管在众多观众面前演出，韦斯特仍在应对多年来的反犹太言论以及自 2022 年开始接受纳粹象征主义和言论所带来的强烈抵制，这些言论导致了这位说唱歌手曾经令人敬畏的音乐、时尚和设计组合的崩溃。

paras.en: As part of the lingering unease with booking Ye, this year he’s had concerts in France, Poland and the Czech Republic canceled, as well as a headlining set at London’s Wireless Festival; dates in Italy and India were also waved off citing “security concerns.”
paras.zh: 由于对叶的预订感到挥之不去的不安，今年他取消了在法国、波兰和捷克共和国的音乐会，以及在伦敦无线音乐节上的头条新闻；意大利和印度的日期也因“安全问题”而被取消。

articles.title: Zach Bryan Wears ‘Free Palestine’ Shirt at Robert Kraft’s Gillette Stadium
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Grammy winner Zach Bryan took a pointed fashion stance at Gillette Stadium on Friday night (Oct. 2), wearing a black T-shirt reading “Free Palestine” during the first of two dates on his With Heaven On Tour at the Foxborough, Mass., venue.
paras.zh: 周五晚上（10 月 2 日），格莱美奖得主扎克·布莱恩 (Zach Bryan) 在吉列体育场 (Gillette Stadium) 采取了尖锐的时尚立场，在马萨诸塞州福克斯伯勒 (Foxborough) 场地举行的“With Heaven On”巡演的两次约会中的第一次约会中，他穿着一件写着“自由巴勒斯坦”的黑色 T 恤。

paras.en: Members of Bryan’s band were also spotted in matching shirts, according to TMZ, with fan footage of the moment quickly circulating on social media. Bryan did not appear to address the shirt from the stage.
paras.zh: 据 TMZ 报道，布莱恩乐队的成员也被发现穿着相配的衬衫，这一时刻的粉丝视频在社交媒体上迅速流传。布莱恩似乎没有在台上对这件衬衫发表讲话。

paras.en: The choice of wardrobe — and venue — is hard to read as a coincidence. Gillette Stadium is owned by the Kraft Group, led by New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft, who weeks earlier played a central role in removing Macklemore from the remaining U.S. dates of Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour over the rapper’s pro-Palestinian statements onstage.
paras.zh: 服装和场地的选择很难被视为巧合。吉列体育场归卡夫集团所有，该集团由新英格兰爱国者队老板罗伯特·卡夫领导。几周前，由于说唱歌手在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论，他在将麦克勒莫从艾德·希兰循环巡回演唱会的剩余美国日期中除名的过程中发挥了核心作用。

paras.en: During his opening sets at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, N.J., on Sept. 4 and 5, Macklemore declared “Free Palestine” to the crowd and performed his 2024 protest song “Hind’s Hall.” On the second night, he also spoke directly to Jewish fans in attendance, saying his criticism of the Israeli government was not directed at them.
paras.zh: 9 月 4 日至 5 日，在新泽西州东卢瑟福大都会人寿体育场举行的开场演出中，麦克莫尔向观众宣布“自由巴勒斯坦”，并演唱了他的 2024 年抗议歌曲“Hind’s Hall”。第二天晚上，他还直接对出席的犹太球迷发表讲话，称他对以色列政府的批评并不是针对他们的。

paras.en: The Israeli-American Council launched a petition calling for his removal, and on Sept. 14 tour promoter Messina Touring Group confirmed Macklemore would no longer appear on the remaining U.S. dates after multiple NFL stadium owners reportedly threatened to pull shows if he stayed on the bill.
paras.zh: 以色列-美国委员会发起了一份请愿书，要求将他免职。9月14日，巡演发起人Messina Touring Group证实，麦克勒莫将不再出现在剩余的美国演出中，据报道，多个NFL体育场老板威胁说，如果他继续留在名单上，他们将取消演出。

paras.en: Kraft confirmed his involvement in a statement that same day, saying he felt a responsibility to speak up when he believed a line had been crossed on antisemitism, while acknowledging that Palestinian suffering is real.
paras.zh: 克拉夫特当天在一份声明中证实了他的参与，称当他认为反犹太主义已经越过底线时，他感到有责任大声疾呼，同时承认巴勒斯坦人的苦难是真实的。

paras.en: Sheeran said in his own statement the following day that the removal was the promoter’s decision, not his, and that he had spoken directly with Kraft while trying to find a resolution.
paras.zh: 希兰在第二天的声明中表示，撤职是发起人的决定，而不是他的决定，他在试图找到解决方案时已直接与卡夫进行了交谈。

paras.en: The fallout was swift. Fellow openers Finneas, Aaron Rowe and Lukas Graham exited the tour in solidarity, as did Irish folk band Beoga, who had been performing with Sheeran, while Macklemore responded with a lengthy Instagram post detailing the money, brand deals, festivals and private shows he says his advocacy has cost him.
paras.zh: 后果很快。开场嘉宾芬尼斯 (Finneas)、亚伦·罗 (Aaron Rowe) 和卢卡斯·格雷厄姆 (Lukas Graham) 声援退出巡演，与希兰一起演出的爱尔兰民谣乐队 Beoga 也退出了巡演，而麦克勒莫尔则在 Instagram 上发了一篇长文作为回应，详细说明了他的宣传所带来的金钱、品牌交易、节日和私人演出。

paras.en: He later pledged $1 million from his touring earnings to Palestinian aid organizations and announced a Free Palestine Tour — a short European run hitting Dublin, Paris and London from Oct. 26 to 30 — which he has since said sold out immediately.
paras.zh: 后来他承诺从自己的巡演收入中拿出 100 万美元捐给巴勒斯坦援助组织，并宣布举办“自由巴勒斯坦之旅”——10 月 26 日至 30 日前往都柏林、巴黎和伦敦进行欧洲短途巡演——此后他表示巡演门票立即售空。

paras.en: Sheeran never made it to Foxborough in the end: his two Gillette Stadium dates last weekend were scrapped due to severe weather conditions — despite the tour having bowed to the venue owners’ demands.
paras.zh: 希兰最终未能到达福克斯伯勒：他上周末的两次吉列体育场演出由于恶劣的天气条件而被取消——尽管巡演屈服于场地所有者的要求。

paras.en: Bryan has rarely shied away from friction with powerful figures. In October 2025, a teaser of his song “Bad News” — which references ICE raids — drew public criticism from the Department of Homeland Security and the White House, with Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem saying at the time that she was disappointed by the clip. Bryan pushed back at the time, arguing that the song spoke to both sides of the aisle and urging fans not to let social media narratives divide them. The track ultimately appeared on his album With Heaven on Top, released Jan. 9, 2026.
paras.zh: 布莱恩很少回避与有权势人物的摩擦。 2025 年 10 月，他的歌曲《Bad News》的预告片（其中提到了 ICE 的突袭行动）引起了国土安全部和白宫的公开批评，国土安全部部长克里斯蒂·诺姆当时表示，她对这段视频感到失望。布莱恩当时反驳道，他认为这首歌代表了两党观点，并敦促歌迷不要让社交媒体的叙述分裂他们。这首歌最终出现在他于 2026 年 1 月 9 日发行的专辑《With Heaven on Top》中。

paras.en: Bryan is scheduled to return to Gillette Stadium for the second night of his Foxborough stand on Saturday (Oct. 3) — and all eyes will be on whether the shirt makes a repeat appearance, and whether Kraft, who has yet to publicly respond, takes any action. Representatives for Kraft did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 布莱恩计划于周六（10 月 3 日）返回吉列体育场，参加他在福克斯伯勒站的第二个晚上，所有的目光都集中在这件球衣是否会再次出现，以及尚未公开回应的卡夫是否会采取任何行动。卡夫的代表没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: ‘Behemoth!’ Review: Pedro Pascal Hints at Soulful Depths, but the Drama Keeps Stalling in Tony Gilroy’s Wan Character Study of a Virtuoso Cellist
articles.author: David Rooney

paras.en: Tony Gilroy returns to features after 14 years’ absence — the last three of them spent in the Star Wars TV trenches as creator, showrunner and head writer on Andor — with a movie that makes itself hard to love. Hampered by a fussy hopscotching time structure that too often halts the dramatic momentum and by a central character whose passivity fights against the warmth and magnetism of Pedro Pascal in the role, Behemoth! is an odd duck, alternately intriguing and frustrating. What it does have going for it is a series of thrilling sequences observing the workings of an orchestra employed on Hollywood’s scoring stages.
paras.zh: 托尼·吉尔罗伊 (Tony Gilroy) 阔别 14 年之后重返荧幕——他们最后三年都在《星球大战》电视战壕中担任《安多》的创作者、剧集主管和首席编剧——带来了一部让人难以喜爱的电影。繁琐的跳房子时间结构常常阻碍戏剧性的势头，而且中心人物的消极性与佩德罗·帕斯卡在角色“巨兽”中的温暖和魅力相抗衡！是一只奇怪的鸭子，时而令人着迷，时而令人沮丧。它的真正优点是一系列令人兴奋的序列，观察好莱坞配乐舞台上使用的管弦乐队的运作。

paras.en: That rarely glimpsed milieu and a virtuoso cellist protagonist might make Gilroy’s film sound like Maestro meets Tár. But the story’s internal engine seldom revs hard enough to stand up to either of those comparisons, despite its capable ensemble cast and polished craftsmanship.
paras.zh: 这种罕见的环境和一位演奏家大提琴家的主角可能会让吉尔罗伊的电影听起来就像大师遇见塔尔。但尽管故事的演员阵容强大，制作工艺精湛，但故事的内在引擎很少能经得起这两种比较。

paras.en: Cast: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Alexa Swinton, Kaya Ralls, Erik Griffin, JoBeth Williams, Margarita Levieva, Hank Azaria, Will Arnett
paras.zh: 主演: 佩德罗·帕斯卡 / 奥利维亚·王尔德 / 伊娃·维克多 / 亚历克萨·斯文顿 / 卡亚·拉尔斯 / 埃里克·格里芬 / 乔贝斯·威廉姆斯 / 玛格丽塔·莱维耶娃 / 汉克·阿扎利亚 / 威尔·阿奈特

paras.en: One issue is that the script by Gilroy (an Oscar nominee for screenwriting and direction on Michael Clayton) gives insufficient dimension to Pascal’s character, Alex Serian, for someone meant to carry a film. He’s a sideliner in his own life, which may well be the result of living in the shadow of a family of narcissists, but that is not enough to make him interesting. Nor does it help that Alex’s failed relationships seem less a symptom of his own damage than his poor choice of partners.
paras.zh: 一个问题是，吉尔罗伊（因《迈克尔·克莱顿》的编剧和导演而获得奥斯卡提名）的剧本对于帕斯卡饰演的亚历克斯·塞里安的角色来说，没有给他足够的维度来承载一部电影。他在自己的生活中是一个旁观者，这很可能是生活在一个自恋者家庭的阴影下的结果，但这还不足以让他变得有趣。亚历克斯失败的人际关系与其说是他自己受到伤害的症状，不如说是他对伴侣选择不当的结果，这也无济于事。

paras.en: The women characters generally are not drawn kindly, especially Carol Spedding (Olivia Wilde), a wealthy, married arts patron whose ferocious pursuit of Alex when he ends their affair makes her seem like a soul sister to Glenn Close in Fatal Attraction. Maybe Carol’s $6 million gift to the Chicago Symphony during Alex’s tenure there enables her to feel some kind of ownership, though that’s more implied than explored. “I bleed for you and you shun me?” screeches the manic drama queen after he blocks her calls.
paras.zh: 女性角色通常都不会被描绘得友善，尤其是卡罗尔·斯佩丁（奥利维亚·王尔德饰），她是一位富有的已婚艺术赞助人，当亚历克斯结束了他们的婚外情后，她对亚历克斯进行了猛烈的追求，这让她看起来就像《致命诱惑》中格伦·克洛斯的灵魂姐妹。也许卡罗尔在亚历克斯任职期间向芝加哥交响乐团捐赠了 600 万美元的礼物，让她感受到了某种所有权，尽管这更多的是隐含的，而不是探索出来的。 “我为你流血，你却躲避我？”狂躁的戏剧女王在他阻止她的电话后尖叫道。

paras.en: Alex’s flight from scary Carol lands him back in his hometown, Los Angeles, after 20 years of playing in other cities, looking to get back into session work recording orchestral film scores. It’s in those scenes on studio lots — including the Barbra Streisand Scoring Studio at Sony — that the movie is most dynamic.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯逃离可怕的卡罗尔后，回到了家乡洛杉矶，在其他城市演奏了 20 年之后，他希望重新开始录制管弦乐电影配乐。正是在制片厂的那些场景中——包括索尼的芭芭拉·史翠珊配乐工作室——这部电影才最具活力。

paras.en: That’s in large part due to the staggering range of ravishing original film music we see being performed — from dark drama to suspense to action to soaring romance — written by an assembly of nine respected composers billed as “The Behemoth! Collective.” They include Michael Abels, Emily Bear, Lukas Frank, Michael Giacchino, James Newton Howard, Henry Jackman, Nami Melumad, Brandan Roberts and Alan Silvestri. Much of their work also plays over scenes elsewhere in the movie, including an art rock song, a requiem, a cartoon theme tune, a harp concerto and cello etudes.
paras.zh: 这在很大程度上是由于我们看到正在表演的令人惊叹的原创电影音乐——从黑暗戏剧到悬疑，从动作到飙升的浪漫——由九位受人尊敬的作曲家组成的一个被称为“巨兽！集体”的组合创作。他们包括迈克尔·阿贝尔、艾米丽·贝尔、卢卡斯·弗兰克、迈克尔·吉亚基诺、詹姆斯·牛顿·霍华德、亨利·杰克曼、纳米·梅鲁玛德、布兰登·罗伯茨和艾伦·西尔维斯特里。他们的大部分作品也出现在电影的其他场景中，包括一首艺术摇滚歌曲、一首安魂曲、一首卡通主题曲、一首竖琴协奏曲和大提琴练习曲。

paras.en: For anyone who loves movies, being prompted to think about the experiential role that a great score plays is fascinating, but while Behemoth! feints toward being a celebration of film music, it never fully commits. It seems a missed opportunity that we don’t get to watch music being matched to specific beats on the screen, beyond background shots of fuzzy footage on a monitor.
paras.zh: 对于任何热爱电影的人来说，被提示去思考伟大的配乐所扮演的体验角色是令人着迷的，但虽然《巨兽！》假装是对电影音乐的庆祝，但它从未完全承诺。除了显示器上模糊镜头的背景镜头之外，我们无法在屏幕上观看与特定节拍相匹配的音乐，这似乎是一个错失的机会。

paras.en: Alex’s relationship with his parents was defined by their need to outshine their children. We see video of Alex playing Bach at age 6 on Johnny Carson’s show, but the film seems to suggest their nurturing of their sons’ musical gifts was just another way to burnish their own reputations.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯与父母的关系是因为他们需要超越自己的孩子。我们在约翰尼·卡森的节目中看到亚历克斯六岁时演奏巴赫的视频，但这部电影似乎表明他们培养儿子的音乐天赋只是另一种提升自己声誉的方式。

paras.en: His self-absorbed brother Andy (Will Arnett, who’s in a different movie) became something of a black sheep when he turned his back on classical viola to form a briefly successful rock band in the ‘90s. He now hosts a podcast about the TV and movie themes of their late father Peter (Hank Azaria, in a video cameo). Their mother Ginnie (an unrecognizable JoBeth Williams) was a renowned harpist, fading fast with dementia when Alex stays with her upon first returning to L.A. She once said of her husband, “He was a Peter who really wanted to be a Pierre.”
paras.zh: 他自私的弟弟安迪（威尔·阿奈特，在另一部电影中饰演）在上世纪 90 年代放弃古典中提琴组建了一支短暂成功的摇滚乐队后，成了害群之马。他现在主持一个关于已故父亲彼得（汉克·阿扎利亚，视频客串）的电视和电影主题的播客。他们的母亲吉妮（乔贝斯·威廉姆斯饰）是一位著名的竖琴手，当亚历克斯第一次回到洛杉矶和她在一起时，她的痴呆症很快就消失了。她曾经这样评价她的丈夫：“他是一个真正想成为皮埃尔的彼得。”

paras.en: But those glimmers of insight fail to coalesce into a fleshed-out family mythology — though we do learn that Alex and Andy’s grandfather died from a stroke, immedicately after hitting a high C while playing trumpet on the same MGM stage where Alex now works. There’s simply not enough meat on the bones of the parental background or in Alex and Andy’s conversations about them to give much shape to the supposedly chaotic upbringing that formed them.
paras.zh: 但这些洞察力的曙光未能融合成一个充实的家庭神话——尽管我们确实了解到亚历克斯和安迪的祖父在亚历克斯现在工作的米高梅舞台上吹小号时演奏高音C后立即死于中风。父母背景或亚历克斯和安迪关于他们的谈话中根本没有足够的肉来塑造他们所谓的混乱的成长经历。

paras.en: The movie is more engaged in Alex’s reflections on his own life in the two decades since he left, jumping between fizzled relationships and elite orchestra positions in Boston, Dallas and Chicago. The one woman he appears to have loved is brilliant violinist Nadia (Eva Victor), who bailed to marry a billionaire businessman (Matthew Lillard). Victor (Sorry, Baby) is a vivid screen presence, but Nadia isn’t around long enough to leave much of an impression before Alex’s memories jump to her funeral six years later.
paras.zh: 这部电影更多地讲述了亚历克斯对自己离开后二十年生活的反思，在失败的人际关系和波士顿、达拉斯和芝加哥的精英乐团职位之间跳跃。他似乎爱过的唯一一个女人是才华横溢的小提琴家纳迪亚（伊娃·维克多饰），她放弃嫁给了一位亿万富翁商人（马修·里沃德饰）。维克多（对不起，宝贝）是一个生动的银幕形象，但娜迪亚出现的时间不够长，无法给人留下太多印象，六年后亚历克斯的记忆跳到了她的葬礼上。

paras.en: It’s on that solemn occasion that he first sees Nadia’s prodigiously gifted daughter Viviana when she plays an original piano composition of astonishing maturity. That piques Alex’s curiosity about the possibility that he might be the girl’s father; his paternity sleuthing gives the movie a much-needed kick.
paras.zh: 正是在那个庄严的场合，他第一次见到了纳迪亚（Nadia）才华横溢的女儿维维安娜（Viviana），当时她演奏了一首成熟得惊人的原创钢琴曲。这激起了亚历克斯的好奇心，他想知道他可能是女孩的父亲。他的亲子调查给这部电影带来了急需的动力。

paras.en: While Alex’s romantic past is too thinly outlined to be compelling, Pascal’s internalized performance becomes more affecting once the character’s paternal instincts emerge. This happens first with Bronte (Kaya Ralls), a bright young cellist he coaches for an audition with the prestigious San Francisco Symphony. (Professional musician Ralls is a natural in her first acting role.)
paras.zh: 虽然亚历克斯的浪漫过去被勾勒得太薄弱而无法引人注目，但一旦角色的父亲本能显现出来，帕斯卡的内在表演就会变得更具影响力。这首先发生在勃朗特（卡亚·拉尔斯饰演）身上，他是一位聪明的年轻大提琴家，他指导他参加著名的旧金山交响乐团的试镜。 （专业音乐家拉尔斯在她的第一个表演角色中很自然。）

paras.en: But it’s when he starts following Viviana’s success as a composer and musician across multiple genres that the film finally gains some emotional heft. An interlude during which their professional paths cross, when 15-year-old Viviana (Alexa Swinton, terrific) is hired to take over scoring duties on a major movie from a temperamental Euro-diva (Thomas Kretschmann, amusingly playing a male Lydia Tár), is lovely. But it comes too late in a movie that gives us few reasons to care about its opaque central character.
paras.zh: 但当他开始追随维维安娜作为跨多个流派的作曲家和音乐家的成功时，这部电影终于获得了一些情感分量。当 15 岁的维维安娜（亚历克斯·斯文顿饰）受聘从喜怒无常的欧洲女主角（托马斯·克莱舒曼饰，有趣地扮演男性莉迪亚·塔尔饰）接替一部大片的配乐职责时，他们职业道路上的一段插曲非常可爱。但对于一部让我们没有理由关心其不透明的中心人物的电影来说，它来得太晚了。

paras.en: Behemoth! is handsomely shot by Damián García, who previously worked with Gilroy on Andor, but in the end it’s satisfying only as a sensory experience in which music acquires physical form, an aspect greatly enhanced by the advanced sound technology of Dolby Atmos.
paras.zh: 巨兽！由达米安·加西亚 (Damián García) 拍摄，他曾与吉尔罗伊 (Gilroy) 在《安多》(Andor) 中合作过，但最终它只是作为一种感官体验而令人满意，在这种体验中，音乐获得了物理形式，而杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 的先进声音技术大大增强了这一方面。

paras.en: Production company: Searchlight Pictures
paras.zh: 制作公司：探照灯影业

paras.zh: 主演: 佩德罗·帕斯卡 / 奥利维亚·王尔德 / 伊娃·维克多 / 亚历克萨·斯文顿 / 卡亚·拉尔斯 / 埃里克·格里芬 / 乔贝斯·威廉姆斯 / 玛格丽塔·莱维耶娃 / 汉克·阿扎利亚 / 威尔·阿奈特 / 阿莉娅·肖卡特 / 托马斯·克莱舒曼 / 马修·里沃德 / 兹拉科·布里奇 / 斯蒂芬妮·西格曼 / 凯特·琳·谢尔

articles.title: George Cheeks May Level Up in David Ellison’s TV Empire
articles.author: Erik Hayden

paras.en: The last surviving Paramount Global co-CEO is likely to ascend in a new chapter of the company.
paras.zh: 最后一位幸存的派拉蒙全球联席首席执行官很可能会在公司的新篇章中升任。

paras.en: George Cheeks, who currently oversees the CBS Studios portfolio and Paramount’s linear TV channels, is said to be poised to add oversight of Skydance‘s television studios, including Warner Bros. TV studios and Paramount TV studios, when the deal closes next week. In November of last year, Paramount Skydance reworked its linear TV business under Cheeks, chair of TV media at Paramount, adding cable outlets BET, Comedy Central, MTV and Nickelodeon to Cheeks’ portfolio alongside CBS.
paras.zh: 目前负责哥伦比亚广播公司工作室投资组合和派拉蒙线性电视频道的乔治·奇克斯(George Cheeks)据说将在下周交易完成时增加对Skydance电视工作室的监管，其中包括华纳兄弟电视工作室和派拉蒙电视工作室。去年 11 月，派拉蒙 Skydance 在派拉蒙电视媒体主席 Cheeks 的领导下重组了其线性电视业务，将 BET、Comedy Central、MTV 和 Nickelodeon 等有线电视频道与 CBS 一起纳入 Cheeks 的投资组合中。

paras.en: In the previous Shari Redstone regime, Cheeks was part of a trio titled “the office of the CEO” along with Brian Robbins and Chris McCarthy on an interim basis after CEO Bob Bakish was ousted amid a sale process that ultimately went in the direction of David Ellison’s Skydance Media.
paras.zh: 在之前的沙里·雷石东政权中，奇克斯与布莱恩·罗宾斯和克里斯·麦卡锡一起临时成为“首席执行官办公室”三人组的一员，此前首席执行官鲍勃·巴基什在一次出售过程中被赶下台，最终向大卫·埃里森的 Skydance Media 方向发展。

paras.en: Cheeks’ goal will now be stability, reorganization and to milk those titles for cash, with wide cuts expected across the company as it seeks to harvest the revenue from carriage fees and redistribute to other priorities, like streaming, and paying down debt.
paras.zh: 奇克斯现在的目标将是稳定、重组并从这些头衔中榨取现金，预计整个公司将大幅削减收入，因为该公司寻求从运输费中获得收入，并将其重新分配给其他优先事项，例如流媒体和偿还债务。

paras.en: The combined company, notably, also will have to abide by a consent decree negotiated with the 12 states that sued Ellison’s team. That includes having the Paramount and Warners cable channels (Comedy Central-MTV-BET-Nick and HGTV-Food Network-TNT-CNN-Discovery, respectively) negotiate affiliate agreements separately.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，合并后的公司还必须遵守与起诉埃里森团队的 12 个州谈判达成的同意令。这包括让派拉蒙和华纳有线频道（分别是喜剧中心-MTV-BET-尼克和HGTV-食品网络-TNT-CNN-Discovery）单独谈判附属协议。

paras.en: On Friday, after Ellison shared on X that once Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery combine they will take on the name Skydance, it was also reported Warner Bros. film chiefs Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy were exiting.
paras.zh: 周五，埃里森在 X 上透露，一旦派拉蒙和华纳兄弟探索合并，他们将更名为 Skydance，据报道，华纳兄弟电影首席执行官迈克尔·德·卢卡 (Michael De Luca) 和帕梅拉·阿布迪 (Pamela Abdy) 将退出。

paras.en: Deadline first reported Cheeks’ elevation.
paras.zh: Deadline 首先报道了奇克斯的身高。

articles.title: “Good Heavens”: Kathleen Turner Reacts to Michael Douglas’ Bombshell About Their Secret Romance During ‘Romancing the Stone’
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Michael Douglas revealed in a new excerpt from his memoir One Helluva Ride that he and Kathleen Turner had a secret romantic relationship while filming 1984’s Romancing the Stone, and the actress is responding to his revelation.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·道格拉斯 (Michael Douglas) 在他的回忆录《One Helluva Ride》的新摘录中透露，他和凯瑟琳·特纳 (Kathleen Turner) 在拍摄 1984 年的《浪漫石头》时曾有过一段秘密的浪漫关系，而这位女演员正在对他的爆料做出回应。

paras.en: The Fatal Attraction actor shared an exclusive excerpt from his new memoir with People Thursday, writing that he and his then-wife, Diandra Douglas, were separated and “were both having extramarital affairs.” He wrote that “Kathleen and I fell hard for each other and began a relationship,” and vowed to keep their romance private.
paras.zh: 这位《致命吸引力》演员与《人物》杂志周四分享了他新回忆录的独家摘录，其中写道，他和当时的妻子黛安德拉·道格拉斯已经分居，并且“都有婚外情”。他写道，“凯瑟琳和我深深地爱上了彼此，并开始了恋爱关系”，并发誓要将他们的恋情保密。

paras.en: “The chemistry I had with Kathleen Turner was so strong, audiences have been certain for years that we were in a relationship together while making the film. We both denied it through Romancing The Stone, Jewel of the Nile, War of the Roses, and even while doing press a few years ago for The Kominsky Method,” he said, noting four projects they’ve worked on together.
paras.zh: “我和凯瑟琳·特纳之间的化学反应非常强烈，观众多年来一直确信我们在制作这部电影时就在一起了。我们都通过《浪漫石头》、《尼罗河上的宝石》、《玫瑰战争》，甚至在几年前为《科明斯基方法》做新闻报道时都否认了这一点，”他说，并指出了他们一起合作的四个项目。

paras.en: “The official story went as follows: Yes, we confessed, we had amazing chemistry. Yes, we were both, as Kathleen said, ‘terrible flirts,’ and yes, we were both tempted, but nothing ever happened between us,” Douglas wrote, per the excerpt. “That was a lie.”
paras.zh: “官方的故事是这样的：是的，我们承认，我们有着惊人的化学反应。是的，正如凯瑟琳所说，我们都是‘可怕的调情’，是的，我们都受到了诱惑，但我们之间什么也没发生，”道格拉斯在摘录中写道。 “那是一个谎言。”

paras.en: Turner responded to Douglas’ admission on Friday. “Good heavens what a fuss about something 40 years ago!” the actress wrote in a statement shared with People. “I love Michael and I look forward to enjoying the book.”
paras.zh: 特纳周五对道格拉斯的承认做出了回应。 “天哪，40年前的事情真是大惊小怪啊！”这位女演员在与《人物》杂志分享的一份声明中写道。 “我爱迈克尔，我期待着享受这本书。”

paras.en: Elsewhere in his excerpt, the two-time Oscar winner said they lied about their romance for 40 years “to protect my wife and son.” He said they kept things so under wraps that director Bob Zemeckis and their co-star Danny DeVito “were unaware.”
paras.zh: 这位两届奥斯卡奖得主在摘录的其他地方表示，他们在恋爱问题上撒谎了 40 年，“是为了保护我的妻子和儿子”。他说，他们对事情保密，以至于导演鲍勃·泽米吉斯和联合主演丹尼·德维托“都不知道”。

paras.en: “The truth is that during the production of Romancing the Stone, Kathleen and I fell hard for each other and began a relationship,” Douglas wrote. “It wasn’t a fly-by night affair; it grew naturally from how closely we were working together, how much pressure we were under, how much we respected and cared for one another, and how attracted we were to each other. Like every other guy in the world at the time, I was knocked sideways by Kathleen….”
paras.zh: “事实是，在制作《浪漫石头》期间，凯瑟琳和我深深地爱上了彼此，并开始了恋爱关系，”道格拉斯写道。 “这不是一场不经意间的事情；它是自然而然地发生的，因为我们在一起工作的密切程度，我们承受的压力有多大，我们有多么尊重和关心彼此，以及我们彼此之间有多么吸引。像当时世界上所有其他人一样，我被凯瑟琳击倒了……”

paras.en: Douglas wrote that during a set visit, Diandra “grew suspicious,” and spoke with Turner and “made it clear to her that we were still married.”
paras.zh: 道格拉斯写道，在一次探访期间，黛安德拉“变得可疑”，并与特纳交谈并“向她明确表示我们仍然是婚姻关系”。

paras.en: “Her view of the terms of our separation was different from mine. This gave Kathleen pause. She didn’t want to interfere,” he wrote. “After that visit, Kathleen and I ended things, and I went back to Diandra.”
paras.zh: “她对我们分居条款的看法与我不同。这让凯瑟琳犹豫了。她不想干涉，”他写道。 “那次拜访之后，凯瑟琳和我结束了一切，然后我回到了黛安德拉。”

articles.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell

paras.en: The Department of Justice will not reopen its criminal investigation into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell over the central bank's overbudget multibillion-dollar headquarters renovation a department spokesperson told CNBC.
paras.zh: 司法部发言人告诉 CNBC，司法部不会重新启动对美联储前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔 (Jerome Powell) 的刑事调查，该调查涉及美联储预算超支的数十亿美元总部改造工程。

paras.en: "We're not reopening a criminal investigation into him," Attorney General Todd Blanche told Bloomberg in an interview Friday.
paras.zh: “我们不会重新对他展开刑事调查，”司法部长托德·布兰奇周五在接受彭博社采访时表示。

paras.en: Blanche did not rule out separate Justice Department action related to the renovation in his interview. He told the outlet the independent audit of the renovation could prompt an investigation if it uncovers evidence of criminal wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 布兰奇在采访中并未排除司法部就翻修工程采取单独行动的可能性。他告诉媒体，如果发现犯罪行为的证据，对翻修工程的独立审计可能会引发调查。

paras.en: His comments come days after the Federal Reserve's inspector general found no reasonable grounds to believe that a federal crime had occurred requiring a referral to the attorney general, even as the watchdog faulted the central bank for major management and oversight failures that contributed to the project's soaring costs.
paras.zh: 几天前，美联储监察长发现没有合理的理由相信发生了联邦犯罪，需要将其移交给司法部长，尽管监管机构指责央行存在重大管理和监督失误，导致该项目成本飙升。

paras.en: President Donald Trump slammed the decision, said in a Truth Social post Wednesday after the news, saying that Powell should be "forced to resign" from the central bank's Board of Governors "at a minimum."
paras.zh: 周三消息传出后，唐纳德·特朗普总统在《真相社会》的一篇文章中猛烈抨击了这一决定，称鲍威尔“至少应该”“被迫”辞去央行理事会职务。

paras.en: "He can't manage a Building, and he certainly shouldn't be allowed to manage his High Interest Rate Policy (only on 'TRUMP!')," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他无法管理一座大楼，当然也不应该允许他管理他的高利率政策（仅限于‘特朗普！’）。”

paras.en: The Justice Department opened its investigation into the renovation in January. Prosecutors issued grand jury subpoenas seeking related records but a federal judge quashed those subpoenas in March, finding they had been issued for an improper purpose and that the government had produced essentially no evidence that Powell committed a crime. The DOJ disputed the ruling but later closed its investigation rather than appeal.
paras.zh: 司法部于一月份开始对翻修工程进行调查。检察官向大陪审团发出传票，寻求相关记录，但一名联邦法官在三月份撤销了这些传票，认为这些传票是出于不当目的而发出的，而且政府基本上没有提供鲍威尔犯罪的证据。美国司法部对裁决提出异议，但后来结束了调查而不是上诉。

paras.en: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, who succeeded Powell in May, said the central bank would bring in an independent auditor and strengthen oversight of the project. Powell remains on the Fed's Board of Governors, where his separate term runs through Jan. 31, 2028.
paras.zh: 五月份接替鲍威尔的美联储主席凯文·沃什表示，央行将聘请独立审计员并加强对该项目的监督。鲍威尔仍担任美联储理事会成员，其任期将持续至 2028 年 1 月 31 日。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly pushed Powell to leave the board altogether after years of clashes over interest-rate policy.
paras.zh: 在多年的利率政策冲突后，特朗普多次敦促鲍威尔完全离开董事会。

paras.en: CNBC's Ryan Ruggiero contributed to this report.
paras.zh: CNBC 的 Ryan Ruggiero 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration

paras.en: Cerebras stock plummeted nearly 20% this week to its lowest price since the company's monster IPO in May, after a report that chip giant Nvidia will power a crucial piece of OpenAI's latest model.
paras.zh: 在有报道称芯片巨头英伟达将为 OpenAI 最新型号的关键部件提供动力后，Cerebras 股价本周暴跌近 20%，跌至该公司 5 月份大规模 IPO 以来的最低价格。

paras.en: Research firm SemiAnalysis posted on X on Wednesday that OpenAI will power its "Ultrafast" mode for GPT-6.1 Sol with Nvidia graphics processing units instead of Cerebras hardware. Cerebras shares are now down by more than half since their initial pop that followed the company's debut on the Nasdaq.
paras.zh: 研究公司 SemiAnalysis 周三在 X 上发布消息称，OpenAI 将使用 Nvidia 图形处理单元而不是 Cerebras 硬件为其 GPT-6.1 Sol 的“超快”模式提供支持。自公司在纳斯达克首次亮相以来，Cerebras 股价现已下跌一半以上。

paras.en: The stock, which closed on Friday at $166.43, was also under pressure this week due to the expiration of post-IPO restrictions on some insider shares.
paras.zh: 该股周五收于 166.43 美元，由于一些内部人士股票的 IPO 后限制到期，本周也面临压力。

paras.en: However, it rose almost 3% in extended trading on Friday after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman responded to the "speculation about our partnership with Cerebras."
paras.zh: 然而，在 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 回应“有关我们与 Cerebras 合作的猜测”后，周五盘后交易中该股上涨了近 3%。

paras.en: "Cerebras is a close partner, and we have a deep engagement pushing on the frontiers of speed," Altman wrote in a post on X.
paras.zh: Altman 在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“Cerebras 是一个亲密的合作伙伴，我们在推动速度前沿方面有着深入的合作。”

paras.en: Still, it's been a brutal stretch for Cerebras, which closed at a $95 billion market cap on the first day of trading, just shy of joining the ranks of Meta, Alibaba and now SpaceX, which closed their initial day with valuations over $100 billion.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这对 Cerebras 来说仍然是一个残酷的考验，该公司在交易首日收盘时的市值为 950 亿美元，仅差一点就加入了 Meta、阿里巴巴和现在的 SpaceX 的行列，后者首日收盘时估值超过 1000 亿美元。

paras.en: Cerebras' market cap now sits at just over $39 billion.
paras.zh: Cerebras 的市值目前略高于 390 亿美元。

paras.en: Investors were excited by the prospect of an alternative to Nvidia to power AI. Cerebras makes dinner plate-sized ASICs, or a custom microchip built for inference workloads, and leases them from inside its own data centers as a cloud service. In January, Cerebras struck a deal worth over $10 billion with OpenAI to supply it with 750 megawatts of computing power through 2028.
paras.zh: 投资者对英伟达替代品驱动人工智能的前景感到兴奋。 Cerebras 制造餐盘大小的 ASIC，即为推理工作负载构建的定制微芯片，并从自己的数据中心内部将它们作为云服务出租。今年 1 月，Cerebras 与 OpenAI 达成了一项价值超过 100 亿美元的协议，到 2028 年为其提供 750 兆瓦的计算能力。

paras.en: Losing OpenAI inference to Nvidia has put a damper on that exuberance. According to McKinsey, inference is set to surpass training as the most dominant workload in AI data centers by the end of the decade.
paras.zh: OpenAI 推理功能输给了 Nvidia，这让这种繁荣受到了抑制。麦肯锡表示，到本世纪末，推理将超越训练，成为人工智能数据中心最主要的工作负载。

paras.en: Meanwhile, as more time passes from the IPO, additional shares will hit the market. According to the company's prospectus, up to 19.4 million shares held by directors, officers, non-executive employees, and non-employee holders unlocked on Wednesday. That's equal to 8% of total shares outstanding.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着IPO时间的推移，更多的股票将会上市。根据该公司的招股说明书，周三解锁了董事、管理人员、非执行员工和非员工持有者持有的多达 1940 万股股票。这相当于已发行股票总数的 8%。

paras.en: Prior to that, up to 14.6 million shares have been unlocked for sale every two weeks since Aug. 19.
paras.zh: 此前，自8月19日以来，每两周解锁出售的股票数量高达1460万股。

paras.en: CEO Andrew Feldman and CTO Sean Lie, both minted billionaires by the IPO process, sold over $240 million of Class A shares between Aug. 20 and Sept. 25 under trading plans adopted shortly after the IPO. Other executives have also sold shares valued in the millions.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Andrew Feldman 和首席技术官 Sean Lie 均通过 IPO 成为亿万富翁，根据 IPO 后不久通过的交易计划，他们在 8 月 20 日至 9 月 25 日期间出售了价值超过 2.4 亿美元的 A 类股票。其他高管也出售了价值数百万美元的股票。

paras.en: WATCH: CNBC’s full interview with Cerebras Systems CEO Andrew Feldman
paras.zh: 观看：CNBC 对 Cerebras Systems 首席执行官安德鲁·费尔德曼 (Andrew Feldman) 的完整采访

articles.title: America’s data center fight is a preview of what's to come for the rest of the world

paras.en: As the AI boom becomes a major part of political debate, the public backlash against data centers in the U.S. is spreading to Europe and Asia — raising risks for investors.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能热潮成为政治辩论的主要部分，公众对美国数据中心的强烈反对正在蔓延到欧洲和亚洲，这增加了投资者的风险。

paras.en: Across the Atlantic, negative sentiment is growing in Europe, which has more at stake due to its densely populated countries and higher electricity prices, experts told CNBC.
paras.zh: 专家告诉 CNBC，在大西洋彼岸，欧洲的负面情绪正在加剧，由于人口稠密和电价上涨，欧洲面临的风险更大。

paras.en: Similar tensions are emerging in South Korea, with growing opposition to data centers near residential areas and proposals for tighter local restrictions, even as the national government pushes to accelerate development.
paras.zh: 韩国也出现了类似的紧张局势，尽管韩国政府正在推动加速发展，但人们越来越反对住宅区附近的数据中心，并提议采取更严格的地方限制。

paras.en: Public opposition has already impacted around $42 billion of data center investments in Europe, in account delays and cancellations, according to research from STL Partners. That compares to around $77 billion in the U.S.
paras.zh: 根据 STL Partners 的研究，公众的反对已经影响了欧洲约 420 亿美元的数据中心投资，导致账户延迟和取消。相比之下，美国的这一数字约为 770 亿美元。

paras.en: The pushback could be the "straw that breaks the camel's back," Olivier Darmouni, associate professor at HEC Paris who specializes in the energy transition, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 巴黎高等商学院专门研究能源转型的副教授奥利维尔·达穆尼 (Olivier Darmouni) 告诉 CNBC，这种阻力可能是“压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草”。

paras.en: More than 70 data center projects in Europe were rejected or restricted between January and April — more than in all of 2025, according to the European Data Center Monitor. It found that pushback had snowballed from local town halls to courts, regulators and parliaments.
paras.zh: 据欧洲数据中心监测机构称，1 月至 4 月期间，欧洲有 70 多个数据中心项目被拒绝或限制，这一数字比 2025 年全年的还要多。调查发现，抵制情绪已从当地市政厅滚雪球般蔓延到法院、监管机构和议会。

paras.en: Scotland has paused planning approvals for new hyperscale data centers after campaigners called on the government to avoid the "cautionary tale" of Ireland, where overwhelming power demand led to a moratorium.
paras.zh: 在活动人士呼吁政府避免重蹈爱尔兰的“警世故事”之后，苏格兰暂停了对新超大规模数据中心的规划审批，爱尔兰压倒性的电力需求导致了暂停。

paras.en: Constraints have been rising in the Nordics, where investors were drawn to large tracts of land and renewable energy. After a surge in power applications, Denmark passed an emergency law that could see data centers at the back of the queue for grid power applications.
paras.zh: 北欧地区的限制不断增加，那里的投资者被大片土地和可再生能源所吸引。在电力应用激增之后，丹麦通过了一项紧急法，该法可能使数据中心排在电网电力应用队列的最后。

paras.en: Spain also proposed new data center rules this summer, requiring data centers to source 80% of their electricity from renewables. Projects in the U.K. have stalled after pushback from locals.
paras.zh: 西班牙今年夏天还提出了新的数据中心规则，要求数据中心80%的电力来自可再生能源。在当地人的反对下，英国的项目陷入停滞。

paras.en: Much of the concern centers around water usage, power consumption, electricity prices, and the sheer amount of space that some centers require. There is also little agreement on how many permanent jobs the sector creates, and no precedent for projecting a center's economic value per megawatt.
paras.zh: 大部分问题都集中在用水量、电力消耗、电价以及一些中心所需的巨大空间上。对于该行业创造多少永久性就业机会也没有达成一致，也没有预测一个中心每兆瓦经济价值的先例。

paras.en: "The gains of AI are very diffused," Darmouni told CNBC.
paras.zh: 达穆尼对 CNBC 表示：“人工智能的收益非常分散。”

paras.en: "There's definitely been more understanding of the scale of the potential AI build-out and its geographical spread, and perhaps ... more information about how much bigger these are, and that they're a little bit more like giant ghost warehouses that consume a lot of resources and can hurt local communities in some ways."
paras.zh: “人们肯定对潜在人工智能建设的规模及其地理分布有了更多的了解，也许……更多关于这些规模有多大的信息，以及它们更像是消耗大量资源并可能在某些方面伤害当地社区的巨型幽灵仓库。”

paras.en: Europe's denser population, and the fact that many data center operators are U.S. companies, might mean that the backlash hits harder, the professor added.
paras.zh: 这位教授补充说，欧洲人口密集，而且许多数据中心运营商都是美国公司，这可能意味着这种抵制会更加严重。

paras.en: South Korea, home to tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, sits at the heart of the AI supply chain. In June, its government named AI data centers as one of three major investment projects, alongside semiconductors and physical AI.
paras.zh: 韩国是科技巨头三星电子和 SK 海力士的所在地，位于人工智能供应链的核心。今年六月，中国政府将人工智能数据中心列为三大投资项目之一，与半导体和物理人工智能并列。

paras.en: But its push to build the infrastructure needed is running into resistance at the local level.
paras.zh: 但其建设所需基础设施的努力在地方层面遇到阻力。

paras.en: In the Geumcheon district of southwestern Seoul, residents have called for authorities to revoke the building permit and halt construction of a data center near their homes, according to the local government.
paras.zh: 据当地政府称，在首尔西南部的金川区，居民呼吁当局吊销建筑许可证，并停止在他们家附近建设数据中心。

paras.en: In July, officials announced plans to require consent from a majority of residents living within 200 meters of proposed data center sites and to introduce a three-stage system for reviewing projects and mediating disputes.
paras.zh: 7月，官员们宣布计划要求居住在拟议数据中心地点200米范围内的大多数居民同意，并引入一个三阶段系统来审查项目和调解纠纷。

paras.en: Residents have also gathered outside the local government office on weekday mornings for months to protest against the project. The demonstrations had continued for 172 days as of mid-August, according to local media.
paras.zh: 几个月来，居民们还在工作日早上聚集在当地政府办公室外抗议该项目。据当地媒体报道，截至8月中旬，示威活动已持续172天。

paras.en: In Gwacheon, a city just south of Seoul, a local council member proposed an ordinance aimed at protecting nearby residents from risks associated with data centers operating around the clock, including potential fires involving backup batteries.
paras.zh: 在首尔以南的果川市，当地议会成员提出了一项法令，旨在保护附近居民免受与全天候运行的数据中心相关的风险，包括涉及备用电池的潜在火灾。

paras.en: Despite the pusback, the AI boom shows little sign of slowing down.
paras.zh: 尽管受到阻碍，人工智能的繁荣几乎没有放缓的迹象。

paras.en: But a community's ability "to derail a $10 billion [data center] plan is quite powerful," said Asya Walters, managing director at Alvarez & Marsal.
paras.zh: 但 Alvarez & Marsal 董事总经理 Asya Walters 表示，社区“破坏 100 亿美元（数据中心）计划的能力非常强大”。

paras.en: She told CNBC the business-friendly environment in the U.S. has historically made it easier to overcome pushback.
paras.zh: 她告诉 CNBC，美国的商业友好环境历来更容易克服阻力。

paras.en: But in Europe and Asia, there's some "hot and coldness" at the country level about where demand is going, Walters said. The "push and pull" between favorable conditions for data centers and more restrictive regulation can be challenging for investment.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯说，但在欧洲和亚洲，国家层面的需求走向存在一些“冷热”。数据中心的有利条件和更严格的监管之间的“推拉”可能会给投资带来挑战。

paras.en: Public backlash can also end up raising costs for operators, because even if they pull out of a project before construction starts, money will likely have already been spent.
paras.zh: 公众的强烈反对最终也会增加运营商的成本，因为即使他们在施工开始前退出项目，资金也可能已经被花掉了。

paras.en: Though most capex expenditure happens after the permits are in place, operators spend a lot to reach that point, "so there is some loss that could happen there if they never get the permits," Walters said.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯说，尽管大多数资本支出发生在获得许可证之后，但运营商花费了大量资金才能达到这一点，“因此，如果他们从未获得许可证，可能会发生一些损失。”

paras.en: "Digital infrastructure is becoming more visible and it's understandable that communities want to understand what's being built near them, why it's needed and how local impacts are being managed," said Eulalia Flo, vice president of growth and emerging markets, EMEA at Equinix, one of the biggest data center operators in Europe.
paras.zh: 欧洲最大的数据中心运营商之一 Equinix 欧洲、中东和非洲地区增长和新兴市场副总裁 Eulalia Flo 表示：“数字基础设施正变得越来越明显，社区希望了解附近正在建设什么、为什么需要这些基础设施以及如何管理当地影响，这是可以理解的。”

paras.en: "We don't see this as a structural constraint on growth, but the policy environment is genuinely tightening in some markets," said Flo.
paras.zh: 弗洛表示：“我们并不认为这是对增长的结构性限制，但一些市场的政策环境确实正在收紧。”

paras.en: But the AI buildout has meant "a misunderstanding of the industry in a very broad sense," according to Dominic Ward, CEO of data center operator Verne.
paras.zh: 但数据中心运营商 Verne 首席执行官多米尼克·沃德 (Dominic Ward) 表示，人工智能的发展意味着“在非常广泛的意义上对该行业的误解”。

paras.en: "We used to be a completely unknown part of the economy," Ward told CNBC. "We were just a black box. We were just a building that had stuff that went in that nobody understood. Now we are one of the fundamental layers driving the economy."
paras.zh: “我们曾经是经济中完全不为人所知的一部分，”沃德告诉 CNBC。 “我们只是一个黑匣子。我们只是一座建筑物，里面的东西没人理解。现在我们是推动经济的基本层之一。”

paras.en: He added: "Now everybody knows where they are, so there's kind of no hiding behind this."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“现在每个人都知道自己在哪里，所以这背后没有什么隐藏的了。”

articles.title: Mathematicians name 50 of the highest-stakes problems in math

paras.en: Mathematicians love to collect elegant, profound questions that defy proof: the longer the holdout, the better. And one day in June, groups from around the world gathered to do just that. The goal was a new list of 50 high-stakes questions with an important caveat: there had to be a way to automatically check solutions to the problems. Workshops took place in six cities: London, Toronto, Los Angeles, New York City, Berkeley, Calif., and Cambridge, Mass.
paras.zh: 数学家喜欢收集难以证明的优雅、深刻的问题：坚持的时间越长越好。六月的一天，来自世界各地的团体聚集在一起就是为了实现这一目标。目标是列出 50 个高风险问题的新列表，并附带一个重要警告：必须有一种方法来自动检查问题的解决方案。研讨会在六个城市举行：伦敦、多伦多、洛杉矶、纽约市、加利福尼亚州伯克利和马萨诸塞州剑桥。

paras.en: That morning Yang-Hui He, a mathematician at the London Institute for Mathematical Sciences, was accompanied by a very young guest. His son was on school break, so He brought him along to the workshop. The two entered a room full of mathematicians who were well supplied with lunch, snacks, and coffee and got to work. Under the watchful eye of his cake-munching son, He collaborated with others to submit three problems that touched on fields from knot theory to algebra, topology and number theory. “There’s a big culture in mathematics, which is solving open conjectures,” He says. “Many people get Fields Medals because they solve open conjectures. This is very big.”
paras.zh: 那天早上，伦敦数学科学研究所的数学家何阳辉带着一位非常年轻的客人。他的儿子正在放假，所以他带他一起去车间。两人走进一个满是数学家的房间，他们准备好了午餐、零食和咖啡，然后开始工作。在吃蛋糕的儿子的注视下，他与其他人合作提交了三个问题，涉及从结论到代数、拓扑和数论的领域。 “数学中有一种很大的文化，那就是解决开放的猜想，”他说。 “许多人获得菲尔兹奖是因为他们解决了开放猜想。这是非常重大的。”

paras.en: The event was held at the request of Epoch AI, an organization that benchmarks the progress of artificial intelligence systems. Epoch AI senior researcher Greg Burnham says the problems cover a broad spectrum of topics. Lately AI models from various companies have been cutting through a large swath of math’s biggest challenges. Earlier this month, for instance, OpenAI claimed a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, one of the towering Millennium Prize Problems.
paras.zh: 该活动是应 Epoch AI 的要求举办的，Epoch AI 是一个对人工智能系统进展进行基准测试的组织。 Epoch AI 高级研究员 Greg Burnham 表示，这些问题涵盖了广泛的主题。最近，来自不同公司的人工智能模型已经解决了大量数学难题。例如，本月早些时候，OpenAI 声称找到了纳维-斯托克斯问题的解决方案，这是最高的千年奖问题之一。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: As of late September, a few of the problems from the new list have been solved, including some landmark ones.
