articles.title: Mulberry may reshape gut bacteria and influence metabolism

paras.en: Mulberry may reshape gut bacteria and influence metabolism
paras.zh: 桑葚可能重塑肠道细菌并影响新陈代谢

paras.en: Mulberry leaves and fruit contain compounds that may influence gut bacteria and, in turn, metabolism.
paras.zh: 桑叶和果实含有可能影响肠道细菌并进而影响新陈代谢的化合物。

paras.en: - Mulberry compounds may reshape the gut microbiome in ways that support intestinal health and metabolism, with some combinations showing especially strong effects in animal studies. However, the results vary depending on the plant part and processing method, and the benefits have yet to be confirmed in humans.
paras.zh: - 桑葚化合物可以以支持肠道健康和新陈代谢的方式重塑肠道微生物群，其中一些组合在动物研究中显示出特别强烈的效果。然而，结果因植物部位和加工方法而异，并且其益处尚未在人类中得到证实。

paras.en: Mulberry has been eaten as food and used in traditional medicine for centuries. Now, researchers are examining whether compounds in the plant can alter the gut microbiota and, in turn, affect metabolism. A review involving scientists from Wroclaw Medical University suggests that the results may depend heavily on the mulberry species, which part of the plant is used, and how it is processed.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，桑葚一直被作为食物食用并用于传统医学。现在，研究人员正在研究植物中的化合物是否可以改变肠道微生物群，进而影响新陈代谢。弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学科学家参与的一项审查表明，结果可能在很大程度上取决于桑树的种类、使用植物的哪一部分以及加工方式。

paras.en: "The gut microbiota not only contributes to the functioning of the gastrointestinal tract but may also influence metabolism throughout the body. Mulberry is particularly interesting in this respect because it contains numerous bioactive compounds, including polyphenols and polysaccharides, which may interact with gut microorganisms," explains Anna Prescha, PhD, DSc, Professor at Wroclaw Medical University, from the Department of Dietetics and Bromatology.
paras.zh: “肠道微生物群不仅有助于胃肠道的功能，还可能影响全身的新陈代谢。桑葚在这方面特别有趣，因为它含有多种生物活性化合物，包括多酚和多糖，可能与肠道微生物相互作用，”弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学营养学和食品学系教授 Anna Prescha 博士解释道。

paras.en: Different Mulberries Contain Different Compounds
paras.zh: 不同的桑葚含有不同的化合物

paras.en: Research to date has concentrated mostly on white mulberry (Morus alba), although black mulberry (Morus nigra), especially its fruit, has also produced notable results.
paras.zh: 迄今为止的研究主要集中在白桑（Morus alba）上，尽管黑桑（Morus nigra），特别是其果实，也取得了显着的成果。

paras.en: Mulberry leaves contain several biologically active substances, including 1-deoxynojirimycin (DNJ), which is known to affect carbohydrate metabolism, along with polyphenols and polysaccharides. Black mulberry fruit, meanwhile, contains high levels of anthocyanins and other phenolic compounds, as well as polysaccharides.
paras.zh: 桑叶含有多种生物活性物质，包括 1-脱氧野尻霉素 (DNJ)，它已知会影响碳水化合物代谢，同时还含有多酚和多糖。与此同时，黑桑葚含有高含量的花青素和其他酚类化合物以及多糖。

paras.en: How the plant material is processed can also make a major difference. Drying, fermentation, and extraction methods can change both the amount and relative proportions of bioactive compounds. As a result, two preparations made from the same plant material may differ considerably in composition and biological effects.
paras.zh: 植物材料的加工方式也会产生重大影响。干燥、发酵和提取方法可以改变生物活性化合物的数量和相对比例。因此，由相同植物材料制成的两种制剂在成分和生物效应上可能有很大差异。

paras.en: The review found that preparations made from both mulberry leaves and fruit may affect the composition and activity of the gut microbiota. Some studies reported shifts in beneficial bacteria along with higher production of short-chain fatty acids such as acetate, propionate, and butyrate.
paras.zh: 该评论发现，由桑叶和桑果制成的制剂可能会影响肠道微生物群的组成和活性。一些研究报告称，有益细菌发生了变化，同时短链脂肪酸（如乙酸盐、丙酸盐和丁酸盐）的产量增加了。

paras.en: These compounds are produced when gut microbes ferment dietary material and are important for normal intestinal function. In some experiments, changes in the microbiota were also associated with improvements in measurements related to glucose and lipid metabolism.
paras.zh: 这些化合物是肠道微生物发酵膳食材料时产生的，对正常肠道功能很重要。在一些实验中，微生物群的变化也与葡萄糖和脂质代谢相关测量的改善有关。

paras.en: The results, however, were not consistent across every preparation. Both the material being studied and the way it was processed appeared to influence the outcome.
paras.zh: 然而，每次准备的结果并不一致。所研究的材料及其处理方式似乎都会影响结果。

paras.en: Black mulberry fruit polysaccharides offer one example. Researchers using different extraction techniques produced fractions with different structures and different levels of utilization by gut microbes. Fractions produced through water extraction and with pectate lyase showed the strongest prebiotic potential.
paras.zh: 黑桑果多糖就是一个例子。研究人员使用不同的提取技术生产出具有不同结构和不同肠道微生物利用水平的级分。通过水提取和果胶酸裂合酶产生的级分显示​​出最强的益生元潜力。

paras.en: Studies involving polysaccharides from mulberry leaves also suggest that structural characteristics matter. Features such as molecular weight and monosaccharide composition may determine which bacteria can use the compounds as a substrate and which short-chain fatty acids are ultimately produced.
paras.zh: 涉及桑叶多糖的研究也表明结构特征很重要。分子量和单糖组成等特征可能决定哪些细菌可以使用这些化合物作为底物以及最终产生哪些短链脂肪酸。

paras.en: Combined Mulberry Compounds Show Stronger Effects in Mice
paras.zh: 组合桑葚化合物对小鼠显示出更强的作用

paras.en: Some of the most intriguing findings came from experiments involving more complex mulberry preparations.
paras.zh: 一些最有趣的发现来自涉及更复杂的桑葚制剂的实验。

paras.en: In mice fed a high-fat diet, a fraction containing both polyphenols and polysaccharides from white mulberry fruit produced more favorable changes in the gut microbiota than either fraction given on its own. Those microbial changes were accompanied by improvements in some measures linked to metabolic syndrome and intestinal health.
paras.zh: 在喂食高脂肪饮食的小鼠中，含有来自白桑果的多酚和多糖的部分比单独给予任何一种部分对肠道微生物群产生更有利的变化。这些微生物变化伴随着与代谢综合征和肠道健康相关的一些指标的改善。

paras.en: Researchers also performed a microbiota transplantation experiment using the same model. Gut microbiota from mice that had received the combined mulberry fraction were transferred to other animals. Those recipients also showed improvements in some metabolic disturbances, adding evidence that changes in the microbiota may help drive the effects of the mulberry preparation.
paras.zh: 研究人员还使用相同的模型进行了微生物移植实验。接受组合桑葚成分的小鼠的肠道微生物群被转移到其他动物身上。这些接受者还表现出一些代谢紊乱的改善，进一步证明微生物群的变化可能有助于推动桑葚制剂的效果。

paras.en: "These findings suggest that what matters is not only the presence of an individual compound, but also the complex composition of the preparation, the proportions of its compounds, and their interactions. Therefore, rather than searching for a single universal product, it is worth determining which combination of species, plant part, composition, and processing method produces a specific biological effect," emphasizes Prof. Anna Prescha.
paras.zh: “这些发现表明，重要的不仅是单个化合物的存在，还包括制剂的复杂组成、化合物的比例及其相互作用。因此，与其寻找单一的通用产品，不如确定物种、植物部分、成分和加工方法的哪种组合会产生特定的生物效应，”Anna Prescha 教授强调道。

paras.en: The project grew out of the Nutri-Sfera Student Research Group at the Department of Dietetics and Bromatology at Wroclaw Medical University.
paras.zh: 该项目源自弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学营养学和食品学系的 Nutri-Sfera 学生研究小组。

paras.en: The topic was proposed by two students who have since graduated: Marta Miszczak from the Dietetics program and Karolina Kłosowska-Buryło from the Pharmacy program. Their involvement brought together nutritional and pharmaceutical approaches to studying mulberry and the gut microbiota.
paras.zh: 该主题是由两名已毕业的学生提出的：营养学项目的 Marta Miszczak 和药学项目的 Karolina Kłosowska-Buryło。他们的参与汇集了营养学和药物学方法来研究桑葚和肠道微生物群。

paras.en: "This fitted very well with the interdisciplinary nature of the study. It combined a perspective on mulberry as a plant material with a specific composition with an analysis of its potential effects on the microbiota and metabolism," adds Prof. Prescha.
paras.zh: “这非常符合该研究的跨学科性质。它将桑葚作为一种具有特定成分的植物材料的观点与对其对微生物群和新陈代谢的潜在影响的分析相结合，”普雷沙教授补充道。

paras.en: Despite the promising experimental findings, one major question remains unresolved. Researchers have not yet conducted human studies that directly examine how mulberry preparations affect the gut microbiota.
paras.zh: 尽管实验结果很有希望，但一个主要问题仍未解决。研究人员尚未进行直接研究桑葚制剂如何影响肠道微生物群的人体研究。

paras.en: Most of the existing evidence comes from animal models and in vitro experiments. Comparing results across studies is also difficult because relatively few investigations combine biological findings with a detailed chemical analysis of the exact mulberry preparation being tested.
paras.zh: 现有证据大部分来自动物模型和体外实验。比较不同研究的结果也很困难，因为相对较少的研究将生物学发现与对所测试的桑葚制剂的详细化学分析结合起来。

paras.en: "The available findings are promising, but at this stage they do not allow us to determine whether the relationships observed in experimental models between mulberry preparations, the microbiota, and metabolism also occur in humans," Prof. Prescha points out.
paras.zh: “现有的研究结果很有希望，但在现阶段，我们还无法确定实验模型中观察到的桑葚制剂、微生物群和新陈代谢之间的关系是否也发生在人类身上，”普雷沙教授指出。

paras.en: Researchers say clinical trials will need to use carefully characterized and standardized mulberry preparations. Such studies could help determine how different products affect the human gut microbiota, how large those effects are, and whether they result in measurable health benefits.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，临床试验需要使用经过仔细表征和标准化的桑葚制剂。此类研究可以帮助确定不同的产品如何影响人类肠道微生物群、这些影响有多大以及它们是否会带来可衡量的健康益处。

paras.en: Mulberry leaves and fruit contain different compounds. The leaves contain, among other substances, DNJ, which is associated with carbohydrate metabolism, while black mulberry fruit is particularly rich in anthocyanins.
paras.zh: 桑叶和果实含有不同的化合物。叶子中含有与碳水化合物代谢有关的 DNJ 等物质，而黑桑葚果实中的花青素含量特别丰富。

paras.en: Processing can change mulberry's biological effects. Even preparations made from the same plant part may behave differently depending on the extraction or fermentation method.
paras.zh: 加工可以改变桑葚的生物效应。即使由同一植物部分制成的制剂也可能因提取或发酵方法的不同而表现不同。

paras.en: In experimental studies, combining compounds sometimes produced stronger effects than using them separately. In mice, a combination of polyphenols and polysaccharides from white mulberry fruit produced greater beneficial changes in the microbiota than either fraction alone.
paras.zh: 在实验研究中，组合化合物有时比单独使用它们产生更强的效果。在小鼠中，白桑葚中的多酚和多糖的组合比单独使用任何一种成分都能对微生物群产生更大的有益变化。

paras.en: The gut microbiota may also help mediate these effects. In one experiment, transferring microbiota from mice that received a mulberry preparation to other animals was associated with improvements in some metabolic disturbances.
paras.zh: 肠道微生物群也可能有助于调节这些影响。在一项实验中，将接受桑葚制剂的小鼠的微生物群转移到其他动物身上与某些代谢紊乱的改善有关。

paras.en: The biggest unanswered question is whether these findings apply to people. No human studies have yet directly tested how mulberry preparations affect the gut microbiota.
paras.zh: 最大的悬而未决的问题是这些发现是否适用于人类。目前尚无人体研究直接测试桑葚制剂如何影响肠道微生物群。

paras.en: Materials provided by Wroclaw Medical University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Marta Maria Miszczak, Karolina KÅosowska-BuryÅo, Joanna Magdalena PieczyÅska, Monika Bielecka, Anna Prescha. Mulberry, Gut Microbiota and Gut Functionality: Effects Shaped by Raw Material and Processing Methods. Biomolecules, 2026; 16 (7): 965 DOI: 10.3390/biom16070965
paras.zh: - Marta Maria Miszczak、Karolina KÅosowska-BuryÅo、Joanna Magdalena PieczyÅska、Monika Bielecka、Anna Prescha。桑葚、肠道微生物群和肠道功能：原料和加工方法产生的影响。生物分子，2026； 16（7）：965 DOI：10.3390/biom16070965

articles.title: This common mistake can add nearly 7 points to your blood pressure reading

paras.en: This common mistake can add nearly 7 points to your blood pressure reading
paras.zh: 这个常见错误可能会使您的血压读数增加近 7 分

paras.en: Something as simple as where you rest your arm could make your blood pressure reading look dangerously higher than it really is.
paras.zh: 像手臂休息的地方这样简单的事情可能会让你的血压读数看起来比实际值高出危险的水平。

paras.en: - A common mistake during blood pressure checks could make readings appear substantially higher than they really are. Johns Hopkins researchers found that leaving the arm unsupported can raise systolic readings by about 6.5 mmHg, potentially affecting a hypertension diagnosis.
paras.zh: - 血压检查过程中的一个常见错误可能会导致读数明显高于实际值。约翰·霍普金斯大学的研究人员发现，如果手臂不受支撑，收缩压读数会升高约 6.5 mmHg，可能会影响高血压的诊断。

paras.en: A Johns Hopkins Medicine-led study suggests that the way a patient positions their arm during a blood pressure (BP) check can meaningfully affect the result. Common arm positions used during screenings may make blood pressure appear higher than it actually is, potentially contributing to an incorrect diagnosis of hypertension.
paras.zh: 约翰霍普金斯大学医学院主导的一项研究表明，患者在血压​​ (BP) 检查期间放置手臂的方式会对结果产生有意义的影响。筛查期间使用的常见手臂姿势可能会使血压看起来高于实际值，从而可能导致高血压的错误诊断。

paras.en: In a report on the study, published in JAMA Internal Medicine, researchers compared three arm positions: an arm supported on a desk, an arm supported on a lap, and an unsupported arm hanging at the patient's side. They found that resting the arm on the lap increased systolic pressure (the top number in a BP reading) by nearly 4 mmHg, while allowing the arm to hang unsupported at the side increased systolic pressure by nearly 7 mmHg.
paras.zh: 在《美国医学会内科学》杂志上发表的一份研究报告中，研究人员比较了三种手臂姿势：手臂支撑在桌子上，手臂支撑在膝盖上，以及无支撑的手臂悬挂在患者身边。他们发现，将手臂放在膝盖上会使收缩压（血压读数中的最高数字）增加近 4 毫米汞柱，而让手臂在没有支撑的情况下悬挂在一侧则会使收缩压增加近 7 毫米汞柱。

paras.en: Arm position can make a major difference
paras.zh: 手臂位置可以产生重大影响

paras.en: The results show that arm position makes a "huge difference" in obtaining an accurate blood pressure measurement, according to Tammy Brady, M.D., Ph.D., vice chair for clinical research in the Department of Pediatrics at the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, medical director of the pediatric hypertension program at Johns Hopkins Children's Center, deputy director of the Welch Center for Prevention, Epidemiology, and Clinical Research and senior author of the study.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学医学院儿科临床研究副主席、约翰·霍普金斯儿童中心小儿高血压项目医学主任、韦尔奇预防、流行病学和临床研究中心副主任、该研究的资深作者塔米·布雷迪 (Tammy Brady) 表示，结果表明，手臂位置对于获得准确的血压测量结果有“巨大差异”。

paras.en: The researchers say the findings reinforce clinical recommendations that call for the patient's arm to be firmly supported on a desk or another surface during blood pressure measurement.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这些发现强化了临床建议，即在血压测量期间将患者的手臂牢固地支撑在桌子或其他表面上。

paras.en: According to the American Heart Association, nearly half of U.S. adults have elevated blood pressure, a diagnosis made when the measured force of blood flowing through blood vessels is higher than what is generally considered normal, on average 120/80. If left untreated, high blood pressure can increase the risk of heart attack, stroke and other serious cardiovascular problems.
paras.zh: 根据美国心脏协会的数据，近一半的美国成年人血压升高，这是当测量到的流经血管的血液力量高于通常认为的正常值（平均为 120/80）时做出的诊断。如果不及时治疗，高血压会增加心脏病发作、中风和其他严重心血管问题的风险。

paras.en: Hypertension often produces few or no noticeable symptoms, making early and regular screening during routine medical visits an important part of managing the condition. In many cases, blood pressure can be controlled through lifestyle changes such as weight loss, healthy diets and exercise, along with treatment using any of a variety of medications.
paras.zh: 高血压通常很少或没有明显的症状，因此在常规就诊期间进行早期和定期筛查是控制病情的重要组成部分。在许多情况下，可以通过改变生活方式（例如减肥、健康饮食和锻炼）以及使用各种药物进行治疗来控制血压。

paras.en: The latest clinical practice guidelines from the American Heart Association outline several steps intended to improve measurement accuracy. These include using an appropriate cuff size, supporting the back, keeping the feet flat on the floor with the legs uncrossed, and positioning the arm correctly. The middle of an adjustable BP cuff should be at mid-heart level while the arm rests on a desk or table.
paras.zh: 美国心脏协会的最新临床实践指南概述了旨在提高测量准确性的几个步骤。这些措施包括使用合适的袖带尺寸、支撑背部、保持双脚平放在地板上且双腿不交叉以及正确定位手臂。当手臂放在书桌或桌子上时，可调节血压袖带的中部应位于心脏中部水平。

paras.en: Despite those recommendations, the researchers say blood pressure is frequently checked while patients sit on an exam table with little or no support for their arms. Sometimes a clinician holds the patient's arm, while in other cases the patient rests the arm in their lap.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些建议，研究人员表示，在检查血压时，患者经常坐在检查台上，手臂很少或没有支撑。有时，临床医生握住患者的手臂，而在其他情况下，患者将手臂放在膝盖上。

paras.en: For the Johns Hopkins study, researchers enrolled 133 adult participants (78% Black, 52% female) between Aug. 9, 2022, and June 1, 2023. Participants ranged in age from 18 to 80 and were randomly assigned to one of six groups that differed in the order in which the three seated arm positions were tested.
paras.zh: 在约翰霍普金斯大学的研究中，研究人员在 2022 年 8 月 9 日至 2023 年 6 月 1 日期间招募了 133 名成年参与者（78% 黑人，52% 女性）。参与者年龄从 18 岁到 80 岁不等，并被随机分配到六组中的一组，这六组的测试顺序不同。

paras.en: All measurements were collected during a single visit between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. Before blood pressure was measured, participants emptied their bladders and walked for two minutes to simulate the typical experience of walking into a clinic or medical office before a screening. They then rested while seated for five minutes, with their backs and feet supported.
paras.zh: 所有测量值均在上午 9 点至下午 6 点之间的单次访问期间收集。在测量血压之前，参与者排空膀胱并步行两分钟，以模拟筛查前走进诊所或医疗办公室的典型体验。然后，他们坐着休息五分钟，背部和脚部得到支撑。

paras.en: Each participant wore an upper arm BP cuff chosen according to the size of their upper arm. Researchers used a digital blood pressure device to collect three sets of three measurements, with 30 seconds between individual readings.
paras.zh: 每个参与者都佩戴根据其上臂尺寸选择的上臂血压袖带。研究人员使用数字血压设备收集了三组三组测量值，各个读数之间间隔 30 秒。

paras.en: Researchers carefully controlled each measurement
paras.zh: 研究人员仔细控制每一次测量

paras.en: After each group of three readings, researchers removed the cuff. Participants then walked for two minutes and rested for another five minutes. During the same visit, each person completed a fourth set of three measurements while their arm was supported on a desk. This additional set was included to account for the well known variation that can occur between blood pressure readings.
paras.zh: 每组三次读数后，研究人员取下袖带。然后参与者步行两分钟，再休息五分钟。在同一次访问中，每个人都完成了第四组三次测量，同时他们的手臂支撑在桌子上。包含这一附加组是为了考虑血压读数之间可能发生的众所周知的变化。

paras.en: Every measurement took place in a quiet, private setting. Participants were also instructed not to speak with researchers or use their phones while their blood pressure was being checked.
paras.zh: 每次测量都在安静、私密的环境中进行。参与者还被要求在检查血压时不要与研究人员交谈或使用手机。

paras.en: The results showed that two arm positions commonly seen in clinical practice, resting the arm on the lap or leaving it unsupported at the side, produced substantially higher blood pressure measurements than the recommended position of supporting the arm on a desk.
paras.zh: 结果表明，临床实践中常见的两种手臂姿势（将手臂放在膝盖上或将其放在侧面不受支撑）所产生的血压测量值比建议的将手臂支撑在桌子上的位置要高得多。

paras.en: Resting the arm on the lap overestimated systolic BP, the top number of a reading, or the force of blood flow when pumped out of the heart, by 3.9 mmHg. It also overestimated diastolic blood pressure, the bottom number, or the pressure in the arteries when the heart rests between beats, by 4.0 mmHg.
paras.zh: 将手臂放在膝盖上会高估收缩压（读数的最高值，或从心脏泵出的血流压力）3.9 毫米汞柱。它还高估了舒张压（最低值，即心脏在两次跳动之间休息时的动脉压力）4.0 毫米汞柱。

paras.en: Leaving the arm unsupported at the side produced an even larger difference. Systolic pressure was overestimated by 6.5 mmHg, while diastolic pressure was overestimated by 4.4 mmHg.
paras.zh: 让手臂在侧面不受支撑会产生更大的差异。收缩压被高估了 6.5 mmHg，而舒张压被高估了 4.4 mmHg。

paras.en: A difference large enough to affect diagnosis
paras.zh: 差异大到足以影响诊断

paras.en: "If you are consistently measuring blood pressure with an unsupported arm, and that gives you an overestimated BP of 6.5 mmHg, that's a potential difference between a systolic BP of 123 and 130, or 133 and 140 -- which is considered stage 2 hypertension," says Sherry Liu, M.H.S., an epidemiology research coordinator at the Welch Center for Prevention, Epidemiology, and Clinical Research, Department of Epidemiology, at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health and study author.
paras.zh: 韦尔奇预防、流行病学和临床中心的流行病学研究协调员 Sherry Liu, M.H.S. 表示：“如果您一直用无支撑的手臂测量血压，那么您的血压会被高估为 6.5 mmHg，那么收缩压 123 和 130，或者 133 和 140 之间可能存在差异，这被认为是 2 期高血压。”约翰·霍普金斯大学彭博公共卫生学院流行病学系研究人员和研究作者。

paras.en: The investigators note that the findings may apply only to blood pressure measurements taken with automated devices. The results may not necessarily extend to readings collected with other types of blood pressure equipment.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，这些发现可能仅适用于使用自动化设备进行的血压测量。结果可能不一定适用于使用其他类型的血压设备收集的读数。

paras.en: Brady says the findings nevertheless show why clinicians should follow recommended measurement procedures more carefully. She also says patients "must advocate for themselves in the clinical setting and when measuring their BP at home."
paras.zh: 布雷迪说，尽管如此，研究结果表明为什么临床医生应该更仔细地遵循推荐的测量程序。她还表示，患者“必须在临床环境中以及在家测量血压时为自己辩护”。

paras.en: Along with Brady and Liu, authors from Johns Hopkins are Di Zhao, Ahmed Sabit, Chathurangi Pathiravasan, Junichi Ishigami, Jeanne Charleston, Edgar Miller III, Kunihiro Matsushita and Lawrence Appel.
paras.zh: 除 Brady 和 Liu 之外，来自约翰·霍普金斯大学的作者还有赵迪、Ahmed Sabit、Chathurangi Pathiravasan、Junichi Ishigami、Jeanne Charleston、Edgar Miller III、Kunihiro Matsushita 和 Lawrence Appel。

paras.en: This study was supported by Resolve to Save Lives, which is funded by Bloomberg Philanthropies, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and Gates Philanthropy Partners, which is funded with support from the Chan Zuckerberg Foundation.
paras.zh: 这项研究得到了“决心拯救生命”项目的支持，该项目由彭博慈善基金会、比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会和盖茨慈善合作伙伴资助，该项目得到了陈·扎克伯格基金会的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by Johns Hopkins Medicine. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由约翰霍普金斯大学医学中心提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Hairong Liu, Di Zhao, Ahmed Sabit, Chathurangi H. Pathiravasan, Junichi Ishigami, Jeanne Charleston, Edgar R. Miller, Kunihiro Matsushita, Lawrence J. Appel, Tammy M. Brady. Arm Position and Blood Pressure Readings. JAMA Internal Medicine, 2024; 184 (12): 1436 DOI: 10.1001/jamainternmed.2024.5213
paras.zh: - 刘海蓉、赵迪、Ahmed Sabit、Chathurangi H. Pathiravasan、Junichi Ishigami、Jeanne Charleston、Edgar R. Miller、Kunihiro Matsushita、Lawrence J. Appel、Tammy M. Brady。手臂位置和血压读数。 《美国医学会杂志》内科，2024； 184 (12): 1436 DOI: 10.1001/jamainternmed.2024.5213

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation (CSF) Welcomes Two New Members
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: September 21, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome ORBITInsure and Renaissance Strategic Advisors (RSA) as its newest members. ORBITInsure joins CSF as a Space Supply Chain member, while RSA joins CSF as an Associate Member and as a member of both the Space Supply Chain Council and State and Local Council. Together, the two organizations bring expertise in space insurance and risk intelligence, as well as strategy and M&A across the aerospace, defense, and government sectors.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联盟 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 ORBITInsure 和 Renaissance Strategy Advisors (RSA) 成为其最新成员。 ORBITInsure 作为太空供应链成员加入 CSF，而 RSA 作为准会员以及太空供应链委员会和州及地方委员会的成员加入 CSF。这两个组织共同带来了太空保险和风险情报以及航空航天、国防和政府部门的战略和并购方面的专业知识。

paras.en: ORBITInsure sits between mission engineering and insurance, transforming complex technical, environmental, and operational mission data into actionable risk intelligence that enables brokers, underwriters, operators, and investors to make faster, more informed decisions across the space insurance lifecycle.
paras.zh: ORBITInsure 介于任务工程和保险之间，将复杂的技术、环境和运营任务数据转化为可操作的风险情报，使经纪人、承保人、运营商和投资者能够在整个太空保险生命周期中做出更快、更明智的决策。

paras.en: “Through our membership in the Commercial Space Federation (CSF), ORBITInsure is committed to strengthening the resilience and growth of the commercial space ecosystem by making data-driven risk transfer more accessible to emerging and established space ventures alike,” said Robert Whearty, CEO of ORBITInsure
paras.zh: ORBITInsure 首席执行官 Robert Whearty 表示：“作为商业航天联盟 (CSF) 的会员，ORBITInsure 致力于让新兴和成熟的航天企业更容易获得数据驱动的风险转移，从而增强商业航天生态系统的弹性和增长。”

paras.en: Founded in 2007, Renaissance Strategic Advisors’ (RSA) purpose is to bring clarity and confidence to its clients’ most consequential initiatives across the Aerospace, Defense, and Government sectors. RSA’s reputation is built upon leading sector expertise, a relentless adherence to rigorous analysis, and a focus on consequential outcomes.
paras.zh: Renaissance Strategy Advisors (RSA) 成立于 2007 年，其宗旨是为客户在航空航天、国防和政府部门最重要的举措带来清晰度和信心。 RSA 的声誉建立在领先的行业专业知识、对严格分析的不懈坚持以及对结果的关注之上。

paras.en: “As the leading aerospace & defense focused strategy and M&A firm, Renaissance Strategic Advisors is excited to join CSF’s Space Supply Chain Council (S2C2), where we will collaborate to solve economic challenges facing the industry and our clients. We also look forward to partnering with CSF on research, events, and providing data-driven insights to key stakeholders to help shape the future of the commercial space industry,” said Mikhail Grinberg, Senior Partner at Renaissance Strategic Advisors
paras.zh: Renaissance Strategy Advisors高级合伙人Mikhail Grinberg表示：“作为领先的航空航天和国防战略与并购公司，Renaissance Strategy Advisors很高兴加入CSF的太空供应链委员会(S2C2)，我们将在该委员会合作解决行业和客户面临的经济挑战。我们还期待与CSF在研究、活动方面进行合作，并向主要利益相关者提供数据驱动的见解，以帮助塑造商业航天行业的未来。”

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: NASA’s DAVINCI Probe Can Stand the Heat
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: The engineering development unit for NASA’s DAVINCI (Deep Atmosphere Venus Investigation of Noble gases, Chemistry, and Imaging) probe is photographed prior to a major thermal evaluation.
paras.zh: NASA 的 DAVINCI（深层大气金星稀有气体、化学和成像研究）探测器的工程开发单元在进行重大热评估之前进行了拍摄。

paras.en: The DAVINCI team put the yoga ball-sized vessel into a ceramic-lined chamber with heat-scorched walls and ratcheted up the temperature to 869 F, or 465 C, over the course of about an hour — the same pace the probe will heat up during its descent to the surface of Venus.
paras.zh: DAVINCI 团队将瑜伽球大小的容器放入陶瓷衬里的室内，室内壁被热烧焦，并在大约一个小时的时间内将温度升至 869 华氏度（即 465 摄氏度）——与探测器下降到金星表面时升温的速度相同。

paras.en: DAVINCI will study the origin, evolution, and present state of Venus in unprecedented detail to help determine whether it was once wet and habitable, like Earth.
paras.zh: 达芬奇将以前所未有的细节研究金星的起源、演化和现状，以帮助确定它是否曾经像地球一样潮湿且适合居住。

articles.title: Heading Home: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 Concludes Station Science Mission
articles.author: Chris Getteau

paras.en: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission is ending, with the crew scheduled to return in early October. NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev will head home from the International Space Station after supporting research that benefits life on Earth and prepares humans for missions into deep space.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SpaceX Crew-12 任务即将结束，机组人员计划于 10 月初返回。美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 宇航员杰西卡·梅尔 (Jessica Meir) 和杰克·海瑟薇 (Jack Hathaway)、欧洲航天局 (ESA) 宇航员索菲·阿德诺 (Sophie Adenot) 和俄罗斯航天局 (Roscosmos) 宇航员安德烈·费德亚耶夫 (Andrey Fedyaev) 在支持有益于地球生命并为人类执行深空任务做好准备的研究后，将从国际空间站启程回家。

paras.en: Here’s a look back at some of their accomplishments:
paras.zh: 以下是他们的一些成就的回顾：

paras.en: The crew members look out the window of a Dragon spacecraft during their journey to the space station, a destination that offers a unique vantage point to observe both Earth and the cosmos. Research in microgravity allows the scientific community to experiment through a new perspective, from changes in how cells behave to how materials take shape, space offers new paths to scientific discovery.
paras.zh: 在前往国际空间站的旅程中，宇航员们从龙飞船的窗外望去，这个目的地为观察地球和宇宙提供了独特的有利位置。微重力研究使科学界能够通过新的视角进行实验，从细胞行为的变化到材料形成的方式，太空为科学发现提供了新的途径。

paras.en: Learn more about research in microgravity.
paras.zh: 了解有关微重力研究的更多信息。

paras.en: Hathaway floats alongside hardware used for crystal growth experiments aboard the orbiting laboratory. Microgravity reveals new details about crystal structures, helping researchers improve the quality and stability of pharmaceuticals. Here, cancer-targeting treatments are crystallized to better understand their properties and help advance cancer therapies on Earth.
paras.zh: 海瑟薇漂浮在轨道实验室上用于晶体生长实验的硬件旁边。微重力揭示了晶体结构的新细节，帮助研究人员提高药物的质量和稳定性。在这里，癌症靶向治疗被具体化，以更好地了解其特性并帮助推进地球上的癌症治疗。

paras.en: Learn more about the Pharmaceutical In-space Laboratory (ADSEP-PIL-15).
paras.zh: 了解有关太空制药实验室 (ADSEP-PIL-15) 的更多信息。

paras.en: Meir works with cables that deliver light used to cool, trap, and study atoms inside the Cold Atom Lab. In microgravity, ultracold atoms can be observed for longer periods, giving scientists a window to peer into the quantum realm. A recent upgrade to the facility increases the number of atoms produced, providing more data to advance quantum technologies such as solar cells and the components that power cell phones and computers.
paras.zh: 梅尔使用传输光的电缆来冷却、捕获和研究冷原子实验室内的原子。在微重力下，超冷原子可以被观察更长时间，为科学家们提供了一个观察量子领域的窗口。该设施最近的升级增加了产生的原子数量，为推进太阳能电池以及为手机和计算机供电的组件等量子技术提供了更多数据。

paras.en: Adenot holds a small container that houses a bone scaffold made from wood, designed to mimic the structure of real bones and support the growth of bone cells. Since microgravity can accelerate bone loss, it offers a unique opportunity to test how well the scaffold promotes bone regeneration. Insights from this study could protect future space explorers and provide new treatment options for patients with osteoporosis, a disease that affects more than 200 million people globally.
paras.zh: Adenot 拿着一个小容器，里面装有木制的骨支架，旨在模仿真实骨骼的结构并支持骨细胞的生长。由于微重力会加速骨质流失，因此它提供了一个独特的机会来测试支架促进骨再生的效果。这项研究的见解可以保护未来的太空探索者，并为骨质疏松症患者提供新的治疗选择，这种疾病影响着全球超过 2 亿人。

paras.en: Meir sets up hardware for an investigation that studies soft materials made from tiny particles suspended in water. In microgravity, scientists can study how these particles interact and assemble into structures differently than they do on Earth. Understanding these interactions could help scientists fine-tune the texture, stability, and performance of materials used for growing plants, 3D printing, and producing pharmaceuticals.
paras.zh: 梅尔为一项研究设置了硬件，该研究研究由悬浮在水中的微小颗粒制成的软材料。在微重力下，科学家可以研究这些粒子如何相互作用并组装成与地球上不同的结构。了解这些相互作用可以帮助科学家微调用于种植植物、3D 打印和生产药品的材料的质地、稳定性和性能。

paras.en: Hathaway holds equipment to test for antibiotic-resistant bacteria aboard the space station. Some bacteria can withstand antibiotics, starvation, and disinfection, making them a concern in closed environments like spacecraft. Sequencing DNA in microgravity can reveal how resilient microbes adapt to space, helping scientists identify countermeasures to manage antibiotic‑resistant bacteria during exploration missions while also advancing efforts to combat resistance on Earth.
paras.zh: 海瑟薇在空间站上拥有测试抗生素耐药细菌的设备。有些细菌可以耐受抗生素、饥饿和消毒，这使得它们在航天器等封闭环境中成为一个问题。微重力下的 DNA 测序可以揭示微生物如何适应太空，帮助科学家确定在探索任务期间管理抗生素耐药细菌的对策，同时也推进对抗地球上耐药性的努力。

paras.en: Learn more about CS-05A: Genomic Enumeration of Antibiotic Resistance in Space (GEARS).
paras.zh: 了解有关 CS-05A 的更多信息：太空抗生素耐药性基因组计数 (GEARS)。

paras.en: Expedition 74 crew members smile among fresh produce delivered aboard NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 24 mission. Cargo flights bring critical supplies, fresh food, sweet treats, and new science to the space station. The Cygnus XL spacecraft also delivered many research projects, including an instrument that could improve space-weather modeling and a project that could help protect gut-microbiome stability on future exploration missions.
paras.zh: 74 名探险队成员在 NASA 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼商业补给服务 24 号任务中运送的新鲜农产品中微笑。货运航班将重要物资、新鲜食品、甜点和新科学带到空间站。天鹅座 XL 航天器还交付了许多研究项目，包括一个可以改进空间天气建模的仪器和一个可以帮助保护未来探索任务中肠道微生物组稳定性的项目。

paras.en: Meir works on an investigation that studies how engineered cartilage tissue develops in microgravity, which may help scientists produce medical implants that more closely resemble natural cartilage. For millions of people with cartilage injuries, space-grown tissue could offer treatment options that don’t require transplanting cartilage from another part of the body.
paras.zh: 梅尔正在进行一项研究，研究工程软骨组织如何在微重力下发育，这可能有助于科学家生产更接近天然软骨的医用植入物。对于数百万软骨损伤的人来说，太空生长的组织可以提供不需要从身体其他部位移植软骨的治疗选择。

paras.en: Learn more about Biomimetic Tissue Engineering in Microgravity for Cartilage using Aggregate Rejuvenation, Tension, and Self-Assembly (BEM-CARTS).
paras.zh: 了解有关使用骨料再生、张力和自组装的微重力软骨仿生组织工程 (BEM-CARTS) 的更多信息。

paras.en: Adenot installs the Metal 3D Printer aboard the orbital complex. Several small metal parts have already been 3D printed in microgravity and returned to Earth, where their quality is evaluated against those made on the ground. Producing metal parts on demand in space could give future crews the ability to make or replace what they need far from Earth, reducing reliance on spare parts and resupply missions.
paras.zh: Adenot 在轨道综合体上安装了金属 3D 打印机。一些小型金属部件已经在微重力下进行了 3D 打印并返回地球，并根据地面制造的部件对它们的质量进行了评估。在太空按需生产金属零件可以让未来的宇航员能够在远离地球的地方制造或更换他们需要的东西，从而减少对备件和补给任务的依赖。

paras.en: Adenot works to produce intravenous (IV) fluid on demand in microgravity. Commercial IV fluids expire after about 16 months and carrying them on long-duration missions adds weight and takes up valuable space. This system could provide a critical medical resource when resupply is limited and improve access in remote areas or during emergencies on Earth.
paras.zh: Adenot 致力于在微重力下按需生产静脉 (IV) 液体。商用静脉输液大约在 16 个月后失效，携带它们执行长期任务会增加重量并占用宝贵的空间。该系统可以在补给有限时提供关键的医疗资源，并改善偏远地区或地球紧急情况下的访问。

paras.en: Learn more about Intravenous Fluid Generation – Mini (IVGEN Mini).
paras.zh: 了解有关静脉液体生成 – 迷你 (IVGEN Mini) 的更多信息。

paras.en: Hathaway takes a selfie as Meir conducts a stem cell investigation in space. Microgravity can help produce larger numbers of clinical-grade stem cells that retain their ability to transform into other cells. Cells used in this experiment could help rebuild blood and immune systems after chemotherapy, advancing care for leukemia and other blood diseases on Earth.
paras.zh: 海瑟薇在梅尔在太空进行干细胞研究时自拍。微重力可以帮助产生大量临床级干细胞，并保留其转化为其他细胞的能力。该实验中使用的细胞可以帮助化疗后重建血液和免疫系统，从而推进对地球上白血病和其他血液疾病的治疗。

paras.en: Learn more about the Hematopoietic Stem Cell Expansion in Space: Pathfinder Investigation (InSPA-StemCellEX-H2).
paras.zh: 了解有关太空造血干细胞扩增：探路者研究 (InSPA-StemCellEX-H2) 的更多信息。

paras.en: Hathaway holds an experiment container that uses bone marrow cells to study how microgravity affects bone and muscle. The research uses structures that mimic parts of bone marrow, and some samples are exposed to vibrations that simulate exercise. Tracking changes in these cells could reveal new ways to combat bone and muscle loss during spaceflight and support bone health on Earth.
paras.zh: 海瑟薇拿着一个实验容器，使用骨髓细胞来研究微重力如何影响骨骼和肌肉。该研究使用模仿骨髓部分的结构，并且一些样本暴露于模拟运动的振动中。追踪这些细胞的变化可以揭示对抗太空飞行期间骨骼和肌肉损失并支持地球骨骼健康的新方法。

articles.title: NASA Astronaut Christina Koch to Join NFL Fans in Philadelphia
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: As part of NASA’s ongoing Inspiration Tour, NASA astronaut Christina Koch will highlight America’s strengths in space exploration and aeronautics innovation at the Philadelphia Eagles vs. Los Angeles Rams game in Philadelphia on Sunday, Oct. 4.
paras.zh: 作为 NASA 正在进行的灵感之旅的一部分，NASA 宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫 (Christina Koch) 将于 10 月 4 日周日在费城举行的费城老鹰队与洛杉矶公羊队的比赛中强调美国在太空探索和航空创新方面的优势。

paras.en: A self-proclaimed Philadelphia sports fan, Koch is an explorer and engineer who spent a total of 338 days in space across two missions, including serving as a mission specialist for the agency’s Artemis II mission earlier this year. On April 1, Koch launched from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida aboard the Orion spacecraft on top of the agency’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket as part of Artemis II. Koch and her fellow crew members completed a historic lunar flyby, marking humanity’s return to the vicinity of the Moon for the first time in more than 50 years.
paras.zh: 科赫自称是费城体育迷，也是一名探险家和工程师，他在两次太空任务中总共度过了 338 天，其中包括今年早些时候担任该机构阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的任务专家。 4 月 1 日，作为阿耳忒弥斯二号的一部分，科赫乘坐猎户座飞船从 NASA 位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心发射升空，该飞船位于该机构的 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭之上。科赫和她的船员同事完成了一次历史性的月球飞越，标志着人类 50 多年来首次重返月球附近。

paras.en: NASA team members will engage with fans at the agency’s Experience Zone, located outside the stadium from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. before the game. Fans can learn more about NASA’s return to the Moon through the agency’s Artemis program, enjoy interactive games, and capture photos at a selfie station and with a large, inflatable NASA logo.
paras.zh: NASA 团队成员将于上午 10 点至下午 1 点在体育场外的该机构体验区与粉丝互动。比赛前。粉丝们可以通过 NASA 的 Artemis 计划了解有关 NASA 重返月球的更多信息，享受互动游戏，并在带有大型充气 NASA 徽标的自拍站拍摄照片。

paras.en: With stops across the nation, NASA’s Inspiration Tour convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders to connect the agency with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space.
paras.zh: NASA 的灵感之旅在全国各地停靠，聚集了学术界、工业界和公共部门的利益相关者，将该机构与推动美国在太空领域发挥领导作用的人员、技术和组织联系起来。

paras.en: The tour will culminate in MAX POWER, a public exposition of American air and space innovation, Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8, on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Held in honor of America’s historic 250th anniversary, the multi-day, family-friendly event will showcase the next-generation aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous vehicles, and technologies that will help define the future of transportation in air and space.
paras.zh: 此次巡演将在 MAX POWER 上达到高潮，这是一场美国航空航天创新的公开展览，将于 11 月 7 日星期六和 11 月 8 日星期日在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心及其附近举行。为纪念美国历史性的 250 周年而举办的这项为期多天、适合家庭的活动将展示下一代飞机、航天器、自动驾驶汽车以及有助于定义航空和太空运输未来的技术。

paras.en: For more information about MAX POWER and the agency’s missions, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 MAX POWER 和该机构使命的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / jessica.c.taveau@nasa.gov
paras.zh: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / jessica.c.taveau@nasa.gov

articles.title: Ukraine war ‘a human rights catastrophe’ that must end, says Türk

paras.en: Ukraine war ‘a human rights catastrophe’ that must end, says Türk
paras.zh: 图尔克表示，乌克兰战争是一场必须结束的“人权灾难”

paras.en: The war in Ukraine is a human rights catastrophe that is “growing and intensifying by the week” and threatening an even greater disaster across the region, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周五表示，乌克兰战争是一场人权灾难，“这一灾难正在日益加剧并加剧”，并有可能在整个地区引发更大的灾难。

paras.en: Addressing the Human Rights Council in Geneva, Mr. Türk said his office had verified some 15,280 civilians killed and injured in Ukraine during the first eight months of this year – on average more than 400 every week, and 55 per cent more than in the same period in 2025.
paras.zh: 图尔克在日内瓦人权理事会发表讲话时表示，他的办公室已核实今年前 8 个月在乌克兰约有 15,280 名平民伤亡，平均每周超过 400 人，比 2025 年同期增加了 55%。

paras.en: “The full-scale invasion unleashed by the Russian Federation is killing and injuring hundreds of people every week, as frontlines barely move,” he said, noting that apartment buildings, schools, medical centres, railways and shops had been hit in recent attacks.
paras.zh: 他说：“俄罗斯联邦发动的全面入侵每周造成数百人死伤，而前线几乎没有移动。”他指出，公寓楼、学校、医疗中心、铁路和商店在最近的袭击中都受到了袭击。

paras.en: The UN rights chief said a recent report by his office had found “shocking levels of sexual violence against civilians and prisoners of war”.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务主管表示，他的办公室最近的一份报告发现“针对平民和战俘的性暴力程度令人震惊”。

paras.en: Of more than 1,000 cases documented, 89 per cent were attributed to Russian authorities and 11 per cent to Ukraine. Most victims were men, particularly in places of detention, but women and children were also affected, primarily in occupied territory.
paras.zh: 在记录的 1000 多起案件中，89% 是俄罗斯当局所为，11% 是乌克兰当局所为。大多数受害者是男性，特别是在拘留场所，但妇女和儿童也受到影响，主要是在被占领土。

paras.en: “This is just one terrible manifestation of the cruelty that has come to define this war. Alongside peace, there must be accountability,” he said.
paras.zh: “这只是这场战争的残酷性的一个可怕表现。除了和平，还必须有问责制，”他说。

paras.en: Mr. Türk said people across Ukraine were living in constant dread, with air raid alerts in Kyiv active for 33 hours during one 48-hour period earlier this week.
paras.zh: 图尔克表示，乌克兰各地的人们一直生活在恐惧之中，本周早些时候，基辅的空袭警报在 48 小时内持续了 33 小时。

paras.en: Near the frontlines, the use of aerial glide bombs by the Russian Federation in the Donetsk, Kharkiv, Sumy and Zaporizhzhia regions killed and injured nearly 2,500 civilians in the first eight months of the year; 62 per cent more than in the same period last year.
paras.zh: 今年前八个月，俄罗斯联邦在顿涅茨克、哈尔科夫、苏梅和扎波罗热地区前线附近使用空中滑翔炸弹，造成近 2,500 名平民伤亡；比去年同期增加了 62%。

paras.en: “Ukraine is a laboratory for drone warfare,” he said, calling for urgent international action to deal with the carnage caused by these weapons around the world.
paras.zh: 他说：“乌克兰是无人机战争的实验室。”他呼吁国际社会采取紧急行动，应对这些武器在世界各地造成的屠杀。

paras.en: Attacks on energy infrastructure and commercial property have increased sharply, he said, and Russian strikes on supermarkets and food companies are already causing temporary shortages of vegetables and dairy products in some areas. “As winter approaches, Ukrainians fear the worst is yet to come.”
paras.zh: 他说，针对能源基础设施和商业地产的袭击急剧增加，俄罗斯对超市和食品公司的袭击已经导致一些地区的蔬菜和乳制品暂时短缺。 “随着冬天的临近，乌克兰人担心最糟糕的情况尚未到来。”

paras.en: An estimated 2,000 people are trapped in Oleshky without running water, electricity or gas, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，估计有 2000 人被困在奥列什基，没有自来水、电力或天然气。

paras.en: Civilian casualties in the Russian Federation have also reportedly increased, Mr. Türk said, though his Office has been unable to fully verify reports as it has not been granted access.
paras.zh: 蒂尔克表示，据报道，俄罗斯联邦的平民伤亡人数也有所增加，但他的办公室因未获准查阅而无法完全核实报告。

paras.en: He urged the Russian leadership to “consider what this war is doing to their own society”, which he said was sinking into fear, denial and a militarized economy “that puts death and destruction ahead of healthcare and education”.
paras.zh: 他敦促俄罗斯领导人“考虑这场战争对他们自己的社会造成的影响”，他说，俄罗斯社会正在陷入恐惧、否认和“将死亡和破坏置于医疗保健和教育之上”的军事化经济。

paras.en: Mr. Türk also said he was alarmed by human rights violations linked to the presence of fighters from third countries.
paras.zh: 图尔克还表示，他对来自第三国武装分子的存在所造成的侵犯人权行为感到震惊。

paras.en: His staff have interviewed prisoners of war from 36 countries held by Ukraine, many of whom said they had been deceived into joining Russian forces.
paras.zh: 他的工作人员采访了被乌克兰关押的 36 个国家的战俘，其中许多人表示他们被欺骗加入了俄罗斯军队。

paras.en: Mr. Türk called for confidence-building measures based on human rights to rebuild momentum towards negotiations.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生呼吁采取基于人权的建立信任措施，以重建谈判势头。

paras.en: These could include an agreement to end attacks on economic targets and energy infrastructure, local ceasefires on the frontlines, enabling civilians to leave – and a full exchange of prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 其中可能包括达成协议，结束对经济目标和能源基础设施的攻击、前线局部停火、允许平民离开，以及全面交换战俘。

paras.en: “To the international community, and particularly states with influence, I say: please take urgent action to push for a negotiated peace now, before this tragedy becomes even worse,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我对国际社会，特别是有影响力的国家说：请立即采取紧急行动，推动通过谈判实现和平，以免这场悲剧变得更加严重。”

articles.title: Global life expectancy bounces back to near pre-pandemic levels, WHO says

paras.en: Global life expectancy bounces back to near pre-pandemic levels, WHO says
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示，全球预期寿命反弹至接近大流行前的水平

paras.en: According to the UN health agency’s latest Global Health Estimates, life expectancy reached 73.3 years in 2023, just shy of the 73.4 years recorded in 2019.
paras.zh: 根据联合国卫生机构最新的全球健康估计，2023年人类预期寿命达到73.3岁，略低于2019年的73.4岁。

paras.en: “Living longer is one of the great achievements of public health,” said Dr. Alain Labrique, Director of WHO’s Department of Data, Digital Health, Analytics and AI.
paras.zh: “延长寿命是公共卫生的伟大成就之一，”世卫组织数据、数字健康、分析和人工智能司司长阿兰·拉布里克博士说。

paras.en: The estimates, which cover trends in death and disability worldwide by region and by country from 2000 to 2023, draw on various sources including national vital registration data and estimates from WHO technical programmes alongside UN partner organizations.
paras.zh: 这些估计涵盖了 2000 年至 2023 年全球按地区和国家的死亡和残疾趋势，利用了各种来源，包括国家人口动态登记数据以及世卫组织技术项目与联合国伙伴组织的估计。

paras.en: Healthy life expectancy – the years people live in good health – has recovered more slowly, reaching 62.8 years in 2023, still 0.4 years below its 2019 level.
paras.zh: 健康预期寿命（人们健康地生活的年限）恢复速度较慢，到 2023 年将达到 62.8 岁，仍比 2019 年的水平低 0.4 岁。

paras.en: “The next challenge is to ensure that those additional years are lived in good health, while health systems are equipped to respond to the changing needs of populations,” Dr. Labrique said.
paras.zh: 拉布里克博士说：“下一个挑战是确保这些额外的岁月能够健康地度过，同时卫生系统能够满足人口不断变化的需求。”

paras.en: The estimates also point to a long-term shift in what people die from.
paras.zh: 这些估计还表明人们的死亡原因发生了长期变化。

paras.en: In 2023, for the first time, communicable diseases – one that spreads from one person or animal to another, or from a surface to a person – accounted for less than half of all deaths in low-income countries, a further step in what WHO calls the “global epidemiological transition”.
paras.zh: 2023年，传染病——一种从一个人或动物传播到另一个人或另一个人，或从一个物体表面传播到一个人的疾病——占低收入国家所有死亡人数的一半以下，这是世卫组织所称的“全球流行病学转变”的又一步。

paras.en: Worldwide, noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) caused 74 per cent of deaths in 2023, up from 58 per cent in 2000, and eight of the world’s 10 leading causes of death were NCDs.
paras.zh: 到 2023 年，全球死亡人数中，非传染性疾病 (NCD) 占 74%，高于 2000 年的 58%，全球十大死因中有 8 个是非传染性疾病。

paras.en: Cardiovascular diseases remain the leading cause of death and disease burden. Ischaemic heart disease alone caused approximately 9.5 million deaths in 2023 and the loss of 210 million years of healthy life.
paras.zh: 心血管疾病仍然是死亡和疾病负担的主要原因。 2023 年，仅缺血性心脏病就导致约 950 万人死亡，并损失了 2.1 亿年的健康寿命。

paras.en: Many parts of the world have made substantial progress in reducing that burden since 2000, though individual risk increased in Western Pacific and Southeast Asia regions, highlighting persistent inequalities.
paras.zh: 自 2000 年以来，世界许多地区在减轻这一负担方面取得了实质性进展，但西太平洋和东南亚地区的个人风险有所增加，凸显了持续存在的不平等。

paras.en: Other chronic conditions are becoming more prominent. Dementia rose from the 19th leading cause of death globally in 2000 to the fifth in 2023, with deaths from the condition tripling over the period.
paras.zh: 其他慢性病也变得更加突出。痴呆症从 2000 年全球第 19 大死因上升到 2023 年的第 5 大死因，在此期间，痴呆症死亡人数增加了两倍。

paras.en: The risk of dying from diabetes has also risen substantially since 2000, particularly in South-East Asia.
paras.zh: 自 2000 年以来，死于糖尿病的风险也大幅上升，特别是在东南亚。

paras.en: Between 2019 and 2023, the global age-standardised rate of “healthy life” lost rose by about 20 per cent for depressive disorders and nearly 45 per cent for anxiety disorders.
paras.zh: 2019年至2023年间，全球年龄标准化的抑郁症“健康生活”损失率上升了约20%，焦虑症则上升了近45%。

paras.en: For drug use disorders, the Americas recorded the largest increases in risk of death and healthy life lost between 2000 and 2023, while the Western Pacific saw substantial declines.
paras.zh: 对于吸毒障碍，2000 年至 2023 年间，美洲的死亡和健康生命损失风险增幅最大，而西太平洋地区则大幅下降。

paras.en: “The value of these estimates is not only in the numbers themselves,” Dr. Labrique said. “By showing how causes of death and disease burden are changing over time and across populations, they give countries evidence to help shape health policies and priorities.”
paras.zh: “这些估计的价值不仅仅在于数字本身，”拉布里克博士说。 “通过显示死亡原因和疾病负担如何随着时间和人群的变化而变化，它们为各国提供了帮助制定卫生政策和优先事项的证据。”

articles.title: ‘Money alone won’t get us there’: UN steps up aid for 12 forgotten crises

paras.en: ‘Money alone won’t get us there’: UN steps up aid for 12 forgotten crises
paras.zh: “仅靠金钱无法帮助我们实现这一目标”：联合国加大对 12 个被遗忘危机的援助力度

paras.en: That was the message from UN relief chief Tom Fletcher on Friday, as the aid coordination office he runs, OCHA, released $160 million to keep life-saving help flowing in 12 of the most underfunded crises on the planet.
paras.zh: 这是联合国救援负责人汤姆·弗莱彻 (Tom Fletcher) 周五发出的信息，他负责的援助协调办公室 OCHA 拨款 1.6 亿美元，以确保在全球 12 个资金最不足的危机中提供救生援助。

paras.en: “We have 87 million people to reach, and no time to waste,” said Mr. Fletcher, the Emergency Relief Coordinator.
paras.zh: “我们有 8700 万人需要救助，没有时间可以浪费，”紧急救济协调员弗莱彻先生说。

paras.en: “Today’s new funding will help us get aid to people who might otherwise be left behind. But money alone won’t get us there: leaders must exercise political will to open access, remove obstacles and help us reach people whose lives are on the line.”
paras.zh: “今天的新资金将帮助我们向那些可能被抛在后面的人提供援助。但仅靠金钱无法帮助我们实现这一目标：领导人必须展现政治意愿，开放准入，消除障碍，帮助我们帮助那些生命垂危的人们。”

paras.en: The 87 million are the world’s needy facing the most severe crises this year.
paras.zh: 这 8700 万人是全球今年面临最严重危机的贫困人口。

paras.en: Five of the 12 crises – Afghanistan, the Occupied Palestinian Territory, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen – are among 10 contexts where Mr. Fletcher has called for urgent diplomatic action to secure access. Unlocking it would open the way to assistance for 11 million people.
paras.zh: 12 场危机中的 5 场——阿富汗、巴勒斯坦被占领土、南苏丹、苏丹和也门——属于弗莱彻先生呼吁采取紧急外交行动以确保准入的 10 种情况之一。解锁它将为 1100 万人提供援助。

paras.en: The bulk of the allocation, $150 million, comes from the UN’s Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF) and will be shared out as follows:
paras.zh: 大部分拨款 1.5 亿美元来自联合国中央应急基金 (CERF)，分配方式如下：

paras.en: - Afghanistan, the Occupied Palestinian Territory and Yemen: $18 million each
paras.zh: - 阿富汗、巴勒斯坦被占领土和也门：各 1,800 万美元

paras.en: - Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger: $10 million each
paras.zh: - 布基纳法索、马里和尼日尔：各 1000 万美元

paras.en: A further $10 million is set aside for people with disabilities in the same 12 crises, so that aid reaches them and works for them.
paras.zh: 另外还为这 12 场危机中的残疾人预留了 1000 万美元，以便援助能够到达并为他们服务。

paras.en: CERF is teaming up with the UN Global Disability Fund, which will add up to $4 million in funding and technical support through its Inclusion Catalyst Hub.
paras.zh: 中央应急基金正在与联合国全球残疾基金合作，该基金将通过其包容性催化剂中心提供高达 400 万美元的资金和技术支持。

paras.en: Part of that will go towards strengthening local organizations of people with disabilities and their role in the response.
paras.zh: 其中一部分将用于加强当地残疾人组织及其在应对行动中的作用。

paras.en: CERF, managed by OCHA, is one of the fastest funding tools available. Allocations for underfunded emergencies rest on analysis of more than 100 humanitarian indicators and wide consultation with partners.
paras.zh: 由人道协调厅管理的中央应急基金是最快的筹资工具之一。针对资金不足的紧急情况的拨款取决于对 100 多项人道主义指标的分析以及与合作伙伴的广泛协商。

paras.en: Friday’s release takes CERF allocations in 2026 to $483 million.
paras.zh: 周五公布的数据显示，中央应急基金 2026 年拨款达到 4.83 亿美元。

paras.en: Since the General Assembly created it in 2005, the fund has channelled some $10.2 billion to hundreds of millions of people in more than 117 countries and territories, thanks to 135 Member States and observers, along with private donors and individuals. Its annual funding target is $1 billion.
paras.zh: 自大会于 2005 年设立以来，在 135 个会员国和观察员以及私人捐助者和个人的帮助下，该基金已向超过 117 个国家和地区的数亿人提供了约 102 亿美元。其年度融资目标为10亿美元。

paras.zh: 世界飞镖大奖赛：詹姆斯·韦德和内森·阿斯皮纳尔在半决赛前发表声明

paras.en: James Wade faces Luke Humphries in final four after dropping just one leg in win over Gian van Veen; Nathan Aspinall averages 105.15 to set up Gerwyn Price meeting; watch the World Grand Prix semi-finals live on Saturday, from 8pm on Sky Sports+, 8.30pm on Main Event
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦德在战胜吉安·范·维恩的比赛中仅丢掉一腿，在四强赛中对阵卢克·汉弗莱斯；内森·阿斯皮纳尔 (Nathan Aspinall) 平均赔率为 105.15，以召开格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 会议；观看周六世界大奖赛半决赛直播，天空体育+晚上 8 点开始，主赛事晚上 8 点 30 分开始

paras.en: James Wade and Nathan Aspinall put in statement performances that will have made their semi-final opponents take note ahead of a mouthwatering Saturday night line-up at the World Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦德和内森·阿斯皮诺尔在周六晚上的世界大奖赛上令人垂涎欲滴的阵容中表现出色，这将使他们的半决赛对手注意到。

paras.en: Aspinall threatened to set a new tournament record average when storming to a 3-0 win over Ryan Joyce, his 105.15 mark ultimately landing as the fourth-highest in history and the best-ever in a quarter-final.
paras.zh: 阿斯皮诺尔 (Aspinall) 以 3-0 战胜瑞恩·乔伊斯 (Ryan Joyce)，威胁要创造新的赛事平均分纪录，他的 105.15 分最终成为历史第四高分，也是四分之一决赛中的最佳成绩。

paras.en: Wade, meanwhile, dropped only one leg as he, in his words, "bashed up" world No 2 Gian van Veen in a match that lasted little more than 20 minutes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，韦德只摔倒了一条腿，用他的话说，他在一场持续了 20 分钟多一点的比赛中“猛击”了世界排名第二的吉安·范维恩。

paras.en: "That really was a performance to remember from Wade," Sky Sports' Wayne Mardle said. "From start to finish, he was absolutely devastating. World Class."
paras.zh: “韦德的表现确实令人难忘，”天空体育的韦恩·马德尔说。 “从开始到结束，他绝对是毁灭性的。世界级的。”

paras.en: Three-time world champion John Part concurred with that assesment, saying: "James is not just looking like a great dart thrower to me, he's looking like a winner.
paras.zh: 三届世界冠军约翰·帕特同意这一评价，他说：“对我来说，詹姆斯不仅看起来像一个伟大的飞镖投手，他看起来就像一个胜利者。

paras.en: "I really have a lot of faith in James managing the other players, and that's what winners do. They see what they have to work with, and work against.
paras.zh: “我真的对詹姆斯管理其他球员很有信心，这就是胜利者所做的。他们看到他们必须合作和对抗的东西。

paras.en: "At the start of the match, James saw his opponent struggling and put his foot down to get the job done.
paras.zh: “比赛开始时，詹姆斯看到对手在挣扎，于是他下定决心完成任务。

paras.en: "I think he's a legitimate title contender here."
paras.zh: “我认为他是这里的合法冠军争夺者。”

paras.en: Humphries 'disappointed' despite clinching semi-final spot
paras.zh: 尽管获得半决赛席位，汉弗莱斯仍“失望”

paras.en: Wade will face former world No 1 Luke Humphries in the final four, who was, by contrast, far from convincing despite the 3-0 scoreline from his quarter-final victory over debutant Neils Zonneveld.
paras.zh: 韦德将在四强赛中迎战前世界第一卢克·汉弗里斯，相比之下，尽管他在四分之一决赛中以 3-0 的比分击败了首次亮相的尼尔斯·佐内维尔德，但他的表现还远不能令人信服。

paras.en: Humphries averaged 85.91, the same as the Dutchmand, but his clutch doubling ultimately proved the difference as the 2023 champion reached the final four for a fourth-straight year.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯场均得分为 85.91，与荷兰人相同，但他的关键加倍最终证明了差异，这位 2023 年冠军连续第四年进入四强。

paras.en: Despite that, Humphries told Sky Sports afterwards: "I'm really disappointed. I felt really good in practice, but I came out here tonight and it didn't feel great to be honest.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，汉弗莱斯赛后告诉天空体育：“我真的很失望。我在训练中感觉非常好，但今晚我来到这里，说实话感觉不太好。”

paras.en: "It kind of felt like I was the second-best player for the first two sets, but I got away with it.
paras.zh: “感觉好像我是前两盘第二好的球员，但我侥幸逃脱了。

paras.en: "It's one of those performances where you're not thrilled, but I won 3-0.
paras.zh: “这是一场你不会感到兴奋的表演，但我以 3-0 获胜。

paras.en: "Hopefully tomorrow night is a lot better, because if it isn't I won't be here on Sunday."
paras.zh: “希望明天晚上会好很多，因为如果不是这样，我周日就不会来这里了。”

paras.en: Humphries added on his semi-final opponent: "James [Wade] is a tough task in itself. He's a tough player to play against.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯在谈到他的半决赛对手时补充道：“詹姆斯（韦德）本身就是一项艰巨的任务。他是一位很难对付的球员。

paras.en: "If I score the way I know I can, then it will be a tough night for James. If I don't, it's going to be a tough night for myself."
paras.zh: “如果我按照我知道的方式得分，那么这对詹姆斯来说将是一个艰难的夜晚。如果我不这样做，这对我自己来说也将是一个艰难的夜晚。”

paras.en: Aspinall thrilled by 'one of carrer-best performances'
paras.zh: 阿斯皮诺尔对“职业生涯最佳表演之一”感到兴奋

paras.en: Aspinall will face Price in Saturday's other semi-final after The Iceman came back from two sets down to beat Jonny Clayton in an all-Welsh affair, surving three match darts before edging the contest.
paras.zh: 阿斯皮诺尔将在周六的另一场半决赛中面对普莱斯，冰人在两盘落后的情况下逆转击败乔尼·克莱顿，在全威尔士比赛中击败了乔尼·克莱顿，在比赛中取得了优势。

paras.en: But it's Aspinall who is feeling particularly bullish going into a repeat of the 2022 semi-final, which The Asp won as he finished runner-up to Michael van Gerwen that year.
paras.zh: 但阿斯皮诺尔对重演 2022 年半决赛感到特别乐观，当年阿斯皮纳尔在半决赛中击败迈克尔·范格文获得亚军。

paras.en: Aspinall's last major title came at the World Matchplay in 2023, but he's ready to change that.
paras.zh: 阿斯皮诺尔的最后一个大满贯冠军是在 2023 年的世界比洞赛上获得的，但他已经准备好改变这一状况。

paras.en: "I feel like I can win this tournament, and I feel like I'm ready to win another major again. There's no reason why I can't," Aspinall told Sky Sports after his stunning quarter-final win over Joyce.
paras.zh: “我觉得我可以赢得这场比赛，而且我觉得我已经准备好再次赢得另一场大满贯赛了。我没有理由不能，”阿斯皮诺尔在四分之一决赛击败乔伊斯后告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "I'm absolutely buzzing. All day I've felt so relaxed. I turned up tonight and felt so focussed.
paras.zh: “我真的很兴奋。一整天我都感觉很放松。今晚我出现了，感觉很专注。

paras.en: "I'm really happy with that performance. My starting, my finishing, my 180s - it's probably one of my best performances ever on stage for my whole career."
paras.zh: “我对那次表演真的很满意。我的开始，我的结束，我的 180 岁——这可能是我整个职业生涯中舞台上最好的表演之一。”

paras.en: Watch day six of the World Grand Prix live on Sky Sports+ from 8pm on Saturday and Sky Sports Main Event from 8.30pm, with coverage every day up to and including the final on Sunday. Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW.
paras.zh: 周六晚上 8 点起在天空体育+ 上观看世界大奖赛第六天的直播，晚上 8 点 30 分起在天空体育主赛事上观看直播，每天都有报道，直至周日的决赛。 NOW 提供最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播。

articles.title: Scandinavia seeks sixth Group 1 in Prix du Cadran

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Scandinavia seeks sixth Group 1 in Prix du Cadran
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：斯堪的纳维亚在 Prix du Cadran 中寻求第一组第六名

paras.en: Arc weekend gets under way at ParisLongchamp on Saturday with Gold Cup hero Scandinavia looking well-placed to land the Prix du Cadran; Ascot plays host to domestic action with Thunder Call and Mezcala in the feature contest
paras.zh: Arc 周末将于周六在巴黎隆尚 (ParisLongchamp) 拉开帷幕，金杯英雄斯堪的纳维亚 (Scandinavia) 看起来很有可能获得 Prix du Cadran；阿斯科特在专题竞赛中与 Thunder Call 和 Mezcala 一起主办国内比赛

paras.en: Scandinavia takes on Queenstown and Caballo De Mar as Arc weekend gets underway - live on Sky Sports Racing.
paras.zh: Arc 周末即将开始，斯堪的纳维亚将迎战皇后镇和卡瓦略德玛 - 天空体育赛车直播。

paras.en: 4.00 ParisLongchamp - Star stayer Scandinavia bids for a sixth Group 1 success
paras.zh: 4.00 ParisLongchamp - 斯堪的纳维亚半岛明星选手力争第六次获得一级赛冠军

paras.en: Superstar stayer Scandinavia is the headline act on Day 1 of the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe meeting. Aidan O'Brien's prolific winner heads a field of 10 for this Prix du Cadran.
paras.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚超级巨星成为卡塔尔凯旋门大奖赛第一天的头条新闻。艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 的多产获胜者在本次 Prix du Cadran 比赛中领先 10 名。

paras.en: He arrives unbeaten in his past eight starts recording a staggering five Group 1 wins in the process and looks hard to oppose as he heads up in distance once again.
paras.zh: 他在过去的八场比赛中保持不败，并在这一过程中取得了令人惊叹的五场第一组胜利，并且当他再次领先时，看起来很难对手。

paras.en: Stablemate Queenstown, the ride of Wayne Lordan, heads the likely dangers. He returned with an excellent victory in Group 3 company at the Curragh in August before chasing home Scandinavia in the Irish St Leger. Third in this race last year, he could hit the frame once more.
paras.zh: 韦恩·洛丹 (Wayne Lordan) 的马厩皇后镇 (Queenstown) 将面临可能的危险。 8 月，他在克拉格球场 (Curragh) 的第 3 组比赛中取得了出色的胜利，随后在爱尔兰圣莱杰 (Irish St Leger) 赛上追回斯堪的纳维亚半岛。去年在这场比赛中获得第三名，他可以再次击中框架。

paras.en: - Ground to suit Maltese Cross' Arc bid, says Haggas
paras.zh: - 哈加斯表示，地面适合马耳他十字的弧线竞标

paras.en: - Who wins the Arc? Jamie Lynch's big-race runner guide
paras.zh: - 谁赢得了弧线？杰米·林奇的大型跑步者指南

paras.en: George Scott's defending champion Caballo De Mar cannot be ruled out after bouncing back to form with a comfortable success in the Doncaster Cup, while Double Major is the pick of the bigger prices.
paras.zh: 乔治·斯科特 (George Scott) 的卫冕冠军卡巴洛·德马尔 (Caballo De Mar) 在唐卡斯特杯 (Doncaster Cup) 中轻松恢复状态并取得成功后，不能排除他的参赛资格，而双大满贯赛则是价格更高的球员的选择。

paras.en: 3.25 ParisLongchamp - Top fillies Sunly and Waardah lock horns
paras.zh: 3.25 ParisLongchamp - 顶级母马 Sunly 和 Waardah 锁角

paras.en: Classy pair Sunly and Wardaah headline a field of 11 for this Group 1 Prix de Royallieu.
paras.zh: 优雅的 Sunly 和 Wardaah 组合在本次 1 组 Prix de Royallieu 比赛中成为 11 名参赛选手中的佼佼者。

paras.en: Francis-Henri Graffard skipped the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in favour of this contest and his charge Sunly will be a short price to land a maiden top-level success under Christophe Soumillon. She could outclass her rivals if staying this extra yardage.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德（Francis-Henri Graffard）跳过了凯旋门大奖赛，转而参加了这场比赛，而他所率领的桑利（Sunly）将很快在克里斯托夫·苏米永（Christophe Soumillon）的带领下首次获得顶级赛事的胜利。如果保持这个额外的码数，她就可以超越她的对手。

paras.en: Wardaah took the Park Hill Stakes at Doncaster on her last start, beating Consent and Cameo in the process and looks ready for a crack at this better grade.
paras.zh: 瓦尔达（Wardaah）在唐卡斯特（Doncaster）的帕克山锦标赛（Park Hill Stakes）上一场比赛中获胜，击败了康森特（Consent）和卡梅奥（Cameo），看起来已经准备好迎接更好的成绩。

paras.en: Consent saw off Santorini Star to land this race last season and, after finishing fourth at Goodwood and third at Doncaster, she seems to be progressing with each outing.
paras.zh: 上赛季，Consent 击败了 Santorini Star 参加了这场比赛，在古德伍德获得第四名、唐卡斯特获得第三名之后，她似乎每场比赛都在进步。

paras.en: Ribblesdale winner Earth Shot is another who makes each-way appeal in a stellar field.
paras.zh: 里布尔斯代尔 (Ribblesdale) 冠军地球射击 (Earth Shot) 是另一位在恒星领域中展现单向吸引力的选手。

paras.en: 3.35 Ascot - Thunder Call and Mezcala headline 18 runners
paras.zh: 3.35 Ascot - Thunder Call 和 Mezcala 头条 18 名参赛者

paras.en: A typically competitive edition of the BetMGM Challenge Cup where Thunder Call and Mezcala will be fancied in a field of 18.
paras.zh: 这是 BetMGM 挑战杯的典型竞争版本，Thunder Call 和 Mezcala 将在 18 名参赛者中脱颖而出。

paras.en: The William Haggas-trained Thunder Call handled the step up to seven furlongs when easily disposing of a good field over this course and distance last month and should have more to give despite a tricky draw in stall one.
paras.zh: 威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 训练的“雷霆召唤”(Thunder Call) 上个月在这条赛道和距离上轻松处理了一个不错的场地，从而处理了长达 7 弗隆的台阶，尽管在第一个摊位上遇到了棘手的平局，但应该还有更多的表现。

paras.en: Jack Channon saddles Mezcala, who landed the Buckingham Palace Stakes over this trip and track at the Royal meeting and has been dropped 1lb for his latest sixth at Doncaster.
paras.zh: 杰克·查农 (Jack Channon) 为梅斯卡拉 (Mezcala) 提供鞍座，梅斯卡拉 (Mezcala) 在这次旅行和皇家会议上获得了白金汉宫锦标赛冠军，并在唐卡斯特 (Doncaster) 的最新第六场比赛中减重 1 磅。

paras.en: Several have place chances including course specialist Hickory, while George Boughey's Moonfall took the Britannia here, caught the eye at Doncaster last time, but must prove he can handle to dip to seven furlongs.
paras.zh: 包括球场专家 Hickory 在内的几位球员都有机会，而 George Boughey 的 Moonfall 则带领不列颠尼亚号来到这里，上次在唐卡斯特引起了人们的注意，但他必须证明他能够应对下降到七弗隆的情况。

paras.en: Having faltered in the St Leger last time out, Pierre Bonnard will be looking to bonce back when he goes to post for the Group 2 Prix Chaudenay at 12.23pm. The son of Camelot was only beaten two lengths by Arc hopeful Maltese Cross in the Great Voltigeur and looks the class act of the field. In opposition, Space Waltz represents the formidable Fabre team while Amy Murphy saddles the hat-trick-seeking Victoire Magique.
paras.zh: 皮埃尔·博纳尔 (Pierre Bonnard) 上次在圣莱热 (St Leger) 表现不佳，他希望在下午 12 点 23 分参加第 2 组肖德奈大奖赛 (Chaudenay Prix Chaudenay) 比赛时能东山再起。 “卡米洛特之子”在伟大的伏尔蒂格赛中只被充满希望的“马耳他十字”击败了两个马位，看起来是赛场上的佼佼者。在对手中，太空华尔兹代表着强大的法布尔队，而艾米·墨菲则为寻求帽子戏法的维克多·马奎克队上演帽子戏法。

paras.en: Wimbledon Hawkeye and Phineas clash in the subsequent Group 2 Prix Dollar, with the former horse arguably unlucky to have been denied in the Irish Champion Stakes last time. Phineas has won four on the spin and looks to be a real talent for the Fabre operation, while Distant Storm represents Charlie Appleby and Godolphin once more after success at Deauville last time.
paras.zh: 温布尔登鹰眼和菲尼亚斯在随后的第 2 组美元大奖赛中发生冲突，前一匹马可以说很不幸地在爱尔兰冠军锦标赛中被拒绝。菲尼亚斯在旋转中赢得了四场胜利，看起来是法布尔行动的真正天才，而《遥远的风暴》继上次在多维尔取得成功后再次代表查理·阿普尔比和戈多芬。

paras.en: Quddwah tops the runners assembled for the 4.35pm Prix Daniel Wildenstein, while Fallen Angel and 2025 Sussex Stakes winner Qirat line up to take him on.
paras.zh: Quddwah 在下午 4.35 举行的 Daniel Wildenstein 大奖赛中名列前茅，而 Fallen Angel 和 2025 年苏塞克斯锦标赛冠军 Qirat 则排队与他较量。

paras.en: The John and Thady Gosden-trained So Regal looks the pick of the runners declared for Ascot's 1.15pm BetMGM British EBF October Stakes, having ran with credit in Group 3 company when last seen. Of the others, three-time winner Secret History could be the chief threat, despite not running to her optimum level in a competitive York handicap in August.
paras.zh: 接受过 John 和 Thady Gosden 训练的 So Regal 看起来是阿斯科特下午 1.15 点 BetMGM 英国 EBF 十月锦标赛宣布的参赛选手之一，上次出现时他在第 3 组公司中获得了荣誉。在其他选手中，三届冠军“秘史”可能是主要威胁，尽管她在八月份的约克让分赛中没有发挥出最佳水平。

paras.en: Tuco Salamanca and Regional lock horns in the five-furlong BetMGM Rous Stakes (1.50pm) before crowd favourite Al Aasy faces five rivals in the BetMGM Cumberland Lodge Stakes (2.25pm). A hardy individual, he showed real tenacity to defeat Chestnut Rocket - who lines up in Sunday's Arc - at Deauville when last seen.
paras.zh: Tuco Salamanca 和 Regional 在五弗长的 BetMGM Rous Stakes（下午 1.50）中展开激烈角逐，之后，深受观众喜爱的 Al Aasy 在 BetMGM Cumberland Lodge Stakes（下午 2.25）中将与五位对手对决。他是一个坚强的人，最后一次出现在多维尔时，他表现出了真正的毅力，击败了周日弧线比赛中的栗子火箭队。

paras.en: It's Prince Of India versus Division in the 3pm John Guest Racing Bengough Stakes, with the latter favourite in the market after being narrowly beaten by Samangan in France recently.
paras.zh: 这是下午 3 点举行的 John Guest Racing Bengough Stakes 比赛中印度王子队 (Prince Of India) 对阵分区队 (Division) 的比赛，后者最近在法国以微弱优势被萨曼根 (Samangan) 击败，成为市场上最受欢迎的球队。

paras.en: Fontwell and Southwell open their gates for action over jumps and on the Flat, with 15 races scheduled between them.
paras.zh: Fontwell 和 Southwell 为障碍赛和平地上的比赛敞开了大门，他们之间安排了 15 场比赛。

paras.en: The day begins with three Group 1 contests from Australia, with Sir Delius and Aeliana involved in Flemington's 7.25am Turnball Stakes after top clashes from Randwick earlier in the morning.
paras.zh: 这一天从来自澳大利亚的三场第一组比赛开始，在早上早些时候兰德威克的顶级比赛之后，德利厄斯爵士和艾莉安娜参加了弗莱明顿上午 7.25 的特恩鲍尔锦标赛。

paras.en: A Grade 2 runner-up earlier in the campaign, Francis-Henri Graffard's Mandanaba eyes a return to the winners' enclosure when she contests the 9.44pm First Lady Stakes. Classic Q is partnered with John Velazquez for this step up to Grade 1 company here, while stablemate And One More Time seeks a hat-trick for Mark Casse.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德 (Francis-Henri Graffard) 的曼达纳巴 (Mandanaba) 曾在竞选初期获得二级亚军，她希望在晚上 9 点 44 分的“第一夫人锦标赛”中重返获胜者名单。 Classic Q 与 John Velazquez 合作，在这里晋升为一级公司，而稳定伙伴 And One More Time 则为 Mark Casse 寻求帽子戏法。

paras.en: American History looked to have the makings of a real star when bolting up on debut by eight lengths. Todd Pletcher's charge returns to action in the Claiborne Breeders' Futurity - a Grade 1 for two-year-olds.
paras.zh: 《美国历史》在首次亮相时就以八个长度领先，看起来具备成为真正明星的素质。托德·普莱彻 (Todd Pletcher) 的负责人在克莱本育马者未来赛 (Claiborne Breeders' Futurity) 中重返赛场 - 两岁马一级赛。

paras.en: Purview takes on Ancient Egypt in the Grade 1 Canadian International from Woodbine before attention switches back to the United States and Keeneland's Coolmore Turf Mile. Lake Forest flies the flag for the Haggas stable in here, with Cieren Fallon booked to ride.
paras.zh: Purview 在一级加拿大国际赛中从 Woodbine 迎战古埃及，然后注意力转移回美国和基恩兰的库尔莫尔草坪英里赛。森林湖 (Lake Forest) 悬挂着哈加斯 (Haggas) 马厩的旗帜，西伦·法伦 (Cieren Fallon) 已预订骑行。

articles.title: How the eviction of an 87-year-old became Spain's 'last straw'
articles.author: Tessa Flemming

paras.en: It was an image of an 87-year-old woman on a stretcher, wheeled out by paramedics, that sparked a national movement.
paras.zh: 一张躺在担架上的 87 岁妇女被护理人员推出的照片引发了一场全国性的运动。

paras.en: Maricarmen Abascal had lived in her Madrid apartment for more than 70 years.
paras.zh: Maricarmen Abascal 在她位于马德里的公寓里住了 70 多年。

paras.en: She took over the lease her father signed in 1956, and enjoyed capped rent.
paras.zh: 她接手了父亲1956年签署的租约，并享受租金上限。

paras.en: Then, in 2018, her apartment was bought by an investment firm.
paras.zh: 然后，2018年，她的公寓被一家投资公司买下了。

paras.en: The monthly rent soon soared from €500 ($811) to €1,650 ($2,678).
paras.zh: 月租金很快从 500 欧元（811 美元）飙升至 1,650 欧元（2,678 美元）。

paras.en: And Maricarmen, a pensioner with a disability whose monthly benefits total €1,350 ($2,192), was forced out in a court-ordered eviction.
paras.zh: Maricarmen 是一名残疾养老金领取者，每月福利总额为 1,350 欧元（2,192 美元），在法院下令驱逐中被迫离开。

paras.en: For Spaniards, the eviction stirred up a deep-seated anger over a housing crisis that has only worsened in recent years.
paras.zh: 对于西班牙人来说，驱逐激起了人们对住房危机的根深蒂固的愤怒，而这种危机近年来不断恶化。

paras.en: Previously, protests included flotillas in the path of cruise ships and water pistol protests, as locals blamed tourism for housing unaffordability.
paras.zh: 此前，抗议活动包括船队挡住游轮航线和水枪抗议，当地人将住房负担不起归咎于旅游业。

paras.en: But it is Maricarmen's plight that could be the catalyst for real change to protect renters.
paras.zh: 但马里卡门的困境可能成为保护租房者的真正变革的催化剂。

paras.en: Days before her eviction, Maricarmen walked writer David Uclés through her Retiro home of more than seven decades.
paras.zh: 在被驱逐的前几天，马里卡门带着作家大卫·尤克莱斯参观了她在雷蒂罗居住了七十多年的家。

paras.en: She showed him the living room where she watched the coverage of former Spanish leader and dictator Francisco Franco's death in 1975.
paras.zh: 她带他参观了客厅，在那里她观看了 1975 年西班牙前领导人兼独裁者弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥去世的报道。

paras.en: She showed him the bedrooms where her mother and father drew their final breaths.
paras.zh: 她带他参观了她父母最后呼吸的卧室。

paras.en: "I've always felt safe here," she told Uclés and Spanish newspaper El País.
paras.zh: “我在这里一直感到安全，”她告诉尤克莱斯和西班牙报纸《国家报》。

paras.en: "My home has been everything to me. I wouldn't exist without it."
paras.zh: “我的家就是我的一切。没有它我就不会存在。”

paras.en: The apartment in the upscale central Madrid suburb has been Maricarmen's sanctuary since she was 17.
paras.zh: 这套位于马德里市中心高档郊区的公寓从 Maricarmen 17 岁起就成了她的庇护所。

paras.en: But for the past eight years, it has also turned into a battleground in her David-and-Goliath fight.
paras.zh: 但在过去的八年里，这里也变成了她以弱胜强的战场。

paras.en: After real estate investment company Urbagestión took over Maricarmen's lease in 2018, it first attempted to raise the rent to €2,650 ($4,313) — a 300 per cent increase.
paras.zh: 房地产投资公司 Urbagestión 于 2018 年接管 Maricarmen 的租约后，首先尝试将租金提高至 2,650 欧元（4,313 美元），涨幅达 300%。

paras.en: That was later decreased to €1,650 ($2,678).
What followed was a drawn-out court feud over the new contract.
paras.zh: 接下来是围绕新合同的旷日持久的法庭争执。

paras.en: Three previous attempts to evict her were blocked by the courts. And with each appeal by Urbagestión, public attention on the case grew.
paras.zh: 此前三次驱逐她的尝试均被法院阻止。随着 Urbagestión 的每一次上诉，公众对此案的关注度都在增加。

paras.en: In June, the UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights called for the pensioner's eviction to be halted and for her to be offered affordable alternative accommodation.
paras.zh: 六月，联合国经济、社会和文化权利委员会呼吁停止驱逐这位养老金领取者，并为她提供负担得起的替代住所。

paras.en: Madrid City Council said later that Maricarmen had declined its offer of a place in an aged care home.
paras.zh: 马德里市议会后来表示，马里卡门拒绝了其在老年护理院提供的住宿机会。

paras.en: Then, in late September, the courts ruled in Urbagestión's favour.
paras.zh: 然后，在 9 月下旬，法院做出了有利于 Urbagestión 的裁决。

paras.en: A groundswell of protesters gathered at Maricarmen's address to protect the pensioner.
paras.zh: 大批抗议者聚集在马里卡门的演讲前，以保护这位养老金领取者。

paras.en: "Fight for your housing because we have the right to it," she told the crowd of hundreds on September 22.
paras.zh: 9 月 22 日，她对数百人说：“为你们的住房而战，因为我们有权获得它。”

paras.en: The next morning, police officers beat down Maricarmen's door.
paras.zh: 第二天早上，警察敲开了马里卡门的门。

paras.en: Reporters were cordoned off, and several demonstrators were dragged away.
paras.zh: 记者被封锁，几名示威者被拖走。

paras.en: Over the past decade, the average rental price per square metre in Spain has almost doubled, reaching €15.10 ($24.62) per square metre in August, according to real estate portal Idealista.
paras.zh: 根据房地产门户网站 Idealista 的数据，在过去十年中，西班牙每平方米的平均租金价格几乎翻了一番，8 月份达到每平方米 15.10 欧元（24.62 美元）。

paras.en: The Bank of Spain estimates that the country of about 50 million people is short of 700,000 homes, based on the gap between demand and new construction.
paras.zh: 西班牙央行根据需求与新建房屋之间的差距估计，这个拥有约 5000 万人口的国家缺少 70 万套住房。

paras.en: Social housing in Spain makes up less than 2 per cent of the housing stock, according to Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development data.
paras.zh: 根据经济合作与发展组织的数据，西班牙的社会住房仅占住房存量的不到 2%。

paras.en: The European Union average is about 6–7 per cent.
paras.zh: 欧盟的平均水平约为 6-7%。

paras.en: Protesters did not back down as Maricarmen recovered in hospital.
paras.zh: 当马里卡门在医院康复时，抗议者并没有退缩。

paras.en: Instead, they built a tent encampment in Puerta del Sol, one of Madrid's busiest landmarks.
paras.zh: 相反，他们在马德里最繁忙的地标之一太阳门搭建了一个帐篷营地。

paras.en: "Maricarmen is one person, but there are many people in this situation," one protester said.
paras.zh: 一名抗议者说：“马里卡门是一个人，但有很多人处于这种情况。”

paras.en: "We want the right to decent housing for all."
paras.zh: “我们希望所有人都有权获得体面的住房。”

paras.en: A 43-year-old teacher, Simón de la Riva, said: "Maricarmen has been, in a way, the last straw that sparked this social unrest, but we've been dealing with this whole issue for a long time now."
paras.zh: 43 岁的教师西蒙·德拉里瓦 (Simón de la Riva) 表示：“从某种程度上来说，马里卡门是引发这场社会动荡的最后一根稻草，但我们已经处理这整个问题很长时间了。”

paras.en: The encampment was led largely by Madrid's Tenant Union, with aims set out by spokesperson Valeria Racu.
paras.zh: 该营地主要由马德里租户联盟领导，其目标由发言人瓦莱里娅·拉库（Valeria Racu）制定。

paras.en: Either the investment rental falls or the government falls: "Let it be very clear," she said.
paras.zh: 要么投资租金下降，要么政府垮台：“说得非常清楚，”她说。

paras.en: Spain is expected to head to an election in less than 12 months.
paras.zh: 预计西​​班牙将在不到 12 个月的时间内举行大选。

paras.en: Still facing heat over the Ceuta crisis, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has told the public he is working "against the clock" to bring new housing regulations into law.
paras.zh: 仍面临休达危机的压力，总理佩德罗·桑切斯告诉公众，他正在“争分夺秒”地将新的住房法规纳入法律。

paras.en: The new decrees would be "for Maricarmen and for the millions of Spaniards who are suffering from the housing crisis".
paras.zh: 新法令将“为了马里卡门和数百万遭受住房危机的西班牙人”。

paras.en: "This is not a question of ideology; it is a question of humanity,"
paras.zh: “这不是意识形态问题，而是人性问题”

paras.en: "We didn't think this was going to happen because situations like this happen all the time," Urbagestión co-owner Ricardo Alonso told conservative outlet Horizonte.
paras.zh: Urbagestión 共同所有人里卡多·阿隆索 (Ricardo Alonso) 告诉保守派媒体 Horizo​​nte：“我们认为这种情况不会发生，因为这样的情况一直在发生。”

paras.en: He said protesters had pursued and overwhelmed the company.
paras.zh: 他说，抗议者追赶并淹没了该公司。

paras.en: After five days of protest and more than four hours of meetings, Urbagestión offered Maricarmen a new eight-year rental contract on September 28.
paras.zh: 经过五天的抗议和四个多小时的会议，Urbagestión 于 9 月 28 日向 Maricarmen 提供了一份新的八年租赁合同。

paras.en: The contract came with a capped rent that would not exceed 30 per cent of her net income, similar to what she paid before the company took over in 2018.
paras.zh: 该合同附带的租金上限不会超过她净收入的 30%，与 2018 年公司接管之前她支付的租金类似。

paras.en: Mr Sánchez followed shortly after, with two new housing measures.
paras.zh: 桑切斯先生紧随其后，推出了两项新的住房措施。

paras.en: Among his promises were plans to stop "vulture funds" from buying in bulk then reselling properties at higher prices; an eviction ban on vulnerable tenants until 2030; and a new tax on seasonal rentals.
paras.zh: 他的承诺包括计划阻止“秃鹫基金”大量购买房产然后以更高的价格转售； 2030 年之前禁止驱逐弱势租户；以及针对季节性租金的新税。

paras.en: But Spain's Congress on Friday rejected those measures, heightening speculation that Mr Sánchez, who does not have a congressional majority, may call an early general election.
paras.zh: 但西班牙国会周五拒绝了这些措施，加剧了人们对桑切斯先生可能会提前举行大选的猜测，桑切斯先生在国会中不占多数。

paras.en: Madrid's tent encampment shows no sign of packing up.
paras.zh: 马德里的帐篷营地没有任何收拾行李的迹象。

paras.en: Elsewhere, more tent cities are popping up across Spain — in Barcelona, Seville and even the tourist mecca of Palma de Mallorca, in the Balearic Islands.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，更多的帐篷城市正在西班牙各地涌现——巴塞罗那、塞维利亚，甚至巴利阿里群岛的旅游圣地马略卡岛帕尔马。

paras.en: In Madrid, the tenants' union said mass protests would go ahead on Saturday, local time, while crowds had already met outside Spain's assembly chanting "your profits, our misery", according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，在马德里，租户工会表示大规模抗议活动将于当地时间周六继续进行，而人群已经聚集在西班牙议会外，高呼“你的利润，我们的苦难”。

paras.en: "There are years when nothing happens, and weeks when history is made. This could be one of them," the union said in a statement.
paras.zh: 工会在一份声明中表示：“有几年什么都没有发生，有几周创造历史。这可能就是其中之一。”

paras.en: From her hospital bed, Maricarmen continued to champion those who had supported her.
paras.zh: 在病床上，马里卡门继续支持那些支持她的人。

paras.en: "I have fought so that others can learn to fight for what's theirs," she said.
paras.zh: “我奋斗是为了让其他人能够学会为属于他们的东西而奋斗，”她说。

paras.en: It is a fight symbolic of the slogan some have used in the days since the pensioner's eviction.
paras.zh: 这是一场象征着自养老金领取者被驱逐以来一些人使用的口号的斗争。

paras.en: A slogan that hints this fight is anything but over.
paras.zh: 这句口号暗示这场战斗还没有结束。

paras.en: "Until the end comrades, as Maricarmen has taught us."
paras.zh: “直到最后，同志们，正如马里卡门教给我们的那样。”

articles.title: Australian arrested for holding 'pistol-like object' in Hong Kong

paras.en: An Australian man has been arrested after being spotted with a "pistol-like object" in a bar in Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子在香港一家酒吧被发现携带“手枪状物体”后被捕。

paras.en: The Hong Kong Police Force alleges the man then damaged a wall and a smoke detector while in custody.
paras.zh: 香港警务处称，该男子在拘留期间损坏了墙壁和烟雾探测器。

paras.en: An expert says possession of an imitation firearm carries a maximum penalty of two years' imprisonment.
paras.zh: 一位专家表示，拥有仿制枪支最高可判处两年监禁。

paras.en: An Australian man has been in custody in Hong Kong after being arrested on suspicion of carrying what appeared to be a gun and causing property damage.
paras.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子因涉嫌携带疑似枪支并造成财产损失而被捕，目前在香港被拘留。

paras.en: The Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) deployed counterterrorism officers and the Emergency Unit, after reports the 36-year-old tourist was "holding a pistol-like object" on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，有报道称这名 36 岁的游客“持有手枪状物体”，香港警务处 (HKPF) 部署了反恐人员和冲锋队。

paras.en: Pictures seen by the ABC showed the man with his face covered by a black hood as he was taken away in a police vehicle in the district of Jordan.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司看到的照片显示，这名男子在约旦地区被一辆警车带走，他的脸被黑色头罩遮住。

paras.en: Despite multiple local media reports that the object seized was a "toy gun", the ABC could not independently verify the claim.
paras.zh: 尽管多家当地媒体报道称查获的物品是一把“玩具枪”，但澳大利亚广播公司无法独立核实这一说法。

paras.en: In a statement to the ABC, a spokesperson for HKPF confirmed the man has been charged with one count of possession of an imitation firearm and one count of criminal damage.
paras.zh: 香港警察发言人在给澳大利亚广播公司的一份声明中证实，该男子已被指控一项持有仿制枪支罪和一项刑事毁坏罪。

paras.en: "Police officers arrived at the scene and a suspected air gun was seized," a HKPF spokesperson told ABC News.
paras.zh: 香港警察发言人告诉美国广播公司新闻：“警察到达现场，缴获了一把疑似气枪。”

paras.en: "While in custody at Yau Ma Tei Police Station, he damaged a wall and a smoke detector, leading to an additional offence of criminal damage."
paras.zh: “在油麻地警署羁押期间，他损坏了墙壁和烟雾探测器，导致追加刑事毁坏罪。”

paras.en: The case will be mentioned at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today.
paras.zh: 案件将于今日在西九龙裁判法院提堂。

paras.en: The Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) told the ABC it was providing consular assistance to the family of the Australian citizen.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚外交和贸易部（DFAT）告诉澳大利亚广播公司，它正在向澳大利亚公民的家人提供领事协助。

paras.en: HKPF said officers were first alerted just after 10pm on Wednesday, after the man was reportedly spotted carrying "a pistol-like object" in an alleyway near Shanghai Street in the Yau Ma Tei district of the city.
paras.zh: 香港警务处表示，周三晚上 10 点刚过，警方首次收到警报，因为据报该男子被发现在油麻地区上海街附近的一条小巷里携带“手枪状物体”。

paras.en: About 15 minutes later, police reportedly received a second report that the man had tried to enter a bar in the Jordan district.
paras.zh: 据报道，大约15分钟后，警方接到第二份报告，称该男子试图进入约旦区的一家酒吧。

paras.en: Local media outlet The Standard reported the man had entered the bar to use the toilet, but a staff member called the police and asked him to leave.
paras.zh: 当地媒体《标准报》报道称，该男子进入酒吧上厕所，但一名工作人员报了警并要求他离开。

paras.en: The outlet also reported the man was on holiday with his family and had been drinking alcohol.
paras.zh: 该媒体还报道称，该男子当时正在与家人一起度假，并且一直在喝酒。

paras.en: Hong Kong has strict laws governing firearms and imitation firearms, although toy guns are legally available in some shops.
paras.zh: 尽管玩具枪可以在一些商店合法销售，但香港对枪支和仿制枪支有严格的法律管理。

paras.en: Authorities have tightened security measures in recent years following the large-scale anti-extradition protest in 2019.
