articles.title: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter

paras.en: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter
paras.zh: 加沙：世卫组织呼吁在冬季到来之前提供大量援助

paras.en: Repeated delays in bringing lifesaving medicines, prosthetics and more from Israel into Gaza risk having devastating consequences on Palestinians who urgently need them in the war-torn enclave, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）周五表示，从以色列向加沙运送救生药品、假肢等物资的工作一再拖延，可能会对饱受战争蹂躏的飞地中迫切需要这些物资的巴勒斯坦人造成毁灭性后果。

paras.en: “A truck full of non-priority supplies or the right supplies arriving too late, doesn't save lives. That's the question that actually matters," said Dr Reinhilde Van De Weerdt, WHO Representative in the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT).
paras.zh: 世卫组织驻巴勒斯坦被占领土代表 Reinhilde Van De Weerdt 博士表示：“一辆满载非优先物资的卡车或正确的物资抵达太晚，并不能挽救生命。这是真正重要的问题。”

paras.en: Almost 12 months into a fragile ceasefire agreement between Hamas fighters and Israel marked by ongoing Israeli airstrikes and other military activity, Gaza’s humanitarian situation remains “overwhelming”, according to the UN aid coordination office, OCHA.
paras.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室人道协调厅表示，哈马斯武装分子与以色列达成脆弱的停火协议已近 12 个月，以色列持续进行空袭和其他军事活动，加沙的人道主义局势仍然“不堪重负”。

paras.en: Approved aid can only be brought into the Strip via Kerem Shalom in the southern tip of the enclave, while Rafah (also in the south) is open for the limited movement of people including patients requiring medical treatment abroad. At least four other main entry points into Gaza for aid remain closed: Kissufim, Gate 96, Erez and Erez West.
paras.zh: 批准的援助只能通过该飞地南端的凯雷姆沙洛姆进入加沙地带，而拉法（也在南部）对人员有限的流动开放，包括需要在国外接受治疗的患者。至少有四个进入加沙的援助主要入口仍然关闭：Kissufim、96 号门、埃雷兹和埃雷兹西。

paras.en: In a call to the Israeli authorities to “release the pressure on medical supplies”, Dr Van De Weerdt also stressed that essential medicines “should not be considered as dual use” – and therefore banned by Israel on the grounds that they could be used by Hamas fighters – “as they are globally accepted standards on medical items anybody needs anywhere to run a hospital or a clinic”.
paras.zh: 在呼吁以色列当局“释放医疗用品压力”时，范德韦尔特博士还强调，基本药物“不应被视为双重用途”——因此被以色列禁止，理由是它们可能被哈马斯武装分子使用——“因为它们是全球公认的医疗用品标准，任何人在任何地方经营医院或诊所都需要”。

paras.en: In the last six months, one shipment of prosthetics and assistive devices was rejected four times. "Every rejection means another delay for someone who has already lost a limb and is simply waiting for the chance to walk again," stressed the WHO official, who noted that medicines "by contrast, move relatively well", with almost 87 per cent approved and just over 1 per cent rejected.
paras.zh: 在过去六个月中，一批假肢和辅助器具被拒绝四次。这位世卫组织官员强调说：“对于已经失去肢体、只是等待再次行走机会的人来说，每一次拒绝都意味着又一次延误。”他指出，药物“相比之下，移动得相对顺利”，近 87% 的药物获得批准，略高于 1% 的药物被拒绝。

paras.en: UN aid agencies operating in Gaza still provide critical assistance to families across the Strip in coordination with the Israeli authorities, but this lifesaving work is impeded by a lack of reliable and timely access.
paras.zh: 在加沙开展行动的联合国援助机构仍在与以色列当局协调，向加沙地带的家庭提供重要援助，但这项救生工作因缺乏可靠和及时的准入而受到阻碍。

paras.en: “Our ask is simple and has not changed: we need the unimpeded and predictable entry of humanitarian and health supplies into Gaza at scale. We also need a multi-crossing model so that aid isn't forced to trickle down through a limited number of crossings,” the WHO senior official said.
paras.zh: 世卫组织高级官员表示：“我们的要求很简单，也没有改变：我们需要大规模、不受阻碍和可预测的人道主义和卫生用品进入加沙。我们还需要一种多重过境模式，这样援助就不会被迫通过有限数量的过境点流入。”

paras.en: Highlighting the “extraordinary health workers” still risking their lives to help others in Gaza, Dr Van De Weerdt said that too few supplies were reaching them and not enough patients were getting the care they needed and deserved. The already dire humanitarian situation risks getting even worse soon, once autumn ends.
paras.zh: 范德韦尔特博士强调，“杰出的卫生工作者”仍在冒着生命危险帮助加沙的其他人，他说，到达他们手中的物资太少，也没有足够的患者得到他们需要和应得的护理。秋季结束后，本已严峻的人道主义局势有可能很快变得更糟。

paras.en: “As winter begins, this urgency to get supplies into Gaza only deepens. Almost two million people are in need of shelter to protect against the cold and the risk of flooding, exposing people to serious health and safety risks, let alone [their] dignity,” the WHO official explained.
paras.zh: 世卫组织官员解释说：“随着冬季的到来，向加沙运送物资的紧迫性只会进一步加深。近200万人需要庇护所以抵御寒冷和洪水的风险，这使人们面临严重的健康和安全风险，更不用说[他们的]尊严。”

paras.en: As in previous winters in Gaza, the enclave’s residents are expected to face a heightened risk of preventable disease outbreaks, linked to the absence of safe shelter, a lack of clean water and the high number of rats, whose bites transmit infection. The destruction of public health laboratories has complicated the task of identifying potential epidemics, WHO explained.
paras.zh: 与加沙往年冬天一样，该飞地的居民预计将面临更大的可预防疾病爆发的风险，原因是缺乏安全住所、缺乏清洁水以及大量老鼠，老鼠的叮咬会传播感染。世卫组织解释说，公共卫生实验室被毁使识别潜在流行病的任务变得更加复杂。

paras.en: The development follows a warning from OCHA on Thursday about serious public health risks linked to the accumulation of solid waste in the heart of Gaza City.
paras.zh: 此前，人道主义事务协调厅周四就加沙市中心固体废物堆积所带来的严重公共卫生风险发出警告。

paras.en: Recent gains in improving sanitation in Gaza remain fragile because of a lack of reliable access to heavy machinery and equipment, OCHA explained, “or to engine oil and spare parts required to keep them running. Sustained funding for fuel is also critical.”
paras.zh: 人道协调厅解释说，由于无法可靠地获得重型机械和设备，“或者缺乏维持其运行所需的发动机油和备件”，加沙最近在改善卫生条件方面取得的进展仍然脆弱。持续的燃料资金也至关重要。

paras.en: Meanwhile, mine action partners reported that they still lack “permissions and equipment” to remove unexploded ordnance hazards identified in the rubble during 37 assessment missions.
paras.zh: 与此同时，排雷行动合作伙伴报告称，他们仍然缺乏“许可和设备”来清除 37 次评估任务期间在废墟中发现的未爆炸弹药危险。

articles.title: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis

paras.en: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis
paras.zh: 也门战事升级加剧粮食安全危机

paras.en: Fighting between Government forces and Houthi rebels along the southwestern coast has forced nearly 150,000 people from their homes, disrupted markets and restricted humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 政府军与胡塞叛乱分子在西南海岸发生的战斗迫使近 15 万人逃离家园，扰乱市场并限制人道主义援助准入。

paras.en: “What is beginning as a hunger crisis in Yemen could certainly compound a greater food security crisis far beyond its borders,” Matthew Hollingworth, WFP Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations, told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署负责项目业务的助理执行主任马修·霍林沃斯在日内瓦对记者说：“也门的饥饿危机肯定会加剧远远超出其边界的更大的粮食安全危机。”

paras.en: Yemen was already among the world’s top humanitarian crises and “hunger hotspots” prior to the escalation. More than 18 million people nationwide face acute food security, and some 2.2 million children under five are acutely malnourished.
paras.zh: 在升级之前，也门已经是世界上最严重的人道主义危机和“饥饿热点”之一。全国有超过1800万人面临严重的粮食安全问题，约220万五岁以下儿童严重营养不良。

paras.en: Speaking from Rome. Mr. Hollingworth said that today, nearly three out of four households in accessible areas are unable to meet their basic needs – “a record number for this year in just a few weeks.”
paras.zh: 从罗马说起。霍林沃斯先生表示，如今，在交通便利的地区，近四分之三的家庭无法满足其基本需求——“在短短几周内就创下了今年的创纪录数字”。

paras.en: “People are finding it hard to put any food on the table, or if they indeed have a table if they're displaced,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人们发现餐桌上很难有任何食物，或者即使他们流离失所，也很难找到桌子。”

paras.en: “They're skipping meals, they are eating a much smaller diversity of food types, and they are facing hunger on a daily basis.”
paras.zh: “他们不吃饭，吃的食物种类少得多，而且每天都面临饥饿。”

paras.en: Food prices are rising sharply, while traders report limited wheat flour stocks and disruption to vegetable oil supplies, which is making it difficult for families to afford these items.
paras.zh: 食品价格大幅上涨，而贸易商报告小麦面粉库存有限，植物油供应中断，这使得家庭难以负担这些物品。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the influx of displaced people is putting pressure on urban areas and existing displacement sites. Many have arrived at these locations after walking for days without water or food.
paras.zh: 与此同时，流离失所者的涌入给城市地区和现有的流离失所地点带来了压力。许多人在没有水和食物的情况下步行数天后到达这些地点。

paras.en: WFP is stepping up operations in Yemen and has assisted more than 70,000 people across two of the biggest “displacement hotspots” in Lahaj and Taiz, providing hot meals and other assistance.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署正在加强在也门的行动，并已为拉哈吉和塔伊兹两个最大的“流离失所热点地区”的 7 万多人提供了热餐和其他援助。

paras.en: The UN agency was already supporting more than 1.5 million people in Government-held areas prior to the escalation.
paras.zh: 在升级之前，联合国机构已经为政府控制地区的超过 150 万人提供了支持。

paras.en: “We know we can reach that height of support with the pre-positioned stocks we have, but we are finding it increasingly hard to move food into frontline areas,” Mr. Hollingworth said.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生说：“我们知道，利用我们所拥有的预先配置的库存，我们可以达到这样的支撑高度，但我们发现将粮食运送到前线地区变得越来越困难。”

paras.en: The fighting has cut off access to parts of Taiz and Hudaydah, preventing WFP and partners from accessing some 350,000 people in areas where they used to assist.
paras.zh: 战斗导致塔伊兹和荷台达部分地区的交通被切断，粮食计划署及其合作伙伴无法接触到他们曾经援助过的地区的约 35 万人。

paras.en: Humanitarian teams cannot work in these areas, which are under the control of the Houthi de facto authorities, in line with an operational pause mandated by the UN Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 根据联合国秘书长的暂停行动规定，人道主义救援队无法在这些地区开展工作，这些地区由胡塞事实上的当局控制。

paras.en: In the face of the food security crisis, WFP is drawing on its stocks already allocated for the broader response in Yemen.
paras.zh: 面对粮食安全危机，粮食计划署正在动用已分配的库存，用于也门的更广泛应对行动。

paras.en: “We're robbing Peter to feed Paul,” Mr. Hollingworth said, stressing the critical need for funding to support both newly displaced people and the millions who have depended on the agency’s support for years.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生说：“我们是在抢彼得来养活保罗。”他强调，迫切需要资金来支持新的流离失所者和多年来依赖该机构支持的数百万人。

paras.en: “If the world doesn't step up soon to help Yemen, the outlook is going to get bleaker,” he warned, because “the consequences of this conflict are stretching beyond Yemen.”
paras.zh: “如果世界不尽快采取行动帮助也门，前景将会变得更加黯淡，”他警告说，因为“这场冲突的后果将蔓延到也门以外的地区。”

paras.en: At least 3,700 Yemenis have crossed the Bab al-Mandab Strait to seek shelter in Djibouti, where WFP is working with the authorities to support the arrivals.
paras.zh: 至少有 3,700 名也门人越过曼德海峡前往吉布提寻求庇护，粮食计划署正在与当地当局合作为抵达者提供支持。

paras.en: Mr. Hollingworth said the Strait is critical for the transport of food, fuel and commercial goods moving between Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生表示，该海峡对于亚洲、中东、非洲和欧洲之间的食品、燃料和商品运输至关重要。

paras.en: “Instability around this corridor risks driving food prices higher and deepening food insecurity across a much bigger region –the world.”
paras.zh: “这条走廊周围的不稳定可能会推高粮食价格，并加剧整个更大地区（全世界）的粮食不安全。”

paras.en: He noted that the Yemen crisis is happening at a time when Bab al-Mandab and two other “critical maritime choke points” – the Black Sea and the Strait of Hormuz - are under pressure.
paras.zh: 他指出，也门危机发生之际，曼德海峡和另外两个“关键海上咽喉要道”——黑海和霍尔木兹海峡——正面临压力。

paras.en: “When all three of these are under pressure at the same time, you can add to that the impact of a super El Niño weather pattern. These consequences are going to ripple through food systems everywhere,” he said.
paras.zh: “当这三个因素同时面临压力时，超级厄尔尼诺天气模式的影响就会加剧。这些后果将波及世界各地的粮食系统，”他说。

paras.en: “We've said this before but let me be clear once again: today's humanitarian shock and supply chain disruptions can become tomorrow's global food crisis.”
paras.zh: “我们之前已经说过这一点，但让我再次明确：今天的人道主义冲击和供应链中断可能会成为明天的全球粮食危机。”

articles.title: World News in Brief: Cycle of violence continues in Haiti, seafarer deaths off Somalia, food insecurity in the Middle East

paras.en: World News in Brief: Cycle of violence continues in Haiti, seafarer deaths off Somalia, food insecurity in the Middle East
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：海地暴力循环仍在继续，索马里海域海员死亡，中东粮食不安全

paras.en: In an update to the Human Rights Council, the High Commissioner welcomed the first Gang Suppression Force operations, mandated by the UN Security Council.
paras.zh: 在向人权理事会通报最新情况时，高级专员对联合国安理会授权的首次帮派镇压行动表示欢迎。

paras.en: These will help boost security in Haiti “but the Force remains far below the strength needed”, Mr. Türk insisted, in support of its “full, accelerated deployment” with human rights safeguards embedded.
paras.zh: 图尔克坚称，这些将有助于加强海地的安全，“但部队的兵力仍远远低于所需的水平”，以支持其“全面、加速部署”并纳入人权保障措施。

paras.en: At least 5,700 people have been confirmed killed or injured by gangs – or during operations against them – since 1 January, according to the UN human rights office, OHCHR.
paras.zh: 据联合国人权高专办称，自 1 月 1 日以来，至少有 5,700 人被团伙或在针对团伙的行动中杀害或受伤。

paras.en: Gang members have also kidnapped more than 230 people and raped at least 1,000 women and girls. The real figures are likely much higher, Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: 该团伙成员还绑架了 230 多人，并强奸了至少 1,000 名妇女和女孩。图尔克先生说，实际数字可能要高得多。

paras.en: In his update, the High Commissioner for Human Rights also warned that “extortion, looting and destruction of property” are crippling economic activity in Haiti.
paras.zh: 人权事务高级专员在最新情况中还警告说，“敲诈勒索、抢劫和破坏财产”正在削弱海地的经济活动。

paras.en: The “constant danger” prevents people from reaching schools, hospitals, and essential services, Mr. Türk stressed.
paras.zh: 图尔克强调，“持续的危险”使人们无法到达学校、医院和基本服务机构。

paras.en: Five seafarers killed as three hijacked ships are freed off Somalia
paras.zh: 三艘被劫持的船只在索马里海域被释放，五名海员丧生

paras.en: Three hijacked ships have been freed after months in captivity, but five seafarers died during the rescue of one of them, the head of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has said.
paras.zh: 国际海事组织（IMO）负责人表示，三艘被劫持的船只在被囚禁数月后已被释放，但其中一艘船只有五名海员在营救过程中死亡。

paras.en: IMO Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez offered his condolences after the operation to free the HONOUR 25 in Somali waters on 29 September, in which several other crew members were seriously injured.
paras.zh: 国际海事组织秘书长阿塞尼奥·多明计斯在 9 月 29 日在索马里水域解救 HONOR 25 号行动后表示哀悼，此次行动导致其他几名船员受重伤。

paras.en: Mr. Dominguez said seafarers “should not have to lose their lives for the service they provide for the world”, and called for renewed resolve, targeted cooperation and the resources needed to stop piracy in the region.
paras.zh: 多明格斯表示，海员“不应该因为为世界提供的服务而失去生命”，并呼吁重新下定决心、开展有针对性的合作并提供制止该地区海盗活动所需的资源。

paras.en: The HONOUR 25 was one of three vessels released this week, along with the SEAMULL (also known as SIBU 1) and the MT EUREKA, all seized between April and August by pirates and armed robbers.
paras.zh: HONOR 25 是本周获释的三艘船只之一，其他船只还有 SEAMULL（也称为 SIBU 1）和 MT EUREKA，均在 4 月至 8 月期间被海盗和武装劫匪扣押。

paras.en: In total, 44 seafarers were freed and their governments are working to arrange their repatriation. Mr. Dominguez thanked Somalia's Government for its efforts, but noted that 22 seafarers remain captive aboard the ASANA.
paras.zh: 总共有 44 名海员获释，他们的政府正在努力安排他们的遣返。多明计斯先生感谢索马里政府所做的努力，但指出仍有 22 名海员仍被扣押在 ASANA 上。

paras.en: He urged Governments to bring new initiatives, such as the proposed Group of Friends of Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers, to the IMO, and stressed the importance of the EUNAVFOR Aspides and Atalanta operations for maritime security in the region.
paras.zh: 他敦促各国政府向国际海事组织提出新的倡议，例如拟议的航运和海员安全保障之友小组，并强调欧洲海军阿斯皮德斯和亚特兰大行动对该地区海事安全的重要性。

paras.en: Millions more women could go hungry as tensions escalate in the Middle East
paras.zh: 随着中东紧张局势升级，数百万妇女可能会挨饿

paras.en: An additional 11.7 million women and girls in 28 countries could face food insecurity by the end of the year due to the escalating conflict in the Middle East and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 由于中东冲突升级和霍尔木兹海峡的混乱，到今年年底，28个国家的另外1170万妇女和女童可能面临粮食不安全。

paras.en: These crises are driving up food prices and putting a strain on livelihoods and household resources, UN Women said in new analysis published on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署在周五发布的新分析中表示，这些危机正在推高食品价格，给生计和家庭资源带来压力。

paras.en: Presenting the findings to journalists in Geneva, UN Women Deputy Executive Director Nyaradzayi Gumbonzvanda said the estimates are a potential scenario, not a forecast, and that the number is in addition to the 208 million women and girls who were already estimated to be food insecure or malnourished in these countries.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署副执行主任 Nyaradzayi Gumbonzvanda 在日内瓦向记者介绍调查结果时表示，这些估计只是一种可能的情况，而不是预测，而且这个数字不包括在这些国家中已经估计有 2.08 亿妇女和女童面临粮食不安全或营养不良的人数。

paras.en: “Experience from past conflicts shows that when food is scarce, women often reduce the amount they eat or skip meals so that children and other family members can eat,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“过去冲突的经验表明，当食物匮乏时，妇女往往会减少进食量或不吃饭，以便孩子和其他家庭成员有饭吃。”

paras.en: The greatest numbers of women and girls at risk are in populous countries, while South Sudan, Sudan, Haiti, Yemen and Palestine face the highest concentration of overlapping vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 面临风险的妇女和女童数量最多的是人口稠密的国家，而南苏丹、苏丹、海地、也门和巴勒斯坦面临的重叠脆弱性最为集中。

paras.en: UN Women recommends linking food and cash assistance to nutrition, protection, employment and agricultural services. Women should also have access to land, credit and productive resources.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署建议将粮食和现金援助与营养、保护、就业和农业服务联系起来。妇女还应该能够获得土地、信贷和生产资源。

paras.en: The agency also highlighted the need for better collection of data that shows where food insecurity is worsening and who is eating less, losing income and carrying the heaviest burden of unpaid care work.
paras.zh: 该机构还强调需要更好地收集数据，以显示哪些地区的粮食不安全状况正在恶化，以及哪些人吃得更少、收入减少以及承担最重的无偿护理工作负担。

articles.title: Doyle: Maltese Cross to bring home Arc glory for Marquand and Haggas

paras.en: Hollie Doyle: Maltese Cross to bring home Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe glory for Tom Marquand and William Haggas
paras.zh: 霍莉·多伊尔：马耳他十字勋章将为汤姆·马昆德和威廉·哈加斯带回凯旋门奖荣耀

paras.en: Speaking to Simon Mapletoft, Sky Sports Racing ambassador Hollie Doyle looks forward to a thrilling weekend of action, headlined by Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe; Watch Europe's richest race - live on Sky Sports Racing - at 3.05pm
paras.zh: 天空体育赛车大使霍莉·多伊尔 (Hollie Doyle) 在接受西蒙·梅普莱托夫特 (Simon Mapletoft) 采访时，期待着以周日凯旋门大奖赛为主角的激动人心的周末。下午 3.05 观看欧洲最富有的赛事 - 天空体育赛车直播

paras.en: Before heading to Paris to cheer on Maltese Cross, Hollie Doyle penned her latest exclusive blog ahead of Arc weekend.
paras.zh: 在前往巴黎为马耳他十字勋章加油之前，霍莉·多伊尔在弧形周末之前写下了她最新的独家博客。

paras.en: I'm on the Maltese Cross team for obvious reasons in the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (3.05) at ParisLongchamp on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Racing. He gives my husband Tom [Marquand], his trainer William Haggas and owner George Waud an outstanding chance of winning this great race.
paras.zh: 周日，在巴黎隆尚举行的卡塔尔凯旋门大奖赛（3.05）中，我加入马耳他十字队，原因显而易见，天空体育赛车直播。他为我的丈夫汤姆（马昆德）、他的练马师威廉·哈加斯和马主乔治·沃德提供了赢得这场伟大比赛的绝佳机会。

paras.en: What he's achieved this year has been pretty spectacular and I don't think anyone's seen the best of him yet. The Grand Prix de Paris and the Great Voltigeur at York were only the tip of the iceberg in terms of how good this horse could be.
paras.zh: 他今年取得的成就相当惊人，我认为还没有人看到他最好的一面。巴黎大奖赛和约克伏尔蒂格大赛只是这匹马的优秀表现的冰山一角。

paras.en: He got roughed up a little in both those races but has a great mind for a three-year-old which will stand him in good stead again in the hurly burly of the Arc, particularly from his wide draw in stall 11.
paras.zh: 他在这两场比赛中都受到了一点粗暴，但对于一匹三岁马来说，他有着伟大的头脑，这将使他在喧闹的弧线中再次保持良好的状态，特别是在他在第11号摊位的大抽签中。

paras.en: - Kevin Blake's Arc day tips: Three fancies on star-studded undercard
paras.zh: - 凯文·布莱克 (Kevin Blake) 的 Arc Day 秘诀：对明星云集的底牌的三种幻想

paras.en: - Who wins the Arc? Sky Sports Racing team tips
paras.zh: - 谁赢得了弧线？天空体育赛车队提示

paras.en: Last year's winner Daryz will of course be a tough opponent with the draw in his favour and looks to have been produced to the minute by his master trainer Francis-Henri Graffard, but Maltese Cross, whose only defeat came on softer ground in the Derby, will be a huge threat to all.
paras.zh: 去年的冠军达里兹当然会是一个强硬的对手，他的平局对他有利，看起来是由他的主教练弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德精心打造的，但马耳他·克罗斯在德比中唯一的失利是在较软的地面上发生的，这对所有人来说都是一个巨大的威胁。

paras.en: I'd love to see his British compatriot Kalpana make her presence felt, too. After all, Andrew Balding's wonderful mare has proven she can compete against the boys at the top table by winning the King George and was impressive in the Yorkshire Oaks after that.
paras.zh: 我很高兴看到他的英国同胞卡尔帕纳也能展现出她的存在。毕竟，安德鲁·鲍尔丁 (Andrew Balding) 的出色母马赢得了乔治国王赛 (King George)，证明了她可以与顶尖选手竞争，并在约克郡橡树赛 (Yorkshire Oaks) 中表现出色。

paras.en: Great opportunity for Godolphin filly in Boussac
paras.zh: 布萨克高多芬母马的绝佳机会

paras.en: Green Empress is entitled to take the beating in a slightly disappointing renewal of the Qatar Prix Marcel Boussac Criterium des Pouliches (12.31) on Sunday.
paras.zh: 绿色皇后有权在周日卡塔尔大奖赛马塞尔·布萨克普利切斯赛道 (12.31) 的更新中稍显令人失望。

paras.en: Joseph O'Brien's filly found only the prolific Sun Goddess too strong in the Moyglare Stakes on her latest start but any chinks in her armour could be exploited by Godolphin's interesting runner Miss Miniver.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·奥布莱恩 (Joseph O'Brien) 的母马发现，多产的太阳女神 (Sun Goddess) 在莫伊格拉尔锦标赛 (Moyglare Stakes) 的最新比赛中表现过于强劲，但她盔甲上的任何缝隙都可能被戈多芬 (Godolphin) 有趣的赛跑者米尼弗小姐 (Miss Miniver) 利用。

paras.en: Though Green Empress's market rival Allela could be anything at this stage, Roger Varian is backing the daughter of Wootton Bassett up quickly after her fourth in the Group 2 Rockfel at Newmarket so this could be a great opportunity to bag a fairly weak Group 1.
paras.zh: 虽然“绿皇后”的市场竞争对手“阿莱拉”在现阶段可能会有所作为，但罗杰·瓦里安正在支持伍顿·巴塞特的女儿在纽马克特获得第二组“洛克菲尔”第四名后迅速崛起，因此这可能是一个绝佳的机会来囊括相当弱的第一组。

paras.en: Joseph O'Brien's excellent season can continue with the progressive Folsom Blues in the Qatar Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere Longines (1.09) on Sunday.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·奥布莱恩 (Joseph O'Brien) 的出色赛季将在周日的卡塔尔浪琴大奖赛 (Jean-Luc Lagardere Longines) (1.09) 中与进步的福尔瑟姆布鲁斯 (Folsom Blues) 一起继续。

paras.en: The son of Blue Point lost nothing in defeat behind last weekend's Cheveley Park heroine Sun Goddess in the Pheonix Stakes at the Curragh before returning to take the Group 1 National Stakes in most emphatic style.
paras.zh: 蓝点之子在上周末在卡拉格举办的菲尼克斯锦标赛中输给切夫利公园女英雄太阳女神后，没有损失任何东西，然后以最有力的方式重返国家一级锦标赛。

paras.en: He hasn't been blessed with the best draw but has the class to overcome that while James Doyle's mount Imperial Strike looks way overpriced in his quest to reverse Group 3 form with the unbeaten Avec Toi.
paras.zh: 他并没有获得最好的平局，但他有能力克服这一点，而詹姆斯·道尔（James Doyle）的坐骑“帝国打击”（Imperial Strike）在他与不败的阿维克·托伊（Avec Toi）扭转第3组状态的过程中看起来价格过高。

paras.en: It would be a great result for racing if Naana's Shadow could win the Prix de l'Abbaye de Longchamp Longines (1.47) on Sunday for Galashiels trainer Katie Scott.
paras.zh: 如果Naana's Shadow 能够在周日为Galashiels 练马师Katie Scott 赢得Longchamp Longines 修道院大奖赛（1.47），这对于比赛来说将是一个伟大的成绩。

paras.en: Katie, who trains only a small string, has worked wonders with this grey filly who won the Group 3 trial for this race over course and distance last month so deserves to be favourite.
paras.zh: 凯蒂（Katie）只训练了一小群，但她与这匹灰色母马创造了奇迹，这只灰色母马在上个月的比赛中赢得了第三组选拔赛的路线和距离，因此值得受到青睐。

paras.en: However, her starting position in stall 13 isn't great on such a draw-dependent track so I'm expecting Francis-Henri Graffard's SHIRI to reverse that form while keeping a close eye on Harry Eustace's Time For Sandals, who has the talent to go close if she can get back to her best form.
paras.zh: 然而，在这样一个依赖平局的赛道上，她在第 13 号摊位的首发位置并不是很好，所以我期待弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德 (Francis-Henri Graffard) 的 SHIRI 扭转这种状态，同时密切关注哈利·尤斯塔斯 (Harry Eustace) 的 Time For Sandals，如果她能恢复到最佳状态，她就有能力接近这一点。

paras.en: Precise can hit the right notes in Opera
paras.zh: 精确可以在 Opera 中击中正确的音符

paras.en: Aventure will be a short price to supplement her Group 1 success in the Prix Romanet when she reappears in the Prix de l'Opera Longines (3.50) on Sunday. Christophe Ferland's mare beat a below-best Diamond Necklace that day so I'm not sure how strong that form was, however.
paras.zh: 当她周日再次出现在浪琴表歌剧大奖赛 (3.50) 中时，Aventure 将以短期价格补充她在罗曼内特大奖赛第一组的成功。克里斯托夫·费兰 (Christophe Ferland) 的母马那天击败了一条低于最佳水平的钻石项链，所以我不确定这种形式有多强。

paras.en: I prefer Aidan O'Brien's filly Precise, who hasn't managed to get her head in front since winning the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot but had run well in top company before her underwhelming display in the Matron last time.
paras.zh: 我更喜欢艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 的母马“精确”(Precise)，自从在皇家阿斯科特赛马会 (Royal Ascot) 赢得加冕赛冠军后，她就再也没有领先过，但在上次在马特隆 (Matron) 中表现平平之前，她在顶级公司中表现出色。

paras.en: She's much better than she showed on Irish Champions' weekend so looks a strong alternative to the likely favourite with the ever-consistent Pink Panthera seemingly booked for another placing.
paras.zh: 她比她在爱尔兰冠军周末上表现得要好得多，因此看起来是一个强有力的替代品，可能是最受欢迎的粉红豹的有力替代品，而一直稳定的粉红豹似乎已经预订了另一个名次。

paras.en: Fozzy Stack can strike a blow for Ireland in the Qatar Prix de la Foret (4.25) on Sunday with Thesecretadversary, who should be able to roll into a nice rhythm on a track that will play to his strengths.
paras.zh: Fozzy Stack 可以在周日的卡塔尔拉福雷大奖赛 (4.25) 中与 Thesecretadversary 一起为爱尔兰队带来一击，后者应该能够在赛道上形成良好的节奏，从而发挥他的优势。

paras.en: Stepping back in trip looks ideal for the Jersey Stakes winner who is a value alternative to favourite Samangan, who only got the verdict in a bunch finish at Deauville last time so probably needs to find more.
paras.zh: 对于泽西锦标赛冠军来说，退后一步看起来是理想的选择，他是最受欢迎的萨曼根的一个有价值的替代品，萨曼根上次在多维尔的比赛中只获得了胜利，所以可能需要找到更多。

paras.en: Aidan O'Brien's True Love was only fifth in that race and didn't look herself in the Matron last month but is another who will appreciate dropping back in distance and can go well, too.
paras.zh: 艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 的“真爱”(True Love) 在那场比赛中仅排名第五，上个月在 Matron 比赛中也没有表现出自己的样子，但她也是另一位愿意退后距离并且也能跑得很好的人。

paras.en: Haggas holds key to Saturday's Cumberland Lodge
paras.zh: 哈加斯持有周六坎伯兰旅馆的钥匙

paras.en: William Haggas, who runs the strongly fancied Maltese Cross in the Arc in Paris on Sunday, holds the key to the two feature races at Ascot on Saturday, including the Group 3 Bet MGM Cumberland Lodge Stakes (2.25), live on Sky Sports Racing..
paras.zh: 周日在巴黎圆弧赛马耳他十字赛 (Maltese Cross) 上运行的威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 掌握着周六阿斯科特 (Ascot) 两场专题比赛的关键，其中包括由天空体育赛车 (Sky Sports Racing) 直播的第 3 组投注米高梅坎伯兰洛奇锦标赛 (2.25)。

paras.en: Gallant veteran Al Aasy is definitely the class horse in the race and is definitely the one they all have to beat in this Group 3. He's already won at a higher level this year and will get on well with Danny Tudhope.
paras.zh: 英勇的老将阿尔·阿西（Al Aasy）绝对是比赛中的一流马，也绝对是他们在第 3 组中必须击败的一匹马。他今年已经在更高的水平上获胜，并将与丹尼·图德霍普（Danny Tudhope）相处得很好。

paras.en: Stablemate Tenability is ultra-tough as he showed when winning the Listed August Stakes at Windsor and looks fairly progressive but will need to step forward to put Al Aasy in his place.
paras.zh: Stablemate Tenability 非常强硬，正如他在温莎赢得八月公开锦标赛时所表现出的那样，看起来相当进步，但需要挺身而出，让 Al Aasy 取代他的位置。

paras.en: Division only just failed to nail the Group 1 Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville last time - form that sets a demanding standard in the John Guest Racing Bengough Stakes (3.00).
paras.zh: 该部门上次在多维尔举行的 Maurice de Gheest 一级方程式锦标赛中只是未能获得冠军，这种状态在 John Guest Racing Bengough 锦标赛 (3.00) 中树立了严格的标准。

paras.en: William Haggas's Wathnan Racing colt can compromise his chance with a slow start but if the race is run to suit him this represents a great opportunity to get a Group 3 success on his CV.
paras.zh: 威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 的瓦斯南赛车 (Wathnan Racing) 小马可能会因起步缓慢而损害他的机会，但如果比赛进行得适合他，这将是他在第 3 组中取得成功的绝佳机会。

paras.en: Any flaws could be exposed by Godolphin's Hidden Force, who has undergone wind surgery since finishing a beaten favourite in the Craven back in the spring but could be anything, while Marco Botti's Prince Of India must go well after his win in Listed company at Newmarket.
paras.zh: 戈多芬的“隐藏力量”可能会暴露出任何缺陷，自从春季在克雷文赛上击败热门选手以来，他已经接受了风力手术，但可能是任何东西，而马可·博蒂的印度王子在纽马克特上市公司获胜后必须走得很好。

paras.en: Hollie Doyle was speaking to Sky Sports Racing's Simon Mapletoft.
paras.zh: 霍莉·多伊尔正在接受天空体育赛车队的西蒙·梅普莱托夫特的采访。

paras.en: Watch every race from Autumn Racing Weekend at Ascot live on Sky Sports Racing on Friday and Saturday
paras.zh: 周五和周六，观看天空体育赛车直播阿斯科特秋季赛马周末的每场比赛

articles.title: Jordan handles Piers Morgan 'sledging' to move into contention

paras.en: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship: Matthew Jordan moves into contention with Casey Jarvis leading by one
paras.zh: 阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛：马修乔丹进入争夺，凯西贾维斯领先一杆

paras.en: Matthew Jordan survives 'sledging' from outspoken television presenter Piers Morgan to move into contention at Alfred Dunhill Links; South African Casey Jarvis leads by one on 11 under after a 67 at Kingsbarns
paras.zh: 马修·乔丹 (Matthew Jordan) 从直言不讳的电视节目主持人皮尔斯·摩根 (Piers Morgan) 的“雪橇”中幸存下来，进入阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯 (Alfred Dunhill Links) 的竞争；南非选手凯西·贾维斯 (Casey Jarvis) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 67 杆后，以低于标准杆 11 杆的成绩领先一杆

paras.en: Matthew Jordan shot a seven-under 65 to move into contention at the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship despite having to put up with Piers Morgan's verbal jousting.
paras.zh: 马修·乔丹 (Matthew Jordan) 打出 65 杆，低于标准杆 7 杆，尽管不得不忍受皮尔斯·摩根 (Piers Morgan) 的口角，但他还是进入了阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛 (Alfred Dunhill Links Champions) 的争夺行列。

paras.en: The Royal Liverpool member is looking for his first DP World Tour win in his 183rd tournament and he shrugged off the good-natured criticism from the television presenter - his amateur playing partner for the team part of the event - to card six birdies and an eagle at Carnoustie.
paras.zh: 这位皇家利物浦成员正在寻求他的第 183 场比赛中的首个 DP 世界巡回赛胜利，他对电视节目主持人（他在赛事团队部分的业余比赛搭档）的善意批评不屑一顾，在卡诺斯蒂打出了 6 只小鸟和 1 只老鹰。

paras.en: His one mishap was a bogey at the ninth, his final hole, but he got to 10 under and into a four-way tie for second place.
paras.zh: 他的一次失误是在第九洞（最后一个洞）吞下柏忌，但他打出低于标准杆 10 杆的成绩，并以四人并列第二名的成绩。

paras.en: - Alfred Dunhill Links Championship [External Leaderboard]
paras.zh: - Alfred Dunhill Links 锦标赛 [外部排行榜]

paras.en: - DP World Tour: Latest headlines, reports, highlights
paras.zh: - DP 世界巡演：最新头条、报道、亮点

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "Yeah, with Piers, the amount of sledging that goes on towards me is incredible," said Jordan.
paras.zh: “是的，和皮尔斯一起，向我发起的雪橇数量令人难以置信，”乔丹说。

paras.en: "We are supposed to be a team but honestly it's all about him and that's how he makes it.
paras.zh: “我们应该是一个团队，但老实说，一切都与他有关，这就是他的成功方式。

paras.en: "I think Peter Jones (star of Dragons Den) missed a two-foot putt on 15 and he (Morgan) comes up to me - because I hit it to two foot as well - and he says: 'Don't do a Jonesy'.
paras.zh: “我认为彼得·琼斯（《龙穴》明星）在 15 号洞错过了一个两英尺的推杆，他（摩根）走到我身边 - 因为我也将球打到了两英尺 - 他说：‘不要做琼斯’。

paras.en: "So that kind of puts the heebie-jeebies in you over that small putt. He just cuts at me like that and every time I seem to do something good, it's him taking the limelight."
paras.zh: “所以这会让你在那个小推杆上感到惊慌。他就这样切入我，每次我似乎做了一些好事，都是他成为了众人瞩目的焦点。”

paras.en: South African Casey Jarvis leads by one on 11 under after a 67 at Kingsbarns but the round of the delay belonged to Spaniard Rocco Repetto Taylor who had an eight-under 64 at Kingsbarns, the second of three courses being used for the first three rounds with St Andrews also hosting on the final day.
paras.zh: 南非选手凯西·贾维斯 (Casey Jarvis) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 67 杆后，以低于标准杆 11 杆领先一杆，但推迟的一轮属于西班牙选手罗科·雷佩托·泰勒 (Rocco Repetto Taylor)，他在 Kingsbarns 打出 64 杆，低于标准杆 8 杆，这是前三轮比赛使用的三个球场中的第二个，圣安德鲁斯也在最后一天主办。

paras.en: The 23-year-old had four birdies and an eagle in his final nine holes to sit 10 under alongside Jordan and South African MJ Daffue.
paras.zh: 这位 23 岁的球员在最后九洞抓到 4 只小鸟和 1 只老鹰，与乔丹和南非人 MJ Daffue 并列低于标准杆 10 杆。

paras.en: Defending champion Bob MacIntyre is at eight under after a 65 at Kingsbarns, where Brooks Koepka shot a 67 to sit level with the Scot.
paras.zh: 卫冕冠军鲍勃·麦金泰尔在 Kingsbarns 打出 65 杆，低于标准杆 8 杆，布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 打出 67 杆，与苏格兰人并列。

paras.en: Tommy Fleetwood is at six under after a four-under 68 at Kingsbarns, as is Ryder Cup team-mate Matt Fitzpatrick with a 70 at the same course.
paras.zh: 汤米·弗利特伍德 (Tommy Fleetwood) 在 Kingsbarns 打出低于标准杆 4 杆的 68 杆，目前成绩为低于标准杆 6 杆，莱德杯队友马特·菲茨帕特里克 (Matt Fitzpatrick) 在同一球场打出 70 杆。

paras.en: In their first DP World Tour appearances in nearly four years, Lee Westwood got to four under after a 69 at Kingsbarns but fellow LIV golfer Ian Poulter went out in 41 at Carnoustie on his way to 76 which left him four over.
paras.zh: 近四年来首次参加 DP 世界巡回赛，李·维斯特伍德 (Lee Westwood) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 69 杆，打出低于标准杆 4 杆的成绩，但 LIV 高尔夫球手伊恩·保尔特 (Ian Poulter) 在卡洛斯蒂 (Carnoustie) 打出 41 杆，最终打出 76 杆，低于标准杆 4 杆。

articles.title: Is Littler heading to Minehead? World No 1 to headline World Youth Championships

paras.en: Luke Littler: World No 1 to headline World Youth Championships with chance to reach final at Minehead
paras.zh: 卢克·利特勒：世界排名第一的世界青年锦标赛有机会进入迈恩黑德决赛

paras.en: Luke Littler will compete at the 2026 World Youth Championships but reigning champ Gian van Veen will not attend in the final year he is eligible; you can watch the conclusion of the World Grand Prix Darts live on Sky Sports this weekend
paras.zh: 卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 将参加 2026 年世界青年锦标赛，但卫冕冠军吉安·范·维恩 (Gian van Veen) 将不会参加他有资格参加的最后一年；您可以在本周末通过天空体育直播观看世界飞镖大奖赛的结束

paras.en: World No 1 and former champion Luke Littler will headline the list of Tour Card Holders and International Qualifiers competing in Monday's Winmau World Youth Championship.
paras.zh: 世界排名第一的前冠军卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 将成为周一举行的 Winmau 世界青年锦标赛的巡回赛卡持有者和国际预选赛选手名单中的头号人物。

paras.en: The full 128-player field for this year's showpiece will be finalised following the conclusion of the Development Tour season this weekend, with Events 21-24 taking place in Wigan on October 3-4.
paras.zh: 今年的 128 名参赛选手将在本周末的发展巡回赛赛季结束后最终确定，第 21 至 24 场比赛将于 10 月 3 日至 4 日在维冈举行。

paras.en: The 2026 World Youth Championship will see the round-robin phase and the knockout phase from the last 64 down to the semi-finals staged on Monday October 5 at the Robin Park Leisure Centre.
paras.zh: 2026 年世界青年锦标赛将于 10 月 5 日星期一在罗宾公园休闲中心举行，包括循环赛阶段和 64 强淘汰赛直至半决赛。

paras.en: Littler, who withdrew from Players Championship 29 and 30 after his defeat at the World Series Finals in Amsterdam effectively ended his chances of qualifying for the finals in Minehead in November, but he could still play at the venue.
paras.zh: 利特勒在阿姆斯特丹举行的世界系列赛决赛中失利后，退出了球员锦标赛第 29 和第 30 场比赛，这实际上结束了他进入 11 月份在迈恩黑德举行的决赛的机会，但他仍然可以在该场地比赛。

paras.en: The final will be held on Sunday November 29 at Butlin's Minehead Resort during the Ladbrokes Players Championship Finals, with a boosted top prize of £15,000 also on offer.
paras.zh: 决赛将于 11 月 29 日星期日在立博球员锦标赛决赛期间在布特林的迈恩黑德度假村举行，最高奖金为 15,000 英镑。

paras.en: The 128-player line-up will include all age-qualified PDC Tour Card Holders who have accepted the invitation to compete and 26 international representatives, with the remaining places set to be filled from the final Development Tour Rankings.
paras.zh: 128名选手阵容将包括所有接受参赛邀请、符合年龄要求的PDC巡回赛卡持有者以及26名国际代表，其余名额将从最终的发展巡回赛排名中填补。

paras.en: The group stage sees the players split into 32 groups of four, with one seed per group for the round-robin action - with seedings based on the PDC Werner Rankings Ladder and then the Development Tour Rankings.
paras.zh: 小组赛阶段，选手们被分成 32 个小组，每组四人，每组一名种子选手进行循环赛——种子选手的排名基于 PDC 维尔纳排名天梯，然后是发展巡回赛排名。

paras.en: The top two players in each group will subsequently progress to the knockout stages, which begin from the last 64 onwards.
paras.zh: 每组前两名选手将随后进入淘汰赛阶段，淘汰赛从 64 强开始。

paras.en: World Champion Littler - who lifted the World Youth Championship in 2023 - will be the top seed given his status as world No 1, ahead of Poland's Sebastian Bialecki and Ireland's Keane Barry.
paras.zh: 世界冠军利特勒在 2023 年举起了世青赛冠军，鉴于他的世界排名第一，他将成为头号种子，领先于波兰的塞巴斯蒂安·比亚莱茨基和爱尔兰的基恩·巴里。

paras.en: Jurjen van der Velde - the 2024 runner-up - will also return alongside the likes of Cam Crabtree, Charlie Manby, Owen Bates and Czechia's Adam Gawlas.
paras.zh: 2024 年亚军 Jurjen van der Velde 也将与 Cam Crabtree、Charlie Manby、Owen Bates 和捷克选手 Adam Gawlas 等人一起回归。

paras.en: The field also includes 16-year-old Lewis Cook from the JDC circuit - along with fellow stars Kaya Baysal, Archie Self and Ben Townley who have stepped up to the Development Tour this year - with Eleanor Cairns and Kyana Frauenfelder featuring from the PDC Women's Series rankings.
paras.zh: 参赛名单中还包括来自 JDC 巡回赛的 16 岁选手刘易斯·库克 (Lewis Cook)，以及今年参加发展巡回赛的同为明星的卡亚·贝萨尔 (Kaya Baysal)、阿奇·塞尔夫 (Archie Self) 和本·汤利 (Ben Townley)，以及来自 PDC 女子系列赛排名的埃莉诺·凯恩斯 (Eleanor Cairns) 和基亚娜·弗劳恩菲尔德 (Kyana Frauenfelder)。

paras.en: Reigning two-time champion Gian van Veen will not return to defend his title while Beau Greaves - runner-up to Van Veen 12 months ago - and Yorick Hofkens have also chosen not to compete in Monday's event.
paras.zh: 两届卫冕冠军吉安·范维恩将不会重返卫冕，而 12 个月前范维恩亚军博·格里夫斯和约里克·霍夫肯斯也选择不参加周一的比赛。

paras.en: The Winmau World Youth Championship will begin from 11.30am on Monday at the Robin Park Leisure Centre, with group games being played over the best of nine legs.
paras.zh: Winmau 世界青年锦标赛将于周一上午 11 点 30 分在罗宾公园休闲中心开始，小组赛将采用九回合三胜制进行。

paras.en: The top two players from each group will then advance to the last 64, which will be contested in a knockout format over the best of 11 legs.
paras.zh: 每组前两名选手将晋级 64 强赛，并以 11 回合两胜制的淘汰赛形式进行角逐。
