articles.title: Screaming, panicking, blood: Passengers detail horrifying Israel-bound flight
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: TEL AVIV — A stabbing, an emergency alert, a terrifying midair plunge.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——刺伤事件、紧急警报、可怕的半空中坠落事件。

paras.en: Details are still emerging after an Israel-bound flight carrying 180 people emitted a distress signal Wednesday, raising fears of a possible hijacking when one pilot stabbed the other in the cockpit.
paras.zh: 周三，一架载有 180 人的飞往以色列的航班发出求救信号，一名飞行员在驾驶舱内刺伤另一名飞行员，引发了人们对可能发生劫机事件的担忧。

paras.en: Aviatar Alevi, who was on the Flydubai flight Wednesday, described people “screaming, running, panicking, blood.”
paras.zh: 周三乘坐迪拜航空航班的阿维塔·阿莱维（Aviatar Alevi）描述说，人们“尖叫、奔跑、惊慌、流血”。

paras.en: “At the start, I thought it was a plane malfunction, but then I started hearing screaming about the stabbings,” Alevi, 17, told NBC News. “Then I understood the weight of the actual situation.”
paras.zh: “一开始，我以为这是飞机故障，但后来我开始听到有关刺伤事件的尖叫声，”17 岁的阿莱维告诉 NBC 新闻。 “然后我就明白了实际情况的重要性。”

paras.en: “We didn’t know what was going to happen,” he said, adding that the possibility of death “was definitely an option.”
paras.zh: “我们不知道会发生什么，”他说，并补充说死亡的可能性“绝对是一种选择”。

paras.en: The plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, one of its rudders damaged, apparently by the force of its descent.
paras.zh: 这架飞机在沙特阿拉伯紧急降落，其中一个方向舵显然是由于下降的力量而损坏。

paras.en: The passengers, who had been flying from Dubai, were mobbed by media and flag-waving fellow Israelis after they finally arrived at Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 这些从迪拜起飞的乘客最终抵达特拉维夫附近的本古里安机场后，被媒体和挥舞旗帜的以色列同胞包围。

paras.en: They said they feared for their lives after the plane plunged more than 14,000 feet in 29 seconds at one point, according to FlightRadar24.
paras.zh: 据 FlightRadar24 报道，他们表示，飞机在 29 秒内一度坠落超过 14,000 英尺的高度后，他们担心自己的生命安全。

paras.en: “Imagine sitting on the plane, all scared after you fell down five kilometers. You don’t understand anything,” 16-year-old Peleg Itali told NBC News.
paras.zh: 16 岁的 Peleg Itali 告诉 NBC 新闻：“想象一下，坐在飞机上，从 5 公里处坠落后，你感到非常害怕。你什么都听不懂。”

paras.en: Capt. Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, was recovering in a hospital in Saudi Arabia on Thursday as the other pilot, so far identified only as an Omani citizen, was being interrogated elsewhere in the country. Machchhar was widely praised for his efforts to prevent the plane from crashing, opening the cockpit door and allowing passengers and crewmembers to rush in.
paras.zh: 印度国民斯密特·马赫恰尔上尉周四在沙特阿拉伯的一家医院康复，另一名飞行员（迄今为止仅确认为阿曼公民）正在该国其他地方接受审讯。马恰哈尔为防止飞机坠毁、打开驾驶舱门并允许乘客和机组人员冲入而做出的努力受到广泛赞扬。

paras.en: Machchhar and the pilot who initiated the attack were transferred to Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, on Thursday, the Saudi Arabian Interior Ministry said in a statement, citing an unnamed “official source” at the ministry.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯内政部在一份声明中援引该部未透露姓名的“官方消息人士”的话说，马赫恰尔和发起袭击的飞行员于周四被转移到阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比。

paras.en: “The source indicated that initial investigations conducted by the competent authorities in the Kingdom, with the participation of a security team from the sisterly United Arab Emirates, revealed an assault on the pilot by his co-pilot, resulting in both sustaining various injuries,” the ministry said. “The source confirmed that the pilot and his co-pilot, after their health improved and the medical team cleared them, departed the Kingdom for Abu Dhabi this morning.”
paras.zh: 内政部表示：“消息人士表示，在来自姐妹国家阿拉伯联合酋长国的安全小组的参与下，王国主管当局进行的初步调查显示，飞行员的副驾驶袭击了飞行员，造成两人不同程度受伤。” “消息人士证实，飞行员和副驾驶的健康状况有所改善并得到医疗团队的许可后，于今天早上离开沙特前往阿布扎比。”

paras.en: Few details had emerged about the pilot Thursday morning. Questions about a possible motive, including whether it was terrorism-related, hang over the attack.
paras.zh: 周四上午，有关该飞行员的细节几乎没有透露。关于可能动机的问题，包括是否与恐怖主义有关，仍然悬而未决。

paras.en: “I don’t think it was a hijacking. It looks like a suicide attempt, simply because of what this hero, Yaniv, has described,” Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on “CBS Evening News” as he praised Yaniv Hayun, who rushed into the cockpit and subdued the attacker.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在《哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻》节目中称赞冲进驾驶舱制服袭击者的亚尼夫·哈云，“我不认为这是一起劫机事件。这看起来像是一次自杀未遂，只是因为这位英雄亚尼夫所描述的事情。”

paras.en: Hayun, who was pictured with his shirt spattered with blood sitting next to Netanyahu, said he confronted the pilot who initiated the attack, according to the Israeli government press office.
paras.zh: 据以色列政府新闻办公室称，哈云坐在内塔尼亚胡旁边，衬衫沾满血迹，他说他与发起袭击的飞行员对峙。

paras.en: “I grabbed the attacker and choked him, pulled him out first,” Hayun said. “I started pulling the controls.”
paras.zh: “我抓住袭击者并掐住他的脖子，然后把他拉了出来，”海云说。 “我开始拉动控制装置。”

paras.en: “Thank God, we pulled it off. We really put our heads together and worked as a team,” Hayun said, adding: “It was between fear and a sense of a do-or-die situation.”
paras.zh: “感谢上帝，我们成功了。我们真的齐心协力，作为一个团队工作，”海云说，并补充道：“这是在恐惧和生死攸关的感觉之间进行的。”

paras.en: “We had to win. We had to pull through and come out on top,” he said. Hayun told Netanyahu that he acted based on what he had seen on a TV show and helped stabilize the plane.
paras.zh: “我们必须获胜。我们必须渡过难关并取得胜利，”他说。海云告诉内塔尼亚胡，他根据电视节目中看到的情况采取行动，帮助稳定了飞机。

paras.en: Flydubai said on-duty crewmembers on the flight were able to land the plane.
paras.zh: Flydubai 表示，航班上的值班机组人员成功让飞机着陆。

paras.en: Netanyahu said it was still too early to determine why the pilot apparently stabbed his colleague and appeared to try to take over the Flydubai flight and whether Iran was involved.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡表示，现在确定飞行员为何刺伤同事、似乎试图接管迪拜航空航班以及伊朗是否参与其中还为时过早。

paras.en: “We’ve had signs that Iran, in particular through its proxies, was intending to heighten terrorist attacks against Israel and Israeli nationals abroad,” he said. “But I think it’s too early to say whether there was Iranian collusion here.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我们有迹象表明，伊朗，特别是通过其代理人，打算加强对以色列和海外以色列国民的恐怖袭击。” “但我认为现在判断这里是否有伊朗勾结还为时过早。”

paras.en: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz branded the incident a “jihadist terrorist attack attempt,” without expanding on how he had reached that conclusion.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨将该事件称为“圣战恐怖袭击企图”，但没有详细说明他是如何得出这一结论的。

paras.en: President Donald Trump also weighed in, calling it “an incredible story.”
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统也发表了看法，称这是“一个令人难以置信的故事”。

paras.en: “It seems as though the co-pilot was perhaps a terrorist or perhaps a whack job, and he stabbed the pilot,” Trump told reporters.
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“看起来副驾驶可能是一名恐怖分子，或者可能是一名普通人，他刺伤了飞行员。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump told reporters at the White House that the pilot who initiated the attack could be linked to Iran.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普在白宫告诉记者，发起袭击的飞行员可能与伊朗有关。

paras.en: “I would say the answer, based on what I’m hearing, is yes. But we’re working on it right now,” he said.
paras.zh: “根据我所听到的情况，我想说答案是肯定的。但我们现在正在努力解决这个问题，”他说。

paras.en: Asked whether the pilot could have been radicalized or working with Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, Trump replied, “Could have been, yeah.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这名飞行员是否可能变得激进或与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队合作时，特朗普回答说：“可能是的。”

paras.en: Trump also told reporters Thursday that there would be renewed strikes against Iran if it was behind the attack.
paras.zh: 特朗普周四还对记者表示，如果伊朗是此次袭击的幕后黑手，将会对伊朗发动新一轮打击。

paras.en: “Oh, they’ll be hit very hard, don’t worry,” he said.
paras.zh: “哦，他们会受到很大的打击，别担心，”他说。

paras.en: “You just ask them,” he added. “They know what happened. They’ll be hit very hard.”
paras.zh: “你只要问他们就行了，”他补充道。 “他们知道发生了什么。他们会受到非常沉重的打击。”

paras.en: All the passengers were Israeli, according to Netanyahu’s office. Four were dual American-Israeli citizens, two U.S. officials told NBC News.
paras.zh: 据内塔尼亚胡办公室称，所有乘客都是以色列人。两名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻，其中四人是美国和以色列双重公民。

paras.en: With few details about the suspect or any potential motive surrounding the incident, Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for Netanyahu’s office, said there was a “strong opinion” that the incident was a terrorist attack, “but we can’t be sure until we debrief everybody.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼(Doron Spielman)对嫌疑人或事件潜在动机的细节知之甚少，他表示，“强烈认为”该事件是一起恐怖袭击，“但在我们向所有人通报情况之前，我们无法确定。”

paras.en: An investigation by Saudi authorities is ongoing, David Mencer, a spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office, said separately.
paras.zh: 以色列总理办公室发言人戴维·门瑟(David Mencer)单独表示，沙特当局的调查正在进行中。

paras.en: A senior U.S. official and a Saudi official who were both briefed on the Israeli investigation said the stabbing increasingly looked like an act of terrorism based on early findings.
paras.zh: 听取了以色列调查情况简报的一名美国高级官员和一名沙特官员表示，根据早期调查结果，刺伤事件越来越像是恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates’ attorney general, Hamad Saif Al Shamsi, separately ordered an investigation.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西单独下令进行调查。

paras.en: His office said the probe would seek to “gather information and evidence, establish the facts and circumstances of the incident, and determine the underlying motives,” in addition to examining “whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose, or involved any prior planning or direction.”
paras.zh: 他的办公室表示，调查将寻求“收集信息和证据，确定事件的事实和情况，并确定潜在动机”，此外还会审查“该事件是否与任何恐怖活动或目的有关，或涉及任何先前的计划或指示”。

paras.en: Hessa Alyahya, spokesperson for the Saudi Embassy in the U.S., said authorities were waiting to determine whether the attack was a dispute between the pilots or whether it was an act sponsored by Iran or the Houthis.
paras.zh: 沙特驻美国大使馆发言人赫萨·阿利亚亚 (Hessa Alyahya) 表示，当局正在等待确定此次袭击是否是飞行员之间的纠纷，还是伊朗或胡塞武装发起的行动。

paras.en: Israel and Saudi Arabia do not have official diplomatic relations.
paras.zh: 以色列和沙特阿拉伯没有正式外交关系。

articles.title: What we know about the pilot hailed as a hero for averting crash of Israel-bound plane
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: He is being hailed around the world as a hero for helping stop a passenger plane bound for Israel from plunging into the ground, despite his own severe injuries.
paras.zh: 尽管他自己受了重伤，但他仍帮助阻止一架飞往以色列的客机坠入地面，因此在全世界被誉为英雄。

paras.en: Images of Capt. Smit Machchhar covered in blood have gone viral after he fought his fellow pilot, who, according to Israeli officials, stabbed him and attempted to nosedive the plane carrying 174 people from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 斯密特·马赫恰尔机长浑身是血的照片在网上疯传，他与自己的飞行员同伴发生冲突，据以色列官员称，后者刺伤了他，并试图使这架载有 174 人的飞机从迪拜飞往特拉维夫。

paras.en: While bleeding profusely, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door, allowing other passengers and the Emirati crew to overpower the other pilot and take control of the aircraft. The flight was diverted to an airport in Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely.
paras.zh: 在流血过多的情况下，马赫恰尔设法打开了驾驶舱门，让其他乘客和阿联酋机组人员制服了另一名飞行员并控制了飞机。该航班被转移到沙特阿拉伯的一个机场，并在那里安全着陆。

paras.en: The Mumbai native’s actions have “shown the world the highest form of courage” and “prevented another 9/11-like attack from happening,” Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Thursday, after speaking with Machchhar’s family. “The whole world is proud of him,” he added.
paras.zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周四在与马赫恰尔的家人交谈后表示，这位孟买人的行动“向世界展示了最高形式的勇气”，并“阻止了另一场类似 9/11 的袭击发生”。 “全世界都为他感到骄傲，”他补充道。

paras.en: Machchhar spoke previously of getting the “aviation bug” at 19 while pursuing a management course to grow his family’s textile business.
paras.zh: Macchhar 此前曾表示，19 岁时，他在修读管理课程以发展家族纺织业务时迷上了“航空”。

paras.en: He worked for years at a low-cost Indian airline before joining Flydubai and had nearly 10,000 hours of flying experience before Wednesday’s incident.
paras.zh: 在加入 Flydubai 之前，他在一家低成本印度航空公司工作了多年，在周三的事件发生之前，他已经拥有近 10,000 小时的飞行经验。

paras.en: Machchhar is being treated in a hospital in Tabuk city in northwest Saudi Arabia, with his condition described as “stable” on Wednesday by the Indian Embassy in Riyadh. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Fox News he was “very badly wounded.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔正在沙特阿拉伯西北部塔布克市的一家医院接受治疗，印度驻利雅得大使馆周三称他的病情“稳定”。以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡告诉福克斯新闻，他“受了重伤”。

paras.en: Deepak Mittal, India’s ambassador to the United Arab Emirates, said on X he met with Machchhar’s family on Thursday in Dubai and “conveyed full support of the Government of India in ensuring welfare and wellbeing of the Indian Hero.”
paras.zh: 印度驻阿拉伯联合酋长国大使迪帕克·米塔尔 (Deepak Mittal) 10 日表示，他周四在迪拜会见了马恰哈尔的家人，并“转达了印度政府在确保印度英雄的福利和福祉方面的全力支持”。

paras.en: Netanyahu called Machchhar “a true hero.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡称马赫恰尔是“真正的英雄”。

paras.en: “Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker — preventing a catastrophic midair disaster,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“尽管被刺伤并受重伤，但他进行了反击、抵抗，打开了驾驶舱门，使乘客和机组人员制服了袭击者，从而避免了一场灾难性的空中灾难。”

paras.en: Machchhar’s former employer, the Indian budget carrier SpiceJet, said on X that he flew for the airline for 10 years. According to his LinkedIn profile, Machchhar joined the Emirati low-cost carrier Flydubai in 2022 after flying for SpiceJet since 2011.
paras.zh: Macchhar 的前雇主印度廉价航空公司 SpiceJet 在 X 上表示，他在该航空公司工作了 10 年。根据他的 LinkedIn 个人资料，Machchhar 自 2011 年以来一直乘坐香料航空 (SpiceJet) 航班，并于 2022 年加入阿联酋廉价航空公司 Flydubai。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the veteran captain was flying a Boeing 737 Max 8, the newer variant of the 737 plane that Machchhar had nearly 10,000 hours of experience flying, according to his profile and a YouTube podcast interview he gave last year.
paras.zh: 周三，这位经验丰富的机长驾驶着一架波音 737 Max 8，根据他的个人资料和他去年接受的 YouTube 播客采访，马赫恰尔拥有近 10,000 小时的飞行经验，这是 737 飞机的更新型。

paras.en: “My first aircraft was a Boeing, and it’s always been that aircraft all my life,” he said.
paras.zh: “我的第一架飞机是波音，我一生都是这架飞机，”他说。

paras.en: Machchhar said he had flown challenging routes, dodged bad weather and handled medical emergencies in the air before.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说，他以前曾飞过具有挑战性的航线、躲避恶劣天气并处理过空中医疗紧急情况。

paras.en: His mother was “scared” when he first told her of his plan to become a pilot, he said in the 2025 interview, but his supportive father agreed to cover the steep fees for aviation training.
paras.zh: 他在 2025 年接受采访时表示，当他第一次告诉母亲自己成为一名飞行员的计划时，他的母亲感到“害怕”，但支持他的父亲同意支付高昂的航空培训费用。

paras.en: Between 2008 and 2009, Machchhar trained for 18 months at an aviation college in New Zealand. It was the first time he had been outside India, he said, and he had been on only a “couple of flights” as a passenger before learning to fly.
paras.zh: 2008年至2009年间，马赫恰尔在新西兰的一所航空学院接受了18个月的培训。他说，这是他第一次离开印度，在学习飞行之前，他只作为乘客乘坐过“几次航班”。

paras.en: He “stood out” among those training and did well with his studies, Mainland Air chief executive Philip Kean told New Zealand’s 1News, adding: “We’re all very proud of him here.”
paras.zh: 大陆航空首席执行官菲利普·基恩 (Philip Kean) 告诉新西兰 1News，他在这些培训中“脱颖而出”，学习成绩也很好，并补充道：“我们都为他感到骄傲。”

paras.en: In his early days as a qualified pilot, he took whatever flight routes he was assigned.
paras.zh: 在他作为一名合格飞行员的早期，他按照指定的航线飞行。

paras.en: “When I started flying ... the only thing I wanted to do then was fly,” Machchhar told the podcast. “I didn’t want to sleep, I didn’t want to go anywhere, and they loved me for it.”
paras.zh: “当我开始飞行时……我唯一想做的事情就是飞，”马赫恰尔告诉播客。 “我不想睡觉，我不想去任何地方，他们因此而爱我。”

paras.en: “For a pilot to gain that experience and to refine your skills is what a pilot is,” he added.
paras.zh: “飞行员的本质就是获得经验并提高技能，”他补充道。

paras.en: But his attitude changed when he got married and started a family, he said.
paras.zh: 但他说，当他结婚并组建家庭后，他的态度发生了变化。

paras.en: “Now I would say I try when I get out of the cockpit or the aircraft, I don’t want the other guy to know that I’m a pilot. I don’t want to discuss aviation,” he said.
paras.zh: “现在我会说，当我走出驾驶舱或飞机时，我会尝试，我不想让其他人知道我是一名飞行员。我不想讨论航空，”他说。

paras.en: “Now the kids are there,” he said. “They want to play with you.”
paras.zh: “现在孩子们都在那里了，”他说。 “他们想和你一起玩。”

paras.en: In the interview, Machchhar also spoke about the “rigorous training” that pilots and cabin crew undergo, which includes safety and emergency procedures.
paras.zh: 在采访中，马赫恰尔还谈到了飞行员和机组人员接受的“严格培训”，其中包括安全和应急程序。

paras.en: “When we are up there and if something happens, who is going to save you? You’ll be lucky enough to have a doctor on board,” he said.
paras.zh: “当我们在那里时，如果发生什么事情，谁来救你？你会很幸运，船上有医生，”他说。

paras.en: “They can save your life,” he said, referring to the cabin crew.
paras.zh: “他们可以拯救你的生命，”他指的是机组人员。

articles.title: G7 countries to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil reserves
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Member countries in the Group of Seven agreed Friday to release tens of millions of barrels of diesel fuel and crude oil, the latest move by industrial economies around the world to cap soaring gas prices.
paras.zh: 七国集团成员国周五同意释放数千万桶柴油和原油，这是全球工业经济体为遏制天然气价格飙升而采取的最新举措。

paras.en: Following a G7 videoconference hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron, President Donald Trump said, “Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil.”
paras.zh: 在法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙主持的七国集团视频会议后，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，“欧洲刚刚同意释放大量库存的柴油。”

paras.en: “The process will begin immediately,” Trump posted on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “这一过程将立即开始，”特朗普在真相社交网站上发帖称。

paras.en: Gas prices have soared since the United States and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28. But diesel in particular saw a renewed surge this summer after the Russia-Ukraine war escalated in July. Since late February, the average price of U.S. diesel has surged 70% to $6.37 per gallon.
paras.zh: 自 2 月 28 日美国和以色列袭击伊朗以来，天然气价格飙升。但在 7 月俄罗斯-乌克兰战争升级后，今年夏天柴油价格再次飙升。自2月底以来，美国柴油平均价格已飙升70%至每加仑6.37美元。

paras.en: The release will be as much as 100 million barrels over the course of four months, the G7 said in a statement. It noted that there would be a “substantial diesel release within the first 20 days.”
paras.zh: 七国集团在一份声明中表示，四个月内将释放多达 1 亿桶石油。报告指出，“前 20 天内将出现大量柴油排放”。

paras.en: The leaders also said that they would begin coordinating maintenance schedules for oil refineries in their respective countries, “to prevent simultaneous capacity shutdowns and temporarily increase utilization rates where feasible.”
paras.zh: 领导人还表示，他们将开始协调各自国家炼油厂的维护计划，“以防止产能同时关闭，并在可行的情况下暂时提高利用率”。

paras.en: Many American and European refiners are already operating at maximum capacity levels.
paras.zh: 许多美国和欧洲炼油厂已经以最大产能水平运营。

paras.en: “Our citizens’ concerns about energy prices remain a top priority,” the group said.
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“我们公民对能源价格的担忧仍然是首要任务。”

paras.en: Oil analyst Andy Lipow said the release could help smooth over recent supply disruptions.
paras.zh: 石油分析师安迪·利波(Andy Lipow)表示，此次释放可能有助于缓解最近的供应中断。

paras.en: “A release of 100 million barrels of diesel fuel over four months would essentially replace Russian exports which have been banned as Ukrainian drone strikes have severely reduced Russian refining capacity,” said Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates.
paras.zh: Lipow Oil Associates 总裁 Lipow 表示：“四个月内释放 1 亿桶柴油将基本上取代因乌克兰无人机袭击严重削弱俄罗斯炼油能力而被禁止的俄罗斯出口。”

paras.en: At the gas pump, he said, “A release of this magnitude could temporarily reduce diesel prices by 25 cents per gallon but does little to increase refinery capacity to produce more.”
paras.zh: 他在加油站表示，“如此大规模的排放可能会暂时使每加仑柴油价格降低 25 美分，但对提高炼油厂生产更多产能的作用微乎其微。”

paras.en: In March, countries that are members of the International Energy Agency approved a release of 400 million barrels of crude oil. That helped to partially ease the energy supply crunch for a time, but prices continued to rise.
paras.zh: 3月份，国际能源署成员国批准释放4亿桶原油。这在一定程度上缓解了能源供应紧张的局面，但价格仍在继续上涨。

paras.en: As of Friday, prices still remain sharply elevated since the Iran war began. Brent crude oil, which was down 3% in anticipation of the news, still hovered above $100 per barrel. Since the start of the year, Brent prices are up more than 60% still.
paras.zh: 截至周五，自伊朗战争开始以来，价格仍然大幅上涨。受此消息影响，布伦特原油下跌 3%，但仍徘徊在每桶 100 美元上方。自今年年初以来，布伦特原油价格仍上涨了 60% 以上。

paras.en: The agreement between G7 countries also comes after a weeklong pressure campaign by the Trump administration on its European allies, particularly Germany and France, which hold a large share of the European Union’s diesel reserves.
paras.zh: 七国集团国家之间达成的协议也是在特朗普政府对其欧洲盟友，特别是德国和法国进行了为期一周的压力之后达成的，这两个国家在欧盟柴油储备中占有很大份额。

paras.en: “American farmers, truckers, and businesses should not be left carrying the burden of a global diesel shortage” alone, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wrote on X late Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周四晚间写道，“美国农民、卡车司机和企业不应独自承受全球柴油短缺的负担”。

paras.en: With just weeks to go until the Nov. 3 midterm elections, Republicans are facing a wall of poor polling numbers on the economy.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日中期选举仅剩几周时间，共和党人面临着糟糕的经济民调数据。

paras.en: Just 41% of registered voters approve of Trump’s handling of the U.S. economy, according to the most recent NBC News polling, while 56% disapprove.
paras.zh: 根据 NBC News 的最新民意调查，只有 41% 的登记选民认可特朗普对美国经济的处理方式，而 56% 的人不认可。

paras.en: Meanwhile, economists say Trump’s policies are fueling inflation, roiling financial markets and upending global trade.
paras.zh: 与此同时，经济学家表示，特朗普的政策正在加剧通货膨胀，扰乱金融市场并颠覆全球贸易。

paras.en: Against this backdrop, the president and his party were eager for a development like Friday’s G-7 agreement to help show the public they could make progress on a central election issue: Sky-high gas prices.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，总统和他的政党渴望出现像周五七国集团协议这样的进展，以帮助向公众表明他们可以在一个核心选​​举问题上取得进展：天价高油价。

paras.en: But at the same time as Trump is hailing the release of oil and diesel reserves, he has also been openly considering a U.S. diesel export ban.
paras.zh: 但在特朗普欢呼释放石油和柴油储备的同时，他也一直在公开考虑实施美国柴油出口禁令。

paras.en: This would hit E.U. countries, as well as the United Kingdom, particularly hard.
paras.zh: 这将打击欧盟。国家，以及英国，尤其困难。

paras.en: Earlier Friday, the E.U. said it “fully rejects any ban on diesel.”
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，欧盟表示“完全拒绝任何柴油禁令”。

paras.en: “A ban would not be beneficial to anyone,” a European Commission spokeswoman told reporters in a briefing.
paras.zh: “禁令对任何人都没有好处，”欧盟委员会发言人在简报中告诉记者。

paras.en: Following the G7 leaders’ announcement, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said they“welcome the decision of G7 countries not to impose any export bans on allies and the continued solidarity between partners.”
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人宣布这一消息后，欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，他们“欢迎七国集团国家不对盟友实施任何出口禁令的决定以及伙伴之间的持续团结”。

articles.title: Detailed plan led to murder of Hong Kong model Abby Choi, court hears

paras.en: Detailed plan led to murder of Hong Kong model and influencer Abby Choi, court hears
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，详细计划导致香港模特兼影响力人物蔡美儿被谋杀

paras.en: The ex-husband and in-laws of Hong Kong influencer Abby Choi have appeared in court on trial for the 28-year-old's murder.
paras.zh: 香港网红蔡碧儿 (Abby Choi) 的前夫和姻亲因谋杀 28 岁的崔碧碧 (Abby Choi) 案出庭受审。

paras.en: Police discovered parts of the model's dismembered body at a suburban property in Hong Kong in February 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 2 月，警方在香港郊区的一处房产中发现了该模特被肢解的部分尸体。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege Ms Choi's ex-husband Alex Kwong, his father Kwong Kau, and brother Anthony Kwong bought equipment to dispose of her body.
paras.zh: 检方指控蔡女士的前夫邝志强、他的父亲邝九和弟弟邝国健购买了处理她尸体的设备。

articles.title: Nepal plans to drain four glacial lakes after flooding disaster

paras.en: Nepal plans to drain four glacial lakes perched high in the mountains to reduce flood risks.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔计划排干高山上的四个冰川湖，以减少洪水风险。

paras.en: Rescuers are still searching for more than 5,000 people missing in the border region with China after August's glacier collapse.
paras.zh: 8月冰川崩塌后，救援人员仍在中美边境地区搜寻失踪的5000多人。

paras.en: The process of draining water "through gated structures" will start after a detailed study, and could take up to six years to complete.
paras.zh: “通过门控结构”排水的过程将在详细研究后开始，可能需要长达六年的时间才能完成。

paras.en: Nepal will kick off a high-stakes effort to drain four glacial lakes perched high in the mountains, as it scrambles to reduce flood risks, officials said, after a recent disaster that killed more than 1,400.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，在最近发生的一场导致 1,400 多人死亡的灾难之后，尼泊尔将启动一项高风险的工作，排干高山上的四个冰川湖，以减少洪水风险。

paras.en: "Our aim is to lower the risk of the lakes breaching their natural dams and reduce the risk of downstream floods," said Subash Tuladhar, an expert with a government research centre tasked with overseeing the new project.
paras.zh: “我们的目标是降低湖泊冲破天然水坝的风险，并减少下游洪水的风险，”负责监督新项目的政府研究中心专家苏巴什·图拉达尔 (Subash Tuladhar) 说。

paras.en: Canals will drain water into nearby rivers in a regulated way, he said, adding that workers faced health risks as a result of the lengthy periods of high-altitude work required, in addition to the dangers of sudden flooding.
paras.zh: 他说，运河将以规范的方式将水排入附近的河流。他补充说，由于需要长时间的高空作业，除了突然发生洪水的危险外，工人们还面临着健康风险。

paras.en: Design work and detailed studies targeting the central and eastern lakes of Thulagi, Lower Barun, Lumding Tsho and Hongu II, will begin in the fiscal year that runs until mid-July 2027, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，针对 Thulagi、Lower Barun、Lumding Tsho 和 Hongu II 中部和东部湖泊的设计工作和详细研究将于 2027 年 7 月中旬之前的财政年度开始。

paras.en: The lakes, at heights ranging from 4,050m to 5,483m rank among Nepal's most potentially dangerous, the United Nations Development Programme and the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) said in a 2020 report.
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署和国际山地综合发展中心 (ICIMOD) 在 2020 年的一份报告中表示，这些海拔从 4,050m 到 5,483m 的湖泊被列为尼泊尔最具潜在危险的湖泊之一。

paras.en: Nepal had the skills and experience required for the $50-million project to be funded by the Green Climate Fund, the UNDP and the government, added Mr Tuladhar, of Nepal's Centre for Hydrology and Water Resources Research.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔水文和水资源研究中心的图拉达尔先生补充道，尼泊尔拥有绿色气候基金、联合国开发计划署和政府资助的 5000 万美元项目所需的技能和经验。

paras.en: The work of draining "through gated structures" will start after a detailed study, and could take up to six years to complete, said Sanjeeb Baral, the Centre's executive director.
paras.zh: 该中心执行董事桑吉布·巴拉尔表示，“通过门控结构”排水的工作将在详细研究后开始，可能需要六年时间才能完成。

paras.en: It will encompass installation of sensors, a flood forecasting and warning system, and efforts to build downstream resilience and prepare communities for the risks.
paras.zh: 它将包括安装传感器、洪水预报和预警系统，以及建立下游抵御能力和让社区做好应对风险准备的努力。

paras.en: In similar previous efforts, Nepal lowered by 3 m (10 ft) the level of the central Himalayan glacial lake of Tsho Rolpa by in 2000 and that of Imja in the vicinity of Mount Everest, the world's tallest peak, 10 years ago.
paras.zh: 在之前的类似努力中，尼泊尔于 2000 年将喜马拉雅中部措罗尔帕 (Tsho Rolpa) 冰川湖的水位降低了 3 m（10 英尺），并于 10 年前将世界最高峰珠穆朗玛峰附近的伊姆贾 (Imja) 的水位降低了 3 m（10 英尺）。

paras.en: Nepal's disaster served as a warning to the world, Prime Minister Balendra Shah, 36, told the United Nations in an impassioned speech last month that blamed climate change despite his country's negligible emissions.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔36岁的总理巴伦德拉·沙阿上个月在一次慷慨激昂的演讲中对联合国表示，尼泊尔的灾难向世界发出了警告，尽管尼泊尔的排放量微乎其微，但他仍将责任归咎于气候变化。

paras.en: Retreating glaciers, unstable mountain slopes and increasingly unpredictable rivers showed Nepal was paying a heavy price, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，冰川后退、不稳定的山坡和日益不可预测的河流表明尼泊尔正在付出沉重的代价。

paras.en: Nepal, which has reported about 26 glacial lake outburst flood events in the past four decades, loses more than 300 lives and property worth millions of dollars to extreme climate events annually on average.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔在过去40年中报告了约26起冰川湖溃决洪水事件，平均每年因极端气候事件造成300多人的生命和财产损失，价值数百万美元。

paras.en: The latest floods devastated a dozen hydro-electric plants, roads, bridges, farms and settlements. Cash-strapped Nepal would need billions of dollars for early recovery, officials have said.
paras.zh: 最近的洪水摧毁了十几座水力发电厂、道路、桥梁、农场和定居点。官员们表示，现金短缺的尼泊尔需要数十亿美元才能尽早恢复。

paras.en: Lowering the lakes by three metres would significantly reduce the threat, said Samjwal Ratna Bajracharya, a retired ICIMOD expert on glaciers, glacial lakes and outburst floods.
paras.zh: ICIMOD 冰川、冰川湖和溃决洪水专家退休专家 Samjwal Ratna Bajracharya 表示，将湖泊降低三米将大大减少威胁。

paras.en: "They are growing fast, are high up in the Himalayas and could cause outbursts any time, due to earthquakes, avalanches, climatic conditions and unplanned human-induced activity," he told Reuters.
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社：“它们生长迅速，位于喜马拉雅山高处，由于地震、雪崩、气候条件和计划外的人类活动，随时可能引发爆发。”

paras.en: Immense DNA identification task continues
paras.zh: 艰巨的DNA鉴定任务仍在继续

paras.en: With thousands still missing and recovery crews facing mounting DNA profiles to process, fragmented remains and limited technical capacity experts warn matching bodies to families could take weeks.
paras.zh: 由于仍有数千人失踪，救援人员面临着越来越多的 DNA 图谱需要处理、支离破碎的遗体和有限的技术能力，专家警告说，将尸体与家人匹配可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: Just 112 bodies have been identified and returned to their families. A further 5,285 people are missing in Nepal, including hundreds of foreigners.
paras.zh: 目前仅有 112 具尸体的身份已被确认并归还给其家人。尼泊尔另有 5,285 人失踪，其中包括数百名外国人。

paras.en: In China, the toll is 43 dead and 519 missing, according to state media -- taking the combined toll to nearly 1,500 dead and 5,800 missing.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国已造成 43 人死亡、519 人失踪，合计死亡人数接近 1,500 人、失踪人数 5,800 人。

articles.title: Magnitude-4.8 earthquake strikes in rural Victoria

paras.en: A 4.8-magnitude earthquake has been recorded near the Victorian town of Leongatha.
paras.zh: 维多利亚小镇 Leongatha 附近发生了 4.8 级地震。

paras.en: Geoscience Australia said the quake hit at a shallow depth of 10 kilometres just after 2am, and the epicentre was near the South Gippsland town, which is about 135km south-east of Melbourne.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局表示，凌晨2点刚过，地震发生在深度10公里的浅层地震，震中位于墨尔本东南部约135公里处的南吉普斯兰镇附近。

paras.en: The federal agency's websites cited almost 15,000 felt reports in the area by 3am. There have been no reports of injuries or damage.
paras.zh: 截至凌晨 3 点，联邦机构网站引用了该地区近 15,000 份有感报告。目前还没有人员受伤或损坏的报告。

paras.en: Hadi Ghasemi, a geophysicist with Geoscience Australia, told the ABC it was one of the strongest tremors the region had experienced in the last two decades.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局的地球物理学家哈迪·加塞米 (Hadi Ghasemi) 告诉澳大利亚广播公司 (ABC)，这是该地区过去二十年来经历的最强烈的地震之一。

paras.en: "The shaking was widely felt, close to the epicentre. It was a strong shake but I don't expect any major damage,"
paras.zh: “震中附近广泛感受到震动。震动很强烈，但我预计不会造成重大损失。”

paras.en: Geoscience Australia also confirmed that a 3.1-magnitude aftershock struck, also near Leongatha, just before 3am.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局还证实，凌晨 3 点左右，Leongatha 附近也发生了 3.1 级余震。

articles.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust

paras.en: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust
paras.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情因暴力和不信任导致超过 4,000 人死亡

paras.en: Health workers protest lack of pay; Congolese politician beaten to death over response to outbreak
paras.zh: 卫生工作者抗议缺乏工资；刚果政客因应对疫情被殴打致死

paras.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded more than 4,000 deaths, authorities said, as they struggle to contain the spread of the virus.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已造成 4,000 多人死亡，当局表示，他们正在努力遏制病毒的传播。

paras.en: The latest figures released by the health ministry on Thursday showed that 4,018 people have died, making up nearly half of the 8,300 confirmed cases, in what has become the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.
paras.zh: 卫生部周四公布的最新数据显示，已有4,018人死亡，占8,300例确诊病例的近一半，这已成为历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: Congo announced an outbreak on May 15, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which has no known treatment or vaccine.
paras.zh: 刚果于 5 月 15 日宣布爆发疫情，由罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起，目前尚无已知的治疗方法或疫苗。

paras.en: Some health workers gathered in Bunia, the capital of northeastern Ituri province, the heart of the outbreak. They were demanding payment for wages owed, but were quickly dispersed by officials. The protesting workers included surveillance team members, who identify people exposed to infected patients. They waved placards saying, "No money, no data!" and "No payment for months."
paras.zh: 一些卫生工作者聚集在疫情爆发中心、东北部伊图里省首府布尼亚。他们要求支付所欠工资，但很快就被官员驱散。抗议工人包括监测小组成员，他们负责识别与感染患者接触过的人。他们挥舞着标语牌，上面写着：“没有钱，没有数据！”和“几个月没有付款”。

paras.en: Front-line workers have gone on strike several times since the outbreak began, further hampering efforts to contain the disease.
paras.zh: 自疫情爆发以来，一线工人已多次罢工，进一步阻碍了遏制疫情的努力。

paras.en: A senior UN official said that an Ebola-hit camp housing a transit centre for infected patients was burned by soldiers earlier this week as they were looking for weapons in Kigonze, on the outskirts of Bunia, forcing 19,000 people in the camp to flee.
paras.zh: 一名联合国高级官员表示，本周早些时候，士兵们在布尼亚郊区基贡泽寻找武器时烧毁了一个设有感染患者转运中心的埃博拉营地，迫使营地内的 19,000 人逃离。

paras.en: Julien Harneis, the UN senior Ebola co-ordinator, said creating Ebola transit and treatment centres has been a struggle, requiring money and staff, all of which are in short supply.
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉病毒高级协调员朱利安·哈内斯(Julien Harneis)表示，建立埃博拉转运和治疗中心是一项艰巨的任务，需要资金和人员，而这些都供不应求。

paras.en: "When we lose a centre, that means we lose capacity, we lose investment and we have to start again. And above all, it means that people do not get access to the care that they really need," Harneis said.
paras.zh: “当我们失去一个中心时，这意味着我们失去了能力，我们失去了投资，我们必须重新开始。最重要的是，这意味着人们无法获得他们真正需要的护理，”哈内斯说。

paras.en: Infected aid worker evacuated to Netherlands
paras.zh: 受感染的援助人员被疏散至荷兰

paras.en: An aid worker with Médecins Sans Frontières, known in English as Doctors Without Borders, was infected with Ebola while working in Congo, the group said in a statement.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织在一份声明中表示，该组织的一名救援人员在刚果工作期间感染了埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: The worker arrived late on Thursday night after being flown to the Netherlands on a special medical flight and was transferred to a high-level isolation unit, the Leiden University Medical Center said in a statement.
paras.zh: 莱顿大学医学中心在一份声明中称，这名工人乘坐特殊医疗航班飞往荷兰后于周四深夜抵达，并被转移到高级隔离病房。

paras.en: - Suspected Ebola case at Montreal hospital turns out to be a false alarm
paras.zh: - 蒙特利尔医院疑似埃博拉病例结果是虚惊一场

paras.en: - Video Ebola outbreak now deadliest in Congo’s history
paras.zh: - 视频 刚果历史上最致命的埃博拉疫情爆发

paras.en: "The human cost of this crisis is unprecedented in the DRC, with communities facing the largest Ebola disease outbreak ever recorded in the country," MSF said.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织表示：“这场危机在刚果民主共和国造成了前所未有的人员伤亡，社区面临着该国有史以来最大规模的埃博拉疫情。”

paras.en: More than 50 health workers have died after contracting the virus.
paras.zh: 超过 50 名卫生工作者感染病毒后死亡。

paras.en: Community resistance hampering containment efforts
paras.zh: 社区抵制阻碍了遏制工作

paras.en: The World Health Organization has recently raised the alarm about the virus's rapid spread into new health zones, stretching limited resources.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织最近对病毒迅速传播到新的卫生区发出了警告，导致有限的资源捉襟见肘。

paras.en: Africa CDC said in its latest news conference that the number of newly confirmed cases is falling, but that could be attributed to insecurity and challenges in getting communities to co-operate in some of the hot spots. While the spread of the disease has slowed down in some areas, it has accelerated in others, creating what experts see as a delicate situation.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心在最新的新闻发布会上表示，新确诊病例数量正在下降，但这可能归因于一些热点地区的不安全局势和社区合作方面的挑战。虽然这种疾病的传播在某些地区已经放缓，但在其他地区却在加速，造成了专家认为的微妙局面。

paras.en: - Video Moderna authorized to test vaccines to fight Ebola virus in Congo
paras.zh: - 视频 Moderna 获授权在刚果测试抗击埃博拉病毒的疫苗

paras.en: - Aid cuts have slowed fight to contain Ebola in central Africa, doctors say
paras.zh: - 医生称，援助削减减缓了中部非洲遏制埃博拉病毒的斗争

paras.en: Confirmed cases have slowed in recent weeks, from around 850 cases and 470 deaths a week in mid-July to an average of 490 cases and 230 deaths in September.
paras.zh: 最近几周确诊病例数有所放缓，从 7 月中旬的每周约 850 例病例和 470 例死亡病例减少到 9 月份的平均 490 例病例和 230 例死亡病例。

paras.en: A Congolese politician was attacked and beaten to death earlier this week for defending government measures in dealing with the outbreak, highlighting tensions that have stretched both the health community and local resources.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，一名刚果政客因捍卫政府应对疫情的措施而遭到袭击并被殴打致死，这突显了卫生界和当地资源捉襟见肘的紧张局势。

paras.en: The attack on Marie-Célestin Karondwa, a local official with Congo's ruling Union for Democracy and Social Progress party, took place on Sunday at his home in Butembo, an Ebola hot spot in eastern North Kivu province. His house was set on fire afterward, and he died at a hospital from his injuries.
paras.zh: 周日，刚果执政党民主与社会进步联盟当地官员玛丽-塞莱斯廷·卡隆杜瓦 (Marie-Célestin Karondwa) 在位于北基伍省东部埃博拉热点地区布滕博的家中遭到袭击。随后他的房子被纵火，他因伤在医院死亡。

paras.en: Widespread mistrust of health workers and the authorities has hampered efforts to slow the Central African nation's 17th Ebola outbreak.
paras.zh: 对卫生工作者和当局的广泛不信任阻碍了减缓这个中非国家第17次埃博拉疫情爆发的努力。

paras.en: Authorities last month launched a village-centred approach, but those efforts face resistance from residents who dismiss Ebola as a hoax. There is also deep distrust in the country's government for reasons ranging from how it's managed past Ebola outbreaks to chronic corruption.
paras.zh: 当局上个月推出了一项以村庄为中心的方法，但这些努力面临居民的抵制，他们认为埃博拉病毒是一场骗局。由于从过去埃博拉疫情的管理方式到长期腐败等原因，人们对该国政府也存在深深的不信任。

articles.title: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, including diesel, amid energy crunch

paras.en: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, including diesel, amid energy crunch
paras.zh: G7国家同意在能源紧缩之际释放1亿桶石油，包括柴油

paras.en: Move would start with 'substantial' diesel release within first 20 days
paras.zh: 此举将从前 20 天内“大量”释放柴油开始

paras.en: The G7 nations said they agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil, starting with "substantial" amounts of diesel, after the fuel recently hit record prices in the United States.
paras.zh: 七国集团国家表示，在美国燃油价格最近创下历史新高后，他们同意释放 1 亿桶石油，首先是“大量”柴油。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on social media the diesel release would happen "immediately," echoing a G7 promise to start immediately with a "frontloaded substantial release" of diesel within the next 20 days and the rest over four months.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上表示，柴油释放将“立即”进行，这呼应了七国集团的承诺，即立即开始在未来 20 天内“提前大量释放”柴油，其余时间将在四个月内进行。

paras.en: Trump and his Republican Party face pressure to address surging prices ahead of the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前，特朗普和他的共和党面临着解决物价飙升问题的压力。

paras.en: The president faces lagging approval ratings as the Iran war and his trade battles have increased U.S. prices for oil and other goods.
paras.zh: 由于伊朗战争和贸易战导致美国石油和其他商品价格上涨，总统面临着落后的支持率。

paras.en: Gas and diesel prices have soared during the eight-month-long war, a cost Trump has repeatedly said is worth it for making sure Iran does not obtain nuclear weapons. Trump has insisted prices will come down after the war, though there's no end in sight.
paras.zh: 在长达八个月的战争期间，天然气和柴油价格飙升，特朗普一再表示，为了确保伊朗不会获得核武器，这一成本是值得的。特朗普坚称战后物价将会下降，但目前还看不到结束的迹象。

paras.en: The average price of diesel in Canada was $2.63 per litre as of Thursday, though prices were higher in some cities, like Vancouver, where a litre of the fuel cost about $2.71. Heightened prices put pressure on transport truck drivers and farmers, who rely on diesel to run vehicles and equipment.
paras.zh: 截至周四，加拿大柴油平均价格为每升 2.63 美元，但温哥华等一些城市的价格较高，每升柴油价格约为 2.71 美元。价格上涨给依赖柴油驱动车辆和设备的运输卡车司机和农民带来了压力。

paras.en: France holds the rotating presidency of the G7 group and made the announcement in a statement released after videoconference talks that French President Emmanuel Macron presided over. The G7 countries are Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the U.K. and the U.S., plus EU representation.
paras.zh: 法国是七国集团轮值主席国，法国总统马克龙主持视频会议后发表声明宣布了这一消息。七国集团国家包括加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、日本、英国和美国，以及欧盟代表。

paras.en: The International Energy Agency will co-ordinate the effort to combat soaring fuel prices.
paras.zh: 国际能源署将协调努力遏制燃料价格飙升。

paras.en: "We will implement our commitments with a co-ordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels (MB) to begin immediately over 4 months, including a front-loaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“我们将履行我们的承诺，在 4 个月内立即开始通过 IEA 协调释放 1 亿桶 (MB)，其中包括七国集团成员和合作伙伴在前 20 天内预先释放大量柴油。”

paras.en: The release follows a March announcement that International Energy Agency member countries would release 426 million barrels of oil and products to stabilize the oil market.
paras.zh: 在此之前，国际能源署成员国3月份宣布将释放4.26亿桶石油和产品以稳定石油市场。

paras.en: The move also comes after Trump last week floated the idea of banning diesel exports in hopes of bringing down gas prices for American drivers — a move experts caution could backfire, putting strain on an already-stretched global fuel market and further raising prices globally.
paras.zh: 此前，特朗普上周提出禁止柴油出口，希望降低美国司机的汽油价格，专家警告此举可能适得其反，给本已紧张的全球燃料市场带来压力，并进一步抬高全球油价。

paras.en: But the G7 statement said the group, which includes the United States, also agreed not to limit energy exports to each other.
paras.zh: 但七国集团声明称，包括美国在内的七国集团也同意不限制相互之间的能源出口。

paras.en: "We reaffirm our commitment to refrain from export restrictions on energy and energy products between G7 countries and call on all producers to refrain from imposing bans that could exacerbate market tensions," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“我们重申承诺不对七国集团国家之间的能源和能源产品实施出口限制，并呼吁所有生产商不要实施可能加剧市场紧张局势的禁令。”

paras.en: Trump had a conversation overnight with Macron about the need to address rising fuel prices and the availability of petroleum products, according to the French Embassy in the U.S., before chairing the videoconference.
paras.zh: 据法国驻美国大使馆称，在主持视频会议之前，特朗普连夜与马克龙就解决燃油价格上涨和石油产品供应问题的必要性进行了交谈。

paras.en: A new AP-NORC poll found that a majority of U.S. adults blame Trump for higher prices, and approval on his handling of the economy hit a new low.
paras.zh: 美联社-NORC的一项新民意调查发现，大多数美国成年人将物价上涨归咎于特朗普，对他处理经济的支持率创下新低。

articles.title: Gypsy Rose Blanchard speaks out about death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker
articles.author: Helen Surgenor

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard speaks out about death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德 (Gypsy Rose Blanchard) 讲述她的前未婚夫肯·厄克 (Ken Urker) 的去世

paras.en: Urker, 34, was found unresponsive in his Louisiana home on his birthday
paras.zh: 34岁的厄克在生日当天被发现在路易斯安那州的家中失去了知觉

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard, who spent more than seven years in prison for her mother's murder, is speaking out after her former fiancé and the father of her daughter was found dead on Thursday.
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德因谋杀母亲而入狱七年多，在她的前未婚夫和女儿的父亲周四被发现死亡后，她发表了讲话。

paras.en: He was found unresponsive in his Raceland, La., home on Oct. 1, his birthday.
paras.zh: 10 月 1 日，也就是他的生日，他被发现在路易斯安那州雷斯兰的家中失去了知觉。

paras.en: The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Department told CBC News it is still investigating his death, and at this point in the investigation, it has found no evidence of foul play.
paras.zh: 拉福什教区治安部门告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，他们仍在调查他的死亡，目前调查尚未发现谋杀的证据。

paras.en: Blanchard, speaking exclusively to People and TMZ, said an unidentified substance was found at the scene, and she believes Urker died of an overdose. Police have not confirmed the cause of death.
paras.zh: 布兰查德在接受《人物》杂志和 TMZ 独家采访时表示，现场发现了一种不明物质，她认为厄克死于服药过量。警方尚未确认死因。

paras.en: "I don’t know if it was intentional or not," Blanchard told People. "He was not in a good state of mind lately."
paras.zh: “我不知道这是有意还是无意，”布兰查德告诉《人物》杂志。 “他最近精神状态不太好。”

paras.en: She also told the publication that Urker was the subject of intense scrutiny and cyber-bullying throughout their relationship.
paras.zh: 她还告诉该刊物，在他们的关系中，厄克一直受到严格审查和网络欺凌。

paras.en: "I believe the tremendous weight of that scrutiny and harassment had a profound impact on him, and I hope his passing serves as a reminder that there is a real person behind every screen, every headline and every comment," she told People.
paras.zh: 她告诉《人物》杂志：“我相信这种审查和骚扰的巨大影响对他产生了深远的影响，我希望他的去世能够提醒人们，每个屏幕、每个头条新闻和每条评论背后都有一个真实的人。”

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker connected in 2017, when he wrote to her in prison after watching the HBO Documentary Mommy Dead and Dearest.
paras.zh: 布兰查德和厄克于 2017 年结识，当时他在监狱里观看 HBO 纪录片《妈妈已死》后给她写信。

paras.en: The film explains how Blanchard's mother, Dee Dee, was believed to have factitious disorder imposed on another (FDIA) — formerly known as Munchausen syndrome by proxy — and for years allegedly forced her daughter to use a wheelchair and feeding tubes she didn't need.
paras.zh: 影片讲述了布兰查德的母亲迪迪 (Dee Dee) 被认为患有强迫症 (FDIA)——以前被称为代理孟乔森综合症 (Munchausen Syndrome)——并据称多年来强迫她的女儿使用轮椅和她不需要的喂食管。

paras.en: In her early 20's, Blanchard and then-boyfriend Nicholas Godejohn came up with a scheme to murder Dee Dee.
paras.zh: 20 岁出头时，布兰查德和当时的男友尼古拉斯·戈德约翰想出了一个谋杀迪迪的计划。

paras.en: Godejohn is serving a life sentence for first-degree murder.
paras.zh: 戈德约翰因一级谋杀罪被判无期徒刑，正在服刑。

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard pleaded guilty to second-degree murder, and was still incarcerated when Urker proposed to her in October 2018. They briefly called off their engagement, before reuniting in 2019.
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德 (Gypsy Rose Blanchard) 承认犯有二级谋杀罪，2018 年 10 月厄克向她求婚时，她仍被监禁。他们短暂取消了订婚，然后于 2019 年复合。

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker separated again for several years, during which time she married Ryan Anderson, and then publicly separated from him in December 2023, four months after she was released from prison.
paras.zh: 布兰查德和厄克再次分居数年，期间她与瑞安·安德森结婚，然后于 2023 年 12 月（即她出狱四个月后）公开与他分居。

paras.en: In June 2024, the docuseries Gypsy Rose: Life After Lock Up premiered on the Lifetime channel.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月，纪录片系列《吉普赛玫瑰：锁定之后的生活》在 Lifetime 频道首播。

paras.en: It followed Blanchard as she reintegrated into society, finalized her divorce from Ryan Anderson and rekindled her relationship with Urker.
paras.zh: 随后布兰查德重新融入社会，完成了与瑞安·安德森的离婚，并重新点燃了与厄克的关系。

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker had a baby together in December 2024, a daughter named Aurora Rain Urker.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月，布兰查德和厄克生下了一个孩子，女儿名叫奥罗拉·雷恩·厄克 (Aurora Rain Urker)。

paras.en: Following his death, Blanchard told People that Urker was a devoted parent and the love of her life.
paras.zh: 乌克去世后，布兰查德告诉《人物》杂志，乌克是一位慈爱的父母，也是她一生的挚爱。

paras.en: "Ken was an amazing father and a man who was deeply loved. He will forever be my soulmate and my red string, a connection that time, distance and even death can never erase."
paras.zh: “肯是一位了不起的父亲，也是一个深受爱的人。他将永远是我的灵魂伴侣和我的红线，一种时间、距离甚至死亡都无法抹去的联系。”

paras.en: Blanchard appeared on the We Need to Talk podcast in June of this year, where she talked about her tumultuous childhood, revisited the night her mother was killed and how she's trying to move past her dark history.
paras.zh: 今年六月，布兰查德出现在“我们需要谈谈”播客中，她在节目中谈到了自己动荡的童年，回顾了母亲被杀的那天晚上，以及她如何努力摆脱黑暗的历史。

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to one of Blanchard's former representatives for further comment.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系布兰查德的一位前代表寻求进一步评论。

articles.title: Argentina launches cash-for-citizenship scheme

paras.en: Argentina's government launched a scheme it hopes will attract wealthy investors and simultaneously "further strengthen the Argentine Republic's fiscal and financial position," offering people the chance to apply for citizenship via investment and thus bypass the more typical procedures.
paras.zh: 阿根廷政府推出了一项计划，希望能够吸引富有的投资者，同时“进一步加强阿根廷共和国的财政和金融地位”，为人们提供通过投资申请公民身份的机会，从而绕过更典型的程序。

paras.en: Economy Minister Luis Caputo and Cabinet chief Diego Santilli launched the citizenship-by-investment program amid the "Argentina Week" business event in Paris, saying it would start accepting applications during the fourth quarter of 2026.
paras.zh: 经济部长路易斯·卡普托和内阁首席迭戈·桑蒂利在巴黎“阿根廷周”商业活动期间启动了投资公民计划，称该计划将于 2026 年第四季度开始接受申请。

paras.en: "This announcement is part of Argentina's drive toward international openness and integration, accompanied by reforms aimed at strengthening the investment climate and attracting capital," the Economy Ministry said in a statement.
paras.zh: 经济部在一份声明中表示：“这一宣布是阿根廷推动国际开放和一体化的一部分，同时还进行了旨在加强投资环境和吸引资本的改革。”

paras.en: Argentina's President Javier Milei has tried to portray himself as a cost-cutting pro-business leader restoring stability to one of the world's most fragile economies, which has defaulted on or restructured parts of its national debt multiple times just this century. Its most recent emergency loans scheme from the IMF and World Bank was approved last April.
paras.zh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱试图将自己描绘成一位削减成本、支持商业的领导人，致力于恢复世界上最脆弱经济体之一的稳定，仅在本世纪，阿根廷就多次拖欠或重组部分国债。国际货币基金组织和世界银行最近的紧急贷款计划于去年四月获得批准。

paras.en: What are the details of the citizenship-by-investment program?
paras.zh: 投资公民计划的细节是什么？

paras.en: The program plans to offer "two simple and transparent mechanisms" to the primary investors seeking citizenship for themselves and perhaps for their immediate family.
paras.zh: 该计划计划为为自己及其直系亲属寻求公民身份的主要投资者提供“两种简单而透明的机制”。

paras.en: The first is "making a direct, non-refundable contribution of $350,000 (roughly €310,000) to the National Treasury," the Economy Ministry said. The other higher risk, higher reward approach will be "subscribing to a $800,000 public bond created specifically for this program."
paras.zh: 经济部表示，第一个是“向国家财政部直接、不可退还捐款 35 万美元（约合 31 万欧元）”。另一种风险较高、回报较高的方法是“认购专门为此计划创建的 80 万美元公共债券”。

paras.en: The principal applicant's spouse and children aged 25 or under can then also apply, albeit themselves having to pay smaller fees. Spouses and childless children aged 18-25 would be charged $100,000 each, and minors would have to contribute $25,000 each.
paras.zh: 主申请人的配偶和 25 岁或以下的子女也可以申请，尽管他们自己需要支付较少的费用。 18-25岁的配偶和无子女的儿童每人需缴纳10万美元，未成年人每人需缴纳25,000美元。

paras.en: "Under this scheme, a typical family unit consisting of a principal applicant, their spouse, and two minor children could apply for Argentine citizenship for a total of $500,000," the ministry said, referring to a sum equating to well over a century earning Argentina's nominal median wage.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“根据该计划，一个由主申请人、其配偶和两名未成年子女组成的典型家庭单位可以申请阿根廷公民身份，金额总计为 50 万美元。”该金额相当于一个多世纪以来阿根廷名义工资中位数的收入。

paras.en: Argentina said it would incorporate recommendations from the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) and the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) to ensure the adoption of international best practices and "comply with applicable standards regarding the prevention of money laundering, terrorist financing, and financial transparency."
paras.zh: 阿根廷表示，将采纳经济合作与发展组织（OECD）和金融行动特别工作组（FATF）的建议，以确保采用国际最佳实践，并“遵守有关防止洗钱、恐怖主义融资和金融透明度的适用标准”。

paras.en: "We continue working to strengthen Argentina's ties with the world, project the value of our citizenship internationally, and consolidate the country as an open and reliable nation," Economy Minister Caputo said online.
paras.zh: 经济部长卡普托在网上表示：“我们将继续努力加强阿根廷与世界的联系，在国际上体现我们公民的价值，并巩固该国作为一个开放和可靠的国家的地位。”

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Iran accused of blocking SIM cards, digital access to silence dissent

paras.en: In Iran, cell phone numbers are a key tool for digital identity verification and access to banking, judicial, administrative and insurance services, as well as many everyday activities.
paras.zh: 在伊朗，手机号码是数字身份验证和获得银行、司法、行政和保险服务以及许多日常活动的关键工具。

paras.en: As a result, disconnecting a SIM card can do more than block calls and text messages. It can also cut off access to a wide range of digital services.
paras.zh: 因此，断开 SIM 卡的连接不仅仅可以阻止通话和短信。它还可以切断对各种数字服务的访问。

paras.en: Some Iranians said the restrictions on their cell phones were accompanied by the blocking of user accounts and access to banking and government services. They said access was restored only after they deleted critical content or pledged to stop participating in protest-related activities.
paras.zh: 一些伊朗人表示，对他们手机的限制还伴随着用户账户以及银行和政府服务的封锁。他们表示，只有在删除关键内容或承诺停止参与抗议相关活动后，访问权限才会恢复。

paras.en: DW spoke to three people in Iran about the issue. They have used pseudonyms out of concern for their safety.
paras.zh: 德国之声采访了伊朗的三名人士，讨论了这个问题。出于对自身安全的考虑，他们使用了化名。

paras.en: Sina told DW that he realized his SIM card had been disconnected while returning from university and trying to book a taxi by phone.
paras.zh: 新浪告诉德国之声，他从大学回来并试图通过电话预订出租车时发现自己的SIM卡已断开。

paras.en: The 25-year-old said that after visiting a telecommunications center, he received a call from someone claiming to be from the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IO-IRGC), who instructed him to go to a specified location to have his SIM card reconnected.
paras.zh: 25岁的男子表示，在访问一家电信中心后，他接到自称是伊斯兰革命卫队情报组织（IO-IRGC）人员的电话，指示他前往指定地点重新连接SIM卡。

paras.en: Sina said he was interrogated for about six hours and that his mobile phone was confiscated.
paras.zh: 新浪称，他被审问了大约六个小时，手机被没收。

paras.en: He said the return of his SIM card and phone was made conditional on signing a pledge expressing "remorse" for his activist activities and online "propaganda against the system." He said he was also required to publish posts supporting the Islamic Republic to "prove his brotherhood with the system."
paras.zh: 他说，归还他的 SIM 卡和手机的条件是签署一份承诺书，表达对他的激进活动和网上“反体制宣传”的“悔恨”。他说，他还被要求发布支持伊斯兰共和国的帖子，以“证明他与该系统的兄弟情谊”。

paras.en: Several hours later, he said, his family discovered that posts on his Instagram account had been deleted. Only one remained, stating that "the activities of the page are in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran."
paras.zh: 他说，几个小时后，他的家人发现他 Instagram 帐户上的帖子已被删除。只剩下一条，称“该页面的活动符合伊朗伊斯兰共和国的法律”。

paras.en: A month later, he said, he had still not received his SIM card or mobile phone back and was unable to access his social media accounts.
paras.zh: 他说，一个月后，他仍然没有收到 SIM 卡或手机，也无法访问他的社交媒体帐户。

paras.en: Sorour, a 41-year-old translator at an official translation office in Tehran, said that after her SIM card was disconnected, she went to a location designated by the IO-IRGC, where she was interrogated for hours about her activities on Instagram and X.
paras.zh: 41 岁的苏鲁尔是德黑兰官方翻译办公室的一名翻译，她说，在她的 SIM 卡被拔掉后，她去了 IO-IRGC 指定的地点，在那里她被审问了几个小时，询问她在 Instagram 和 X 上的活动。

paras.en: Sorour said she was told to make her account private and pledge to refrain from activities critical of the authorities, including advocating for political prisoners, protesting executions and supporting demonstrators during nationwide anti-government protests that began in late December 2025.
paras.zh: 索鲁尔表示，她被告知将自己的账户设为私人账户，并承诺不参与批评当局的活动，包括为政治犯辩护、抗议处决以及在 2025 年 12 月下旬开始的全国反政府抗议活动中支持示威者。

paras.en: Mina, who lives in Isfahan, said she was summoned by an institution she identified as the IO-IRGC after posting a comment supporting one of the country's political currents under a post by a foreign-based news outlet.
paras.zh: 居住在伊斯法罕的米娜表示，她在一家外国新闻媒体的帖子下发表支持该国政治潮流的评论后，被一个她称为 IO-IRGC 的机构传唤。

paras.en: The 63-year-old said her SIM card and national identification card were blocked after she refused to comply with the summons.
paras.zh: 这位 63 岁的女士表示，在她拒绝遵守传票后，她的 SIM 卡和国民身份证被封锁。

paras.en: According to Mina, the restrictions disrupted her access to bank transfers, administrative systems, online purchases and services that require electronic identity verification and one-time passwords.
paras.zh: 米娜表示，这些限制扰乱了她对银行转账、管理系统、网上购物和需要电子身份验证和一次性密码的服务的访问。

paras.en: She told DW she had also been denied access to Sana, the judiciary's electronic system, and was therefore unable to determine whether a case or charges had been filed against her.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声，她也被拒绝访问司法机构的电子系统Sana，因此无法确定是否对她提出了案件或指控。

paras.en: SIM cards: the key to digital life in Iran
paras.zh: SIM 卡：伊朗数字生活的关键

paras.en: Several other Iranian citizens also posted similar complaints on social media.
paras.zh: 其他几名伊朗公民也在社交媒体上发表了类似的抱怨。

paras.en: Zia Nabavi, a former political prisoner, said in an Instagram post that his SIM card had been suddenly disconnected.
paras.zh: 前政治犯齐亚·纳巴维 (Zia Nabavi) 在 Instagram 上发帖称，他的 SIM 卡突然断开连接。

paras.en: He said he discovered the issue while at a doctor's office, where he needed access to his mobile phone and banking text messages.
paras.zh: 他说，他在医生办公室时发现了这个问题，当时他需要访问他的手机和银行短信。

paras.en: "For a long time, I have come to the conclusion that the government's policy toward critics and opponents is to apply pressure that pushes them toward obedience or withdrawing from their activities," Nabavi wrote.
paras.zh: 纳巴维写道：“长期以来，我得出的结论是，政府对批评者和反对者的政策是施加压力，迫使他们服从或退出活动。”

paras.en: Reyhaneh Saeedi, a physician and activist, also said on Instagram that her SIM card has been blocked for months and that this is the second time she has faced such restrictions.
paras.zh: 医生兼活动家 Reyhaneh Saeedi 也在 Instagram 上表示，她的 SIM 卡已被封锁数月，这是她第二次面临此类限制。

paras.en: She said the measure has effectively prevented her from practicing medicine, issuing prescriptions and renewing her Medical Council and medical office licenses.
paras.zh: 她说，这项措施有效地阻止了她行医、开具处方以及更新医疗委员会和医疗办公室执照。

paras.en: Saeedi said her identification card had also been deactivated. She added that no ruling had been formally served on her, she had not been informed of any charges or judicial proceedings, and her efforts to determine the reason for the restrictions had yielded no results.
paras.zh: 萨伊迪说，她的身份证也已被停用。她补充说，尚未对她正式做出任何裁决，她没有被告知任何指控或司法程序，她为确定限制原因所做的努力也没有取得任何结果。

paras.en: Actress Shaghayegh Dehghan said on Instagram that her SIM card had been blocked and that she did not know which institution or authority was behind the move.
paras.zh: 女演员 Shaghayegh Dehghan 在 Instagram 上表示，她的 SIM 卡已被封锁，她不知道是哪个机构或当局在幕后黑手。

paras.en: The disconnection of SIM cards and other digital restrictions has become part of a broader set of tools that the Islamic Republic has used over the past four decades to exert pressure on opponents, critics, journalists, and civil and human rights activists.
paras.zh: SIM卡的断开和其他数字限制已成为伊斯兰共和国在过去四十年中用来向反对者、批评者、记者以及公民和人权活动家施加压力的更广泛工具的一部分。

paras.en: The Defending Free Flow of Information (DeFFI) organization reported in 2025 that journalists and activists had their SIM cards blocked without judicial orders.
paras.zh: 捍卫信息自由流动 (DeFFI) 组织在 2025 年报告称，记者和活动人士的 SIM 卡在没有司法命令的情况下被封锁。

paras.en: The measures have raised concerns about the powers exercised by security institutions to deny citizens access to communication tools and essential services.
paras.zh: 这些措施引起了人们对安全机构行使权力拒绝公民使用通信工具和基本服务的担忧。

paras.en: They have also highlighted the absence of a clear accountability mechanism, leaving those affected with no obvious avenue to challenge the restrictions or seek an explanation.
paras.zh: 他们还强调，缺乏明确的问责机制，导致受影响的人没有明显的途径质疑这些限制或寻求解释。

paras.en: This article was originally published in Farsi
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于波斯语

articles.title: Spain's parliament rejects housing bill as protests continue

paras.en: Spain's parliament has narrowly voted down a pair of emergency government decrees aiming to quell widespread protests against rising rental costs for housing.
paras.zh: 西班牙议会以微弱优势否决了两项紧急政府法令，旨在平息针对住房租金成本上涨的广泛抗议。

paras.en: Hundreds of protesters were gathered outside the parliament in Madrid amid the marathon debate culminating in a pair of votes on Friday. They yelled "shame" and "your profits, our misery," as news of the measures being quashed filtered through.
paras.zh: 数百名抗议者聚集在马德里议会外，这场马拉松式的辩论在周五的两次投票中达到了顶峰。当这些措施被废除的消息传开时，他们大喊“耻辱”和“你的利润，我们的痛苦”。

paras.en: Spain has been gripped by protests for around a week, including a tent city set up in central Madrid, ignited by the eviction of an 87-year-old pensioner from her apartment that threw the more longstanding issue of unaffordable housing costs into sharp focus.
paras.zh: 西班牙已经持续了大约一周的抗议活动，其中包括在马德里市中心建立的一个帐篷城，起因是一名 87 岁的养老金领取者被驱逐出公寓，这使得长期存在的负担不起的住房费用问题成为人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: Why and how did the emergency decrees fail?
paras.zh: 紧急状态法令为何以及如何失败？

paras.en: Left-leaning Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez leads a minority government in Spain and so relies on opposition support to legislate.
paras.zh: 西班牙左倾总理佩德罗·桑切斯领导着一个少数派政府，因此立法依赖反对派的支持。

paras.en: Sanchez spoke at the close of a marathon 5-hour debate in the Chamber of Deputies ahead of the vote, urging members: "Do the right thing, or history will judge you, and sooner than you think."
paras.zh: 投票前，桑切斯在众议院进行了长达 5 个小时的马拉松式辩论，他在结束时发表讲话，敦促议员们：“做正确的事，否则历史将会审判你，而且比你想象的要早。”

paras.en: One Catalan party that sometimes supports Sanchez's government, the economically right-leaning Junts group, joined the opposition in voting down the measures.
paras.zh: 有时支持桑切斯政府的加泰罗尼亚政党——经济上右倾的“Junts”团体也加入了反对派的行列，投票否决了这些措施。

paras.en: The first emergency decree, which the government said would stop evictions of vulnerable people, make real estate speculation harder and provide tax incentives to encourage renting, failed by a narrow margin of 178-172.
paras.zh: 政府表示，第一项紧急法令将阻止对弱势群体的驱逐，加大房地产投机力度，并提供税收优惠以鼓励租房，但以 178 票对 172 票的微弱差距未能通过。

paras.en: The second decree, which sought to make residential leases automatically renewable by tenants, fell further short of a majority at 184-166.
paras.zh: 第二项法令旨在让租户自动续签住宅租约，但以 184 票对 166 票未能获得多数票。

paras.en: Opponents to the measures argued, among other things, that they risked compounding the situation by reducing housing supply.
paras.zh: 除其他外，这些措施的反对者认为，这些措施可能会减少住房供应，从而使情况变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Some also argued that Sanchez should respond to the deadlock by calling early elections, possibly initiating a wholesale change of government.
paras.zh: 一些人还认为，桑切斯应该通过提前举行选举来应对僵局，这可能会引发政府的大规模更迭。

paras.en: The Tenants' Union which had led protests across Spain said it would press on with plans for more mass rallies on Saturday, aiming to continue heaping pressure on the coalition and opposition alike.
paras.zh: 领导西班牙各地抗议活动的租客联盟表示，将继续推进周六举行更多大规模集会的计划，旨在继续向联盟和反对派施加压力。

paras.en: "The encampment will continue and will continue expanding to other neighborhoods," Tenants' Union spokesperson Alicia del Rio said. "We're aiming for a general strike."
paras.zh: 租户联盟发言人阿丽西娅·德尔·里奥（Alicia del Rio）表示：“营地将继续存在，并将继续扩展到其他社区。” “我们的目标是举行总罢工。”

paras.en: The current wave of protests, albeit concerning an issue that's been bubbling away near the surface for years, was triggered by the high-profile eviction of 87-year-old Madrid resident Maricarmen Abascal from the apartment she had occupied for almost all of her life.
paras.zh: 当前的抗议浪潮虽然涉及多年来一直浮出水面的问题，但其起因是 87 岁的马德里居民马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔 (Marcarmen Abascal) 被高调驱逐出她几乎居住了一辈子的公寓。

paras.en: The investment company owning Abascal's building reversed the measure in her case this week but only after the issue had become a symbol of growing frustration of housing costs.
paras.zh: 拥有阿巴斯卡大楼的投资公司本周撤销了针对她的案件的措施，但只是在该问题成为住房成本日益沮丧的象征之后。

paras.en: Rents have roughly doubled in Spain in the last decade and young people, facing one of Europe's toughest labor markets for school-leavers and graduates, frequently live with their parents past the age of 30.
paras.zh: 过去十年，西班牙的房租大约翻了一番，而年轻人面临着欧洲最艰难的离校生和毕业生劳动力市场之一，30 岁以上的年轻人往往与父母住在一起。

paras.en: "People have said 'enough is enough;' this cannot go on. The housing problem must be resolved; structural measures must be taken, and this cannot continue," Abascal's lawyer, Beatriz Duro, said in an interview with Reuters on Thursday.
paras.zh: “人们常说‘受够了’；这种情况不能再继续下去了。住房问题必须解决；必须采取结构性措施，这种情况不能继续下去，”阿巴斯卡尔的律师比阿特丽斯·杜罗(Beatriz Duro)周四在接受路透社采访时表示。

paras.en: The next step after Friday's failed vote in parliament is difficult to identify. Sanchez has so far ruled out calling early elections. He could try to formulate another emergency decree or decrees in response to the protests, but any such move would need to overcome the same hurdles in parliament.
paras.zh: 周五议会投票失败后下一步的行动很难确定。桑切斯到目前为止已经排除了提前举行选举的可能性。他可以尝试制定另一项紧急法令或多项法令来应对抗议活动，但任何此类举措都需要克服议会中的相同障碍。
